text:
I literally JUST came from my local beauty supply store and bought two packs of 18" Color #27 Remy Clips. When I say a "pack" I mean 2 individual clips in each pack, so a total of 4 INDIVIDUAL clips, not sewn together, or graduated down like this one on Amazon. Literally 4 individual clips I wanted to add to my pony tail for length. Even though this Amazon product says "7 pcs" I think they mean "7 layers" because it actually includes 16 individual pieces sewn into a graduated pattern of 7 rows, just like the picture shows.

So here are some AMAZING things I've already discovered that I think anyone considering this purchase should know:

1. This is a PERFECT color match for me. I HIGHLY recommend finding out if you have a local beauty store that sells this brand, and go COLOR-MATCH it FIRST. I was in between two colors and could have easily gone with either, or even mixed them together for a highlighted look.

2. Amazon's price is amazingly lower than the beauty stores. For the 4 measly individual clip-ons I purchased at the store, I paid a whopping $32.68; but for $24 on AMAZON (with Free Super Saver 2-Day Shipping) you get 16 individual pieces, already sewn together into a full head piece. Pretty amazing savings.

PRICE SAVINGS: If you do the math and divide out the cost of each individual clip, I paid $8.17 per individual clip from the beauty supply store, and only $1.50 per individual clip on Amazon!!! For the EXACT same product! Needless to say, I'm returning these 4 individual extensions tomorrow morning first thing. I've already ordered this 16 piece kit from Amazon tonight, and can't wait to get it on Tuesday. I will update my review then to let you know what I think.

3. These extensions are NOT for full thick hair, or for those of you wanting the full, thick hair look. They are pencil strait, and super silky thin. The four individual clips in my ponytail do look a little "skinny", but they are believable, and my husband is sooooo thrilled (I chopped off all my mid-back length hair after our wedding into a bob, now I'm growing it back out, but its taking an eternity:-).

So, keep that in mind if you don't already have thin hair, or if you are wanting super full extensions. Maybe two sets of these extensions would give you the fullness you want, but for me, it's about believability. I'm not competing for the title of: "Biggest Hair in Texas" any time soon:-)

4. I've worn synthetic extensions as a ponytail before, so I know the difference between real and synthetic. Plus, the proof is in a simple test. Cut a tiny piece of hair and burn it with a match. If it has that distinctive burnt hair smell, then you have the real deal. I mean, it's not like they are giving you 5 pounds of extensions and calling it real hair. It is a reasonable amount of hair to be considered human hair in my opinion. Even if its not human hair, I could care less. For the price, and believability (ESPECIALLY for a girl living in the heart of L.A.:-) its worth every penny to give it a shot.

5. Because its so thin, and presumably, real human hair, you will need to be GENTLE with taking care of it. Brushing through it like its growing out of your head is not smart, it will start falling out of the clips, even though it is sewn into each clip. Use a delicate, tangle free brush and gently brush downward, once, maybe twice. Over brushing will not make it grow like your real hair, so try and avoid this bad habit. I've already caught myself running my fingers through it several times, and did brush it a bunch before reading the packaging and more info from Remy online. The better you take care of it, the longer it will last.

6. For all the negative reviewers out there, if you want a head full of real human hair, that's full and thick and that appeals to your every wish and desire, you're going to pay thousands of dollars for it. Yes, I said thousands. Real hair isn't cheap, (again, the reason why these clips are on the thin side, it's not cheap , and they aren't giving it away for free, so you get the amount of hair you pay for). If you still want huge, full hair without spending tons of money, maybe order the synthetic stuff and see how you like it. Some of it might actually not be so bad. Since I'm not looking for that kind of look, and because I already have pencil straight, thin hair, would rather have this product over anything else while I'm patiently growing out my own real hair:-).

title: Nice package, not so High Fidelity
text:
I hoped for performance similar to the Etymotic musician's earplug products, which I had previously owned and used extensively. In this I was disappointed.

This product has very useful and attractive packaging; the black case with ring can be kept on with keys so you always have these on hand. That is an excellent idea, and does work as the black metal container is small, light, but stout.

The plugs themselves are rather difficult to insert fully. If inserted lightly, they only reduce sounds slightly. If inserted more deeply, which takes some effort -- do so with care -- they do reduce sounds more substantially as desired, but this comes with a pronounced roll off in the high frequencies. So as far as "high fidelity" goes, I cannot endorse these. The level of reduction, subjectively, is about half that of the typical "safety industrial" foam plugs.

For tonally neutral noise level reduction, such as for live music or performance on stage etc., I will be continuing to purchase other products that actually do perform that purpose well.

title: Mixed feelings
text:
I love this company. They have excellent customer service and sincerely care about the performance of their products and the satisfaction of their customers. I want to see this young company succeed. Their weighted heating pad is awesome, so when I saw that they'd added another product to their line-up, I felt very comfortable ordering it.

Let's talk about this heated eye mask. I think the design is great. The mask is extremely comfortable and blocks out light completely. The heating element is creative, with a cord attaching magnetically to the left temple of the mask. I appreciate this feature greatly because the cord crosses my body to get plugged in, and if I was anxious about accidentally getting tangled in the cord I'd never be able to fall asleep. Sometimes I wish that there was an additional option to connect it on the right side, too.
But that's not the only problem. When the mask is operating, the heat is weak even on its hottest setting. Despite the weakness of the heat, there is a chemical smell when the heat is engaged. It is disconcerting. I like the mask without the heat, I really do. If they manufactured one without heat whatsoever, I would still want to use it. I plan to keep an eye on the reviews to see if anyone else mentions the strange chemical smell or if my device is unique.

title: A lot of work to put things together, only OK in the end
text:
I got these small decoration to put around an apartment. There's quite a bit of assembly required. The Happy Halloween banner has to have a cord threaded through each letter (two holes each), the pom-poms are very thin tissue paper that needs to be very carefully separated and rolled and tied, and the white orange and black decorations that need to be carefully teased into balls. It takes a lot of work to do all of this; it has to be slow because the paper's so thin.

The balloons are generally nice. There's one with confetti where the confetti is quite dull and the balloon somewhat milky, so the effect is pretty poor. In any case the confetti just sinks to the bottom of the balloon. One popped and made a mess.

The Mylar balloons are fine. There was no straw or anything to blow them up with it, so that was frustrating. I suppose getting some helium would have made this all easier as it's hard to mount a balloon when it wants to fall down. The smaller ones have long bits sticking out the bottom that look a little random.

Overall it took a few hours to make some mediocre decorations and I didn't really find this worth it.

The caffeine is a nice morning pick-me-up, but I'm not convinced tying the caffeine to a Clif bar is a wise idea. First off, I want to eat two or three and I'd never have that much coffee during the day otherwise. So I'm tempted to have them when I'm hungry even if I don't want the caffeine hit. It is something I have to keep away from the kids also as they are tempted. If I a healthy snack, there are many options, Clif and otherwise. If I want a caffeine hit, I can do it with fewer calories, be it an actual drink of coffee/espresso or some other caffeinated beverage. The times when I want both a snack and a caffeine hit are more rare.

Overall it is a very good product, especially if you have more will power than me and don't have to worry about teens eating four espresso's worth at a time.

title: Lots Of Finger Sticks
text:
As far as women’s health test kits go, I have done another kit very similar that requires blood samples, as well as saliva samples and it test for a few more hormones.
For the price you can get a more inclusive test.

The first blood collection, regardless of your cycle length, needs to be on day 3 to 4 of your menstrual cycle. Day 1 would be the first day of your period so you would need to start collecting blood on day 3 or day 4.

For the second blood collection, If you have a regular cycle which is 21 to 35 days then you collect your blood spot on day 1921 of your menstrual cycle. For short cycles, which is less than 21 days, you collect the blood seven days before your next period. If you have a long cycle, which is 36-40 days, collect blood spots on day 21 or seven days after ovulation.

You do not realize how much blood it takes to fill up 12 circles and you have to fill in the entire circle with blood without touching your finger to the card.

You’re supposed to allow the blood to drip from your finger so expect multiple pricks and a pretty lengthy amount of time in order to fill up this card.

Once you have filled out your form and both sets of what I called blood circles, you do not need to forget to register your kit online because that’s the only way that you’ll get your results.

These kits are a good idea, so I guess you just need to know exactly which hormones you’re looking for and go from there.

title: This style is better than others I have tested.
text:
I received this Ionic Hair Straightener brush for free to test and evaluate.

This is very much like the others that I have tried. There are buttons that adjust the temp, turn it on and toggle between Celsius and Fahrenheit. This brush says that it has "ionic" strength. I cannot verify this.

There are a few differences between this brush and the others I have tested in recent months. This one has the buttons on the back of the handle instead of on the side. One button turns on the ionic function, one button is the temp/on off control. This brush heats up very hot, up to 450 degrees, hot enough to sizzle your hair if you are not careful! The one thing I love about this brush vs the other brushes I have tried is that it does not have the odd little red balls on the ends of the brush tips. This brush has flat and smooth brush "bristles". (No give to them, they are rigid.) They snagged my hair much less.

I have frizzy hair and no matter what I try, ceramic, ionic, metal, etc.. My hair looks the same after each, so if there is some magic to the way "ions" work with my hair, I am not seeing it. I am not using a heat appliance to make my hair healthy. If you notice a difference then this will please you because it has the technology to help your hair.

How does it work? It functions much the same way as a flat iron except this glides through the hair instead of along it. It takes the same amount of time to use this as a flat iron, I didn't notice that it saved any time at all over a flat iron. It still must be used on perfectly dry hair. (That means heat protectant spray needs to dry before using this. Steaming your hair is probably not a great idea, but do as you feel is needed, I am letting my hair dry first.)

It gets my hair smooth and sleek and is as easy to use as the flat iron. It is good for days where the humidity is going to bring out the frizz or when I want to go a day between washes but my hair has frizzed into a bozo look, even in a pony tail. This can tame the frizz in about half an hour if I am combing my hair flat, or in 4 minutes if I have my hair in a pony tail and am taming only that. This style of straightener brush snags less hair during use than the other models I have tested. That is a major bonus.

I am not sure what is easier to use or which one I prefer. I have both the flat iron and this brush sitting there. I alternate between them because I don't have a favorite.

title: Fun starter toy.
text:
I was offered these nipple clamps for free, but declined the code and paid the asking price for them. Why? Because I felt like doing so.

I am going to get the con out of the way first. The chain in the center is not quite long enough, it should be a bit longer so that the center of the chain can be placed in the bottom's mouth to give a bit of an extra tugging sensation if wanted. Nit picking, I know, but it should be a few inches longer.

These are not a high class set of clamps, they are not meant to be, hence the term "beginner". They can be adjusted to make them tighter or looser which is important for those who are just starting out. The clamps can be made moderately tight, true masochists will want them tighter, but for beginners, it is important to start lighter. Too tight can turn a bottom off of nipple play in a hurry if they do not have a good pain tolerance. We call that breaking our toys and it's not a good idea. (It can also get you thrown in jail, play safely and sanely, if both of you are not saying yes, it's no longer consensual. I don't give a darn what they print in books like Shades of Gray. Consent is a MUST, period.)

These have padded rubber on them that helps to alleviate the "bite" or "pinch" somewhat. The tightest is still not as tight as other types of clamps which is good for beginners.

They are an inexpensive set as expected by the price, but still are quite nice and for the amount of use a beginner will be giving them, they will hold up nicely. They are metal but light weight. (Needs to be light weight for beginners or there would be too much of a tug against the nipples.) If heavier clamping/more weight is desired, the person can move up to a better quality set.

One other minor flaw to note is that they are for small nipples, not the nipples found on larger breasts that are larger than a lady's pinky nail. For bigger nipples and a beginner, the clamp must be placed slightly behind so that they do not pinch unmercifully.

title: Several uses in one!
text:
I was offered this product for free. The following is my unbiased review after testing it carefully.

This is a rechargeable unit that can be used without the cord. I find that a bonus as these units eat batteries. On a full charge, this lasted for forty minutes during testing before I noticed a decrease in power. Pack the cord if you travel with it. I did not test standby time.

The callus remover does it's job well. Be sure to apply only gentle pressure, this is sanding off skin. If you use it against healthy skin, you could cause a mild abrasion. I always rinse the sanding wheel after use and allow it to drip dry after blotting off the water. This removes the skin flakes. Obviously, do not use this if you have an infection of any type on your feet or have any problem that causes numbness in your feet. This will slow down if you press too hard, but use your brain, gentle pressure and short sessions. Putting on socks after you slather on lotion can help keep the calluses at bay long term after using this.

The shaver head is perfect for either trimming or shaving. Not quite baby smooth, but very close. It took as much time as a manual razor but no risk of slicing myself. (Real danger for me, I usually press too firmly with the regular razor and have shaved off narrow patches of skin.)

The epilator is a small head. The petite size makes it ideal for small patches, not so great for legs. It is appropriate for under arms, forearms, etc.. The feeling is more intense than waxing. Waxing is a long strip, this is a tiny swath at a time, a few hairs at a time. If you have a low pain tolerance, skip using this head and use the trimmer instead. I like the smoothness left behind, but disliked the time it took. Waxing takes fifteen minutes for both legs. This took twenty minutes for one. The pulling feeling as hair is yanked takes getting used to at first. Try a small spot first on the leg that is less sensitive. Stay on the side or back of your leg at first as this is a less sensitive spot than the fronts of the leg.

Do use common sense, this is not to be used in the tub or near water.

The directions are easily understood and the callus remover + is packaged neatly in an attractive package designed for retail.

title: Love it, comfortable
text:

title: Noise Pollution in the Bedroom Greatly Reduced.
text:
I was able to put this chin strap on without reference to any pictures. All I had to do was adjust the Velcro straps for a comfortable fit. It took one night to get completely comfortable with chin strap. As I've gotten older, I've turned into a notorious snorer. My husband will nudge me, and sometimes I quit snoring or roll over. And, much to my embarrassment, there's even some drool.

With this chin strap, the loud snoring and drooling has been curbed. I'm sure my husband appreciates more peace and quiet. In all truth, I have to say that my body is determined to exhale through my mouth--even with the chin strap on. A burbling sound will erupt every now and then--it even wakes me up--but overall the obnoxious noises from sleeping on my back have quieted down a lot. My husband hasn't been woken up in the last two nights.

If you need any help seeing how it works, just look at the product's pictures on Amazon, and it's pretty clear how it all fits together.

title: Pulsating/Vibrating Belt Massages and Relieves Tension.  Adjustable Levels.
text:
This massage/vibration belt can be programed for up to 40 minutes. 5 thick magnets deliver a strong pulse or vibration that circles you waistline. It can also be used around your shoulder, knees, hips and thighs. Velcro fasteners make the belt quite adjustable.

The designer states that the placement of the magnet creates a strong magnetic field around the body that can increase circulation, tone muscles and help raise the metabolism in the skins and cells of the area covered.

DETAILS:
Belt
- Measures 50"L x 5"W
- Cord is 66" long

CONTROL BOX:
- Measures 3.25"L x 2"W x .75"D
- Buttons for ON/OFF, TIMER, PROGRAM

I can attest that the belt has a pleasant vibrating and pulsing sensation. It is relaxing and helps with tension. If the belt is fastened tightly, the body surface below will get warm...even sweat at times. I placed the belt around my waist with the control box in an upside down position so that I could read the setting.

I have "Metabolism Syndrome" which makes it really hard to me to lose weight (insulin resistant...). This belt did not help me lose weight. I'd monitor my waist measurement, but I bloat up real easily when I eat different foods. So my favorite use is to massage and relax tension in my shoulders and back. It's almost hypnotic to listen and feel the pulsation.

I purchase this belt at a discount in return for a candid and unbiased review based on my personal experience with the device.

title: Potential Benefits But Mostly Water
text: I have read about the potential health benefits of Humic and Fulvic Acids and was interested in finding a supplement that contained them. Trace Minerals appears to be a trusted and well recognized brand that makes high quality supplements so I was interested in this Liquid Gut Health supplement. Fulvic acid has a list of potential benefits ranging from inflammation to immunity to brain function to metabolic health and more. But there is not a lot of great research comparing dosages and offering proper recommendations. This liquid contains only 10mg per serving of 1 tsp. The rest of it is just water. It tastes and looks just like water. And after taking it for over a week, I can't notice any difference. But if you're looking for a pure and tasteless means of supplementing with fulvic and humic acids, this is certainly a worthy option.

title: Nice Alternative to Powder
text: Spirulina is well known as a superfood with many health benefits. I have used spirulina powder in my morning blended protein smoothie for years. The issue with the powder is that it is a very fine dust and can make a mess. The color is a deep blue-green and even just trying to get a scoop of the powder out of the bag can make your hands stained. Luckily, there is a nice alternative thanks to Spira Kind Spirulina Nibs. These nibs make it much easier to scoop out spirulina to add into my smoothie without any mess. Furthermore, you can use the nibs more versatilely such as adding it as a topper on a salad. I like that this product is USDA certified to be organic. I wish the bag was a bit bigger for the price because it doesn't last as long as a typical spirulina powder.

title: Portable Pre Workout Packet
text: I pack my gym bag and take it with me to work and it can sometimes be a pain to pack pre workout. You can either take the entire container or put a few scoops in a container or bag. Also, some preworkout mixes have caffeine which I try to avoid if I am training in the evening. This VivaStix solves both those problems. It packs 5g of BCAAs, 5g glutamine, and some beet root powder along with being naturally sweetened. It tastes great and is very easy to mix into a water bottle. Quick, convenient, and tasty.

title: Great BCAA Drink that is Naturally Sweetened
text: I like using Pre Workouts before going to the gym but sometimes I work out late and do not want any caffeine. BCAAs are a good way to help my workouts or recovery and are easy to digest. Unfortunately, many products are filled with artificial chemicals, flavors, colors, and sweeteners. I was very pleased to find this amino acid blend by Inno Supps. The ingredients are excellent since it is sweetened with monk fruit, stevia, and some erythritol. I also love that it not only contains BCAAs, but also other essential amino acids and glutamine, therefore making it a more complete protein. I found the taste to be very flavorful and yummy. Definitely recommend it!

title: One of the Best Natural Preworkouts Out There
text: I am an avid weightlifter and have used dozens of different preworkout products over the years. Unfortunately, there is often a dichotomy between high quality ingredients and purity. Many preworkouts are either filled with artificial colors and sweeteners or are extremely weak in their dosage. I have used some potent preworkouts that I love, but do not feel comfortable drinking them on a daily basis if they are filled with chemicals. On the otherhand, many natural preworkouts are so weak in their potency that I do not get much of a benefit from them in the gym. This natural preworkout from Tattle is the best of both worlds. First, it is completely pure thanks to being sweetened with natural monk fruit and colored with purple carrot juice. Then, the potency is on point - 6g of bloodflow-boosting citrulline, 2.5g of betaine, caffeine and huperzine for energy and focus, and the added benefit of nootropics, like Lions Mane & Rhodiola. Taste is great and my workouts have been excellent. Definitely recommended!

title: Pure Greens Powder
text: I like to add a scoop of greens powder into my protein smoothies each day and typically purchase a powder that contains a blend of different greens and other nutrients. Unfortunately, some products have a lot of fillers and only small amounts of the beneficial ingredients. This Organic Wheatgrass Juice Powder is nice because you know each scoop is getting 100% wheatgrass powder that is high quality and organic. You can smell and see the freshness. The taste is certainly mild and tolerable, especially if mixed with other ingredients. The cost is a bit high, but for the amount of servings in the bag, there is decent value. I have not had any digestion issues with it and have noticed improved energy levels overall.

title: Nice, Multifunctional TENS and EMS Unit
text: TENS units have some clinically proven benefits in terms of muscle recovery and pain relief so this Dual Channel unit that also had EMS capabilities definitely appealed to me. The package is compact and somewhat bland on the outside, but inside you will find a nice assortment of pads in addition to the wires and charger as well as a manual and carrying case. As other reviewers have stated, the manual is well-written and easy to understand which is great. I like the fact that it is a rechargeable lithium ion so you do not need to keep replacing batteries. The device is easy to set up and has several different modes. I must say, it is very powerful! Even at the lowest setting, it can be intense on certain muscles. For example, even the lowest power setting on my forearm causes my fingers to fully flex and contract. On larger muscle groups, the higher settings may be more suitable, but certainly start low and assess your tolerance. I enjoyed the different modes and think that each has its potential benefit depending on your goal of pain relief versus muscle strengthening versus massage and recovery.

title: Works Great, Smells Bad
text:
I have been in the process of growing out my hair, and have been taking this for a couple weeks now to see just how it would work for me. First, let me just say yes it does work! I have really been wanting to grow my bangs out, and in the time period since taking these, My bangs went from hitting at the bridge of my nose and now as I write this, they are down to the tip of my nose, a little over an inch.

Because this does grow hair, it truly grows it everywhere. I have also noticed other body hair growing quite faster than normal. I have to pluck my eye brows more, and have to shave my legs more frequently as well. So just be aware that this does target hair growth... all hair.

These are very easy to take, about the size of a normal vitamin pill. However the only thing that might be a bit off putting is the smell. I won't sugar coat it, they stink! If you are someone who is affected by the taste of a pill, then you might have some difficulty with this. However if you can just get them down and swallow them, you are good to go. I have not experienced any after tastes.

I am still currently taking these, and I am enjoying the results that so far I have been given!

title: So far much better than the popular name brands
text:
I’m always on the look out for a good body groomer / trimmer as they usually only last a couple years for
me and the newer ones are failing quicker.

First impressions on this trimmer are as good as I could’ve hoped for: Trimmed great with no nicks. The light is fantastic! This is my first trimmer with a light and it makes me wonder why more don’t have it! The trimmer itself is very comfortable to hold and feels very nicely made - definitely not cheap like the one blade! USB-C charging is incredibly nice to have. Especially for travel! That made me nervous about using it in the shower, but it is marked for shower use and is IP rated. So far it’s working great in there!

It did include an extra steel & ceramic blade which is nice just in case along with various accessories. The stand is junk, but doesn’t affect me - I just leave it in the shower most of the time anyway. The bag is junk too, but I feel the same about it as I do the stand.

Really, the trimmer itself is what shines here and that’s the important part. It cuts well, it feels well made, it’s very comfortable to work with, and it has a light! I do have a bodygroom that I rebuilt and have used as my clipper for a while and, personally, I prefer this one to it. I had previously tried the oneblade and that one stunk in my opinion. If you’ve been struggling to find a great groomer, you can’t beat the build and features this one offers for the price! Honestly I can’t recommend it enough!

title: NOT pure whey "isolate" it's a BLEND! Shame on U!
text:
I am surprised no one before me said anything, but PULEEZ folks...this is NOT pure whey isolate!!!

I usually purchase my pure whey isolate from Nutrition Express...and it IS pure 100% isolate...you can see the difference in color immediately. Pure isolate is almost white and very feathery, light powder.

This stuff that I bought, thinking it was ISOLATE as they advertised, is yellow in color and the label says it's a blend of whey concentrate AND isolate.

So, it's FALSE and misleading advertising to call it whey isolate!

Shame on Amazon!!!! And, certainly a black mark on the honesty of the Elite brand.

There's a BIG difference between the Nutrition Express 100% isolate, which I LOVE, and this blended whey product.

I've been using whey for 5 years as my primary source of protein, and this Elite powder is full of bells and whistles (extra flavoring, artificial flavorings, extra sweet)...but when it comes down to the most important part...the isolate...they're scamming the consumers by their false advertising and selling you cheaper CONCENTRATE instead of 100% isolate.

text:

It is a clear refreshingly scented gel that is a little thicker than an average aloe vera gel, and it is absorbed quickly after massaging on the foot for a few seconds.
It thinly hydrates the skin, and the gel doesn't stay on the skin long as compared to other foot creams or butter which takes a little while for the oil to settle.
If you put this treatment on before bedtime, it provides light hydration without staining the bedsheet.
For minor skin dryness and thin callous (newly developed callous), this works and the skin feels better and a bit softer.
For more serious issues like cracked skin, this gel somewhat softens the area a bit, but the hydration does not last and is not as effective as I hope.

title: Love this product
text:
I’m a flight attendant and with all of that extra time spent at high altitudes in dry air combined with jumping time zones and erratic hours, we have to take extra care of ourselves to compensate. I worked with a fellow fly girl months ago who used collagen powder mixed into her water, and she found it made a difference, but the method of consumption was a turnoff for me. This is perfect.

Nearly two weeks of consistent use and I feel like my nails are thicker, hair is fuller, and I’m hardly breaking out compared to before. Really love what it’s done for my skin the most - it’s clearer and has more of a “glow”, but not in an oily way. I’ve taken biotin pills before, but I think these do more. I did a little more research this time and learned that we already ingest biotin in the food we eat, but it’s not the same with collagen. Collagen also is great for your cartilage, which means less joint pain - an added bonus.

I was attracted to this brand while looking on Amazon because I noticed there are 120 capsules and the serving size is 3. Some similarly priced products on here have only 90 capsules with a serving size of 3. While there are still a few similar products with the same count, the packaging is much more sleek with this brand than all of the other options, hands down. It’s a modern design I don’t mind keeping on my nightstand.

title: Saffron, Be Natural.
text:
I knew about this product by chance as I was looking for Spanish and/or Persian saffron to use with my coffee and some kinds of food recipes. Honestly, I started searching about health facts of saffron extract medicine just after knowing about and receiving this product. I found myself immersed in reading and searching about new topics almost everyday. What really fascinated me about this product at first is the health benefits of saffron, which I am in dire need for. Saffron can be beneficial for mood disorders and depression, many studies state so. In my review, I will first surface the available info about saffron's extract; then, I will extract the main conclusions from credible research papers.

I have reviewed research papers and summarized the main points about and benefits of saffron's extract for a reason. Besides sharing what found amazon readers, I needed to know more about saffron's extract and its benefits to health since it might be the perfect natural choice to treat the symptoms of depression that I have been suffering from in the past several months. And, I wanted to know if there are certain things that I need to be aware of when purchasing a product of saffron's extract.

Anyhow, I've read some information about saffron extract that discuss the growth of scientific evidence in which saffron's extract provides several health benefits including weight loss and treating depression. The study states,

Saffron is best known as a weight loss aid because it reduces your appetite and the craving for a lot of food,
and it works by increasing the serotonin level in your brain. Serotonin is the chemical in your brain
responsible for regulating mood and eating, so by increasing the chemical level, you’ll no longer feel the urge
to overeat (Aleo Nutrition, n.d.)

According to a study that was accomplished in 2010 where a large group of 60 overweight women "took a saffron supplement every day for eight weeks, while another group took only placebo, also for eight weeks. During the test period both groups’ calorie intake were not regulated, but at the end of the period, those who took the saffron extract lost more weight and found their urge to snack had been reduced" (ibid)

Saffron's extract has been found to be as natural antidepressant where a " recent study was done involving 40 adults suffering from depression, with one group given saffron supplements and another placebo for six weeks. After six weeks, those who took the saffron extract reported a significant change in their condition for the better, while those in the placebo group reported nothing significant" (ibid, n.d.).

A growing trend of credible academic and/or scientific sources investigates Saffron's extract in relation to health benefits. In a scientific study that was recently published back in 2013, the article "Protective effect of saffron extract against doxorubicin cardiotoxicity in isolated rabbit heart" that was accomplished by Chahine, N., et al, the authors concluded, "Saffron perfused during electrolysis helps trap ROS and significantly improves myocardial function; however, saffron was less effective against Doxorubicin, thus suggesting that mechanisms other than oxidative stress underlie Doxo cardiotoxicity." (Please see the picture of the abstract of this study below). This study has scientifically investigated and proved the positive effects of saffron against doxorubicin cardiotoxicity in isolated rabbit heart. * Doxorubicin is a bacterial antibiotic that is widely used to treat leukemia and various other forms of cancer.

** I found a great article that synthesizes the major findings of health benefits with regard to saffron's extract. The article "Saffron: THE SALUBRIOUS SPICE," written by Woolven, Linda, Snider, Ted, and HerbalGram in 2016, discussed Saffron's extract in relation/as an aid to
a) Alzheimer's Disease and cognition decline
b) Depression
c) Reproductive Health (sub-hidings)
1. Sexual dysfunction induced by fluoxetine
2. Sexual dysfunction not caused by antidepressant drugs.
3. Men suffering from ED and lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) due to benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH).
4. Other aspects of reproductive health such as saffron's efficacy for menstrual conditions.
d) Eye-health
E) Weight Loss

You may want to search for "Crocus sativus," the scientific name of saffron if you are interested in further research on Saffron's health benefits. To conclude my review, the rating I gave to this product is based on the product's description in which it is natural and has no preservatives; the encouraging findings of saffron's extract. In other words, it is the healthy choice that I am looking for to treat depression and mood disorder. Remember to follow the direction written on the bottle. Disclaimer, I received the product for free.

title: Pleasant, cheap gift.
text:
I’ve found these at the Dollar Tree. This was one of the cheap rewards for the ol home “treasure box” to entice my kids to get their homework done.
My 8 yr old son picked this out and when he finally got to use it he was thrilled by how long it took to dissolve which made it a cool navy/deep purple color and the smell was sweetly pleasant but not overly done. That medium sized bathroom really smelled of sherbet, but not strong smelling down the hallway.
Now he didn’t come out smelling as strong as the fragrance but his skin was somewhat softer, however the water was definitely soft and silky (he was only in for about 12-15min with no other soaps used, for we shower before bathing).

Overall this would make a nice cheap gift that will surely please. It’s not at all a luxury item, and I bet these Amazon sellers are making four to five dollars profit per sell, is it still worth the price of six and change (as of 8/2020)? Yea, sure why not, but you maybe able to find this treasure elsewhere.

As far the other reviews casting a negative light on this product.
1st- Keep a clean tub and you shouldn’t have staining.
If your tub has a build up of soap residue from bathing products, or your tub enamel is scuffed/worn, then yea you might get a ring around the tub.

2nd-One person’s perception of how strong or weak a fragrance is different from person to person. What I can tell you is the bath bomb does have a sweet smell (advertised as sherbet), but my nose didn’t detect any note resembling citrus essential oils. The smell I would describe as a manufactured take on sherbet.

title: I bought this because I heard it might help with ...
text:
I bought this because I heard it might help with my IBS-C, and since I have abdominal pain on a daily basis I got the gelatinized powder because it is suppose to be easier on my stomach... after a couple months of use I did not see any changes with my symptoms, and starting getting increasing stomach pain so I stopped taking it.

For those looking for help with IBS-C, here are some things that have helped me:

Drink 8-16 ounces coconut water every day, helps keep body hydrated more effectively than just plain water

Replace breads and pasta with sprouted grain products (Alvarado Street Bakery has frozen sprouted wheat bagels that are the easiest on my stomach... both in terms of pain and keeping things moving)

Replace gummies/candy/ice cream with a toasted bagel with high quality fruit jelly or natural PB with maple syrup. High quality fruit sorbets absorb much easier than frozen ice cream.

Prescript Assist probiotics have helped, but avoid taking everyday as too many can block me up!

Avoid preservatives/chemicals in food as much as possible, including maltodextrin (in powdered stevia), and carageenan (in nut milk), no gum

Slow cooked chicken thighs, using as little liquid as possible, cooking for 6 hours to break down joint cartilege

Eating only snacks at work (to avoid stomach pain when I have to be on my feet). Eat a large meal when you are home after work

Bath 2 times a day to relax stomach muscles

Avoid dairy, except Kefir probiotic drink. Drink lots of hot chocolate... high quality cocoa in hot water with natural sucanant sugar.

When all else fails.... invest in an enema bag/bucket and do a warm water enema. It is relaxing and provides immediate relief.

title: It's dangerous to go alone! Take this.... Nerdwax review!!!
text: This poindexter's pine tar is not the mcguffin of four eye fusion.... But it delays a very small, very irritating, and forever unceasing fact of nerd life.... Gravity sucks, almost as much as Star Wars Episode 1!!! I've utilized this spectacle stickum for a few days now. For context, I'm a barber and hobbyist dart thrower; and in both, obsessing about my glasses falling down is a massive minute by minute speed bump in life. This is not High IQ nose glue, and this will not completely defeat the incessant fight with gravity; it's more like chapstick for Mensa Initiates!! It lasts anywhere between 3 and 5 hours with a liberal dab on the notepads; we are talking about an application reminiscent to Jabba The Hut's slime trail, not making them look like Ray Stantz circa Ghostbusters 2. Your eyewear is secured with the integrity of a Macgyver invention; meaning they can still slide but this buys you precious time between adjustments. Yes, you still need to apply the same amount of focus in application as Carl Spackler in Caddyshack or you'll wince while losing precious minutes scrubbing your lenses clean, but it's worth it!! The fact that I haven't readjusted my glasses once since I started writing this review hasn't been lost on me; I've spent that time nerding out on ways of shoehorning nerdiness into this review! It's not perfect but it works well enough that I'll carry it as edc!!! Like Bixby Snyder says in Robocop, "I'd buy that for a dollar"!!! In this case it's $10 but you get the point!!

title: One of two defective, promptly replaced. Works great. Recommended!
text:
I ordered two of these batteries. The price was great. Unfortunately, when I received them, one battery would not hold the initial charge. The other battery has performed well. The battery charger for my camera emits a green light when the battery is being charged, which does not go out until the battery is fully charged; however, the light in the defective battery went out right away. Thinking the electrical outlet might be the problem, I switched outlets; same result.

When I e-mailed Amazon with my concerns, I got an almost immediate message from the vendor telling me they were sorry for the inconvenience and that a replacement for the defective battery would be mailed the next business day. It arrived soon after and it works great. Both batteries are functionally the same as the OEM batteries, though their appearance is a little different.

Some other reviews have commented about the battery fitting a little more snugly inside the camera than the OEM, but I didn't notice any difference between these batteries and the original Panasonic battery.

The important question is: would I order these again, considering the initial problem I had in receiving one defective battery? Absolutely! The fact that the replacement was sent out promptly, and it works perfectly, has earned my respect and my future business.

title: Fit perfectly & extremely soft. Just what I needed!
text:
I needed some sort of gloves. I started out searching for medical type gloves that were disposable. After some research I decided no that's not it. I really need a good soft glove that I could wash and reuse so I started researching cotton gloves. I found MANY different brands and types of cotton gloves. What I need them for helped narrow the search, as well as read hundreds of reviews on several brands. Sizing was important also, as I have a bit larger hand (I think). In medical gloves, depending on manufacturer - I can fit a medium or if they run tight, I grab a large size.

I live in the Midwest and this winter has been fierce to say the least! My fingertips and cuticles are EXTREMELY dry and I find myself picking at them as they catch on clothing, etc. Plus, they are also so very tender to the touch. So, that helped narrow down my search. I found a few that looked great, but the reviews were mixed. I needed a slightly fitted glove, not tight, but not too large where they would fall off. I finally found these - Madholly Moisturizing Cotton White Gloves. I'm not sure about the "moisturizing" part as there isn't anything inside of them i.e. silicone or gel that would enhance using a cream product on the hands and place the gloves on and wear to bed - which is what I was looking for. I took a chance and bought them. They are reasonably priced and I could have them delivered quickly. I first tried using cuticle cream the first night. No change. I then tried Aveeno moisturizing cream for extra dry skin and that didn't make a difference either. Last night I decided to go back to basics and used petroleum jelly and I packed it on my fingertips, rubbing each finger nail and cuticle with it working it in and placed the gloves on and went to sleep. I woke up a bit pleased. They feel a bit better. I'm going to do it again tonight and continue this night time ritual, in hopes my fingers will be healed!

As for these wonderful cotton gloves? They are made of a really nice cotton and fit pretty well! Seeing the words "Hand SPA Gloves" also in the title, I thought immediately of paraffin wax, as that was the route I was going to try next. I'm sticking this out, as I think with consistency and time my fingers will be healed and I will save myself some money.

I highly recommend Madholly for their soft cotton gloves,100%!

My heels were so bad, they were wearing holes in my socks in just a few wearings. Admittedly, I was a little hesitant but now I wish I had had one of these all along. I have suffered with the thick, rhino skin and the cracking on my feet to the point of not being able to walk without pain.This little device is great!! It took the dry callused skin right off and all I had to do was sit there. It was almost too easy.

A word of advice to anyone who has not been happy with theirs...
#1 BE PATIENT. The calluses didn't just appear overnight, they are not going to come off all at once and you don't want to make your feet sore. If your calluses are really thick, it might take a couple of sessions.
#2 Don't press too hard. Yes the head stops when you push too hard. It is for your skin; it's supposed to be gentle, it's not going to work like a belt sander. You're not sanding a piece of oak.
#3 Don't use it immediately after bathing - your skin is too soft. Your feet should be clean but TOTALLY dry.
#4 After use, wipe down your feet with a warm damp cloth, gently apply some GOOD lotion and slip on a pair of clean soft socks.
#5 Order one of these, use it and love your feet again. You won't be disappointed!!!

title: They work - but not as well as I hoped.
text:
I am a college student taking classes at Harvard. The chairs in the library don't have cushions or the cushions have gone flat. This makes studying for long periods of time difficult /painful.

So instead of going to the library to study, I purchased new chairs, but after a few months the cushions and the chairs had gone flat. This was frustrating and I got tired of purchasing new chairs, so I decided to purchase cushions as a more cost-effective approach to purchasing new chairs.

I wanted a cushion that would allow me to study for 14 hours a day. Not knowing which cushions to purchase and not wanting to spend time trying out a bunch of different cushions I decided to try out a dozen or so different cushions, all of which had an average rating above four. I called Amazon to see if they would have a problem with me purchasing a bunch of items and then returning them as well as to make sure that my Amazon prime account would not get canceled.

Below is a list of the cushions that I purchased and the experience I had.

1.) CONFORMAX Anywhere, Anytime Gel Car/Truck Seat Cushion
This was the most comfortable cushion of all of the questions that I tried and the one I would recommend the most. I am able to sit for an entire day without my rear end or back getting sore. I previously had to take two Aleve before using this cushion to be able to sit down and study for an entire day. It has a layer of high density foam and a very thick gel which provides a great deal of support without going flat, even if you are a big guy. I am 6 feet tall and about 210 pounds and even at the end of the day, it is just as soft as when you first sit on the cushion.

A couple of other things, this is a large cushion and covers the entire seat which allows you to move around your seats comfortably. The top side of the cushion is a foamy type of cloth, and the bottom side of the cushion has a rubber-ish type of cover to keep it from sliding around on the chair.

The only downside is that it is a large cushion that is also kind of heavy, so it is not a cushion that can be carried around or is transportable.

2.) CONFORMAX "On the Go" Gel Travel Seat Cushion
This was the second most comfortable cushion. I bought the ConforMax “On The Go Gel” cushion because the ConforMax Anywhere cushion was too big to carry around so I got them both. The ConforMax “On The Go” cushion provides the same amount of support as the “ConforMax Anywhere” cushion but is portable due to its smaller size. While it is still too large for me to get inside my backpack, I am able to get it inside my duffel bag/gym bag and take it with me without any difficulty to the computer lab or library. It would also fit inside a large briefcase or a small suitcase.

The ConforMax “On The Go” cushion also allows me to sit for up to 14 hours a day at the library without my posterior or my back getting sore. The only down side is that, because it is smaller due to it being portable, it does not cover the chair completely, so you can not move around as much on a chair.

If you want a cushion that is portable, this is the best cushion.

3.) Nova Ortho Gel Foam Cushion for 18 Inches X 16 Inches Wheelchair, Medium, 3 Inch, Black
After the ConforMax cushions, this was the next most comfortable cushion. The Nova Ortho Gel Foam Cushion has a layer of gel encased in a layer of high density foam.

During the time that I used it, the cushion did not go flat, and provided a great deal of support. By posterior or back did not get sore and I was able to study for 14 hours a day, only getting up to eat or use the restroom.

The cushion really is not portable do to it’s size, but I was able to slightly fold it and get it into my duffle bag so I could take it with me to the library /computer lab at the university.

Overall, I was really happy with the Nova Ortho Gel Foam Cushion and would highly recommend it Especially for folks on the heavier side since it did not flatten out when I used it. I am giving this product a five star rating. With that said, I ended up returning this item. The reason for that it is, the ConforMax cushions were more comfortable.

It should be noted that the ConforMax cushions cost $20 to $25 more than the Nova Ortho Gel Foam Cushion, so if you are on a budget or do not want to spend as much money on the Comformax cushions, this is the next best cushion and the best cushion under $40 that I tried.

4.) Drive Medical Deluxe Skin Protection Gel "E" 3" Wheelchair Seat Cushion, Dark Blue, 18" x 16" 3"

This cushion also provided good level of support and kept my posterior and back from getting sore. The cushion also did not flatten out during the time that I used it. I was able to hold this cushion, put it in my duffle bag and take it with me to the library, but it should be noted I only used it for two days before I returned it.

While the Drive Gel Seat Cushion provided a good level of support, I did not find it comfortable. The reason for that is because the gel is liquidy and moves /slouches around. You get the same type of feeling you get when you sit on a waterbed. I would recommend this product, but with reservations. You are better off with the either of the Comformax cushions ($30 more) and if you are on a budget, the Nova Ortho Gel Foam Cushion ($11 more).

5.) WonderGel Extreme Seat Cushion

I tried three different Wondergel cushions, and they all work, but not as well as I would like them to. For reference purposes, the other five star reviews are accurate. These cushions work and will not go flat. I was able to sit and study for 14 hours per day, only having to get up to eat or use the restroom. With that said, while I was able to study for 14 hours per day and my back did not get sore, but my posterior did get a little sore after sitting for a couple of hours and moderately sore after sitting for 14 hours.

I think the problem was my size. I am 6’ and 210 pounds. My weight just pushed into the walls of the cushion after sitting for a few hours, and I got the same feeling that you get when you have a sock that is bunched up underneath your foot when you are walking.

Of the three Wondergel cushions I tried, this one was the most comfortable for me.

With that said, I returned these cushions after a week. I found the two Comformax cushions and the Nova Ortho Gel Foam Cushion more comfortable and the the Comformax cushions were a little bit cheaper.

One side note – out of all of the large cushions, I found this cushion the easiest to carry around because it folded easily and I could easily get it into my duffle bag.

6.) Wondergel Doublegel Gel Seat Cushion NEW Model - 2"

Please see the review of the WonderGel Extreme Seat Cushion.

This is very similar to the WonderGel Extreme seat cushion but with more gel cushioning. Dispite the extra thickness, I still found the WonderGel Extreme more comfortable.

7.) Wondergel Roll & Go - Gel Seat Cushion

Please see the review of the WonderGel Extreme Seat Cushion. This is similar to the WonderGel extreme, but has a smaller footprint and is not as thick, so it is easier to carry around.

This cushion significantly reduces the amount of pain you would experience if you did not have this cushion and it did allow me to study up to 14 hours a day, but my posterior was sore at the end of the day.

This was the only cushion I could fit into my backpack and did not have to put it in my duffle bag. I was barely able to squeeze it into the laptop section of my backpack. If you are a student and want something that can fit into your backpack, this is your best option.

As previously mentioned, while the cushion significantly reduces the pain and soreness on your posterior, my posterior was still sore at the end of the day. It just reduced the soreness enough for me to be functional all day.

After a few days, I ended up returning the Wondergel Roll & Go and just decided to lug around the CONFORMAX "On the Go" in my duffle bag. This was despite a higher level on inconvenience of lugging around the CONFORMAX "On the Go" in a duffle bag versus of greater level of convenience of carrying around the Wondergel Roll & Go in my backpack.

8.) Duro-Med Polyfoam Wheelchair Cushion, Poly/Cotton Cover, Navy, 3 Inch x 16 Inch x 18 Inch
Despite the large number of 5 star reviews from other reviewers, I found this item to be junk and would not recommend this item at all. After sitting on this cushion for 30 minutes, the cushion went flat. I can not recommend the Duro-Med Polyfoam Wheelchair Cushion.

Summary:
The Wondergel cushions work, but I found the Comformax cushions to do the best job of keeping my back and posterior pain-free. If you are on a budget, the Nova Ortho Gel Foam Cushion is the next best cushion and the best cushion for the price.

title: Great replacement for a Garmin strap
text:
I've gone through about 3 Garmin straps and one Motoactv strap. I end up changing the batteries in each about every 6 months. The straps seem to last about a year--there's a point where even after changing the battery, the strap is worn out to the point where it doesn't read my HR consistently and I'll see drops or spikes.

I ordered this one and snapped one of my Garmin transmitters on. It's the one that came with the soft strap and it fits perfectly. I'm 5'1" and about 108 lbs and I ordered the XS/S. It looked tiny but adjusts to fit me well. I find it relatively comfortable also--the Motoactv strap had the metal piece to adjust it on the left side and it always dug into me. This one has that piece but somehow its placement works better for me.

I've been using it for a couple of weeks now. My Motoactv watch picks up the signal much faster with this strap than it did with any of the others. The HR data is good--no spikes or drops--and it works consistently well thus far. I'm assuming I'll have to change the transmitter battery in 6 months like always, and if this strap lasts a year like the others, I'll be happy, especially considering how much cheaper it is. I will update the post once I know how long it lasts.

title: Great Supplement but difficult to swallow
text: This is a great product and I highly recommend this brand if you are needing a supplement for bone health.  I personally take this supplement because I went into early menopause in my twenties, an unexpected event for my age so this was neglected and therefore I ended up with osteoporosis by the time I was 30. I cannot state whether it has improved my bone health as of yet, but I can tell you it is a well-rounded supplement.  On a positive note, it includes both 1000mg of Calcium and 400IU of Vitamin D-3 per serving.  Additionally it includes 500mg of Magnesium among other nutrients, which as an added bonus, has helped my sleep tremendously.  On the down side, it is a rather large tablet for me to swallow and I sometimes struggle greatly to get the tablet all the way down.  I would not recommend it for an elderly person or someone at a higher risk of choking, which is why I removed one star.  I would much rather take multiple smaller tablets throughout the day than struggle to get down two much larger ones.  I think this is a huge downfall for the brand because this type of supplement is generally beneficial for the older generations which may not be able to swallow them safely.  I remember this product being in a liquid form at one time but I was unable to order that particular kind and so I resorted to this tablet form instead.  I also wish the product did not contain magnesium stearate but it is quite difficult to find a supplement that hits every point on your wish list these days.

title: Good lamp, poor assembly
text:
I like Verilux products, and I have three of them in my office. This lamp replaced a much earlier version of the same product (my original didn't have a grid over the bulb, an excellent feature on the current generation of Verilux products.) But I have to say that the assembly is beyond awful. Two tiny screws are provided, neither of which would fit into the requisite hole. I replaced the one at the gooseneck with a small screw intended to hold a light switch cover, but I only had one of those, so I just skipped the one intended to hold the upright to the base, with the result that it comes apart if somebody picks it up to move it, very annoying.

I suppose these things are built in a slave-labor factory belonging to the People's Liberation Army, and that mine was built by someone with a particular animus toward Chairman Mao. You may have better luck. But don't do what I did, and get rid of the packaging before you put it together. You may want to return it.

Later: I've now thrown it out, having picked it up once too often and had the base fall off. I have accordingly dropped it down one star's worth. Never again, Verilux!

title: it is amazing that you get two for such a low price
text:
Is a loofah a loofah? NO IT ISN'T. THIS LOOFAH WILL CHANGE YOUR LIFE.

*THE GOOD*
1. There's two of them in the package. You know, for more loofahing. But seriously, it is amazing that you get two for such a low price.
2. There's a little hook for it to dry off after you're done using it! It might be really simple, but hey no more leaving your loofah soaking wet only to find it still soaked the next day.
3. It feels so good on your skin. You can feel all the little nasty dead skin particles scrubbing off of you. You feel so new, so clean afterwards.
4. There's an elastic band on the back for your hand. It helps to make sure it doesn't slip when you're using it in the shower.

*THE NOT SO GOOD*
1. It can be a little bit too abrasive once you get it. Although after a shower or two it did soften up, it can irritate really sensitive skin.
2. It tends to get a little bit gross looking after a while, since it is white. After a few showers, my loofah is no longer white, but grayish.
3. The back can get slippery, so it gets hard to hold even with the elastic band.

*SHOULD YOU BUY IT?*
Honestly, there's no better deal in my opinion. You get two great loofahs that work great, and leave you feeling clean. And even if it's not for you, you can still use it to scrub the floors, the sink, the toilet! But in all honesty, yes you should buy this.

title: My skin has NEVER been this smooth.
text:
I've been showering wrong all my life...because I wasn't using these sponges.

I've always had annoying little dots on my skin, particularly legs and upper arms (I've often heard of it called "chicken skin"). I've been told it's ingrown hairs, body acne, etc. (and I believed each of these theories at one point or another). However, I had this even when I was a kid and didn't have any acne at all, so it just wasn't adding up. And regardless of what you call it, it's still frustrating/embarrassing when someone notices it, or worse, points it out when you're wearing a sleeveless top. I'd tried a few things in the past such as body scrubs and oils, and those exfoliating gloves. None of them had any considerable effect, which is why (up to this point) I'd just resigned myself to the fact that I would always have this "ingrown hair"/chicken skin appearance. Until recently, when someone pointed out to me that I had bumps on my arms (like I wasn't aware) and I decided I'd had enough.

Completely fed up, I scoured the internet. Surprisingly, unlike previous searches that had left me frustrated and without an answer, I discovered rather quickly that my skin looks suspiciously similar to a condition called Keratosis Pilaris. It can look like ingrown hairs or little bumps (hence the "chicken skin" comparison...if you have this then you know what I mean). In the past, I've used washcloths, exfoliator gloves, and those round, brightly-colored bath poufs, but none of them really did anything other than get me clean (which, to be fair, is all I had previously expected from any kind of bath sponge).

Folks. When I say this left me squeaky clean, I mean I probably would have HEARD the squeaking if I'd turned off the water to listen for it. I used it with the Nubian Heritage Coconut and Papaya bar soap, which is good in its own right, but I don't think the soap was the magic bullet here. I say that because at one point I was scrubbing and just kept going for a couple seconds without realizing that I needed to lather up my sponge again, and it had STILL left behind that squeaky clean feeling even without any soap in it! I followed it up with Organic Fiji Sugar Polish and my skin was GLOWING. I've never seen my skin like this. EVER.

I NEVER write reviews, but with this product I absolutely had to (as I will for the two other products that really transformed my skin, Organic Fiji sugar scrub and AmLactin 12% Moisturizing Lotion). I wish I had taken a "before" picture so I could show the drastic difference side-by-side with the "after." It's ridiculous that I've been frustrated with this issue all my life...and then this very ordinary-looking sponge literally made a difference with ONE SHOWER. After about 3 or 4 showers, my skin was even smoother. I've been using it for about a week and a half, not wanting to write a review right away because it just kept getting better and better and I wanted to see how much it would improve. A week and a half later, and I STILL catch myself from time to time just rubbing my skin in disbelief and feeling the smoothness. Again, the sugar scrub and Amlactin lotion also have worked wonders for my skin, so I can't say how much of the improvement is due to the sponge alone vs. the combination...but I have zero intention of discontinuing any of them just to find out. Preemptive apology if you go to purchase these and they're out of stock after I've bought my lifetime supply. :)

title: OK, but not for me.
text:
I've been wet shaving with other badger brushes and a DE razor for a while now. I decided to buy a few badger brushes that I could give to my sons as they got older. This was one of the three brushes and it was the most disappointing. I was interested since it was made out of pure black badger and I've never heard of it before.

When I ran it under a stream of hot water the water turned black as if the black badger was dyed. It also had a rather strong odor - the odor can be common in badger brushes and usually goes away after a few uses. I used it and it did work up a decent lather. However, several of the bristles fell out. Then, after rinsing it off, the middle of the brush looked tangled and matted. I had to use a comb to straighten them out and then hung it to dry. I figured it was it's first use and maybe it would be OK.

The next time I tried it the water didn't turn black and the odor was lessened, but still stronger than my other brushes. More of the bristles fell out and the middle became tangled as it did the first time. I've only had one other brush tangle in the middle and that only happened the first time I used it.

Overall I'm disappointed, but I gave it three stars due to the price being so low and it does create a decent lather. The other two brushes I bought were also cheaper, so there are some decent quality (and cheap) badger brushes available.

So for the black non stick coating on the blade I found that this was a false and most likely the down fall of my review, well I was chopping onions I found they stuck to the blade more then if I used a none coated knife. And then I had a intersting experience well cutting slices of cheese from a 5 pound loaf. This knife was horrible for this task, I found that more force was needed to cut down on the cheese with more effort of trying to get a uniformed cut. The black coating acted more like glue and in the end of a cut you could see the smearing of cheese on the side of the knife. In the end I had to resort to using a older knife to finish cutting cheese.... Now sure some could say " but that's not a proper cheese knife or the wrong tool for the job ". Well sure but this is my kitchen.
But before I go further I've only had this knife a few days and a longer time frame with something of this nature is needed. Yes it's sharp this week but how about a month from now? Not everyone has a knife sharpener nor even want to bother with the task of sharpening.
Custom blend of materials for this knife to keep a sharper edge? I thought the forging process was just as important for a sharp knife. Yes it sounds great on paper but again this comes down to time and trial.
I'll be happy to revisit and refresh this review after a little more time.

title: Work's great, look's great, and can't complain for the price!
text:
After reading through some of the other reviews, especially the negative ones I felt the need to write my own.

1) In regards to this breaking: It's literally a piece of glass maybe that's as thick as 3 quarters stacked together; so of course if you hit it against a wall or cabinet it's going to shatter. Don't blame it on the manufacture or product, it's not like it broke itself, and as a buyer you should know that your purchasing a fragile product if it's made out of glass.

2) In regards to the complaints about this scale being inaccurate, there's two things I'd like to address here:
2a) I see some people complaining about the scale being inaccurate, yet they are weighing themselves on carpet/soft surfaces. At-home digital do not work on carpet. Over the past 10 years I've owned 3 different scales, and every single one of them has always said the same thing in the instructions: place on a hard surface. Nothing has changed since then. You're weight is not evenly distributed onto the scale when placed on a carpet, since the softness of it will absorb and distribute the weight your putting on it, as opposed to your weight being distributed to the weighing-mechanisms inside the scale.
2b) This is an $8 scale, and people are giving it 1 star reviews for being 1-2 pounds off?! I've had $30 scales that are off by that much, and this is literally at a fraction of the price! For $8 I wouldn't expect perfection out of anything, but this scale is pretty darn close in my opinion.

title: So amazing but.....
text:
I bought this product because my husband suffers from severe plantar fasciitis as well as some bone spurs in his feet. Every night he comes home and complains about his feet hurting and asking me to rub and massage them. Now personally, I don't like feet. Not even my husbands. So, when I was offered this product at a discounted price in retune of my honest/unbiased opinion I was like Yes, Please!!! It arrived very quickly (thank you, Prime) and although the it is turquoise my husband loves it. Every night he sits on the couch and just puts his feet inside and relaxes. My husband wears a size 10 1/2 and said his feet fit comfortably. There are 2 program cycles and 5 levels of intensity. Let me just be clear, to go past level 1 is VERY, VERY intense. I really enjoyed the shiatsu part (but it's really just some little balls that roll around under your feet and the air pressure that makes it come and go with deepness. Now, I am not a sufferer of foot pain so I wasn't too impressed but my husband is OVER THE MOON excited. Plus, it keeps the kid entertained (3rd picture).

With all that being said, I do wish it had some way to put air pressure on the back of the heels. Especially since that's his major area for pain. I also would probably never pay $160 for this product. Maybe $50-60 tops, but I do think the asking price is above and beyond what is considered "worth it".

I refused to let this bother me and as long as you are VERY careful when you are getting a strand or storing the container...it probably wont fall back in. The deal-breaker was how fragile the floss was. Dental Lace sadly could not floss my teeth. Each time I flossed I would have to go through 4-5 strands (fishing it back out of the bottle half the time). There were a couple molars I could not floss at all because the space between was too tight and the Lace would just break. On each break, some Lace would get left stuck between the teeth. title: Don't Buy it!
text:
I found the unit totally unsatisfactory.

For the price of $184.00 all you get is a cheesy little cell phone that can only call 911 with one button press and hang up with the second button press. It appeared that you could have gotten this in a Dollar Store.

Any cell phone with, even with no service can call 911 for free as long as it has a battery charge with three button presses. The Federal Government requires that all towers accept 911 emergency calls even if the cell phone is not activated with a service company.

It arrived and I was stunned to find a simple little unit that didn't appear to have any quallity built into it.

I tried two test calls to 911. Both failed. Both times I reached the 911 operator but in neither test was the 911 operator able to hear or talk to me. Leaving me to hang up on them and I'm sure leaving the 911 operator wondering if an actual emergency was taking place but having no way to talk the caller.

On the second call there was a lot of "static or screeching" interfereing with the call. I couldn't tell what was going on.

You can get a much better quality phone and product by just getting a simple AT&T flip "Go-Phone" for about $30.00. The phone is much more substantial. Just let the allowable minutes run out and just keep it for dialing 911.

The phone has a battery and a screen. But the screen it totally dark with no display unless you press and make the 911 call.

So you are not able to tell the condition of the battery without calling 911 at the same time. How lame is that? Perhaps a low battery indicator might come up as the battery runs low, but I like to be able to have a look at the remaining charge at any time without having to call 911 in the process.

The buttons were wiggly. The call cancel button was called a toggle button but just appeared to be loose in its position.

The call button, though slightly recessed, was still easily accessible to being pressed if you carried the phone in a purse full of items or your pocket with keys or something. It could easily activate accidentally.

Even the lanyard cord was a cheap ribbon with a crimped piece of metal forming the loop on the end with a clip at the end. Couldn't have been cheaper.

A better bet is just to get a simple flip AT&T "Go-Phone" and let minutes expire. As it flips shut it is less likely to go off in pocket or purse. No lanyard here but much cheaper ($30) for a quality phone.

Even better, look at this:
The GreatCall 5Star Urgent response phone that allows you to press button for 911 and/or press the button and speak to a call center representative where you can talk to operators who can call for help for you.

This unit is only about $50.00 vs. $184.00. There is a small monthly service charge, but very worth it if you have a loved one you are trying to protect. It works on the Verizon network, so you can use it most places away from home where Verizon is available.

You can see it at:
[[ASIN:B0077T1YZC 5Star Urgent Response (Silver)]]

Sorry, guys, but for $184.00 this delivered very, very little.

The Plus:
I returned the unit the same day and received a very quick, full refund without any hassle.

Disappointed.

title: Perfect Tooth Brush Covers for when traveling!
text:
There are four plastic tooth brush covers in this set. They are all of different colors. The ones in my package was Yellow, Orange, Purple and Pink. Each cover set is shaped like a rectangular tube. There is one side where you put the tooth brush in, this part has the plastic that has been cut and sort of opened, yet has flaps that will hold the tooth brush in place. On the other end there are four small little holes that will act as ventilation when the tooth brush is wet. You have to push a little on the brush to get it inside the tooth brush cover, the same when pulling out the tooth brush from the cover. I really like these covers because I prefer to keep my tooth brush protected when traveling. This helps keep the brush clean.
The covers can easily be cleaned by rinsing under warm water or even soaking fora while in soapy water, or in the dishwasher. Overall these covers are real easy to use and I would recommend to anyone traveling. I received these covers for free, in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

title: Outstanding Little Germ Guardian PERFECT for Traveling!
text:
I hesitated buying this because of the negative reviews about its light and noise...glad that I DID buy this! I'm sensitive to many things, including night light and sound, and found this well within my tolerance level, as well as working like a little champion!
I took it to a recent trip to San Francisco staying in a time share--I immediately noticed the chemical smell from the cleaning supplies! I unpacked my little Guardian and plugged it in next to the bed, then left for dinner. Returned about 3 hours later and immediately noticed the absence of the cleaning smells! Wow! I had zero issue with the sound, in fact it was like a soft white noise that was soothing; the light was no issue for me either and could probably be taped over if needed. It was plugged in to the side and lower than my head, so maybe that made a difference.
What was really impressive to me was that this was a 1 bedroom suite and this little Germ Guardian kept the entire place smelling fresh and clean, even with cooking and smoke from the CA fires! I use a full-sized ionizer at home -- I bought this unit specifically for traveling, and it did its job well, and was compact to fit in my suitcase. Very Happy with this purchase!
UPDATE: I've now moved this into my bedroom to keep the air clean. I read somewhere to put a wide mouth jar or bowl of water underneath the unit to add moisture and better conversion. All I know is I'm still happy with it. NOTE: The UV will dissipate in the bulb in short time even though it still produces light! The bulb needs UV to clean the air. Replacement bulbs are easy to find.

title: Easy to use and works great
text:
My husband drinks a lot of protine when he is training for an event. He was just shaking the protein powder and water in a cup with a lid but it would still be chunky and it would not mix well. So off we went on a hunt for something at a reasonable price.

Pros -
* Mixes so well that it causes bubbles and foam (makes really good chocolate milk)
* Easy to use, simply add liquid and powder then mix
* Easy to install batteries, the bottom of the cup has a thick rubber lid and under it is there the batteries go
* I would say 10 - 11 ounces of liquid can fit comfortably and still have room to mix
* Easy to clean, simple add water and soap and turn it on / use a sponge if need be - do not let it sit for long without cleaning as it is not dishwasher safe and that will cause it to be more difficult to clean
* The lid fits really nice and has a rubber ring to prevent spills
* It can be drank straight from the mixer using the spout, simply move the plug to drink or it can be poured into a glass
* great for protein, flavored milk, powdered juice mix, etc.
* Is fun for kids to use too
* It is portable and would be easy to take to and from the gym

Cons -
* I have yet to find something I do not like about this product.

Overall, I am very happy with my order. My son, he is 2, loves to mix his morning milk in it and then I wash it and send it off to work with my hubby. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a great protein mixer at a reasonable price!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. My opinions are based on my own experience and not influenced by anyone or anything else.

title: Expensive cartridges, expensive oil, better off getting a water'd urinal and setting shutoff button to 1-3 seconds instead.
text:
Great concept, works at first but is just a constant pain to deal with. We have a fleet of mobile bathrooms, most of the first ones came with this type of urinal, I hate it and have switched to water urinals instead. Changing the cartridges is one of the worst experiences, it's very gross, and the smell is so bad "it'll outlast religion". On top of all this the $40 cartridges have to be changed every 4-6 months, no not the fluid, the cartridge because it builds up mineral deposits from the piss. And if you get the liquid it's $80 for a gallon, and all it really is... Scented oil. You can get basically any oil (that will float above water/piss) and it'll do the same job, that's how this system works, its oil that floats above the piss to block it from touching the air. BTW, The oil may get you a month or 2 extra before the stink is too much for your guests.

When we switched to water urinals I made the buttons turn off almost instantly, just enough to flush the urine away, and it's been completely trouble free so far. The reality is you need water to get rid of urine, not trap it away inside the urinal. Water urinals are far cheaper to begin with and cheaper to maintain.

If the manufacturer didn't "punish" us so much with the cartridges and fluid price gouging I wouldn't have bothered to make this review BTW.
