title: Software Problems
text: There is a software problem (firmware update V39) with these scales that causes an irreparable error when the scale reboots. It reboots if you change the batteries, switch your wifi network or make other changes. Once you reboot it is bricked, a paperweight, useless. It causes the "sensing, thinking, error" messages that others mention. The support forums at Fitbit are filled with upset people having awkward exchanges with moderators and customer support. There is no update or patch for this. Fitbit will apparently replace scales that are still under warranty (1 year) but has nothing for those with older scales. They are advised to buy a new unit. Some have stated that the units seem to last about a year and then fail. It seems more accurate to say that the batteries last about a year and when they are replaced the software fails. I had mine for more than a year and tried to change to a new wifi network. Others have noted the failure earlier.

text: This is for cleansing.  Yes you can use it daily for a while - I used to do month long fasts and cleanses.  But you wouldn't plan on using this every day for a year - it will leach out too many minerals.  So some people complaining about it being too much a pain every day, yeah, I agree.  Once a week or a couple times a month if you are using it for general cleaning.  and YES THEY WORK.  You can buy a simple hose clamp at any medical supply company or any beer/wine making store.  You can also put coffee, yes coffee, in it because it stimulates the liver to dump crap out.  I made one and what a pain that was.  I also would NOT use city liquid (city water) because that is full of chemicals, including chlorine which is very very bad for you.  If you must use city water get a food grade bucket (beer/wine making store) and let the water sit for a day or two.  Chlorine will dissipate.  Because I didn't use tap water I'd set my water bucket in a hot tub for half an hour or so to warm up to body temperature.

title: Definitely works well for particles in the air
text: I've installed a couple of these ion generators in my kitchen.  I am impressed that my fried bacon odor is generally gone about 2 hours after I'm done cooking.  Before I installed these, the odor would remain 4-5 hours or longer.  As shown in the demonstration with cigarette smoke in a chamber these do work pretty well with larger airborne particles (one that are visible for instance).  For other odors that maybe don't have larger particles I'm still on the fence how much they help.  I noticed that when I've used the spray can air freshener in the bathroom, where I have a couple more installed; the air freshener fragrance disappears much quicker than it used to.  However, as far as just making the bathroom smell "cleaner"; I don't think that's the case with just these units.  I also use an AirtheReal air purifier unit at times and I have noted that the filters do get dirtier faster since I've added these ion generators.  So, given the low price per unit and the very small electrical consumption I think they are helpful if you have the larger particles (like smoke) in the air.  At some point in the future I'd like to get one of the ion testers to see how many ions are generated or how far away these units are effective.  Although some web sites comment about touching the carbon brushes will give you a light shock; I'm not interested in checking the units operation by doing that!

title: Disappointing 😔
text:
Quick context: I have a mouse problem in my kitchen. I keep my kitchen clean, but the mice always access my apartment through my stove. I've tried several things to trap them to no avail, so I decided to try to repeal them with this product instead.

As soon as it comes in the mail, I plugged it in and followed what little instructions there were to follow, and the same evening I noticed a result. The little bastard that likes to visit my kitchen had a nasty surprise, and I could hear him squealing and rolling around under my stovetop. I got my hopes up and assumed that would be the end of it because these things were working as advertised. Imagine my surprise after having these plugged in for a week when I start seeing mouse droppings left across my kitchen counter and in the grills of my stove. Imagine even more of my shocked when I actually see the little bastard poking his head through the grills like he's daring me to play whack-a-mole with him. I even managed to catch him on video, all wow these repellers are plugged into the wall. I don't know what these devices are actually doing but they're not performing as advertised and I'm extremely disappointed. It's not even about the money at this point, I'm disappointed that I got my hopes up for something that looks like it was worth the purchase but doesn't seem to do squat but serve as a night light for my apartment.

Long story short, save your money and invest in those electric traps. Or get a cat.

title: Works great, use 2 drops per ounce of filtered or distilled, NOT TAP water.
text: Bought this straight from 420Science website but should have gotten it off of Amazon for 2 dollars cheaper.  Oh well, this product works well.  Basically what I have worked out is that you need 2 drops per ounce of water used.  It is best to get yourself a small 16-20oz bottle and get yourself some filtered or distilled water.  DO NOT USE TAP WATER or this stuff will not work nearly as good or for nearly as long.  Mix it up really good, get your mixed up water cold and pour it in your water pipe.  Obviously this only works in a water pipe or bubbler that has water in it at all times.  Mixed up as said above, this keeps my glass water pipe clean from resins and junk sticking on the sides.  My glass piece has two percolators as well as an ice catcher and before, the resins would collect on the tops of the percolators as well as above the ice catcher where water didn't touch all the time.  Now, this does not happen.  The water doesn't taste bad but is actually semi sweet/sour.  No harmful products that would hurt you in any way from accidentally drinking the water.  This stuff works great and as advertised.  I don't change my water daily, but every 2-3 days of moderately heavy daily use and it doesn't clog up or taste bad even by then.

title: Works flawlessly with moderate to heavy use for 25-30 days, just wish filter was replaceable
text: First off I have used anything from dryer sheets rubber banded to the thing toilet paper comes on all the way to going through the trouble of getting a 80 dollar fan coupled with a 100 dollar carbon air filter to try and reduce smoke smell.  This thing is basically as good as a big carbon air filter just fits in your hand instead of taking up a whole corner of your room.  These smoke buddies last about 25-30 days of daily moderate-heavy use.  I wrap my lips around it to get a better seal instead of trying to use it like a brass instrument mouthpiece (lips inside the opening).  This keeps the air flow more constant.  You can get as big a hit as you can hold and blow through this and you will not see one bit of smoke come out the other side once it goes through the filter.  Like i said it fits in an average sized hand well and fits almost any sized lips i can imagine of well.  The only down side is they should be more environmentally friendly and screw or pop apart to let you replace the carbon filter with an easy-to-change cartridge instead of making you buy a while new smoke buddy.  This would obviously cut down on price and landfill waste, but I'll continue to buy these because they work so well.  Only smoke you produce is from whatever you are smoking from.

title: Best cleaning solution on the market
text:
I have been using this solution for over 10 years, ever since I got an eye infection from my lens not being clean enough even though I followed my doctor's recommendation for cleaning. After my infection, he gave me a sample of the Alcon brand and recommended I try cleaning them with a stronger solution. After wearing contact lenses for over 20 years now, I've tried it all and nothing, NOTHING else cleans my soft lens as well. In fact, when I've used other brands to try and save money (you know, the general multi-purpose stuff) I can actually feel the difference. The lens don't feel as comfortable for the same period of time and they feel "drier" in my eyes (best way I can think to describe it). And I need to replace them with a fresh pair sooner. To me, the few extra dollars for a bottle is well worth it as it has saved me money on contacts in the long run. I wear lens that are to be replaced every 30 days (so I have to purchase 12 pairs for the year) but using this solution, I can make them last twice as long.

I wear my monthly lens for an astigmatism, so because of that corrective issue, for me, a years supply of contacts runs around $250. I try to make them last longer than that because of that fact. When I went to the doctor's office in January of this year I had had my lens in for about 3-4 months (remember they are monthlys) and while the doctor saw they needed replaced she was amazed at how clean they looked for their age and that I had made them last that long when I wear them every day. That right there is real proof at how well this solution works.

And for the love of the Maker, DO NOT PUT THE SOLUTION IN YOUR EYES!! Use saline solution for a rinse if you really need it. I don't understand how people still make that mistake when it's written all over the bottle, including around the cap now.

title: If you're sensitive to FODMAPs, read this
text:
I was looking for a no-frills, affordable collagen supplement and was thrilled to have found this. Unfortunately (and this is on me for not doing the research), I'm going to have to stop taking it because of the "Beauty Oligo". This is a galactooligosaccharide, which is part of the spectrum of fermentable sugars associated with intolerances (aka FODMAPs). And it looks like I'm part of the population that's sensitive to it (bloating, discomfort, etc.).

I bought 4 of these on sale thinking I was being smart because I knew I'd have to give it a few months to truly see any benefits, but it looks like the joke's on me.

It's hard to rate fairly because I haven't been able to give it enough time to see results, but I'm not going to continue suffering intestinal discomfort for vanity's sake. Anyway, do your research and make sure you know what your body may react unkindly to.

text:
I love these. I bought a pack a few months ago and I haven't reviewed yet since I wanted to try them out for a while first.
I originally got them for myself due to being pregnant and have the MOST SENSITIVE gums in the world. Everytime I would brush with my previous toothbrush my gums would rip and bleed. It sucked. So I bought these.
They're everything I needed. Incredibly soft but still allow for thorough cleaning, very sturdy--I can grip it comfortably without worrying it might snap mid-brush, and it is soooo reasonably priced.

My husband started using them too and he is in love. (As much as one can love one's toothbrush)

Now, there was a little shedding the first few times you use it, but it's not that big of a deal. I just ran it under water and rubbed my thumb across the bristles to get any loose fibers out.
Also, if you're an avid coffee drinker these might not be effective for tongue cleaning. I kept my other stiff toothbrush and I use it only for my tongue if I've had coffee, tea, ect.

All in all, I'm incredibly happy with these and will definitely purchase again once my partner and I have made it through this box.

title: Interesting little device but it's definitely worth the affordable price.
text:
Disclaimer: I was provided a free product from the manufacture to provide a non-biases review.

When I first received this device, my initial thought was "What is this, and what would I possibly use it for?"

Well it works great when used on your back, shoulder, lower back, and other parts of your body. It loosens up muscles and also scratches the back so if you have itchy backs like many of us have, its like a bonus usage. All you do is roll the roller in the area you wish, or slowly move the bigger one back and forth over the area basically kneading it.

After using it for a few minutes you should definitely notice a better feeling in the area you used it before.

For a device this affordable, I highly recommend giving it a try. You may look at this the same way I did initially, but once you start testing it and using it, you'll see what I mean.

Unrelated Note: I find it hilarious that Amazon would recommend this be bundled with a vegetable slicer.

While all 5 gave the same temperature (plus-minus 1F) only 3 of the 5 agreed on relative humidity (RH); the other 2 were off by at least 10%.  Amazon replaced one, but it was also off by 10% in RH. You wouldn't have known it unless you purchased several or had an independent RH meter.  Given that most people would use this at home, e.g., to keep the RH between 30 - 40% during winter, this product is really hit-and-miss when it comes to reliable accuracy.

title: Please bring these back!
text:
I purchased these last time in March of 2019, since then they haven't come back in stock and I am SO SAD!!! Please bring these baaaaaaack.

The curves of the handle were perfect, did not put undue pressure on my fingers (I have nerve pain and a lot of toothbrushes, no matter the material, worsen the hot needles in my fingertips). Additionally, the finish of the handles was completely smooth on all brushes, so none of the usual anxiety when holding onto wood/bamboo textures. It's like they were buffed smooth, unlike many, many, many other bamboo toothbrushes that feel almost like unfinished lumber.

I did not mind the texture of the bristles, it actually made these toothbrushes last so much longer than any other bamboo toothbrush with charcoal-infused bristles that I've tried in over a year and a half. I don't brush particularly hard, I've been told by a hygienist to just grip a toothbrush handle gingerly with very little pressure and that's enough to sufficiently clean the teeth. With the two other brands of bamboo brushes I've used since these lotagoods toothbrushes, I've had to switch to a new toothbrush almost every 2 weeks. The lotagoods toothbrushes lasted at least a month, if not more.

Please bring these *exact* bamboo toothbrushes back! They were absolutely perfect.

title: iHumid
text:
I am a total sucker for aesthetically pleasing product design, and so I went ahead and got the Crane Orange for my dorm room despite a few negative reviews. Well, after a day of usage, I have yet to discover anything to complain about whatsoever -- it worked right out of the box with very easy setup, for all intents and purposes it is completely *silent*, it puts a lot of moisture into the air, and it's ridiculously cute. I did notice that it will hiccup a little when you change the setting -- that is, it'll stop putting moisture into the air for a minute or two, and then restart on the new setting. I don't see this as a problem though, since I played with it for a little while and it appears to be reliable, it just takes a minute to "think" I guess.

My old dorm room had a "normal" humidifier in it, I forget the exact model but it was one of the standard lower price range ones, and I would actually rate this little fruit above the more "adult" and slightly more expensive one. So far, this one hasn't spilled at all, has worked perfectly upon refill (unlike the other one which took a lot of jiggling and coaxing), and just sits there (super quietly) and looks cute and does its job with absolutely no attention needed. I don't know if it would be capable of humidifying anything larger than perhaps a medium sized bedroom, but as a single room device it's perfect.

Next, the listing ad has these words as the first words of the ad: Rapid Remover Vinyl Letter Remover. This sort of gave me the impression this product would remove my vinyl letters rapidly. The instructions on the non-returnable product says: step 1. Remove decal, use heat gun.... 2. Spray product.....

What I learned about the non-refundable bottle is it removes the glue and maybe not the Vinayl letters.

So since I can’t refund the bottle, I gave it a try. First, for my purpose, the heat gun was almost enough. However, for what glue was left behind, this product took care of it. Honestly though in a side by side, goof off worked as well with a more controllable application method. In fact, this product left streaks of discoloration or Re coloration as the case may be (my rig has yellowed a bit)

Overall for the price I would not see myself buying this product again. Glad I bought the small $32 bottle as it will last a life time.

title: Waste of money and time
text:
This product doesn't work at all. I wasn't able to get through the first use.

- The bubble feature barely produced any bubbles. Demo videos show a roiling bubble bath, but all I got was a single stream of tiny bubbles that shifted around from one of the bubble holes to another. And after a few minutes even that stopped.
- The vibrating massage feature worked, for about ten minutes. Then the spa made a muffled clunk and the pitch of the motor changed, after which the vibrations pretty much stopped. In demo videos you can see the ripples on the water surface; after the clunk those ripples were still there only when I took my feet out, and they were much bigger and further apart.
- The white rollers are absolutely painful. Hard plastic with spikes. Stupid idea. When they're in place you can't put any weight on them, so you have to hold your feet up. Not relaxing.
- If you remove the rollers, there are sharp bits sticking up from where the rollers clip in. They are even more uncomfortable than the rollers, and since there are eight of them they're impossible to avoid.
- The attachments do not attach solidly to the center attachment point. Based on the photos you'd think that you could take your foot out and rub it on the pumice stone or other attachments. No, you can't. You'll just knock the stone loose. It's also very awkward if you try, especially since you can't put any pressure down on the other foot because of the rollers. Instead, you can to take both feet out of the bath, cross one leg over the other, and use the stone in your hand to rub your foot.
- The edges of the tub at the heel end are too close and sharp. Other folks have mentioned this, but it's hard to describe. If you sit comfortably in a chair with your feet on the floor and a few inches apart, are your knees together or spread apart? If they're spread apart, then when they're in this spa your ankles will be pressed against the hard white rim of the tub which is curved inwards.
- Noise issues: the air pump for the bubbles makes a pretty loud whine, even though it didn't produce any bubbles. I imagine the bubbling would be noisy if it worked, but you'd have to expect that. The vibrating motor seemed really noisy at first, but I realized that most of the noise was coming from the attachment with three balls in it. I had it in the attachment compartment, and it made a loud rattling. Once I took it out the motor noise wasn't too bad.

The one thing I didn't/couldn't test is the heating feature. The water I put in was already warm, since I didn't want to wait 15 minutes with the vibrations or bubbles on (necessary to turn on the heater) until the water warmed up. I can't say if the heater would keep the water warm because the spa had broken down already after ten minutes. Besides, I couldn't have lasted much longer with the spikes sticking into my feet.

title: sizing problems and product is uncomfortable
text:
After reading the reviews on Amazon, I followed others' advice and ordered the prenatal cradle in a medium even though I could fit (according to sizing instructions) into the small. I am 5'3", pre-pregnancy I weighed 124. I also have a short torso. I am currently pregnant with twins and when I ordered the cradle I was 28 weeks along and had gained about 29 pounds putting me at the upper range for a size small.

The medium arrived and I had to tighten all of the straps to their tightest setting and they still weren't tight enough to fit me. The cradle strap (under belly part) itself was also too big on it's tightest setting. I felt zero support as a result of wearing this device. Although, that I can attribute to my improper sizing order. It took about two weeks for this product to arrive, so returning it and waiting for a smaller size didn't seem like the best option for me.

Additionally, the criss-cross straps in the front were cumbersome and uncomfortable (even as loose as they were). I don't think I would have enjoyed wearing this at all. I went to Babies R Us and tried the Especially for Mom Maternity Support Band and found that to offer little support or relief as well. I've since returned both products and I am just focusing on staying off my feet as much as possible and that seems to be helping.

title: Yummy! (Mixing Instructions Included)
text:
I don't know about the nutrition aspect of this protein, but it makes me feel refreshed and I notice I'm not as sore the next day after drinking. I usually drink one scoop with milk with breakfast when I wake up and one scoop with milk immediately after a workout. This stuff is DELICIOUS! I love it. However, there is a very specific way to mix it or it will taste how I imagine rubbing alcohol tastes.

Be sure if you're going to mix it in a cup to follow these directions.

Materials:
1 Large Cup
1 Butter Knife

Ingredients:
One scoop of "Elite"
A large cup of milk (about 12 oz, which is more than the product directions call for)

The secret to getting the product to mix extremely well is to start mixing as quickly as possible once the milk and powder touch. So I start by pouring one scoop of powder into a large cup. Then I place the handle end of the knife into my mouth. Next, get the milk ready. Pour milk quickly into the cup and immediately drop in the knife and start stirring. This part is very important. You don't want to let the milk sit on the powder for any time at all. So the second the cup is full of milk, drop in that knife and stir. You don't need to stir fast, just make sure you stir consistently and be sure to scrape the bottom corners of the cup. Continue stirring for about a minute and a half and you'll notice there are relatively no clumps and the shake is smooth and tasty. If you don't mix correctly you'll find out soon enough, cause that stuff is disgusting and tastes like chemicals if you don't mix it properly.

I have never tried the powder with any liquid besides milk, so I can't comment on how they taste. And really, there's no point because the milk and powder tastes so good. So good luck, and happy stirring.

title: Feels sturdy and it is accurate
text:
Bought a healthometer from walmart years ago and that thing still works but 1 out of three measurements is out of whack completely so I was weighing myself 3 to 4 times and comparing that to the doctor/gym scales so I know it was accurate if I discarded the one bad measurement. But that was getting annoying. I don’t care for fancy Bluetooth stuff or guestimates on body fat or any other crazy feature they are adding these days I just want a simple sturdy long lasting robust and “inexpensive” simple accurate scale. And this is just that. I compare it to my dr/gym scales and it is spot on every time. No variation if you measure multiple times.

title: Beats isopropyl alcohol  99%
text:
I've always been told to just use rubbing alcohol when removing thermal paste from the integrated heat spreader (IHS). After doing some research, I ran across ArctiClean and decided to purchase it.

- 1st, use 99% isopropyl alcohol wipe(s) to remove most of the thermal paste.
- 2nd, apply kit 1 to remove any residual thermal paste that is left over. It's a tad bit oily and smells like citrus.
- 3rd, use another 99% isopropyl alcohol wipe to remove any leftover oils, from kit 1.
- 4th, take a very soft cloth, which it comes with, to remove any dried up isopropyl alcohol.
- 5th, apply kit 2, purifier, and spread it across the integrated heat spreader.
- 6th, wipe off kit 2, purifier, with a soft cloth.
- 7th, which is the final step, apply your new thermal paste, and you're good to go!

The thermal paste sticks to the integrated heat spreader, and it doesn't go anywhere. Amazing product!

text:
This was love at first sight .... When I opened the a Amazon shipping box and seen the box that this iron came in, I was immediately impressed and said to myself, Wow! this is going to be a quality iron. And it is in many ways, but of course nothing is perfect and this iron has the same faults as most other tools of this kind with the buttons being pressed while using. The iron is made very well with solid construction and a little weight to tell you that it's not a cheap department store item. It heats up fast and gets pretty hot, but it's not too hot that it's uncomfortable, I haven't burned the tips of my ears yet!
I have thin to fine hair and this iron gives me a lot of body and fullness. I normally like to curl and then smooth my hair with the brush option on this iron, it makes my hair wavy after doing this. I will use the straightening part when my hair gets longer, but I tried it and noticed that it didn't really press my hair to well being that it is thin, but it did come out straight. The only problem is with the buttons constantly getting pressed on the handle, very annoying ( maybe someday they will invent a bluetooth iron l.o.l ) or maybe some sort of sliding cap that covers the buttons when using.
It's very convenient to have all of the tools you need all in one and ready to use, instead of getting tangled up in wires from separate tools.
So yes, I'm very happy this item and you will be too.

title: I LIKE IT! :)
text:
I have "been into" aromatherapy since the 1980's and I LOVE the current ultrasonic trend! I have several ultrasonic units of differing brands. When comparing my others to this one, I rate this product 5-Stars (the others would be rated less than 5-Stars, in comparison to this one). Nonetheless, I do have two details outlined below which caused me to "sigh" in disappointment.

THE GOOD STUFF: This diffuser is quite attractive & diffuses the stated durations, effectively (30+ feet away from the unit, I still enjoy my chosen scents). I use the continuous mist setting most of the time and the auto shut off works well when the water/oil mixture is gone. As an aside and to update previous reviews made about the cord.... the diffuser I received does have a BLACK cord, so to those reviewers, it appears you have been heard and taken seriously by the manufacturer!

DISCLOSURE: However, I was very disappointed to discover that the inner water reservoir is PLASTIC (not 100% glass which I was looking to purchase); also, the plastic is evident on the exterior top (opening) of of the unit (about 1/2" in diameter). Alternatively, I assume because the exterior IS heavy glass, the diffuser does become top-heavy when filled & is easily knocked-over if bumped or jostled; positioned on a surface that doesn't see much "action" when it is in use should alleviate this potential issue.

SUMMARY: If these 2 details, above, are not stopping points for you, I HIGHLY recommend this Aromyst Glass Diffuser: it is VERY good-looking...the exterior is made of quality (heavy) opaque, glass in a neutral but decorative "cut" pattern; it disperses the oil very well & runs continuously for a long duration. ENJOY!!!

title: Solid taste, great texture, good nutrition. They have earned a repeat customer.
text:
I have been on a weight loss journey for three years. Finding suitable snacks and items high in protein have become essential in sustaining the weight I have lost and in not feeling deprived. Many companies have started to jump on the wagon of providing alternate protein items. I get it, because I have become somewhat burned out on protein bars and while I have a few favorites that I return to I was certainly ready to try something new. I had tried a different brand that touted protein cookies but it would easily creep into 500 calorie territory. For that I could just have real cookies, you know?

My Protein Bites has a great macro breakdown. I love that it’s made with basic and real ingredients. But more than that, I was surprised by the texture of the cookies. Like fresh baked ones you’d stored away for later. Still soft but not crumbly.

I tried multiple flavors and found the Peanut Buttery one to be good, though it wasn’t my favorite of the bunch. I would have preferred a stronger peanut butter taste as I’m a big PB fan, but it does the job.

I love that it comes in packs of 3 cookies so that if you want to break it up throughout the day you give yourself space for a snack even in the evening. Overall, I was really pleased with this product and this company and will definitely be purchasing from them again in the future.

title: Happy Aria scale user for almost 2 years
text:
I've been using my aria scale for almost 2 years now. I love it. First off, it's a beautiful design. It is unobtrusive in my bathroom but I've also been able to use it all over my house without the ugly scale being the first thing I see in the room. Points for a pretty AND useful device. I've never had a problem with syncing, connectivity, or battery life (it is still running on it's first set of batteries). I've had houseguests step on it and it never once has confused us and put their weight or bmi into my fitbit account. What I like most about it is that I can step on the scale daily and I don't have to look at the number. That way I can track my progress over time online in my fitbit account, but I don't have to obsess over the number on a daily basis.

A side note: It must be calibrated by stepping on it three times and you can't move it or you will have to recalibrate it to get accurate results. I learned this after looking on the fitbit site user forums.

AFTER A FEW DAYS:

If I weigh myself 3 or 4 times, usually most of the readings will be fairly accurate, but about every 4th reading it tells me I'm 10 pounds lighter or heavier than the other readings. text:
My OBGYN recommended this support for me, not for back pain, but for some relief from vericrose veins and varicrosities that have plagued me this pregnancy. She had the same issue with her own last pregnancy and used this support so it was a personal recommendation.

Based on reviews here, I ordered up a size from the sizing chart, which was the way to go. I'm 30 weeks and currently weigh about 160, and the medium was definitely the correct size for me.

First, this device is VERY comfortable. I could wear it to bed! I was worried it would bother my skin in the hot weather but it is comfortable. More importantly, it really, really has helped my discomfort from the vericrose veins.

The only reasons I gave it 4 and not 5 stars are:
1) It is impossible to wear under many tops, due to the positioning of the upper straps.
2) It could be more adjustable at the belly - it has three sets of hook fasteners (like a bra) but they're SO far apart, so it can be hard to get the correct level of tightness depending on your size. Velcro or more rows of hooks would have been more useful.

I might never have tried a product like this if my doctor hadn't suggested it, but now I'm telling every pregnant woman I know about it.

title: Cheaply made
text:
This non-OEM replacement head fits my Microtouch SOLO razor perfectly, and seems to function properly. But...

I put the 5mm comb on the head to check the trim length. When I tried to remove the comb it wouldn't come off. A little more pressure and still no joy. I took the head off the body and tried again while firmly holding the base. It came apart at the swivel hinge. It wasn't broken, and under magnification I could see how to reassemble it.

The clips on the comb that click onto the head are too long and don't release as easily as the ones on the combs that came with the original. The pins that hold the blade to the base and form the swivel hinge are too short. These two factors make this a poorly executed replacement part. Tried the comb from the original head but it's a millimeter or two smaller and won't fit on the head.

Haven't yet decided if I'm returning these for refund, and buy from another source. Or if I'm going to just call it a wash, and go with a different razor. In either case, I wouldn't buy this item again.

title: A little goes a long way
text:
I'm a big lover of essential oils and I always like learning about new oil brands. I hadn't heard of this brand before, but I was given a chance to test it out and I didn't hesitate. I was definitely pleased with my new oil.

This peppermint oil is really strong, but in a good way. I've had oils in the past that were much weaker smelling and it meant that I had to use a lot more of the product to really achieve a good smell. title: Great BCAAs!
text: I bought the cherry lime flavor off Groupon since I could get it super cheap, and at first I was really impressed. I love the taste, but you really have to like cherry limeades. It's got a nice, dominant lemony/lime flavor, with a subtle cherry aftertaste. The amino acid profile is good, but nothing too extraordinary compared to other BCAA supplements, and I've tried A LOT. Compared to the other big brand-name ones I've used (Optimum Nutrition's Amino Energy, Cellucor's Alpha Amino, Neon's Kinetic, X-Tend's, BSN's), I would say it's pretty decent overall. My favorite tends to lean toward's Neon's and X-Tend's aminos, but that's because they have more of a "refreshing" flavor that I like sipping on intra-workout (I'm a sucker for those coconut-water enhanced ones). On another note, like many others have mentioned, the solid form of these aminos smells atrocious (like you just ate a bad burrito and it gave you some intense gas). However, once you mix it into liquid form, it smells like lime. Solubility-wise, the powder mixes pretty well and doesn't leave any clumps or particles swimming around. Concerning the effect of this supplement, I have to first say that I'm a strong believer in supplementing BCAAs during your workout. I feel like doing this has always helped my recovery, helps me push harder in my workout, and I honestly feel like they're the only reason why I am able to have what others consider "a long workout" (roughly 2-3 hours a day depending on if I am workout out solo or what body parts I am training). I don't get tired at all, and I can literally workout for hours and hours if I could...In summation, if you can get over the bad scent and the plastic particles (unless that's just me), then you should absolutely consider purchasing this product. It is very reasonably priced considering it has 44 servings, and Allmax is a great brand with excellent products in general.

The instruction pamphlet included does not clearly explain how to get the best results, so you'll want to take note of the directions on the Amazon website: 1) hold the shaver at a 30 to 45 degree angle, and move it against the direction of hair growth. This will leave short stubble. 2) then go back over the same area, holding the razor at close to 90 degrees, so the wider foil part of the head reaches the remaining hair. This will get you good results.
Don't think you'll be able to just do 1 or 2 passes either at an angle or straight up and remove all the hair. It doesn't work that way. I needed 2 passes at 45 degrees, followed by 1 or sometimes 2 to remove the remaining hair. If you can live with that, it does a fairly good job.

title: Clever Advertising
text: Full disclosure: I am a hearing aids specialist and have dedicated years of my life to helping and treating folks with hearing loss. This is indeed a hearing amplifier. It by law is not allowed to be called a hearing aid.  These devices function similarly to ear horns from centuries ago; they amplify all sound indiscriminately. These WILL help if you live an exceptionally quite life.. i.e. you and the television. These will NOT help if you expect to be in any noisy or most social environments as they are not capable of discriminating speech patterns from general noise as ALL sounds will be amplified. Please seek council of your doctor or local hearing aid dispenser to find out what we can actually do for you with proper technology that is designed for your specific loss. If you are not comfortable or trusting of the person you are dealing with, do not be afraid to "shop." In my experience I have met some that are there for the paycheck and most that are there for the patient. Find the latter and you will find success.

title: Addictive- LOVE IT- but it must be done right to get the best flavor and cconsistency.
text: I am disabled with a severe chronic illness, and I cannot eat many foods. Not only do I need extra nutrition to help me heal, I cannot get what I need frrom the little food I am able to eat. Spiru-tein shakes have become my lifeline! I have about six different flavors I rotate between because I drink 2-3 shakes a day mixed with a scoop and a half of ribose. The cookie dough flavor is one of my absolute favorites! I LOVE that they put little bits of textural interest in the shakes- in ghe cookie dough flavor, it is bits of "cookie dough." Strawberry banana has bits of freeze-dried strawberries and bananas, etc. It makes the shakes more satisfying. **I use a 16 oz shaker cup with a whisk ball inside to make the shakes, and I mix them with half vanilla hemp milk and half very cold water from the fridge.** I think this makes a big difference in the taste. Sixteen ounces seems just perfect- I think if you used less water or fluid to mix it with, it would be too slimy and strong. *Plus, if you do not care for the cookie dough balls, just keep shaking it up and they will gradually shrink and dissolve into the shake.* I love them though, they are one of the best parts to me! If you find you do not like this shake, keep trying- experiment with how much and what kind of fluid you mix in, and make sure it is as cold as you can get it. If I am out of refrigerated water when I make my shake, I use a cocktail shaker with water/hemp milk and ice to get it to the right temperature then strain it into the shaker cup. This applies to all the Spiru-tein shakes. Hope this helps!

title: Nutritional Stats WRONG. Tastes like saw dust.
text:
I love peanut butter and PB&Js but avoid them because I like to have more protein when I eat 200 calories. A PB&J is a meal, after all. So I decided to try some protein peanut butters. Looking at the nutritional stats advertised HERE ON AMAZON--this one had the best. 14g of protein for 200 calories. When my P28 arrived it has 250 calories and 14g protein! WHAT? 50 more calories but no more protein? FYI same flavor of Nuts and More has 190 calories and 12g protein--both on Amazon and on the actual jar. So, for 250 calories of Nuts and More I get 16g of protein! Plus--it tastes better! I bought 3 different brands of protein peanut butter to sample and have tried 2 so far. Nuts and More is delicious. P28 tastes dry and dusty--you can almost feel the protein powder texture in the "butter."

Big disappointment--both taste and false advertising (nutritional stats shown here on Amazon). For a much tastier protein PB with better stats try: http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00T8638BU?psc=1&redirect=true&ref_=oh_aui_detailpage_o00_s00

text:
I would be much happier if this was just marketed as an overall buffer with 4 identical sides rather than a 4-step buffing process. I could have stopped after side 1 and the nail would have looked the exact same.

I got this a while ago and initially just thought I was being paranoid, but recently I've been carrying one around like a crazy person to make other people feel the four sides. The results are in - other than the color and text, the four sides are IDENTICAL. Made of the same material, create the same result.

Will they help buff out the surface of your nail a bit? Meh, probably, if you work at it. But what they WON'T do is bring you through a series of refining steps all the way from "file nail edge" all the way to "shine nail" with the same cumulative, satisfying results of one of the Tropical Shine buffer blocks you can pick up for five bucks (for one, I know, I know, it hurts) at Sally Beauty. title: Very versatile unit
text: This unit offers both TENS nerve stimulation as well as EMS muscle stimulation. I am recovering from recent back surgery for an impinged sciatic nerve, and I'm using this unit for pain management and nerve stimulation on my foot, where there is still numbness from the impingement, as well as to keep my calf and thigh muscles from being atrophied while I'm not able to work out (this is the EMS part). I own an earlier TENS unit from Belifu, which I used daily before getting this one. The previous one (modelSM9126) worked like a charm, but there are several improvements on this unit, making it well worthwhile. This one has 4 channels, allowing for 4 areas to be treated at the same time, rather than 2. you can treat with TENS and EMS at the same time for 2 different areas, if needed. The battery life is very adequate. I have used it for a week now daily and have not have to recharge it, yet. There is a lock function, which locks in your settings, so you don't inadvertently change them while the unit is in your pocket. All in all this device offers most everything you could ask for, and for a very reasonable price. Very intuitive as far as usage is concerned. Definitely would get it again and recommend it to a friend.

I love that this doesn't need watch batteries, it's got a good weight to it (it doesn't feel cheap or too hefty). I have even used it to check my dog's temperature when I thought she had a fever. I like the ear and forehead features.

Guys, if you're looking for a convenient, easy to use and above all accurate thermometer for first aid/household needs look no further! I've just ordered a Basal Body Temperature thermometer from the same company!

I went through my ten days of antibiotics and the following days (usually in agony by day 5 at latest) with ZERO issues whatsoever (part of my delay between receipt and review because I wanted to be sure this wasn't a fluke).

The recommended dosage is 1 a day before eating... or one three times a day for "intense repair". I took one before each meal that I had to take the antibiotic and one a day since to receive the results I listed above (admittedly, I was on a sulfa, which is not typically as hard on me as a cipro or the like..so a stronger antibiotic might require the max dose).

Very very pleased and I will definitely keep these on hand!

Pros:
Size of pill
Speed of efficacy (I only had a few doses before my antibiotics)
Potency

Cons:
None

***This review was for a free/reduced price product.

title: So much more than expected
text: These hearing amplifiers are very comfortable to wear. I like the one-button to control volume and noise reduction. The small charging case is great to store and charge the devise at night. It also eliminates the need for an ON/OFF switch. (read instructions) I like the natural sound they produce.I waited for a month after receiving these In-the-Ear hearing amps before writing a review. I had bought three other In-the-Ear hearing amps before finding these Banglijian devices. Two were rechargeable, but would not stay in my ears…even after trying all three sizes of ear domes. The other pair were battery operated, but quickly realized a ninety-four-year-old guy with poor eyesight and arthritic fingers could not install and remove the extremely small batteries. I have been using a pair of Banglijian behind-the-ear hearing amps for a couple of years and was very satisfied with them. When the corvid-19 pandemic required wearing a mask, removing the mask usually pulled the hearing amp off. That is when I began looking at in-the-ear devices. The intent was to wear them anytime I’m wearing a mask. However, the quality of sound and ease of the one-button adjust…plus the comfort of wearing, has changed my mind.  WORDS OF WISDOM 1- Carefully read the extremely well written instructions. 2- Make certain to use the ear-dome that fits and is comfortable. It takes a while to make these determinations. 3- Make certain you put the hearing device in the ear canal properly. View the photo on Amazon’s web page, if necessary. 4-Set the volume level at the lowest that allows you to hear. I set my volume level too high and the quality of sound was unnatural…especially when listening to music. I cannot vouch for the reliability of the hearing devices. But for now, they will be my primary hearing aids.

title: Brute force knife!
text:
Let me start out by saying that I really wanted to love this knife.

Right out of the gate I had an ordering issue, I contacted the seller about the issue I was having and he promptly replied to my email and got everything straightened out for me. Great customer service!!!

The knife arrived on time and in a box with in one of those brown amazon boxes, which was a good thing because the knife tip was poking through it's packaging box! Guess that means it is sharp (more on that later). I carefully opened up the package and noticed the knife lost its protective blade cap during shipping, probably because it was tossed around on the back of the delivery truck and not the fault of the seller. I picked up the knife and let out an audible "Oh boy!" this thing was heavy! it weighs considerably more than my other 8" chef knives and the handle could double as a self defense weapon in case of emergencies, it's big!

The handle itself appears to be made out of the standard black resin found on most kitchen knives but the edges on the handle are sharp and almost unfinished, I would not want to dice onions for an hour with this in my hand as I could see it becoming uncomfortable...FYI prep chefs.

The blade is sharp as proven by the impaled box, but it is not scary sharp. I chopped up some apples, salami, cheese, grapes, bread, phone book paper..the usual stuff ;) it sliced through them all with only a little effort needed.But if the knife was just a smidgen duller at all I would want to sharpen it right away. You can feel that the blade has a little "tooth" to it as you drag it through some thick veggie skin. A couple passes over a whetstone and strop would polish up the edge nicely.

Overall I would say that this is an ok knife for someone who needs a kitchen knife, but not someone who is a professional or avid home cook. It will slice and dice and split anything but it is a brute force knife and not a finesse knife. The seller was great to work with and because of his customer service I would not hesitate to purchase other items from him.

Comes with a nice case. I was able to travel with it. Awesome.

It came with a few brush heads but due to health conditions, had to be changed earlier than expected.

It is a great alternative and cost efficient like most of the reviews stated but this is where the buyer beware comes in.

Upon looking for replacement heads on Amazon, they were unavailable. Sold out - no big deal. Tried to see if there are compatibles - none. I emailed the manufacturer direct for more info. Their response is sorry- can’t help you. (Screen grab of Email attached)

If you’re big into customer service, that’s the last thing you want to hear rather than a solution or retention to attempt to keep customers. Not a well, not our problem kind of thing. If you want a toothbrush and no replacement of any kind, buy it! But now I have to go find a whole new toothbrush because there’s no choice. If you’re big into customer service, go elsewhere. Otherwise, you’d have to keep buying the same toothbrush kit just for toothbrush heads doesn’t make much sense to me.

title: Best wax I have ever used, but tricky to apply
text: First I’d like to say that this is hands down the best wax I have ever used. It is very sticky and will grab even the finest hairs. It takes a bit of practice to get this wax to behave and be workable. This is a LOW temperature wax and if it’s too hot, will drip and make a colossal mess. It should be about the consistency of a soft peanut butter. If it is dripping easily off the applicator, it is too hot. Also, it does not need to be applied in a thick layer. Apply a very thin layer with a thicker “lip” on the side you intend to grab. You can practice this on the back of your hand, to get it right. When applied properly and at the correct temperature, it will perform beautifully and completely remove all the hairs, even fine ones. Plus, it smells delicious. If you’re a beginner or want a wax that is easier to use, try the blue one.

title: toxic and sloppy plumbing on the bucket
text:
I'm returning the bucket because the plumbing on it is toxic - plastic parts glued together with silicone caulk which is definitely not food safe (go to the hardware store and read the product warnings on silicone caulk). The glue on my bucket was still soft and I took the fittings apart and found the glue was still wet on the inside and smelled strongly of of VOCs which are the solvents in the glue. This is a crazy lack of attention to detail in a product that is clearly a medical device whether or not this manufacturer has registered with the FDA. Oh, and the water intake on the inside was angled up so the bucket would never drain completely.

I'd consider this a big liability risk for the manufacturer. A little bit of silicone glue in your colon is probably not a big deal for people with healthy detox systems, but these days how many of us realistically are that healthy? How many people investing in a colema board would that include?

I wrote to the seller and the manufacturer about this and the seller was attentive but still I'm paying the shipping charge to return the bucket... the manufacturer has not responded as far as I know.

If you want a safer bucket, I'd recommend [[ASIN:B00DOAB8W2 Enema Kit - Clear 3.5 Qt Enema Bucket- BP Free -Silicone Enema Hose- Made in the USA]] - the fittings are stainless steel and there's no glue used, just a silicone washer which is much much safer. Using a smaller bucket also allows you to switch from coffee to yogurt etc very easily which you could not do with a 5 gallon bucket.

The board itself is decent. It is brown, not blue which might be a good thing. It would be easy to design it for better drainage but all in all this can be a lifesaving product so I don't want to complain too loudly if it's not perfect. On the other hand, poor drainage makes this messy job dirtier than it needs to be.

I wanted to love this product, really but I have to call it the way I see it. The bucket probably deserves one star and the board 3.5 so I think I'm being generous with my averaging.

text: I had a hard time rating this product. Although I like the idea and most aspects of the product, I couldn't get the product to work for me. The problem might not be with the product as much as with my ankle size and foot width. I have larger ankles and wide width feet. I also have fibromyalgia; so, I often have problems with my feet swelling. These felt a little snug around the top of my foot and it was kind of uncomfortable. However, the bottom of my foot, particularly my heel, was so comfortable. These really are like walking on clouds. Unfortunately, they also didn't stay in place. They would roll up. I feel this is a nice set if you have slim or average ankles and feet. However, if you have wide width feet and larger ankles and/or feet which swell, then these might not work well for you. They are very comfortable. If they came in two different sizes, this might fix the problem. A slightly larger size would accommodate people with larger ankles and/or wide width feet. It would also be more comfortable for those of us with health issues which cause significant swelling at times in our feet and/or ankles. I know for a lot of people with Rheumatic conditions it can be painful to have anything snug or tight around a swollen area, like the top of the foot, joints, and hands. I am giving this product four stars, because it is comfortable and well made. However, it didn't totally work for me. Finally, I must disclose the fact that I did receive this product at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

The picture shows what looks like 2 refill packages next to the refill bottle,... but it's not really 2 packages. It's 1 package that is sealed and has the cleaner in it, and the other "package" is just the box that the refill comes in. So, the picture is only showing 1 refill. There is no way for you to know this until you've been burned like I have. So, now you know.
BTW, the cleaner may be fine, I'm not sure. This review is only about the mislabeling.

title: Same problem
text:
I like these lights for their slimness and linkability. We've installed them as undercounter lights in our kitchen, and they look wonderful.

However..

As with another reviewer, one of our lights does not work.

I cannot leave my lights plugged in b/c we use this unit also for "uplighting" above the cabinets. We'd have to get a ladder out to touch these things off. I had hoped that these lights would all come on when I plug the linked units back in, but they don't...and it's random if they will or won't. So I have to go to each unit and "touch" it on, as they have no "on" switch...just the touch sensitive function. For one unit however, once I unplugged it, and plugged it back it, despite all the "touching" in the world, this light would not come back on. I tested it's bulb in my other units. No bulb issue, and when I put this bulb back in, the unit came back on like a gem. But again, once I unplugged it, upon plugging back it, that thing will not come on no matter how or where you touch it.

The other problem is that they are attached to two brackets so that you can pivot them and remove them for changing out the lights. At considerable damage to your hand, b/c this light does NOT want to come off. I can also see that it deeply stresses the plastic brackets, and I worry about breakage.

The other problem with the touch on function is that there is no "sweet spot" for THIS is where it works. For some of these lights, though they eventually come on, I spend a good minute trying to get the durn thing to turn on. Although ironically it's very sensitive about turning OFF. Remember, though they advertise the great swivel function, every time you touch it to swivel...off goes the light again. Grrrrr....

I would say that this product would be great improved if they had a "touch on" override switch. If the company offers one that has all these features and brushed nickel, but with an on/off switch, I'd say go for that one!

title: No More Morning Fuzzy Brain!
text:
This stuff is fantastic. I was going to return it thinking it was a scam. These things always seem to be a scam. I've been looking for a nootropic stack to help me get rid of my morning fuzzy brain. I operate optimally at 10pm and night until 2am. Unfortunately the world does not work that way...so I am groggy until noon usually even when I get a solid 8 for weeks at a time. I am also uninspired by the work I have been doing lately so getting motivated has been hard too. I just could not concentrate and my synapses were just firing so slow and I was easily distracted. I abused caffeine for years to the point I started having issues with irritability and shakiness and even irregular heart beat because I needed so much to get me energized. I've tried to come up with my own nootropic "stack" but it is just too hard to keep it all stocked and sorted and straightened out and honestly I never found a stack that worked very well. Exercise is great but it does not last and it does nothing for my motivation and focus. Perhaps I have AADHD but I am not going to get addicted to adderall or ritalin. I want something I can control and I don't need a Dr. involved in dosage and refills etc.

Well this is the answer! I have only taken it for 3 days...being very careful to only take minimum dosages and so forth...and I am back to feeling alive again. I am thinking clearly all day long. I just take it in the morning about 1/2 hour before I want to get up and lie in bed feeling groggy and planning my day and I can feel my enthusiasm for the day wash over me. I can jump out of bed and am ready to go! I have no idea if my memory is better or what other cognitive feats I can perform with ease now but everything is just so much clearer I am sure just about all aspects have improved.

Great to be productive in the day again. Hopefully no more late nights trying to get done what I should have accomplished during the day.
I have a theory that at least 50% of procrastination is based on the inability to focus during non-optimal hours.

I will update this if I crash or start having problems but so far this is the best thing I have found to keep me from living like a vampire. There is no way I am going to return this stuff! I almost feel like hoarding it so that I never run out.

title: Wow! The flavors
text: I lost my sense of smell and subsequently the taste of flavors around 2006. I went to an ENT and with no apparent bedside manner he told me that I was anosmic and that I would never smell or taste again. and then he sent me home with some steroids. I was devastated. Shortly thereafter, I had surgery for a deviated septum. This restored some of my smell, maybe 10% and I learned how to live with this reality, happy that I could taste some bit of flavor. Fast forward to 2020 and the California wildfires, my sense went out completely again. Unwilling to go down without a fight, I stumbled across this product. I ordered it on a Tuesday, with an estimated delivery 10-14 days. I was so happy to get it that Friday! I immediately put it in my freezer. I took it nasally with a little bit of water after. The next morning I woke up and I could smell the banana on my table...amazing! And each day with a little more progress. Today is day 5 and I can actually taste some distinct flavors in my chai tea. I had no idea tea could taste so distinct, with layers of flavor. I'm so pleased I found this product :)

title: 4th month update
text:
(I started taking Toji vitamins a month ago and have noticed less hair fallout. I received a free bottle from the company the day before I was about to finish my first bottle! I am very thankful to them for that!I will continue taking the vitamins, and will be back in five months to offer final reviews. I take them as indicated and have not experienced upset stomach or any negative side-effects. My hair is growing at its normal rate but seems shinier.)

5th month update: Toji has amazing ingredients that can benefit the heart and the brain along with providing the nutrients needed to grow healthy hair, all of that I loved, but suddenly mid-way during my fourth month my hair started falling out in great numbers again. I do not know why this happened since for the first three months I noticed that I was not leaving hairs everywhere; even my husband had noticed. Regardless of this set back I was intent on continuing, with the idea that when I reached the six month mark I would see the results I was hoping for; but to be honest I cannot continue using the product for now. Another reason I will discontinue the use of the product is the price, I cannot afford it right now. (That and the fact that my hair started falling out in great quantities again are the deal breakers.)
Overall, the product seemed promising during the first months of use but after almost six months the number of new hair growth was not impressive, my hair did not grow any faster and my shedding returned. (I am aware that I did not use the product for six months as recommended, although I did take the pills as indicated.)

title: Fabulous and Peaceful just as you would expect....
text: I couldn't believe when I heard that Marianne finally had come out with a CD guiding you through one of her famous Savasana... I took Marianne's Yoga Teacher Training in 2008 and we would often comment how calm and peaceful her voice was and how it would send us all into a deep meditation. But it wasn't only her voice... it was the ability she had to tell a story to help guide you deeper and deeper into your meditation. So of coarse when I heard she had a CD, I had to buy it. I love love it!!! I use it a few times a week and especially if my body is feeling stressed, tired or run down. As a yoga teacher you know the benefits you can receive from proper breathing and meditation. In fact I ordered one for my mom who has high blood pressure and suffers from panic attaches. She said that every time she feels her blood pressure rising she lays down and listens to the CD and she starts to calm down and feels a ton better after that. For some people meditation seems impossible. I have heard many people say " I just can't meditate, my brain just won't stop thinking"... If you think you are one of those people that can't meditate or if you enjoy mediation (like me) but would like to be on the receiving end, in the comfort of your own home then this CD is for you. Mediation helps recharge me... Marianne Thank you for putting together a CD for all your students to enjoy in the comforts of our homes.

text:
Pros:

Cons:
They have engineered the cable end to mate only with Compex brand electrode snaps. Their brand is no better than the generics but is 4 times more expensive. In order to use the generic electrodes, you would have to grind down the tit in the inside of the cable button with a Dremel tool. There is no way to program the device. You are stuck with their programs and can't change any of the parameters manually.

I figure if they don't care about their customers then I don't have to be one.

title: No leakage!
text:
I love these diaper covers. The snaps are good but I tend to like the Velcro a bit better because it's faster.
My diapering system works really well.
(Had to use a CPR doll because my baby was asleep... This doll is smallish so don't think the diapers are huge)
First I got about 3 dozen Osocozy prefolds diapers and a pack of snappis. Then I got this pack of cloth diaper covers. The last thing I bought was some extra bamboo inserts.
This system can seem bulky compared to disposable but it is very effective and I don't even notice the bulk anymore.
Make sure the cloth diaper is completely incased in the cover or leakage will occur. No bits of cloth should stick out.
The reason I wrote this review is because I saw so many reviews about how thirsties covers leak and that is not true. I would suggest getting prefolds and not using the "inserts" that some people tend to use. I know parents who used them and they complained about "pooling of urine". Of coarse there would be "pooling" since the inserts do not add enough cloth to catch all the urine! They were using the inserts to avoid the look of a bulky diaper. There is no avoiding this look when using cloth diapers so get used to it. The inserts are good as a back up at night. I put them over the prefolds to add about two hours.
These covers last for about 5 wet diapers. Less if there's been a poop!
If the diaper gets really wet, usually after long periods in between changing, the white ribbon bits that line the edges can get wet and cause leakage. You can avoid this by changing baby's diaper after three to four hours.
Once this white ribbon piece gets wet, it means it's time to change out the cover completely.

Hope this helps!

title: Overall, satisfied
text: So, this was a deal too good to pass up.  Most of these nail polish strips sell for almost $10 or more for one set, and here I was getting 10 sets for a couple bucks?  I figured if even one set worked right, I'd be making out.  The patterns were random and not necessarily the ones pictured.  I got a few sets that I don't think I can really see myself using, on the other hand, there were a couple there that I wouldn't ordinarily have paid for in the store, but didn't mind trying out for fun (I work in an elementary school and the kids loved the funky ones).  The first box I opened, the strips did not come off the paper backing properly and tore, but the patterns was crazy enough I could patch it together and it worked alright.  Some of the boxes, the strips worked perfectly. With the other boxes, the strips did not come off the paper backing properly again, but they came off well enough that on my short to medium-length nails, there was more than enough there to apply.  Once applied, the strips lasted in great condition until I removed them (a week).  I probably could've gotten a couple more days out of them, but I like to let my nails breathe once a week.  I believe that Sally Hansen has discontinued this product, which is a shame.  I'd used them before, which had influenced my decision to buy these, and my only wish was that they were available in more subdued patterns or colors.  I've used a couple other brands, and would list these as one of my favorites for ease of use and length of wear.

title: Not Jade, but does it matter? Good Value for price.
text:
These are not real jade, but for the price-- you'd be crazy to expect it to be. Real jade pieces are very, very expensive. The point of this product is to work as a massage tool, and to be cool to the touch-- of which, this product does just that.

The majority of jade rollers and Gua Sha pieces on the market are not real jade, so change your expectations. I bought many of these as a care package gift for a number of friends. I am not trying to pass them off as actual jade-- but just as stone.

The color of my pieces were all fairly opaque with white spots peeking through. The color reads more like olive/lime green than emerald or seafoam jade color.

The packs of 5 are well wrapped, and all items arrived quickly without damage.

title: A must-have product for the disabled and wheelchair-bound user
text:
Recently I reordered this product from Amazon. It's arrival was fortuitous as I was heading to the emergency room for medical issues. When admitted to the hospital I set this unit up in my room along side my bed. The urinal worked for Leslie and was so easy and portable. I encountered many nurses and nurse text who said they never saw this before and were very impressed with it. They went on to say that they really need to have this sort of thing available for all their patients since it eliminates many problems with using the old traditional type of urinal. I especially like the newest addition to the product, the cushion rim which provides a tight seal without having to take into surrounding flash.

Are use this product at home in my bedroom, in the bathroom next to my commode, in my car I. Along for trips since it provides a fast and easy way to relieve myself rather than having to get out of the car, retrieve my wheelchair and go to the facilities. Make sure to always order at least one spare , I would hate to be without one. I am a recent right leg amputee below the knee, and this device helps keep me mobile and able to drive in virtually all driving situations.

title: Life changing inserts, esp. for high impact exercises and injury-prone feet
text:
I discovered the importance of solid support inserts back in 2007 after my feet could no longer take the injuries sustained by running in minimally arch-supportive shoes with factory soles/inserts. I used the green superfeet (more rigid) brand for several years, then switched to the orange superfeet (more flex) after my arches began to hurt following sustained (6-12 months) high impact exercises (speed rope, weighted jump rope, squat jumps, olympic style weightlifting, cross fit, weight vest training, etc). After blowing out the heels of the plastic part of the orange superfeet twice, I decided to change it up and took a chance with the SOLE Dean Karnazes DK insoles shown here.

GREAT DECISION!

They form to your feet while providing superior support for the long run. I have had minimal issues with my feet (or knees) since changing, which is saying a hell of a lot for someone as rough on their feet as myself, especially considering I have bunions, med-to-high arches, and bone spurs. I put a different pair of these in my running shoes, hiking boots, gym shoes, and even work shoes. I have had about 4-5 pairs now since about 2010. I can get at least a year out of each pair and that is with a lot of miles. One could probably go much longer than a year with one pair of these inserts, but I try to prevent issues with my gnarly feet these days and regularly changing up inserts and shoes is one approach.

Incidentally, I also tried the SOLE thin sport custom for soccer cleats and dress shoes, but found they did not treat my feet as well.

Key points:
-Don't overheat in the oven! This will ruin the arch support. If anything, pull them out early, they will form over time in your shoe anyhow
-If you do heat them, remove from oven and immediately put them in the shoe you plan to use them with, lace up tight and stand in semi-athletic stance for about two minutes (feet shoulder width apart, knees directly over toes, slightly bent)
-It's a good idea to put new inserts in new shoes, though they will still work well in shoes you have used for a while - I just like to form them up together, seems to work best
-I like to form the inserts to each pair of shoes I have, though I have switched them between various shoes with good success (comfort and support is still maintained)

These inserts have been life-changing for me. They allow me to keep doing all the stuff I love without being slowed by injured feet. Worth every cent and then some!

title: Several caveats
text:
It heats up like it says, and fairly quickly. I used an infrared thermometer and the top maxed out at 113 F, and the concave eye portion at 83 F. The concave eye portion could get hotter if you press it into the heating layer. So the heat is largely influenced by the contour padding and air gaps.

In that respect, it is a very efficient sleep mask, not putting pressure on the eyes, and providing a true blackout. There may be an issue around the nose area as everyone's noses are different. I end up with a slight peak-through at the most comfortable distance up from my nose if I look at it.

The hook-and-loop strap is on the finer side, indeed less likely to trap hair but do move it out of the way. I don't have a particularly large head and there was only one inch left where I set it. So if you have a large head it may not be sufficient.

The magnetic connection is nice, I find it tolerates a good amount of movement. Of course it will disconnect with enough force; much easier vertical than lateral, as there is a small peg reinforcing the connection. 39 inches is not all that much, especially since the control is half way, taking up some slack. It's fine if you are wearing a USB battery but difficult if it's tethered. The connection is on the left side if you're wearing it, which can pose a problem depending on where the power source is. You can use a USB extender cable but it's a hassle.

It comes with a cold gel pack that sits in the concave area, and a sateen finish cinch bag for transport.

In conclusion, it works and comfort was prioritized, but there are some issues. The more direct heat concentrated at the top is limited, and the concave area is effectively creating a low-temperature oven via radiant heat; more even heating and reaching 131 F would be large improvement. I would have appreciated an additional magnetic connection on the other side of the mask. The strap should be longer.

title: Good quality - Comfortable fit - Great price
text:
The 5-pack of Blue Blocking Half Frame Reading Glasses from Louol Readers is a good way to have several identical magnification power reading glasses handy in different locations at a very reasonable price (averaging just $4 per pair at the time of this review). Note that while the power is the same in all 5 pairs, the frame color of each pair is different.
As for blue-blocking, I really can’t determine if these reading glasses actually block any specific wavelength of light. Maybe they do, maybe they don’t. Looking at the edge of the lenses it certainly appears that there is a thin layer of something pressed in between 2 thicker layers of the actual lens material (polycarbonate?) . I can observe a blue tinted reflection of light while holding the glasses under any bright light bulb while my regular (not blue-blocking) glasses do not show any blue tinting.
As for comfort these glasses hit the mark, very comfortable on the bridge of the nose and the flex of the spring hinge hold the glasses onto the face without putting too much pressure on the temples. Overall quality seems really good and the frames are just as fashionable as most name brand frames.
While I feel that the reading glasses themselves are really good, the packaging and packing are concerning. The 5 pairs of glasses are in a very lightweight box with zero padding and the shipping container used by Amazon is a basic soft bag so the product box can be easily crushed during handling and as a result some or all pairs of glasses could get damaged. As seen in 2 of the photos below, the product box was partially crushed although I was fortunate and none of the glasses were damaged. This could certainly be a real issue and something that the manufacturer/packager should consider.

Some friendly advice to parents who are looking to pursue this bed wetting solution...it will be a fairly miserable experience for the first few weeks. You will be up a few times a night for both actual incidents and false alarms (sensor detaches while child moves around). You might second guess your decision to pursue this approach.

Our 6 year old daughter had become very self conscious about wearing diapers at night. We had tried holding back liquids, waking her up to potty and a couple of other approaches, but none of them worked. We discussed going the medication route, but decided that we should give the bed wetting alarm a try before going to a prescription drug approach. After a week of wet beds she hasn't had an accident and we recommend this product to family and friends and they have been satisfied with this product as well. Later we used this same product for our 3 year old and he too has been dry at night after only 8 days. Worth the investment.

Our daughter has been sleeping without the alarm and with no bed wetting issues for the last 2 weeks. title: Buyer beware, Hi-Health has reduced potencey but is charging the same price as before!
text:
For several years I have purchased your Premium Omega-3 Fish Oils with Vitamin E softgels (300 qty) as recommended by my doctor. Through your market store on Amazon I recently purchased a replacement bottle as I was running low. When the bottle arrived I immediately noticed several things. The bottle was smaller and after comparing the two containers I noted significant differences:

- First, the absence of Vitamin E in the ingredients of the new bottle despite it's claim of containing Vitamin E on the front label.

- Second, the softgels were smaller than the previous bottle.

- Third, the reduction of Omega-3 fish oils from 1000mg in the old bottle to 600mg in the new bottle.

- Fourth, the addition of "Mixed Tocopherols" in the other ingredients.

The price for the new bottle remained the same as the old bottle despite the reduction in ingredients and lack of Vitamin E!!!!

There is a serious issue with your labeling since it claims certain ingredients exist, when the required FDA supplement facts labeling does not.

In addition, your company is marketing this new product exactly as it has with the older product, indicating NO change, yet buyer beware. If Tocopherols (or TCP) are a class of chemical compounds many of which have vitamin E activity, why are you listing them as "other ingredients"? This would indicate an almost insignificant presence of these compounds. The older bottle had 1 International Unit of Vitamin E. Obviously, the new product has an insignificant/trace amount of vitamin E.

In the future, I will be searching out for respectable and honest companies, whose products are labeled correctly and offer the same trusted consistently, bottle to bottle.

title: This is amazing
text:
First off, the cold packs are top quality. The exterior was thick enough to resist puncture or tearing, yet pliable enough to form to your body. It never got too cold and didn't have any hard chunks inside like others I've tried. It also remained cold for a long time.

At first glance I was suspicious of the harness. The part that holds the pack is thick cloth on one side and thin on the other. I was afraid the thin side would let too much cold get through and would be flimsy. Once I put the cold pack in it became apparent the fabric was stronger than it looked and offer my skin more protection than I anticipated.

My only issue was the straps. While the velcro was remarkably strong, the elastic strap felt like it would loosen up over time. It was also very small. Without the 2nd strap you would need to be the same size as the model on the box to use the product as advertised. (Full Disclosure: I did not use the item immediately after unboxing. I'm not sure if the 2nd strap was missing or if I misplaced it. In either case, I can't say how it would change the experience. For that reason I only deducted one star due to the strap size. I'll look for the missing strap tonight and adjust my review accordingly if I find it.)

TLDR: Great product. The straps may not work for bigger people, but the packs and their holder are well worth the price even if you have to hold it in place another way.

UPDATE: Okay, found the second strap. All of my concerns are gone. It easy fit around my broad chest and held the cold pack firmly in place while I unpacked my apartment. (I just moved.) With both straps, the shorter one didn't have to work as hard and didn't feel as delicate. I've very impressed.
