It's still usable which is why I'm not returning it, however, it doesn't blend easily because of the clumps.  I either have to use the blender or crush the clumps out of the powder before putting in cold almond milk.  Perhaps it would blend more easily in a hot liquid.

title: Leaves Skin Feeling Clean!
text: I have been curious about these face washers for a while, so I was excited to give this one a try! It holds a charge very long (honestly - after the initial charge, I have yet to charge it again, and it has been over a month!). It has a timer that allows for you to use both sides on each side of your face for the same amount of time. It leaves skin feeling clean, soft and just extra soft! I do think that it works better with face soap that doesn't have any microburst balls (the balls get stuck in the finer bristles unfortunately). Otherwise, it is easy to use, and works well! This would make a nice treat for yourself or a nice gift!

title: Not as Sweet As I Expected but Good Ingredients
text: I expected these gummies to be fresher, sweeter, and moister than they are. The manufacture date is 07-25-2022 and the expiration date is 07-24-2024, but they taste old and stale. They have a lot of good ingredients in them and are a nice boost to my immune system, though, so it's okay if the taste didn't wow me. They're okay, just not as tasty as many of my other supplements. I suppose it's hard to get good flavor when sea moss and turmeric are part of the ingredients, but these gummies also have tapioca syrup and cane sugar to help sweeten them a bit. For those with allergies, know that they do not contain wheat, yeast, gluten, milk, eggs, peanuts, any shellfish, fish, crustacean, dairy, or gelatin. A serving size is 2 gummies, and there are 60 gummies per bottle. This is a 2-pack, so it's a nice 60 day supply. The price is in the upper range but not outrageous.

title: Beautifully Crafted Roller, Nice Magnetic Closure Box
text: The jade roller I received is a very pale green and is absolutely gorgeous. The gold colored metal creates a nice contrast, and the word "glowiest" is tastefully printed in gold on the handle. The rollers are smoothly polished and each of the two ends rolls well. The roller arrives in a form-fitted foam cutout within the box and has a foam cover. This makes for an elegant presentation when the box is opened and the foam cover is lifted. I consider this a good, well made jade facial roller, and also consider it very giftable.

title: Pretty, Nice Sound, Very Limited Selections
text: This Orein Assoupi 3-in-1 Sleep Sound Machine has three different functions. With the color changing lights, it functions as a pretty little lamp. It also functions as a sound machine. Its third function is a a bluetooth speaker. I'll discuss them in turn. The power button, light button and three volume controls ( - , pause/play, and + ) are all located on the front of the machine. The sound button and the timer button are located on the bottom of the machine. LAMP FUNCTION: As a lamp, there are five programs, accessed in sequence by pushing the light button on the far right of the front of the lamp. The programs are: 1) fast color change, 2) move to the beat, 3) slow fade color transition, 4) night light, and 5) lights off. Though there are many light colors, you cannot stop on any particular color but instead can only see either a fast or a slow continuous rotation through them all. The exception is #4, the night light, which is only available golden yellow. As a stand alone light, my favorite setting is 3, the slow fade color transition. It is so peaceful to watch, and is absolutely mesmerizing to me, especially when the house is dark. Setting 2 works best connected to bluetooth, but will also change colors and intensities to the sound machine selections, and it's definitely cool to watch on the rain/thunderstorm setting. SOUND MACHINE FUNCTION: There are five sound programs that are accessible by using the controls on the bottom of the speaker. The programs are 1) rain, 2) fire, 3) meditation, 4) fan, 5) ocean, 6) sound off. They have to be accessed in order. The fire program doesn't sound anything like a crackling fire to me, it sounds like very high pitched tinkling. I didn't like this one at all, although I would have liked it if it had actually sounded like fire. The meditation program is a very soothing new age kind of sound that I like a lot, and I also like the rain which includes lots of thunder, and the ocean. I'm not much for white noise, but the fan would be pleasing to those who are. I thought the sound was amazingly clear and sharp for such a tiny little machine. Sound can be played continuously, or the timer button on the bottom of the machine can be pushed to choose an auto-off of 30, 60, or 90 minutes. BLUETOOTH SPEAKER: It was amazingly easy to connect bluetooth, and I tried it on a number of different types of music using my iPod as the music source. I was pleased with how this little speaker sounded with each music selection I played. While this is obviously not going to match the high fidelity sound of my expensive home sound system, I feel it performed quite well. Note: if the power button is held for two seconds and the blinking blue light is on, indicating the speaker is ready to pair to bluetooth, the speaker will automatically shut down after two minutes if it is not paired with bluetooth. If I change my mind about connecting to bluetooth after the blue light is flashing, I can just press the power button rapidly and the blinking blue light will go away and I will return to normal speaker mode. Also, if the speaker is paired to bluetooth and is paused for 15 minutes or more, the speaker will automatically shut down. I find that the more I use this little sound machine, the more I like it, and am content with its limitations. The slowly fading lights and a soft mediation program in the background with this little machine sitting on the corner of my computer desk at home is just perfect for me, and I am glad I ordered this machine.

title: Breakthrough Chemical Odor that Was Very Potent
text: I love shower steamers, and it's rare for me to find some I don't care for. Unfortunately, these shower are definitely not ones I like. Both the menthol & eucalyptus and the lavender scents have an additional scent that has a very strong chemical smell almost like some sort of industrial solvent. It totally overpowers the smell of both the menthol & eucalyptus and the lavender shower steamers. The fumes were not only unpleasant, they actually started to give me a headache each time. I don't know if I just got a bad batch of these or what, but after trying one of each scent on different days and having the same thing happen each time, I'm not about to try any more. These six shower steamers come wrapped in shiny foil, three eucalyptus (green) and three lavender (purple). They lie on a bed of lavender filler paper, and there is a mesh lavender drawstring bag with an adhesive-backed hook to hang the bag on. The cover of the box is pretty and has a printed lavender ribbon with a bow on it. Two of the sides say "Make your bathroom different!". This has all the right stuff to make a beautiful gift, but the intense, unpleasant scent of these steamers make them something I don't even want to finish using for myself, much less gift to anyone else. I"m giving them a three star for presentation and the benefit of the doubt, based on other reviews, that the box I got is the exception and not the rule.

title: Very Pleasant Vanilla Scent
text: This 3.3 fl oz (100 ml) bottle of Natures Philosophy vanilla essential oil smells absolutely wonderful. The glass amber bottle and the glass eyedropper were packaged well to prevent breakage or leakage, and arrived totally undamaged. There is also a plastic Euro dropper included as an option to the glass eyedropper. This vanilla scent fills my house nicely when added to my diffuser, and should last for quite some time. The enticing scent of vanilla never fails to raise my spirits and lighten my mood, and I am pleased to have such a large bottle to use. I consider this vanilla oil a good value and also very giftable.

title: Works Great, Easy to Use
text: This Jazznap Electric Callus Remover Kit comes with the callus remover, three heads (coarse, medium, and fine), a USB charging cord, and an instruction manual. The white head is the coarse one, the dark black is the medium one, and the lighter black is the fine one. Each works well, and I can visibly see the dust as my callus on my heel is being smoothly ground down. This callus remover arrives already charged, so I was able to test it immediately, which was great. To attach a head, simply pop it into place. There is a sliding switch on the left side of the machine that will release the head when the switch is pushed down. I spend as much time as possible either barefoot or in flip flops, so dry, callused heels are a constant with me. This machine totally resolves that problem. This Jazznap foot callus remover kit currently sells for $25.99. I consider it a very useful item, and I am thrilled to have it.

title: Some good, some not so good
text:
I'm not going to provide a description of the kit, you can read the product information page for that. I'm going to give my opinion on each of the items.
The good:
1. This is a complete system. Everything you need is provided in the kit.
2. The instruction manual is the best I've ever seen with a TENS/EMS unit. Well written and thorough.
3. Also has a "quick start" guide that goes over the basics so you can get up and running quickly.
4. Battery operated. Unit uses 3 AAA batteries. No cords, no recharging, goes anywhere just take extra batteries.
5. "Large" pads are unique. Set of two 3.5' by 5" pads, great for larger muscle groups like lower back.

The "not so good":
1. The price. Current price of $72 is definitely on the high end. Kit is nice but $72, no.
2. Lack of extra pads. Using both channels, there is one set of pads for both the large and small pads. At $72 there should be extra pads. High quality pads are usually good for a max of 10 uses, usually less. iReliev's replacement pad kit, with 8 small and 4 large electrode pads, costs approx $20.
3. iReliev pads use a "pin" type connector. My experience is that pin connectors tend to come loose more easily than "snap" connectors. If one comes loose and touches your skin, it hurts.
Bottom line. I really wanted to give this kit a 5-star rating. As is I was wavering between a 3 or 4 star rating. I was expecting more based on the price. Although good, it's not $72 worth of good. I personally think there are better options available. This review is strictly my personal assessment.

title: Perfect for travel
text: Flosser comes as a complete package ready to put in your overnight bag.  I have a larger capacity water flosser that I keep in my shower and use daily.  This flosser, when in the closed position with the water tank emptied and compressed, is less than half the size of my regular flosser.  With the provided travel bag this is a perfect solution when traveling.  The flosser comes with a good set of instructions which are necessary to read, two sets of tips, the magnetic charging cord and the travel bag that keeps everything together.  You can set your own desired strength with the DIY setting.  Overall a great flosser for travel or daily use.  Recommended.

title: Good Dose, Easy to Swallow
text: Before I go into how much I genuinely like this product, be aware that I ordered these Jan 26, 2022. They arrived Jan 31, 2022 with an expiration date on the container of Feb 2022. I began using them immediately, since this is a 30 day supply, and will still have a few that I'll be taking after they technically expire. Since I don't know with all the supply chain issues lately how much of this was actually in the company's control, am not docking any stars for it, but check your expiration date as soon as it arrives. This is a good policy for any product, anyway, but especially these days. Also be aware if you have allergies that this is a curcumin-whey product and contains milk. That being said, I really, really like this OrangeDuzi turmeric curcumin. The capsules are easy to swallow. I like the dose, I like the 100% natural ingredients, and I even like the flip top lid on the container. The addition of turmeric to my daily supplements a while back has made a huge improvement in my chronic back pain, and I definitely appreciate a high quality turmeric product like this one.

title: Magnets Work Fine Once Appropriate Pressure Applied
text: Several readers have complained about having difficulty with the magnetic closure, but here is what I did and it worked like a champ. Assemble the box. Bend the crease between the top of the box and the magnetic flap sharply to form 90 degrees. With the box formed and the lid closed, place the side with the magnetic flap down on a solid surface. Press firmly (but not hard enough to break it, of course) for 10-15 seconds on the opposite side of the box, pushing it "toward" the side with the magnetic flap. After I did that with each box, they each closed easily and tightly with an audible click each time as the magnets connected. I opened and closed each one repeatedly, and not once did any of the flaps fail to perform properly. These little boxes are nice and sturdy, and are great for small gifts. The glossy white surface is easy to wipe clean, and also easy to decorate and personalize. At the current price of $12.99 for five boxes, I think this is a good value.

title: Beautiful Set of Essential Oils, Nice Presentation
text: I am not an expert on essential oils, nor do I pretend to be. I know what I like to smell and what I don't, and I genuinely love the scent of these essential oils. That is enough for me. This Sality Essential Oils Set comes with 20 essential oils, each in a 10 ml amber glass bottle and each nicely labeled as to what's inside. The box these oils come in is black with beautiful flowers, a bird, and a butterfly artfully decorating the cover. Inside, each oil is in it's own cardboard display section. There is a foldout set of instructions that has a cover with the same design that is on the cover of the box--flowers, bird, butterfly, etc.--and it's quite pretty. The instructions cover far more oils than are present in this particular set, and explain the benefits of each oil. As a personal gift to myself, I am quite happy with these oils. I also consider them very giftable to others.

title: Good Supplement to Healthy Diet
text: My wife uses these. This SMNutrition Women's Multivitamin Gummies bottle contains 60 gummies. A serving is 2 gummies, so this is a 30 day supply. These gummies are soft, tasty, and easy to chew and swallow. They place a strong emphasis on the B vitamins, while also providing 25% of the daily value of iodine and 20% of the daily value of zinc. They don't provide much vitamin C, just 20% of the daily value, but my wife take a separate supplement for Vitamin C, anyway, so that's not a problem for her. It also only provides 8% of the daily value for Vitamin D, but during most of the year she doesn't need it in supplement form because she spends enough time in the sun to meet her Vitamin D needs, and in the winter she takes a separate Vitamin D supplement during the times where she's not going to be outside in the sunshine. Also, she eats a pretty healthy diet which meets many, if not all, of her vitamin and mineral needs year round. For my wife, these SMNutrition multivitamin gummies are perfect for adding to her diet and making sure she is meeting her nutritional needs.

title: My new favorite for non-power bank operation
text: My cat and I are fighting over this heating pad!  I keep a heating pad on my favorite recliner at all times.  Our cat likes to sit in my lap in the evenings and he's discovered that when I get up he can snuggle up on the heating pad which falls to the seat of the chair.  The fight happens when I come back, he doesn't want to move.  I've had a bad back for years and years and heat has been the one constant that helps ease the pain.  This heating pad is very easy to place exactly where you want/need it, it warms up quickly and has a digital control that lets you set the exact temperature (86 - 158 degrees F) you want, it remembers your settings and you can set it to turn off between 1 - 5 hours.  The heat generated by the pad seems to penetrate deeper into my back and is very soothing.  It doesn't cure the pain but it makes is lessen temporarily and that all I can ask.  I do have another hearing pan that I can use with a power bank that comes in handy when I need to be moving around (especially handy when baking Christmas cookies) but his pad now has a permanent home on my recliner.  Oh, and while the heating pad appears exceptionally large and somewhat bulky, it isn't.  When I looked at the pictures on the product information page I thought "that can't be the same heating pad" but it is.  While it is big it's very comfortable to wear/use. Highly recommend.

title: Some good, some not so good
text: Things I liked:  #1 - The price. At $19.99 I think this is the least expensive water flosser that I've seen.  A good value for the price.  #2 - The handle, it has a couple hundred little bumps on it to make it easier to grip while wet.  #3 - The power cord, its a standard USB to micro USB cord.  I've got tons of those so I don't have to worry about losing the cord.  Most flossers have specialized power cords.  Things I'm not fond of: #1 The water tank - it's unique in that you pull it down from the unit to remove it.  It's awkward to remove/replace and it doesn't have a large opening for filling the tank.  I have to question how long it's going to last since the wear and tear seems pretty heavy; #2 the hose connecting the tank to the flosser. The hose in my unit was about !/16" too long.  It wouldn't move, it was stuck in one position in the tank.  I cut off just enough to free it but it's still too stiff to allow it to move around to get where the water is when the tank is low.  Summary: A good choice for an inexpensive flosser.  Doesn't have some of the nicer features found on some higher priced units but good for the price.

title: NON-Sterile Gauze Rolls but Good for Outer Wrapping
text: This package contains 30 rolls of non-sterile 100% polyester gauze and a small roll of paper tape. Each roll of gauze is individually wrapped and measures 4 inches wide and 4.5 yards long. The roll of paper tape measures 1/2 inch wide and 5.5 yards long. Since these gauze rolls are not sterile, I personally would not use them in direct contact with an open wound of any kind because of risk of infection. However, I would feel comfortable using the gauze to help hold a sterile dressing in place or to wrap something besides a wound, such as a sprained ankle or to hold a finger splint in place. This gauze is very elastic and extremely soft and comfortable. Even though these are not sterile, these gauze rolls certainly have a place in my medical supplies and will prove useful for many things. The paper tape is particularly beneficial for anyone like me who has extreme skin irritation or other  reactions to regular tape when it touches the skin. Paper tape is the only type of medical tape I can tolerate without getting blisters and huge reddened areas on my body, so I always keep some of it on hand. This package of 30 rolls of gauze and the roll of paper tape currently lists for $14.89, and I consider it a good value.

title: Interesting, Pleasing Fresh Scent
text: This Focus essential oil roll on is a blend of rosemary, spearmint, and cardamom in a 10ml (0.33 fl. oz.) dark glass bottle. I applied some to my wrist, and was immediately captivated by the light, fresh, wonderful scent. The scent fades very quickly, but I can still smell it if I lift my wrist to my nostrils, and that's actually about the strength I want when I'm in public. This is for my personal enjoyment, it is not meant to be a cologne. Something unusual happened when I put the cap back on and brought it into the living room to take pictures. When I removed the cap again, the bottle was totally open and the entire metal roller ball with the applicator top was stuck inside the cap. I shook the cap, and the applicator top wouldn't come out, but I was able to remove it with needlenose pliers and pressed the plastic applicator containing the roller ball firmly back into the top of the bottle. I've taken the cap on and off a number of times after that to test it, and it hasn't happened again. I had not planned to downgrade my rating because of a fluke occurrence, especially one that was so easily fixed, but I see many other reviewers have had the same problem with the applicator initially coming off. While it is easily corrected, it is a flaw that needs to be addressed by the manufacturer, so I dropped my rating to 4 stars. I like the scent of this rosemary-spearmint-cardamom blend, and I consider this Focus roll on a good value even with the initial hiccup.

title: They Bunch Up Badly on Top of Foot Opposite Heel
text: I like the colors of these ankle braces. Mine fit true to size based on their measuring chart, and are just the right amount of snugness to give good compression without binding in most areas. They seem to be very durable. However, I have the same problem already reported by other reviewers as far as the basic design. Because there is no defined heel, these ankle braces bunch up quite badly on the top of my feet opposite my heels. No matter how many times I pull them up, within a few minutes they are all bunched up again. Since these are compression braces, those bunched up areas dig into the top bend of each foot and get more and more uncomfortable the longer I wear them. I ordered these braces to resolve foot problems, not to create new ones. I will not wear these any longer and will not recommend them to others.

title: Boy Do I Feel Stupid
text: I'd forgotten that I'd ordered an assortment package of these hydration drinks a few months back.  When I tried the various flavors back then I liked one of the flavors but I did not like the orange citrus flavor.  I tried to put my previous experience aside and mixed up a new glass.  That's when I noticed that the packet is supposed to be mixed with 32 ounces of water.  I think I mixed my previous try with 8 ounces.  That's where the "stupid" comes in.  Once I actually mixed the packet with 32 ounces the result was completely different.  It's still not the best tasting drink out there but it's a whole lot better than it was with only 8 ounces of water.  Mixed correctly the orange citrus taste is weak and the mixture seems a bit sweet.  I use hydration drinks during the hotter months here in Central Arkansas, which means from April through October.  Although not my favorite hydration drink, it does taste reasonably good and now I have to go back and modify my previous review.  My dad always said: "If brains were gunpowder, you wouldn't have enough to blow your nose."  I guessing he may have been right.

title: Tasty When My Own Creamer Added
text: I'm not on a Keto diet, but I got this Keto coffee because I love coffee that is French vanilla flavored. It arrives in an interesting box. To open the box, you slide the top part of the box to the right, revealing the tray underneath. There are 20 packets of instant coffee in the box. Each packet contains added vitamins and other nutrients in addition to the coffee itself. To make a cup of coffee, mix a packet with 6-8 oz of hot or cold water. I mix mine with hot. By itself, the coffee is just so so. However, I drink all my coffee with French vanilla coffee creamer, and once I add my creamer, this coffee is absolutely delicious. While I will gladly enjoy the rest of the packets in the box, the current list price of $44.95 is a bit too pricey for me to want to reorder it.

title: Almost Too Cute to Use
text: This gift set consists of six cute bath bombs in assorted shapes and colors. The cover of the box has pink on the left blending into lavender in the middle and blue on the right. It has a white silhouette of a female soaking in a bathtub getting ready to pop one of the many bubbles floating out of the tub. The sides and back of the box have the same color scheme. The back includes directions on how to use the bath bombs and a generic list of ingredients, which are sodium bicarbonate, citric acid, sodium sulfate, organic shea butter, sea salt, essential oils, and FDA approved colorants. When the box is opened, the contents are covered by bright pink crinkle cut paper. Removing the paper reveals the six bath bombs, each individually wrapped in plastic, resting on more pink filler paper. There is no plastic opening tool. The six bath bombs are each different shapes and colors. One is a green and yellow doughnut with lemon scent. One is a pink. blue, and yellow star with cotton candy scent. One is a blue heart with gold glitter brush strokes that has a rose scent. One is an orange macaroon with a white center and with a "milk" fragrance (smells floral through the wrapper). One is a cupcake with a lavender cupcake wrapper, white icing, and tons of multicolored sprinkles on top that has a lavender scent. The last one is a round ball with blue icing and a rainbow on top sprinkled with blue glitter. The scent for this one is sweet orange. These bath bombs have natural and organic ingredients. The bottom of the box clearly cautions "Do not eat!", although the online information says the ingredients are "edible grade." I suppose this is just a reassurance in case I accidentally get any glitter or other ingredients in my mouth. These little bath bombs are almost too cute to use, and I'm going to put them on display in my bathroom for a bit before I indulge myself with them in the bathtub. This set of six bath bombs currently lists for $16.99, and I consider them a good value and very giftable.

title: Nice Scent, Instant Cooling, Prompt Pain Relief
text: Like many people these days, I tend to develop lower back pain after being on the computer all day. It's not something I want to take a pain medication for, so I usually just suffer through it and hope that it eases up somewhat throughout the evening. This BIOLabs PRO Herbal Soothe product is the perfect solution for me. This comes in a 3 ounce (85g) bottle with a pump dispenser, and the label says the bottle will deliver 60-70 pumps. One pump for each side of my lower back provides plenty of creamy ointment to completely saturate the area. It absorbs quickly, so there is no concern of greasy stains on my shirt after I apply it. The cooling effect from the menthol and camphor begins immediately and lasts for quite some time. I can feel my lower back muscles relaxing and the achiness simply melting away. The camphor and menthol can be smelled, but the scent is mild and pleasant, not like many other muscle rubs. So nice to have such quick relief in a topical format that I can use whenever I need it without having to worry about the side effects of an oral pain medication. This all natural cream currently lists for $19.97, and I consider this definitely worth it for the wonderful relief it provides for my aching lower back.

title: Great Rainbow Color Display, Lasts a Long Time
text: This box comes with three huge rainbow cloud bath bombs. Each bath bomb is 6.5 ounces and has a cloud face that is smiling and winking--very cute. The minute a bath bomb is put in the bathtub, it begins to stream a beautiful rainbow of color and to fizz its way around the tub. The show lasted way longer than any other bath bombs I've ever had, and it was an absolute delight to watch. The color continued to stream until every last particle of the giant bath bomb cloud had dissolved. The scent is quite pleasant, but even if it had no scent whatsoever, the color display alone makes these bath bombs well worth the current listing price of $19.99. These bath bombs are most definitely giftable to anyone of any age or gender that likes to take baths--whoever receives them is in for a true treat.

title: You Hadly Know That They're There
text: These are by far the lightest pairs of glasses I've ever owned and I've been wearing glasses for 60+ years.  The optics are great and due to their size it's super easy to just let them slide down your nose a bit so that you can look over them when needed.  The fact that they don't have a rim around the top makes 'em as easy to use as expensive progressive lenses.  I got mine for doing computer work.  My distance vision is fine so if I'm working at the computer and have the TV on, I can just turn my head, look over the top of the glasses and I've got the TV in focus without have to mess with the glasses.  Also great for reading and watching TV at the same time.  They are not blue light blocking which I consider a big plus.  I get tired of the tint on the blockers.  My only minor complaint involves the cases.  They're very light duty.  Even the cheapo plastic cases would have been better.  Again, a minor complaint.  Love 'em and highly recommend 'em.

title: Forgot I had it on
text: This JJGELOS back brace belt fits differently than most others, it sits higher on the back.  My back has been giving me a little extra trouble lately so I started wearing this belt.  The first day I wore it I forgot I had it on after a couple of hours.  The metal stays force the wearer to maintain a better posture and prevent improper bending.  I now wear this back brace whenever my back is acting up, work great.  Size wise I'm a 38 waist and this fit fine.  There was plenty of extra room if needed.  Recommended

title: After 2 weeks, some relief
text: The red light therapy light comes with a very portable, and small, red light device, a pin type charging cord that connects to any USB port and a pair of VERY dark glasses.  The whole package comes in a nice black presentation box in case you want to give it as a gift.  The instructions say to use it for 5 minutes, three times a day for three weeks in order to get results.  I have some damage to both of my upper thumb joints due to a lot of shoveling I've been doing lately.  I've been using the light on my left thumb area for approximately two weeks and have seen some minor improvement when compared to my right thumb.  I can't swear that the improvement is due to the light but am willing to continue using the light to see if it makes any significant improvement.  The light is very small and lightweight.  Easy to tip over if the goose neck is stretched too far from the base.  I'm keeping it on my computer desk and using it while I browse the net.  The unit has a five-minute safety timer that automatically turns the light off.  You are supposed to place the light close to or on the affected area.  Really too small to use on anything but a very small pinpointed area.  Not large enough to use on a large muscle group such as a lower back area.

title: Beautiful, Smooth, Well Carved
text: This set comes with seven small heart shaped crystals in chakra colors and one larger rose quartz crystal heart. There is a black velvet drawstring bag to hold them all. The small crystals are 3/4" long and 3/4" wide. The larger heart is 1 5/8" long and 1 5/8" wide. Each crystal is polished super smooth. They are beautiful to look at and a pleasure to hold. The black velvet bag is well made with good stitching and no loose threads. This is an extremely nice set, a good value, and very giftable, although I intend to keep this set for myself.

title: Intoxicating Scent, Couldn't Get Enough of It
text: I ordered three different bags of these in different scents, so my reviews will be similar for each. This review is for Orange & Lemongrass. Of the three scents I’ve tried so far (Peppermint & Spearmint, Peppermint & Citrus, and this one), this is hands down my favorite. I absolutely love it. This order comes with a package of 10 shower tablets. The tablets are not individually wrapped and are all in a bag with a Velcro closure instead of the standard ziplock closure. The tablets are a bit powdery, as you can clearly see in my photo, but still work well and release an incredible amount of aroma in the shower. They dissolve faster than other shower steamers I have used, but I still managed to get two showers out of each tablet. The lemongrass and orange blend well together, and the scent is downright intoxicating. It made me take a much longer shower than usual, just so I could keep inhaling the fragrance. I feel this is a reasonable price for these 10 shower steamers and definitely consider it giftable because of its incredible scent.

title: Nice Presentation, Very Giftable
text: This order includes 16 vividly colored shower steamers, four in each color and fragrance. The thank you card included in the box tells me that the blue is eucalyptus, the orange is rose, the purple is lavender, and the yellow is lemon. Each steamer is in its own compartment within the box, and each is individually wrapped in plastic. They also each have bits of petal or other plant parts on top of the steamer to enhance the appearance even further. The aroma of each steamer is strong, and I smelled them as soon as I opened the box. Each of the four fragrances is distinctly different. This is a very nice set with a great presentation, and I consider it a good value and a very giftable item.

title: Perfect after a day working in the yard
text: First tried this foot massager after a day of digging up tree roots from a huge pine tree - it'll take a few more days to finish that job.  At any rate, my feet hurt from all the shovel work, especially my left foot.  I initially set the compression control to the lowest settings, the roller setting to high and included the heat.  After a short period I upped the compression to high and that felt great.  I sat back and enjoyed the massage for about 20 minutes and my feet felt great afterwards.  My wife, who has very wide feet with  no arches tried the massager but didn't care for it.  I was just the opposite, I loved it.  I've used the machine three times since that first experience and have continued to enjoy it immensely.  Definitely recommend starting out on the lowest compression setting until you get used to it.  I wear 9.5 shoes and the massager easily accommodated my feet.  I'd suspect that the massager would easily handle significantly larger feet.  Highly recommended.

title: Nicely Finished Humidor With Minor Glitchs
text: [[VIDEOID:274c6930523b8d9dc3928c4733a97ff1]] This WIAEE humidor is a nice size for a working desktop - if your place of employment allows smoking - that would be a welcome addition for any cigar smoking individual.  The box uses quality hardware that works very smoothly.  Unfortunately the box I received had a couple of problems.  #1 the drawer on the bottom was stuck when I received the humidor.  I was able to pry it open with a knife without damaging the box.  After opening, the drawer would not shut.  I had to sand down the top edge and both sides of the drawer face in order to get it to shut.  #2  I did not receive the "humidification system" with my shipment.  That's not really a big deal since I probably wouldn't use it anyhow but it should have been included.  I don't think the humidor I received was the norm for this vendor.  I suspect most of their products are of higher quality. I did not try to contact the vendor regarding the problems as they weren't that big a deal for me.

title: Helps Senior Pet with Improved Mobility
text: I actually got these for my ancient cat, since he weighs as much as a small dog and can benefit just as much from the glucosamine and other ingredients in this treat. When I first offered it to my cat as a whole treat, he was totally uninterested. I broke it up into tiny pieces, but he still wanted nothing to do with it. He goes absolutely nuts over his wet cat food, though, so I have been breaking each treat up into a powder form and stirring it in with his cat food before I give it to him. He's in the habit of gobbling his wet cat food down to the last morsel, and putting this soft chew in his food didn't slow him down one iota. It takes a while for glucosamine to start having an effect in humans, and I figure the same is probably true in animals, but I am starting to see an improvement in his stiffness and his mobility. At one chewy treat per day, and 60 soft chews per package, these will last me for two months. I consider this a good value at $19.99, and I believe my cat does, too.

title: Vibrant Colors, Fantastic Fizz, Fun to Watch
text: These bath bombs have the best spin and fizz of any bath bombs I have ever had. I was so busy watching the show once I dropped one into the tub that I totally forgot to take pictures until it was more than halfway gone, but it was still spinning and fizzing away down to the very last bit. The bath bomb floats on the surface, and if I push it under the water, it bounces right back up, so the entire spinning, colorful effect stays readily visible. The whole show lasted for about 15 minutes. The colors are vibrant. The blue cap dissolves first, and the purple and orange dissolve pretty evenly after that. The fragrance is faintly floral. It leaves my bath water a beautiful reddish orange. The oils and salts in the bath bomb feel very soothing to my skin and leave it feeling clean, soft, and well moisturized when my bath is done. The bath bomb did not leave a residue or a stain of any kind. These bath bombs spin very energetically, and I would not recommend putting one in something as small as a foot bath. Instead, use them in a regular bath tub per the instructions. The only reason I gave these delightful bath bombs a 4 star instead of a 5 star is because the box, instead of being shrink wrapped like most bath bomb sets, is instead held together with a huge piece of packaging tape that goes all the way around the box. When the tape is removed, it leaves a wide stretch of stickiness that prevents the box from being set on anything after that or it will stick to it and spread the adhesive to whatever the box is placed on. This also prevents the box from being used as a gift box, although the bombs themselves make great gifts. Fortunately, this is a problem that can be easily remedied by the seller. Either shrink wrap the box, or just put a tiny amount of tape or another type of seal on the edges of the box, not all the way around the top and bottom. In the meantime, I simply transferred the rest my bath bomb set to another container, no problem. I think these 12 large (4.2 oz), vibrantly colored, fantastically fizzing bath bombs are a good value and very giftable, even if I have to place them in another box each time.

title: Would make a great gift
text: Pack of 12 small bottles (10ml each) in a very nice presentation box.  A nice selection of essential oils.  Pretty much the most popular oils.  I personally use some of them for various repellent concoctions (mice in the basement, deer in the gardens, mosquitoes everywhere).  Others I use in a diffuser.  The oils that I've used so far all have decent aromas, particularly the lemon and rose.  Combined with a small diffuser this set would make a great gift for someone new to essential owners.  Recommended.

title: Pretty Presentation, Nice Scents, Very Giftable
text: This is a very pretty set of 12 multicolored gift bombs beautifully presented on a bed of ivory colored nesting paper. The bath bombs are large, 2 1/4" in diameter. The scents are not labeled and the ingredients are not listed. The online information tells me they are 100% pure organic and the ingredients include sea salt, citric acid, cocoa butter, shea and coconut oil, and plant extracts. A photo in the online product information mentions lavender, rosemary, strawberry, rose, honeysuckle, and photinia. Yet another photo mentions essential oils, sunflower oil and Vitamin E.  While I much prefer fragrance labels and ingredients listed on the bath bomb wrapping, on the box, or on a printout inside the box, these bath bombs are so very pretty and the scents are so lovely that I still consider them quite giftable in spite of the lack of labeling.

title: Easy and Quick to Use, Works Well
text: This order includes a set of 10 markers, 10 crayons, and a plastic sharpener for the crayons. There are six colors designed to match wood types: oak, maple, chestnut, mahogany, cherry, and walnut. There are four colors to match paint instead of wood types: black, white, gray, and burnt sienna. Each marker and corresponding crayon is labeled accordingly. I have used furniture wood repair markers before, but I have purchased them individually as needed, so it's nice to have a complete set on standby. I tested several of the colors on various bits of older furniture around the house, and each worked well. For the current list price of $15.88 for the full set of 10 crayons, 10 markers, and a sharpener, I consider this a good value and a useful item to keep on hand.

title: Not as clingy as others, much more expensive
text: I like the idea of compostable cling wrap although with the amount I use it isn't going to have much of an impact no matter what.  We compost most everything we possible can and I used the resulting compost in my garden.  For me an environmentally friendly product has to produce results similar to its nonfriendly competitors.  For cling wrap I'm not going to pay twice as much for a role of cling wrap that's compostable compared to a better product that's not compostable.  In this case the compostable cling wrap is not as good, or anywhere as cheap, as the noncompostable versions.  Amazon has premium noncmpostavle 100' roles of cling wrap for less than half as much as this product.  And quality wise, I couldn't get the wrap to cling to itself at all.  I did like the cutter, it worked fine.  Bottom line is that it didn't perform as well as competitors and it cost twice as much.  Pass.

title: Very Attractive Container, Nice Soft Pads--Update
text: I got this for my wife, and here is her review: This is such a pretty little makeup remover pad holder, and it looks good just about anywhere I put it. The black tin has interlocking gold-trimmed leaves on both the lid and the bottom of the container, with a nice gold band around the center of the container separating the lid from the bottom. When the lid is removed, there is an inner gold-colored lid with a black knob. Lifting the inner lid, I see the makeup remover pads--there are 16 pads in all. The pads are black with gold trim around the edge, very elegant looking, and are 3 1/2" in diameter. The flip side of the pad is black with a different pattern of gold trim, also very classy. The cotton material of the pads is very soft and gentle to the touch and when wiping my face. I love the fact that both sides of each pad is usable, and the pads themselves are all washable and reusable. Washing instructions are on the box--machine or hand wash in warm water. There is even a soft little 100% cotton mesh laundry bag to use. The box then says to place them on a dry towel or flat surface to dry. The online instructions say they can be dried on a low heat, but since they're 70% bamboo cotton and 30% regular cotton, I think I'll just let them air dry rather than risk shrinkage or distortion. I am very impressed with this makeup remover set. Though I am keeping this set for myself, I consider it very giftable and an excellent value. --Update: My wife likes these pads so much I also ordered a set with a pretty pink and lavender container that has pink and white pads, and a set with a pretty blue container that has light blue and white pads. The system won't let me do the other reviews without overwriting this one, so be advised that I am using the same review for all three sets even though, of course, the pictures for the other containers look different.

title: Quality Steamers at a Reasonable Price & Not Just for Women
text: I've enjoyed a number of different shower steamers over the past few years after discovering some at a resort my wife & I stayed at - so steamers aren't just for women.  I ordered these steamers based on quantity and price.  Eight steamers for $12 is a pretty good deal if the steamers are any good and these are.  I've used two of the steamers so far, the lemon and the sweet orange, and both both smelled good and lasted for more than a single shower.  Used per the directions, placed in a corner not under direct spray, the steamers released a pleasing, relatively strong, true to the indicated fragrance, aroma.  On opening the box I was a bit concerned that the steamers weren't labeled with their scent.  They were packaged with the labels on the underneath side of the individual steamers.  I don't like guessing at what fragrance a steamer has and the labels solve that problem.  This package of steamers would make a nice house warming gift or for most any other occasion.  Highly Recommended.

title: Huge Variety of Sounds, Nice Clear Audio
text: This sound machine is truly impressive with the wide variety of sounds it makes. The instruction manual is detailed and accurate regarding which sounds are there, and in what order, something I don't often find with a sound machine and which I most definitely appreciate. There are six different categories of sound: ASMR (autonomous sensory meridian response, which theoretically stimulates tingling skin and euphoria), Animals, Life, Babies, Nature, and Combination Scene. ASMR includes such unusual sound machine noises as eating potato chips and drinking water, as well as some music selections. The Animals category includes a cicada, pigeon, seagull croak, two different sets of birdsongs, frogs croaking, and crickets. Life includes flipping through a book, a campfire, drinking coffee, keyboard sounds, a train, and a ticking clock. Babies includes two music box selections, two songs being sung, a heartbeat, a lullaby, and ringing. Nature includes dripping water, two different wind sounds, two wave sounds, two thunderstorm sounds, a waterfall, and two rain sounds. Combination Scene includes soft background music (called leisure time), an urban street, a suburban pond, ocean waves, a seashore with playing children with waves and seagulls, an aircraft terminal, a coffee shop, a thunderstorm, sounds in the forest, a farmyard, muffled voices in a library, and something called life force which sounds like blood running though a vein as heard through a stethoscope. There is also a light that can be set at "breathing" (changing intensity), low, medium, and high. There is also a digital readout telling the temperature and the humidity at that location, be it indoors or outdoors. (The instructions do say not to use this sound machine in a high temperature environment, though). There is a timer button (the picture of a clock) with options of 20, 40, or 60 minutes, or continuous playback. There is also a volume button. Press and hold to increase the volume to the desired level, press and hold again to decrease the volume.  On it's own, the sound machine will play each sound one at a time through all the categories. Press the button with bars on it to change from category to category, and the button with musical notes on it to change from sound to sound within the category. If I find one I want to keep listening to, I can press the lock button to keep it set on that sound. It will remember the last sound played when it is next turned on. The sound machine has a battery, and charges via USB cord. The USB-micro USB cord is included, but not a USB to DC adapter. As you can probably tell, I really like this sound machine and all its many features. The original list price was $59.99, but it is currently marked down to $19.99. I think this is an incredibly good deal at this price.

title: Beautiful blue Colr, Very Comfortable Mask
text: I got this gel mask for my wife. She already has similar ones in purple and pink, but blue is her favorite color so she couldn't resist this one. There are no instructions with the mask, only online in the product description. The online instructions say to refrigerate for a minimum of an hour or freeze for a minimum of 30 minutes. The online instructions also include how long to microwave the mask if a heating treatment instead of a cooling treatment is desired. The maximum heating time depends on the wattage of the microwave being used: 700 watts is no more than 15 seconds, 1000 watts is no more than 12 seconds, and 1250 watts is no more than 10 seconds. It warns not to overheat the mask. My wife prefers the cooling treatment. The mask has a cloth side which is very soft and comfortable, and which acts as a barrier to keep the cool gel side from directly contacting her skin. If she wants to wear the mask for an extended period of time, like during a nap, that's the side she uses. The strap has a Velcro closure, and she is able to adjust it to a perfect fit. The other side of the mask is the gel side, and that is much colder against the skin. This is the side my wife uses when she wants a quick treatment, such as for eye strain or a headache. Fridge time of 45 minutes to an hour is plenty for her for a shorter treatment and allows the gel side to be cool, but not uncomfortably cold. She absolutely loves this mask, and finds it very soothing and comfortable.

title: Toenail Clippers Worked Great, Fingernail Clippers Did Not
text: This set consists of a pair of toenail clippers and a set of fingernail clippers. They come in a nice tin box. Inside, there is a form-fitting piece of hard foam with nice cutouts to allow me to easily pick up each pair of clippers. I used the toenail clippers first, and was very pleased with them. The action is smooth, the blade is nice and sharp, and the clippers are very heavy duty. There is a nice ridged area on the end of the handle to allow for a sure grip when using the clippers. The upper half of the handle contains a built-in nail file which does an excellent job of filing. The blades are nicely aligned. Normally I clip my fingernails and toenails right after I get out of the shower, because that's when they are the softest. This time I cut my nails when they were dry and hard, and the toenail clippers had no difficulty whatsoever. Then I switched to the fingernail clippers. The fingernail clippers are just a smaller version of the toenail clippers, same design. Unlike the toenail clippers, however, the fingernail clippers were extremely stiff and hard to press. It took me two hands to close the blade the first time. I figured it was just because they were new, so I kept pressing the handle repeatedly until they loosened up a little. They were still so stiff that I could not use the fingers of my left hand to clip the fingernails on my right hand--the clippers were simply too hard to push down. The only way I could use my left hand to cut my fingernails was if I curled my hand in such a way that I was using the palm of my hand to push the handle down on the clippers. Very awkward at best. I will keep working with the fingernail clippers in the hope that the tension on them will loosen up a bit with repeated use, but they are certainly not my favorite pair at the moment. The toenail clippers rate an easy 5 stars, but the fingernail clippers bring my rating for the entire set down to 3 stars.

title: Very Effective
text: This Avedana pain relieving spray is quick and easy to use. The active ingredient is natural menthol, but it also contains inactive ingredients such as arnica, bosweilla extract, camphor, and a few others which also help with pain relief. The bottle contains 4 fluid ounces, and the expiration date on the bottle I received is 02/2024, which gives me plenty of time to use it. This spray starts relieving pain almost immediately after being applied, and the spray format lets it reach just about anywhere I need it on my body. I can definitely smell the menthol when I first spray it on, but the scent becomes much more subtle very quickly. I'm very happy with this Avedana spray and how it works.

title: Three Nice Fragrances in Easy Roll-on Applicators
text: Love these roll on applicators. They are 3 1/4 inches tall, and they each seal tightly without leakage after being used, so they are convenient for keeping handy in my pocket, desk, or travel kit. Each applicator ball rolls freely and applies a thin layer of oil without dripping. The three scents are Frankincense, Citrus Glow, and Real Love. Citrus Glow is an essential oil blend of orange, lemon, pink grapefruit, bergamot, and vanilla. Real Love is an essential oil blend of Copaiba balsam, pink grapefruit, geranium, , lavender, Ylang ylang, and black pepper. Each bottle contains 10 ml of oil, which should last for quite some time. These oils are USDA certified organic and non GMO, which is a nice plus.

title: Comfortable, Well Made, Breathable, Adjustable
text: Per my wife: There are so many positive things to say about this mask! The design of the mask leaves a nice little air pocket right below my nostrils, making it easy to breathe even when I take a deep breath. Too many times I have felt the discomfort, bordering on paranoia, of feeling a mask sucked up into my nostrils when I was already short of breath. Never a problem with this mask! The adjustable nose band strip lets me get a perfect fit with every wearing so that I have no gaps and so that my glasses don't fog up even with heavy breathing. The wide, soft, stretchy and adjustable ear loops are very gentle on my ears and make it a pleasure to wear this mask for extended periods of time. The inner mesh lining is smooth and comfortable against my face and is also very easy to breath through. The mask comes with two filters, but the overlapping mesh layers inside the mask make me feel quite safe wearing the mask as is without using a filter for my normal everyday activities. It's definitely nice to know I have that option, however, before entering a more crowded or more unsafe environment. This mask is very well made. The stitches are nice and even, and all the outer seams are sewn with good heavy duty thread. The ear loops are a continuation of the upper and lower edges of the mask as opposed to attached separately, which makes for a much stronger mask. the only way those ear loops are coming off is if you physically cut them off. I have tried quite a number of masks over the last year, and so far this one is my definite favorite. 5 stars.

title: Lightweight, Portable, Easy to Use
text: This little round sound machine stands upright on two legs and takes up very little space on a desk, a nightstand, or in a piece of luggage. It is 3 1/2 inches in diameter and about 1 3/4 inches deep. It has a USB charger, and once charged, will run as a stand alone machine. You could run it plugged in if you lay it on its face or tilted it on it's side, but the charger provided will not plug into the upright machine because the legs sit too low for that. It's quite stable both on its side and on its face, though, so it's not a major deal. The operation of the sound machine is super easy. Hold the power button for three seconds to turn it on (or off), turn the front dial to choose one of six sounds (brook, thunder, white noise, wave, wind, or bonfire). Use the + and - buttons to adjust the volume, and use the button with the picture of a light bulb to turn the night light function on. The choices are one light, three lights, or six lights, and the fourth push of that button turns the night light off. The lights fade in and out in as if they are "breathing." The night light, even with all six lights on, is not actually bright enough to function like a night light in the traditional sense--even in total darkness, it does not light up the surroundings enough to be able to see anything except the lights themselves. I think it's purpose is more to give something rhythmic to focus on while falling asleep. The sound machine can be left on continuously, or you can set a timer for increments of 20 minutes ranging from 20-120 minutes. when setting the timer, the number of lit lights, 1-6, multiplied by 20 lets you know what length of time you've set. For a basic, easy to use, lightweight, portable, stand alone sound machine that can be used at home, at work, or while traveling, this little sound machine fits the bill perfectly. 5 stars.

title: Nice Mask, Poor Translation re Health Tips
text: Per my wife: This package comes with two identical masks, so I'll just describe one of them. This is a very nice mask, well fitting, well made, with good facial coverage for me from my nose to under my chin. It has an adjustable nose band, adjustable ear loops, and a slot for a filter if desired. It's made in China, and the Health Tips as written on the package are a little rough as far as the translation. What the package says versus what I believe they meant : "into the bag after use. Carry this product" (keep the storage bag with you to store the mask when not wearing it). "please divide the opposite side" (open the filter slot and use a filter in it). "do not wear back, anti-external will stick dust powder, direct contact between mouth and nose will be detrimental to health." (Don't wear the mask inside out because the outside can get contaminated). "Wash the poison once a day." (Wash off any contaminates daily).  "wash it with warm water first, then bot and hot to dry". (I think "bot" means "blot it off"). So, no, the seller is not saying the mask is poison, as one person thought who rated the mask a one star because of it. This package comes with two very nice masks, a storage bag for the mask when not wearing it, and a mesh laundry bag to put the mask in when it's being laundered. The universal laundry symbols on the mask say to wash cold (though the Health Tips say wash warm), do not bleach, do not dry flat, okay to iron, do not tumble dry, and okay to dry clean using process A (the dry cleaner should know what that means). Since you can't tumble dry the mask per the universal instructions, perhaps "bot and hot to dry" may mean blot the mask off and dry it in the sun or iron it dry. Not sure. In spite of the language barrier in translation, I like the masks, the storage pouch, and the mesh laundry bag. and am rating this complete package 5 stars.

title: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure
text: At the moment I'm not sick so I haven't taken any of the items in this kit. However I'm 68 years old and I have been sick a few times during my 68 years and Vicks has always been a trusted brand in my parents'  and my households.  This kit includes everything a person would need to fight off the flu or a common cold.  The item isn't actually listed yet on Amazon so I don't know what the sale price is going to be and can't comment on the value of the product but I know I'm glad I've got it in reserve.

title: Tiny Soft gel Packs Powerful Punch - Only Take 1 Per Day
text: Hard to believe this tiny little soft gel contains 625% of the recommended daily value of Vitamin D, but it does. 125 mg of D3 equals 5000 IU. These soft gels are so easy to swallow, too. According to the National Institutes of Health, the safe upper daily limit of Vitamin D is 4000 IU daily, so one soft gel is already arguably too much. It takes very little sunlight, as little as 15 minutes a day for light skinned people, to meet their entire daily needs of Vitamin D, never mind the extra Vitamin D taken in through normal dietary sources. The "recommended use" on the label is to take one soft gel in the morning and another at night, which to me seems incredibly risky. The whole point of taking a supplement is to help you stay healthy, not to put you into the hospital with self-induced health problems. Because of how tiny they are and how easy they are to swallow, I would rate these soft gels at 5 stars, as long as they are taken once a day, not twice.

title: Web Page Info Isn't Quite Right
text: #1 Don't believe what you think you see.  The first two photos on the web page make the scrubber head look ridiculously large, it isn't.  It's a normal sized brush head, same as the other brush I use.  The specifications say that the brush is 15" long, it isn't.  It's more like 13 3/4".  It also talks about bristles on both nice, not true.  I'm dinging it one star for the misinformation.  The brush itself is great.  Two sides, one with bristles, one with flexible rubber type protrusions.  The bristles are fairly stiff, which I like for scrubbing in the shower.  The other side feels good dry.  I use it on my lower back kind of like a massager.  Don't pay a lot of attention to the web page info.  It's a very nice shower brush and I recommend it despite the misinformation.

title: Soothing, Great Way to Fall Asleep
text: Went to sleep last night to the sound of water running over stones in a meandering stream.  Also had a soft white light illuminating the bedroom.  Before heading to bed I tried out all of the options offered by this sound machine/nightlight.  It has sounds/music to match most any tastes.  I gravitated to the nature sounds as they were different from other music/sounds I've used to help me go to sleep.  The machine offers nature sounds, short 4 lullabies and six selections of "white music."  One of the "white music" selections is the sound of a running clothes dryer.  That was surprisingly relaxing.  There is only one soft light and it's white.  there are a number of selectable colored lights but for me they were way too bright to be used when going to sleep.  Although the instructions don't mention it, it's possible to set the bright lights to continually change.  The sound quality is surprisingly good.  The controls are very sensitive "touch screen" type and are easy to remember after using the machine a few times.  Especially at the price I think this sound machine is a good deal.  Recommended.

title: Nice Clear Sound, Super Easy to Use
text: This little sound machine has an impressively clear sound to it. After going through the range of nature sounds, white noise, lullabies, color choices, and volumes, I was thoroughly impressed. There were a few surprises. Under the White Noise section, one of the choices was "Fetal Heart Sound," the sound you would hear with a fetal ultrasound. Another was "Clothes Dryer." Both of those sounds were extremely soothing, and something I could easily fall asleep to. I can understand the heartbeat being soothing, but who would have guessed the sound of a clothes dryer would prove to be a peaceful background noise? Of the color choices, my favorite was one called "Colorful Breath Light." That turned out to be simply rolling through the different color choices and intensities, but it was very pleasing to watch, especially with one of the lullabies or nature sounds playing softly in the background. There is also a timer function that allows you to set the timer for 15, 30, 60, 90, or 120 minutes. I like that the user manual that came with it told me exactly what sounds and colors were on the machine so that I didn't have to figure it out by trial and error. I am genuinely enjoying this sound machine. The only hard part is trying to decide whether to keep it on my computer desk or on my bedroom nightstand.

title: Beautiful Mask, Excellent Face Coverage
text: Per my wife: I really, really like these beautiful Galaxy pattern face masks. They provide fantastic coverage of my face from the bridge of my nose down to the end of my chin, without leaving any gaps. They leave a bit more room inside the masks for my nose than all my other masks do, which means there is a little pocket of extra breathing room that I absolutely love. I am a deep breather, and when a mask presses right up against my nostrils whenever I inhale, it makes it hard to breath without feeling like I'm being smothered. These masks come in a pack of two identical masks. Each mask has two filters. The masks are 4-ply masks, not counting the filter, and with that many layers of protection already, I didn't feel like I actually needed the filter for normal everyday use. It's nice to know the option is there, though, and I will keep them in case I need them at some future time. The ear loops are adjustable, and without adjustment they were long enough that they would easily accommodate a face much larger than mine. The elastic of the ear loops was strong but comfortable. The stitches on the mask were tiny and precise, and the material felt quite durable. I have been hesitant to order 4 play masks because the first few that I tried were too hard to breath through, but that is absolutely not the case with these galaxy masks. If I have to wear a mask, I might as well jazz it up a bit, and these galaxy masks are protective, pretty, and fun to wear all in the same package

title: Attractive Gift Bags, Hold a Lot
text: These attractive black gift bags are made of very heavy duty paper stock. The ribbon handles come unattached, but they are simple to put on. There is a plastic wrap around the end of each ribbon, kind of like the wrap on the end of a shoelace except flared at the inner edge, so that when you push the "shoelace" tip through the tiny pre-scored  hole in the bag, the handle can't slip back out again. The ribbon handle is of a good length, about the length on a normal pocketbook, so it's easy to carry the bag. The bag is strong enough to stand up by itself while opened, which makes it easy to load items into it. To give you an idea of its capacity, I was able to fit an entire full length XXL winter women's bathrobe, along with the bag it came in, into this gift bag. These are great gift bags, and the timeless,  stylish design makes them good for gift giving throughout the year.

title: Comfortable, Form Fitting, Well Made
text: These black masks are extremely comfortable. There is no nose bridge, but the way they are designed created a good fit and there was not an issue with my glasses fogging up. They provided good coverage for my face, and I did not have any gaps either on the sides of my face nor at my chin. The ear loops, though not adjustable, were comfortable and were the right length for me. These masks appear to be well made, with two rows of stitching all around the edges. The ear loops have the same double row of stitching holding them in, which is nice. The mask is thick (the description says it has built-in dual filters), so it is a little harder to breathe through than others I own. I would wear something a bit more breathable for exercising or for all-day use, but for running errands around town this mask is great. 5 stars.

title: Bath Boob???
text: Like most, I'm not happy with the title on the front of the box.  Wouldn't have ordered if I'd seen it in the ad on the webpage.  Getting past that, the "bombs" aren't that good.  They're larger than most but the fragrance isn't very strong.  There's nothing in or on the box to indicate the fragrance of each bomb.  I can guess but I'd rather know. title: OK, but doesn't solve my nose breathing problem
text:
Since the pandemic started, I’ve been trying all kinds of masks, mask extenders, face shields, you name it. One problem I have with a lot of masks is that they press down on the tip of my nose and reduce the amount of air going through my small nostrils, one of which already has problems because of a deviated septum. I’ve turned away from the classic folded mask because of this issue, but I also have it with several different kinds of cloth masks. When I saw this bracket, I wondered if it might be the solution to my problem.

When I received these brackets, I held one in place while I put on a cloth mask. This is a task that would go better if I had three hands, but I managed. Once the cloth mask was secured, it held the bracket in place. The bracket keeps the mask away from my lips, which would be great if I wore lipstick. It provides some space, which made the mask feel a little less claustrophobic, but it didn’t do anything to stop the mask from pressing on the tip of my nose. So, while this bracket does what it’s intended to do, it’s not very useful to me.

If you are looking for a mask that doesn’t press on your nose and doesn’t touch your lips, I recommend you get some KN95 masks. Their design really works well at sealing at all the edges, but leaving space around your nose and mouth. The KN95s are a lot easier to find these days, too.

title: Cute & Nice Controls, Just Didn’t Make Much of a Difference on My Lashes
text:
This comes in an outer product box - There’s a cardboard sleeve, and a box slides out from the sleeve. It is made in China. It comes with a little information pamphlet, which I always appreciate since things like that since it seems like so often they aren’t included in things!

It says that it has a temperature display, ceramic heating, four-gear temperature is optional, intelligent temperature control, and dynamic curling.

The charging cord is underneath the plastic shelf in the box holding the eyelash curler.

It has a nice look to it. It is lightweight. The cap is on good. It isn’t going to fall off easily.

The on/off button is the long gold button (see photos). To turn it on, you hold the on/off button down for a few seconds. Then you will see a temperature on the LCD screen. There’s 4 different temperatures you can set it to - 60C, 70C, 80C, and 90C (which is 140F, 158F, 176F, and 194F). To set the temperature you want you just hit the on/off button until it changes to the temperature you want. To turn it off you just hold down the on/off button for a couple seconds. I noticed when I turned it off on a certain temperature, when I would turn it back on it would still be at that temperature. So it’s nice you don’t have to keep setting it to the temperature you want.

The battery display is to the right of the temperature. It’s nice that you can see how much battery you have left. Out of the box I was able to use it without charging it first. It had 2 bars.

The pamphlet says that the curler will shut down automatically after 10 minutes of use. That’s nice in case you forget to turn it off yourself.

This is NOT waterproof so you can NOT use water to clean it. The pamphlet says, “If it is necessary to clean the brush head, please clean with cleaning brush and then wipe with flannel cloth. Do not wash with water.” It also says that you can “NOT wash it with water, alcohol, detergent, mercury, alkaline, or acidic products.”

Even on the lowest heat setting, 60 C (140 F), it feels pretty darn hot. I wasn’t too sure how comfortable I felt holding something so hot against my eye like that. I used it how it described but I didn’t notice a huge difference. They did get a little curl, but it wasn’t much. It just kind of pushed them up a little and they stayed there. tried it quite a few more times and just never noticed it doing too much. Unfortunately, it wasn’t enough of a difference for me to want to go through the process of using it.

Overall, this isn’t for me. I’m not sure if it’s me not doing something right, my lashes, or something else, but the little lift that this gave wasn’t enough of a difference to make it worth the hassle of using it. Maybe I needed to use a higher heat setting, but 60C felt pretty darn hot to me, and I didn’t feel comfortable going any hotter and having to hold it so close to my eye. So, it’s just a no for me. I give it 3 stars for the curler itself - it’s nice, looks nice, feels durable - and the controls - I like how it has an LCD screen, I like that it shows battery display, and I like that it turns off automatically after 10 minutes of use. I just didn’t like the results I got, so I took off 2 stars for that. So I give it 3 stars.

Maximum Power: <2.5W

Product Size: 133*19mm

This pad is thicker than most I've tried and it's heavier. Both of those are caused by the stones that are sewn right into it. Supposedly the jade and other stones help to hold heat longer and the infrared is supposed to help the heat penetrate better. This even comes with a velcro strap and two slots on the back side, so that you can say strap it around your lower back. Usually when I take the heating pad off my back or neck, it's not very long before the pain or stiffness comes back. When I used this pad, it's hours before the pain and stiffness comes back. This is very well made, with neat stitching throughout. It seems very durable and so far I've had no problems whatsoever. I feel like the controller is a little cheap, but it works well and hasn't malfunctioned at all. In face, it remembers my settings, so that the next time I use it, I just turn it on and it sets itself to my preferred temperature. It does take a little longer to heat up than regular heating pads do.

Overall, I love this heating pad and it's my favorite yet!

title: Feel a lot safer using this with 99.9% cleaning rate.
text:
I got a little tired of using and cleaning my daily personal items with sanitizer so when I saw this , I just had to get it. With the current pandemic and environment, we need all the extra help we can get and this little portable UV bag does just that. The other reason is because I hate to throw away my masks after just one or two uses and wanted something to clean as well as disinfect so I can at least re-use the same mask a couple more times at least. Although these UV bags are a little pricey nowadays, I do think that it will save me money over time and definitely worth the price for a little extra safety measure.

So this is an Ultraviolet C or UVC with with a 260-280 nm wavelength, these type of UV lights are also useful in germicidal irradiation, in other words, a method to kill or inactivate microorganism by disrupting their DNA and destroying their nucleic acids. So by placing phones, keys, masks or other items into this bag and turn on the disinfection function and timer, I feel a lot better using or reusing my personal items after each surface cleaning and disinfecting process is completed. At the same time, I am not letting my guards down, I still wash my hands with soaps as often or as needed and practicing all the recommended CDC safety protocols as well.

Setting up this is very easy, after removing the bottom plate and metal shelf out of the box, just pull the sides of the bag and it will pop up. Connect the red and black wires from the bag to the bottom tinfoil and reflection plate accordingly and slowly place the plate onto the bottom of the bag without pulling the wires too much that it may damage the wirings. Once done, flip the tinfoil flap from the top of the bag to cover the visible wires on the side of the bag. Place the metal shelf onto the bottom of the bag, place your items on the shelf, close the lid and zip up. Plug in the USB cable press the ON button and it should automatically turn itself off in about 5 minutes once the surface cleaning and disinfecting process is done, and that should be it. There is a little peep window at the front of the bag that you can see when the UV lights are on or off. A must have tool to fight with this pandemic.

title: Look For Best Price; All Alcohol Pads About The Same
text:
Lots of alcohol pads are offered by lots of sellers. But all the sellers are selling basically the same thing: cotton pads saturated with 70% isopropyl rubbing alcohol.

There is not much that can be done to differentiate one brand from another. Most are 1.25”x1.25” 2-ply pads in sealed 2”x2” packets to keep the alcohol from evaporating. A few may offer larger pads to justify a higher price, but the smaller standard pad is all you need to sanitize a thermometer or hypodermic needle, or to prepare a spot on someone's body for an injection

The same is true for those promoting 4 ply pads. Again, for most users these 2-ply pads are all you need. Why pay more for the oversized ones?

When I was looking for alcohol pads LotFancy had the best price per pad. That is why i bought theirs. It still looks to me as though the still have the best deal, so I recommend you buy theirs. They are all that I and most users need.

title: Good Brush For Scrubbing Your Back In The Shower
text:
This is an excellent bath brush. The handle is the perfect length for scrubbing my back when showering and the bristles are thick but not sharp. They don't scratch when I rub the brush over my back but I feel that it is getting a good cleaning.

The brush comes in 2 parts-- the brush and handle, both wood. The idea is you can remove the handle and use just the brush to, for example, scrub another person’s back in the bathtub or shower. Some brushes have a strap across the handle of the brush to make it easier to scrub with, but this brush does not.

Since I only use the brush to scrub my back in the shower, a removable handle is a bit of a negative. I have learned from experience using a similar 2-part brush that sooner or later, after repeated wetting, the brush starts falling off the handle when you scrub your back. So the first thing I did when I got this brush was to use wood glue to permanently attach the handle to the brush.

I recommend that anyone who will be using the brush only to scrub their own back do the same

Regarding the decorative rope wrapped around the handle it looks nice, but I expect it to become grungy from my soapy hands over time. However, it is easy to remove and taking it off will in no way affect its ability to give me a good back scrub.

There is a small loop at the end of the handle, but it is sized for hanging the brush from a hook or a nail. I replaced it with a bigger loop so I can hang it over one of the water handles of the shower.

Sample provided at a discount to test and review.

title: Just Like the Brand Name Except Poorly Packaged
text:
Petroleum Jelly (often called "Vaseline"--a brand name) used to be considered the treatment for just about any skin related need. It was used to soften dry hands, cure chapped feet, control unruly eyebrows, heal sun or wind-burned skin and treat wounds. Simply apply the petroleum jelly liberally to your face or wherever you’ve been chapped or burned or injured and all would be fine. Today we have more sophisticated (and expensive) topicals and ointments, but it's good to see that petroleum jelly is still around.

An Amazon Brand, Solimo Petroleum Jelly White looks and feels just like that well known brand. It is even in the same type container. However, the packaging process is suspect. None of the containers in the pack of four was completely full. In fact, there was significant air space in each leading me to believe that maybe 70% of the product was in each container. Some air space, of course, is to be expected, but not this much air space.

Rather than tightly wrap each individual container, Amazon has elected to loosely wrap all four containers in plastic wrap. That caused some of the product to leak out causing the containers to feel greasy. This could explain some of the product loss, but certainly not all of it.

As a petroleum jelly, Solimo Petroleum Jelly isn't bad. However, Amazon needs to reconsider how the product is packaged and wrapped so that the consumer gets the value that they paid for when they made the purchase.
