title: Take your emotional temperature!
text:
Our family has been delighted with the results we have seen using the First Assist stress monitor.

When the package arrived our teen and pre-teen son opened it right away and began experimenting!
They have been encouraged to be able to identify, and more importantly, take action when stress/anxiety levels are rising.
It is simple to use, first determine your baseline and then monitor your stress levels so you can take action early.

One day my son was wearing a patch all day and was going to go outside for awhile ( the instructions say to wear patch indoors) and he put the patch on my hand while I was sitting in the Living Room listening to music and said , "Hang onto this for me 'til I come back in." I left the patch on and closed my eyes and simply listened to the music. I was already "in the green" and didn't try to alter my mood intentionally. I opened my eyes and I had moved up one level into the green! So simple, yet we are so busy and often forget the simple things we can to to take care of ourselves!

I think it would be especially valuable for people who have difficulty identifying their mood - "Who me? Angry? I don't get angry." I also think it is valuable for family communication. Both people communicating (parent/child, husband/wife, etc.) could wear the patch and watch for rising stress levels to keep the communication healthy.

Our family has found this little tool valuable in our lives - we are big fans!

But after two few seconds dips into this cleaner and it was back to a beautiful silver necklace.
It has a mild scent until silver is put into the solution. Then almost a sulfur smell. I would be careful of getting the solution on stone, marble or quartz counters. It wasn’t caustic on my hands but it’s a chemical product. I took it into our laundry room with laminate counters and next time I will clean in the garage. Rinsing and drying are required after dipping into the solution.
If you have a little dullness, the silver polishing cloths are easy. But for more extensive tarnishing, this is perfect!

title: It's not bad...
text:
It's not bad, but that doesn't mean it's good either. Hopes that were perhaps too high, coupled with a price tag that is most assuredly too high (and an equally ridiculous restocking fee on returns), equals a cushion that I will ultimately keep but will forever wish was better. I've used this cushion everyday for over a month now, and here are my observations

PRO: Yes, it provides good support while relieving pressure. My tailbone is typically now hurting less after being in my desk chair >6 hours. However, unfortunately, I think the benefit ends here for me

CONs:
-The pressure relief comes at a price. The actual skin on my backside and back of thighs gets very sore and sensitive from the honeycomb-ish pattern. So much so that even a month later, I still have to take occasional breaks from the cushion (in spite of my usual breaks from sitting).
-The manufacturer who advertise "cool comfort" must be living in perhaps an oven if they think this cushion is any cooler than any other cushion I've tried. This cushion be over here keepin' it swassy like all the others!
-The "no-slip design" would perhaps be no-slip if it were on a chair made of glue. Or maybe a shag carpet. Or in an alternate reality. But if you put it on a chair, the little bumps on the bottom of the cover seem only to help it to slip even more than one would expect. Like, I literally have to adjust it about every hour or so because it...just...slips...all...the...time
-It's huge. I'm well aware there are measurements provided in the description. But however many times you measured, and however big you are expecting it to be in your mind...it's bigger than that. Good luck fitting it on your chair of choice.

A couple of side thoughts based on some even more negative reviews I read: the indentation on one half of the cushion is a "feature" not a defect - it's supposed to be there to give your tailbone even greater relief from pressure. Not sure how one user had the cushion for an entire year and never noticed it, then thought it had compressed under their weight. Secondly, the user who posted a picture saying the cover didn't fit clearly tried to put the cushion into the cover sideways lol. If you follow the super easy instructions that come with the cushion, it fits in rather perfectly.

title: Love this product and I'm driving again after a year on the sideline
text: I bought my portable left foot accelerator directly from Mike after talking with him about the device in early September 2021. My car is a 2013 Kia Soul and I installed the device right on the rug. The device is super grippy - digs right into the carpet pile. I kicked it several times to try to dislodge it and I couldn't. Accelerating with the left foot pedal is weird at first but it's a comfortable pedal. I like the sandpapery finish on base and on pedal - I never feel like my foot is going to slip off. I did NOT want an installed left foot accelerator as I'm taking driving lessons with one and  I don't like the "foot feel" at all. My only issue to date is cramping with my right calf while I'm driving as there is no place to rest/stretch out the right leg with this device. You really can't give into resting your right foot on that fixed panel in front of the accelerator! Very bad idea.  Overall, I'm very happy about the way this device works and I love that it is portable and NOT bolted into the frame of my car.

It doesn't help that you usually set it right before you go to sleep...when you're exhausted and you can barely remember anything, much less this overly-complicated process!

First, you will miss strips of hair where the razor blade heads come together in the middle. Meaning you will need to constantly go over the same spots to make sure it has been shaved. If you have shaved your back before this is not something you want to be doing as contorting your body and arms to reach the right places becomes tiresome. Other products have large continuous blades that do not have this issue.

Second, because these are regular razor blades in the product, they are not the best for shaving longer hairs. They will gunk up quickly and wear down fast. Again, having this happen when shaving your back makes the process take much longer.

The handle also does not have a “folding” function meaning there is no way to reduce the length when done. This just makes it an inconvenience to store.

Finally, the price for the replacement blades cost the most of any other back shaver I have seen for an inferior design.

TLDR: This can work, but its design is inferior to other products that will shave your back closer and quicker for similar, if not cheaper prices.

title: By far the best spoof i have every used!
text:
I have been smoking and vaping for over 15 years and have used many a spoof to cover my tracks. I now only vape but this thing still works just as well if not better with vapor. Moving anywhere near someone who doesn't smoke can be stressful for me but especially if I know I won't have the opportunity to go outdoors. In the past, this would lead me to use a spoof; generally a Poland spring bottle with lots of tiny pin holes on the bottom filled with drier sheets, ozium or what ever helps eliminate smoke. The problem with spoofs is they really don't work. Their also pretty irritating to make as you need to find the right size bottle, then finding the filler is even more frustrating as drier sheets are not always handy. Ontop of all that, you need to use it several times to get the airflow right and to figure out how much, if any, smoke it removes. Normally this results in air that smells both like Lysol and weed but is rarely effective. (it also begs the question.."Why does it smell like Lysol and weed in here?")
With the smoke buddy, i can take a huge, milky bag of volcano vapor and the result will be no smell in the room. Its pretty amazing to see a bag full of vapor just disappear as it goes through the device. I'm pretty sure the "magic" inside is just activated carbon as i am familiar with its carbon scrubbing attributes but man, does it ever work! The most smoke or vapor you'll see will undoubtedly come from the gap between the plastic mouthpiece and your mouth. It can be a bit tricky to get it to seal properly (especially if you have a beard) but if you stick your lips out just right, absolutely nothing will come out the other end. This thing is so effective, its a MUST have if you light up in the car. You'll feel just as stupid as i did once you realize this things been around while you've been doing arts and crafts with water bottles and drier sheets all these years!

Other than that, its a good product and i would only use this for traveling because of how easy it is to clean and compact.

I am hard on companies that don't deliver what they advertise.
The quality of the file itself isn't terrible, but as several other reviewers have stated, the grit on both sides appears to be the same. At least I couldn't tell any difference. I have used one of the older files that other people also spoke of in their reviews, and the difference in grit was quite noticeable. It feels like they just split the difference between those two grits in the new files and made them the same in both sides. I guess I don't have a problem with shaping so much; but the finishing side of the older files is far superior to the grit of these new ones.
Many people will probably be happy with this file; but like I said above, I don't like it when a company tells me I'm going to get one thing, but it winds up not being up to their promises.

text:
I had been using foam plugs for years and needed to replace them. I saw these and thought they would be great, the reviews were wonderful so I gave them a try. I need them to block out my husbands snoring.

I used these 3 nights in a row and not once did they block my husbands snoring.

I have small ear canals (so I always have to use to smallest earbuds available) and these were just too big for my ears. The first night I put them in and they felt comfortable but they kept falling out. Turns out I didn’t have them pushed in the whole way. I thought this might also be why they weren’t cancelling the snoring. So I pushed them in as far as they would go and man was that uncomfortable. They were so tight in my ear that I could hear/feel my pulse by my ears which made it impossible to sleep. They gave me a terrible headache so I had to take them out.

I wanted so badly for these to work but unfortunately they aren’t for me. I’ll be returning them and getting foam plugs again.

title: My new favorite ear plugs *and* are great for motorcycle riding
text:
Over the years, I've really had horrible luck with any earphones (or earplugs, in this case) that use silicone tips. They either don't seal in one of my ears, or the seal simply doesn't last. I've tried Etymotic ear plugs which DO seal properly, but they feel...umm.... violating. Super deep-seated.

Loop Earplugs ACTUALLY work for my ears! Not only are they the most comfortable ear plugs I've ever worn, they look good and work surprisingly well. I really do love them.

All that said, if you're looking for maximum sound reduction, then these aren't for you. They're intended to bring the overall volume down about 20 db, while still allowing most sound in, but at a reduced (and clear) volume. These are great for motorcycle riding (block wind noise, but allow important sounds), concerts, sleeping, or anything else can think of where allowing some sound in is very important.

Great work, Loop!

title: The "action" is good, but the product construction and engineering is very ...
text:
The "action" is good, but the product construction and engineering is very poor. I have already had to pitch my unit in the dumpster as 3 of the 4 supports for the motor---that which produces the vibrating action--- have slowly cracked and now broken completely. There is no fix to this kind of a problem. I was curious about the 4 head design so tried the product. Yet there is an engineering problem which could have been avoided by simple heavier construction at the connecting point of the supports to the outside plastic body of the unit. So I recommend to NOT buy this unit. I have owned several of the Homedics units over the past twenty years (at a lower cost). I just ordered another one to replace this unit after only using for two months.

And I can add the infrared is completely misleading. It's simply led lights shining through a red lens on the end of the unit. I provides no real "heat", yet the advertising leads one to believe that it does. Buy the Homedics for less money. They wear out too, but mainly it's the electrical cord near where it goes into the unit. That can be repaired and the unit put back into service. And I can depend on about two years of service.

text:
First of all, I'd like to say that ALL the bad or less than great reviews by some purchasers, are without fundament. This is a really good product and, you can't beat the price ! On top of that the seller : Drive Medical (thru Amazon) delivered the product inside of 3 days
As soon as it came, I put the hose inside of a 3/4" PVC pipe and left it to relax overnight to get the coil shape out of it.
The diverter valve is sturdy plastic and, well made (mine came a little hard to operate but, with a little silicone spray and gentle twisting back and forth, it finally operated freely and smoothly.
Now for the installation: You have to use your imagination and think that you just can't dry-screw the fittings the way they came : You HAVE to use Teflon tape on the male parts of ALL the fittings including the hand held shower attachment(otherwise they all are going to leak!). Don't forget to use the three washers that came with it.Just remember that all the fittings for this product are plastic and cannot be overtightened with a wrench !!.

The only part I do not like is the holder because the shower attachment keeps slipping off; if you'd rather not drill holes in the wall use silicone to hold it. The dog is going to love this thing and ,so will my back. Would highly recommend it, don't let the nay-sayers and "un-handy" installers sway you. I took a chance because the price will mislead you into thinking it's a cheap product but, I was pleasantly proven wrong.

title: great mosquite protection for my toddler
text:
We are in a heavily wooded area near a creek in Central Texas. Mosquitos get very bad and the season lasts more than half a year. In addition, it is very sunny and hot. I did not want to use the DEET spray on my 18 month toddler. The spray just engulfs you in DEET, so I was looking for an alternative that also goes on better. The bug repellent stuff is 7.5% of beta-alanine, n-acetyl-N-butyl-ethyl esther (IR3535)/carboxylic acid. I have no idea what it is, but it works. The tube states to ask a doctor before using it on kids less than 6 months of age.

It is a big bonus that Avon has the sun protection with it. It also contains Vitamin E and Aloe. The sunscreen ingredients are the typical stuff like Ocinoxate 7.5%, Oxybenzone 6.0% and Octisalate 5.0%. The stuff smells pleasantly. It looks like a sunscreen and it goes on like a sunscreen. Make sure to shake the tube before applying because the contents may separate after a while.

Today, my toddler was covered in Avon and I was covered in DEET. The mosquito got me and skipped my little one. So the stuff works. The tube states to reapply every 2 hours or sooner for continued insect protection if effectiveness diminishes. I have not done that since we were ok so far but we have not hit the worst of the mosquito season yet.

I was a bit surprised about the short shelf life of this product. I bought it directly from Avon and the expiration is about a year from when I bought it. However, I will probably use it up in the next few months.

title: Skin So Soft Combats Flies and Prevents Sunburn On My Horses' Noses
text: Probably not what Avon intended, but I have two Arabian horses that live in a pasture year round. Due to an extremely heavy rainfall this year, groundwater/mud puddles have been excessive and with them, so is the black fly crop! They are thick everywhere, and annoying as can be for horses, especially on their muzzles where their fly masks don't cover their skin. Commercially formulated equine bug spray works great on most of their bodies, but the facial area requires something different. A friend told me that she remembered using Avon SSS as a very effective insect repellent on her horses' faces when she was young, so I decided to give it a try. Around the muzzle and nostrils is very sensitive, so I was looking for something that would keep the flies away, but was gentle on the skin. Avon SSS works fantastically in this application. I apply a small amount each day to the area and so far...no flies. And I got a bonus...it contains sun screen as well as bug repellent, so it also helps prevent sunburn...and I guess they like the fragrance, because they both stand very quietly while I apply it to their faces...maybe they know what it does to keep them comfortable! I am thrilled with this product!!!

title: The Ultimate Defense Mechanism Against Mosquitoes
text:
It’s summertime, and you know what that means: attack of the mosquitoes!

As someone who enjoys being outside, and spends a significant amount of time outside as a result, I absolutely cannot stand the tiny terrors that we refer to as mosquitoes. I have had clusters of boil-like bumps and bruises (from scratching) all over my arms, legs, and back caused by presumed planned attacks from these fun-sized invaders.

I proceeded to conduct some research about why I am such a significant target. Subsequently, I learned that mosquitoes are more attracted to individuals with an O blood type, our metabolic rates, the amount of CO2 our bodies release (so, basically just breathing), and dark clothing. Upon acquiring this new-found knowledge, I decided to spend a day outside in all-white clothing, sitting dead still, and holding my breath —since I can’t change my blood type, I just let my body continue to circulate my tainted blood which serves as a siren song for these suckers— and, to my anti-climactic surprise, it didn’t work. I returned home with the same amount of battle scars and scratched myself to sleep.

I decided to air my grievances with some friends and was told to try AVON Skin-So-Soft. Apparently, it acts as a body moisturizer, a sun screen, and a bug guard. Thrilled at the news, I placed an order on Amazon and received my defense mechanism a day later (thanks to Amazon Prime).

Today, I applied the lotion and prayed to the bug guard gods to protect me from the minuscule evils that enjoy fulfilling their bloodlust through my skin. I am absolutely overjoyed to announce that I have not been bitten once since using the lotion and will be sacrificing a handful of mosquito carcasses to the bug guard gods in thanks.

If you are suffering alongside me, I highly recommend AVON Skin-So-Soft as a defense mechanism against these vampiric pests. The battle may have been won but the war is far from over.

title: Heaven for sore plantar fascia
text:
Unlike the other reviewer, I haven't had a problem with the o-rings coming off. About those o-rings...I love using them to better dig into my foot. I use the middle for promoting blood flow. This is best used on hard floors or harder carpeting. It's not the best outdoors on grass or dirt since it doesn't roll very well. While a hard ball works great on the ground or in the hand, I don't find this product to be effective when I hold it in my hand...I believe the shape doesn't allow me to transfer enough force from my hand to my foot. That said, it's obvious that this device is meant to be rolled on the ground, so I won't take away a star because of that, but thought it was something buyers should be aware of.

UPDATE: Another year has passed, and I still haven't had a problem with the o-rings coming off. My roller still looks brand new. I don't use my roller as often anymore because my plantar fasciitis has gone away. I would still highly recommend this to anyone with plantar fasciitis. I keep mine under my desk so I can massage my feet while spending too many hours seated in front of my computer.

If you're looking for a ball like I mentioned earlier, a wooden ball the size of a tennis ball would be ideal. A pool table ball works, but is a little slippery. Old style roller hockey pucks work too, but the newer pucks are bounce resistant and much too soft to really dig into sore muscles.

title: did not work
text:
I not only did not loose weight, I gained! The first time I tried the product, I gained 5 pounds the first week. I did not change my 1500-1600 calorie diet. I went off the product for two weeks and lost the 5lbs. I also notice less swelling of my feet and hands. I tried the product again, increading it from 800mg/day to 1200mg/day, I gained 3 pounds in three days. The swelling returned. Another significant side-effect was severe constipation.

I have read reviews from adults over the age of 50 with similar results as my own.(I am 58) Although, I do believe the reports of positive results, I think there needs to be more research, especially in people over 50. I also wonder about possible cholinergic effects (which results in fluid retention, dry mouth and consipation, among other things). The bottom line -- perhaps we need to be more careful about how positive this product is being presented, especially by a health care professional.

title: You get what you pay for
text:
This is a case of getting what you pay for. Service was excellent and prompt from the seller, but the sais themselves were a disappointment. The advertisement showed these had been marked down from $105 to $29, leading one to believe these were one of the better-quality pair of sais that had been marked down on sale. The balance is not quite right on them, making it awkward to flip them out. They are a bit too heavily weighted on the handle for the length of the blades. The handle itself has cheap plastic wrapping it, not leather. The bend of the two little side-prongs is not as depicted in the photo (they are bent at a right angle, making it difficult to do anything except a basic underhanded flip, not a graceful curve as shown in the photo). If you are only doing basic sai katas, it won't be a problem, but if you plan on using these for some of the more advanced showboating used at Extreme Martial Arts competitions, these sais won't do the trick. When you clash the sais together (a test of the quality of the steel) they make a dull-sounding hollow clang, not a nice crisp ringing like quality sais make.

Overall, for $23, I feel I got a pair of $23 sais (not $105 ones that had been marked down on sale). I am going to pass these down to one of the younger students to learn basic forms on, but will keep looking for an upgrade for myself.

title: Works surprisingly well, basically invisible
text:
I wanted the option to add filters to my G16 (circular polarizer, gradient density), but didn't want to change the size, weight, or convenience. The Lensmate system simply adheres a very slim base on the front of the lens, when you then twist on a light adapter to which you can screw a normal 52mm filter. Without the base, there's no visible difference. With the base, the camera still closes and works as normal.

Included is a lens cap (which you can use with the adapter or when there's a filter on), a guide tube, and even a unique tool to remove the base. Far superior to Canon's solution (a screwed on tube adapter), this is a clever and well-made product.

title: Small size suction is not enough
text:
I am 52 years old with no much wrinkles, but definitely with less skin texture firmness. Cupping is good for this. I tried the cups only once.
I plan to use Rapunzel cupping set on the daily basis. The large cups, work well. I ordered these cups in place of the main brand which runs close to $30. Rapunzel had the best price and the highest customers satisfaction stars.
I actually bought these because of the negative reviews on suction, someone mentioned how they leave a mark, I thought these were just about the right ones for me as they would have provided me with generous suction.
I am very acquainted with cupping for cellulite. In fact I have been using the small cellulite cupping on my face. The cellulite body cups (different brand) provide much more suction but unfortunately they are too big for face area.
I found the Rapunzel Facial cupping set size small for small are to lack of suction. This was the opposite of the negative customer review I actually read.
The small cups of the facial cupping set are used for under the eye mostly, The entire concept of cupping is to activate circulation which eventually help skin texture. Strong suction is necessary at different levels for different part of the face. For me personally, I found the suction of the small area cups is too weak to even do anything to stimulate circulation and drainage of fluid under the eye bag area. I massaged with coconut oil going over for well beyond the recommended 5 minutes. I could not even see a hint of redness or the feeling of activated circulation.
I gave the cupping set 3 stars because of the weakness in suction. Other than that, the cups are well made and sturdy.
I would recommend this product to individuals who never done cupping as it would provide a very safe and less invasive skin treatment.

title: I was amazed at how quickly I felt the influence
text:
While surfing the web one Sunday afternoon I came across ‘Nootropics Supplement for Memory, Focus, Clarity Enhancement - Boosts Cognition, Brain Function & Concentration - With DMAE, Bacopa, Acetyl L Tyrosine, & Huperzine A - 60 Capsules’. Claiming to be a brain booster I thought to myself, sure it is as I haven’t had much luck with other products in that regard. The product was on sale and the price was especially good so I decided why not, I’ll give it a try, the worst it can do is flare my IBD for a short time which is not a high price to pay for a product that could potentially be a long term winner. I was receiving the product at a discount in exchange for an honest review so I clicked through the buying process and sure enough the Amazon Prime delivery van dropped the box at my door in two days flat.

When I opened the package I had a good look at the proprietary blend of ingredients which included;
“DMAE Bitartrate, L Glutamine, Glutamic Acid, Green Tea Extract, Bacopa Extract, Choline, Inositol, N Acetyl L Tyrosine, Bilberry Fruit Extract, GABA, Grape Seed Extract, Grape Fruit Seed Extract, Olive Leaf, Cinnamon Bark Extract, Licorice Root Extract, Boron, DHA, Vanadyl Sulfate, Phosphatidylserine, Huperzine A, Vitamin A, Vitamin C, Vitamin D, Vitamin E, Vitamin B1, Vitamin B2, Vitamin B3, Vitamin B6, Folic Acid Pure, Biotin, Vitamin B5, Calcium, Iron, Magnesium, Zinc, Selenomethionine, Copper, Manganese, Chromium, Molybdenum, Potassium”.

Reading the list over I saw many of the ingredients listed are of plants and minerals which I have had an interest in for many years now. The issues I have found with these is getting them in the proper quantities to effect a positive influence. Hoping for the best I decided to take a half dose, just one single pill, as my system seems to be prone to reacting poorly from ingesting new things as well as prone to being overly sensitive to excessive quantities. I must say I was amazed at how quickly I felt the influence. Within a half hour or so, I was not only clearly focused, I was also highly energized, without jitters. I found myself driven in ways that aren’t typical for me without having taken a supplement specifically for such a thing so there is no doubt in my mind that this product not only works but works quite well.
I realize this review is a bit lengthy however if you have read any my other reviews you will see that is not my typical practice, this is also testimony as to how much like this product. I would not hesitate to recommend it anyone, especially those with IDB and ADD.

title: More economical and an easy install
text:
Our AC service technicians have been recommending installation of UV lights in our plenum for the last couple of years but the price was outrageous - over $1000 for the two units. They did point out some small moldy areas in one of the units on a recent visit so I decided to do a bit more research. I happened to pull up my Amazon app on noted this unit as the daily deal at $25 off so decided to give it a try. This is a much more economical option and was simple to install. I started by marking the position, drilling 4 1/2” holes for each hole, and then using tin shears to clean up the holes. Rather than inserting and using the provided duct tape strips I purchased some adhesive seal strip from local hardware store and applied around the holes which provides good sealing and allows access for checking/changing bulbs without messing with tape.
While it’s difficult to objectively assess the effectiveness of the units, particularly in the short-term, I’ll try to check back in at a later date with an update.

title: Is not dangerous to humans as it’s made out to be by the first reviewer
text:
Enterococcus faecium strains were isolated from an original biotope, artisanal dried Tunisian meat “Dried Ossban,” and evaluated for safety and capacity as probiotics. Gram-positive, catalase negative, and bacteriocin-producing bacteria were screened using selective microbiological media. All isolates were identified by phenotypic and molecular tools. Five E. faecium strains (MZF1, MZF2, MZF3, MZF4, and MZF5) were selected and further assessed for their probiotic properties. They were found to be resistant to the physiological concentrations of bile salts, and the harsh conditions of the gastrointestinal tract, and showed autoaggregation and adhesion ability. All these isolates possess at least one enterocin and could efficiently inhibit the growth of Listeria innocua HPB13. The analysis of their safety profile revealed for almost all the strains the absence of cytotoxicity and virulence determinants, and susceptibility to clinically important antibiotics such as vancomycin. These data suggest that these bacteria, isolated from “Dried Ossban,” do not present a risk to human health, and may be considered as interesting candidates for future use as probiotics and bioprotective cultures for application in the food and/or feed industries.

Keywords: Enterococcus faecium, probiotics, Dried Ossban, safety, antibiotic resistance, virulence determinants

title: It works on fleece!
text: My husband's cat suddenly decided to start urinating in the laundry. It turned out to be UTI, but the damage was done. Someone placed a peed upon blanket on the downstairs laundry shelf and didn't mention.  I kept passing the area and looking for the source of the dreaded smell. I finally realized it was a nice stretchy fleece blanket that was neatly folded and sitting on the shelf. You know how you have that one blanket that you just really like? Not expensive, but just right for cuddling up on the couch to watch a show or read a book. I didn't want to toss it.  The urine had dried on it by the time I found it and I couldn't pin point the direct area for a spot cleaning. I ended up placing the blanket in the bath tub and filled it just over the top of blanket. I added two ounces of Scout's Honor Booster to it and swished it around to be sure it was well mixed and saturated the blanket. I let it soak for a few hours. I then took the still rather sopping blanket to the wash and ran it through a regular wash with an extra rinse. Air dried. The blanket has no scent...NO SCENT left on it! I have a sensitive nose and if I can detect the slightest scent, I know for sure the cat will and may decided to use it again. All other products I  have used up until this point have left a slight lingering urine odor on towels, blankets, clothing.  I foster for a non profit animal rescue and if one cat goes on something, others will follow.  This is much worse when you have an adult male cat that has just been neutered and his body hasn't gotten rid of all the hormones yet.  It takes some cats longer than others to lose that strong male cat urine smell. I love cats but I hate their smell. I freak out if I smell the slightest odor because I feel like my home is dirty and gross. I worry about inviting anyone over or God forbid, going to work and having someone ask "Wow, so you h ave cats?" It's a legit fear for me. I have started adding one ounce of this product to every pet laundry load. I think most products are overrated and hyped. Many make promises that just don't live up to the hype.  I have hesitated on Scout's Honor products due to the price. This one is well worth it. A little does go a long way. I don't know what's in it, but it works. Oh, and it also gets out other organic odors like sweat from a young teenager that seems to be on some sort of bathing strike despite the "soap can be your friend" talk.

Don't be as stupid as me. Read the ingredients before you buy. If you have an allergy to pine trees, don't put it on your glasses. They won't slip, but your eyes will swell shut. One of the ingredients is Gum Rosin.
"Gum rosin was once the only commercial source of rosin. It is the oleoresin (pine gum) of the living pine tree. The harvesting of the oleoresin is simple, involving only periodic wounding of the tree and collecting the sap into cups."
Hopefully I can find a friend to give it away to.

title: Waste of Money!!!!
text: I ordered this test because of the past few years, my body has undergone many significant changes. I suddenly was experiencing sensitivities like never before. I had already figured out I am extremely gluten sensitive. I ordered the test, it came in, I took the hair samples required and then some, sent it all off within 24 hours of receiving it. TWO WEEKS later I inquire about when I may hear back from the test. The rep emailing with me was nice, but could only give me "when we get your sample back +2 business days." Ok, I'm not the most patient person, so I begrudgingly wait. I FINALLY got the results back!!! Nearly three weeks later! The results were all over the board! Nothing made sense. Things I know I'm allergic too and/or highly sensitive to, such as gluten, weren't even in my severities category. Thank goodness I work closely with actual health care professionals about the things going on with me right now or I would be totally lost! Save your money! See a real doctor! There are even wholistic doctors who figure this stuff out.

title: Kills gums
text:
I started using my husband's toothpaste (the product listed on this page) when my Sensodyne Repair and Protect ran out. It seemed okay at first, so I didn't bother replacing my Sensodyne. What a mistake.

As mentioned, this toothpaste was fine for a week or two. Suddenly I developed a sore area on the small web of skin/muscle that connects the bottom lip area to the bottom gum. Despite using Orajel, it continued getting worse and is now a nice white dot of pain. Brushing my teeth with this Crest toothpaste was like applying acid to this area and it made me procrastinate about brushing my teeth altogether.

I only really connected the sore with the toothpaste today when I decided to get some more of my regular Sensodyne, and man was it a difference. I was able to brush the sore softly without it stinging too much. It already feels a lot better than it has done these past few days.

I didn't really experience the "slime" I have seen mentioned a lot here, but that's possibly because I use mouthwash right after brushing.

Either way, would not recommend this to anyone who values their gums.

title: Great, easy to use set up bofy fat scale.  Mine arrived very yellow, however.
text:
Just received this scale today, so these comments are just my first impressions.

Ease of setup: 5 STARS. Ignore the 1-Star reviews, unless you are completely tech clueless. 50% of wireless routers get returned because consumers can't or won't read directions. I imagine the same goes here. It took less perhaps a minute to set up, via my iPhone. Pretty ingenious how the device broadcasts it's own wifi network during setup (that you connect to in order to give it your home wifi network ID and password). The guided setup procedure is well written and very easy to follow, and worked for me without a hitch.

Ease of use: 5 STARS. Step on the scale, and within seconds it displays your weight and calculated body fat percentage (you need to be barefoot for this). It automatically turns on, recognizes you, and connects to your home network to update your fitbit account with the new data. There are no buttons to touch or modes to select. You just step on, and step off, and everything works automagically.

Accuracy: 4 STARS. Weighed myself several times in a row; all weights were within a couple tenths of each other. Body fat percentage calculations were consistent within half a percent. Wearing my new fitbit Surge watch did seem to skew the body fat % a point or two (I was otherwise nude for the calculation), so I just figure I'll keep it on during all my weigh-ins for consistency sake.

Appearance: 3 STARS. I'm disappointed my "white" unit has a very sickly yellow hue underneath the glass surface. All product photos show the scale to be bright white, top and bottom. Unfortunately, mine is only white on the bottom. Hoping this is just an aberration (assuming I get confirmation of such from other buyers), I plan to exchange the unit for another.

title: Only works if your glasses aren't very heavy.
text:
It's an OK product, but definitely has several flaws.
1) The applicator
My glasses are metal frames and the nosepads are pretty close together. This makes it impossible to apply the wax without using an extra tool (Qtip, fingertip,...). The tube is just way too wide to fit between the nosepads.
2) It works, but for a short time.
My glasses are heavy, because i need strong, thick lenses (-6.50). When I apply the wax I don't have to push my glasses up as often as without the wax, but the effect only lasts half an hour or so and then I have to re-apply.
The main ingredient in the product is simple beeswax, so the heat of your skin melts the wax and when the wax absorbs in your skin the glasses start sliding down again. I also have very oily skin, maybe that makes a difference as well. In any case, I have to re-apply so much and often that there's no way this tube will last for 6 months, like the description claims.
Conclusion: It probably works if you have plastic frames, because those are lighter and the nosepads are wider apart, but if you have solid, heavy glasses, this product really doesn't do much. I won't order again.

title: Poor product presentation may cost lives
text:
The poor presentation of this product runs the risk of costing lives!

Hudson View Specialty Products, the seller of this fire blanket, should be ashamed. To be an effective tool a fire blanket needs to be well marked--preferably in bright red--to serve as a constant reminder in the kitchen that it's there to be used in the event of a stove-top fire. The packaging for this product is a hangable clear plastic envelope (with Velcro attachments) covering a cheap, ugly and poorly reproduced black and white cover with the legend "Cooking Fire Extinguisher" in 5/16-inch type, and an even more poorly reproduced black and white copy of the color picture shown on the Amazon page for this product.

Amazingly, directions for use of the fire blanket are not included anywhere in or on the package! What are they thinking?

To make the product usable in our kitchen, I went to www.hudsonmedicalproducts.com, copied the following from the product description, and reproduced it in large bold type on a card I inserted into the clear plastic envelope the fire blanket came in:

FIRE BLANKET
In case of fire on stovetop:
1. Turn OFF burner
2. Remove fire blanket from pouch
3. Open to full size
4. Drop over fire to smother fire

After 1 minute, using a pot holder, partially lift fire blanket to see if fire is extinguished. If not extinguished, drop fire blanket back over the fire and check again in 1 minute.

Caution: Fire blanket may be very hot. Be sure to use a pot holder when lifting fire blanket.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If fire spreads beyond pot or pan, do not use the Fire Blanket. Instead, use standard chemical fire extinguisher or call 911. Never use water in an attempt to extinguish a grease fire.

▪ Only for fires that are confined to a pot or pan.
▪ Not for use on electrical fires, chemical fires, or trash or paper fires.
▪ If fire spreads beyond pot or pan, do not use the Kitchen Fire Blanket. Use standard chemical fire extinguisher or call 911.

Never use water in an attempt to extinguish a grease fire.
http://www.hudsonmedicalproducts.com

With that much information, it actually took two cards, one in the front and one in the back. The information above the line is now on the front of my fire blanket package and what's below the line is on the back. All in big red bold type.

The product itself is OK, though the fire blanket appears to be made of fiberglass cloth, and fire professionals warn against using fiberglass in fire blankets because fiberglass can actually burn and melt. Nonetheless, my layman's opinion is that for a stovetop flash fire this ought to do the job. Hope we never have to find out!

I knew Mg was good for relaxing muscles, but I had NO idea it would get rid of the knots. I had been going to a massage therapist ea month for 7+ years, but now I go to one less often.

title: this a great disc but not worth more than eight dollars
text: "Live" captures Rusted Root on-stage. While released in 1995, the date and venue of the live recording(s) is not given on the disc or accompanying paper sleeve. This EP features four tracks. The interest in Rusted Root has always focused on their early 1990's material. Along such lines, "Live" doesn't disappoint in that all songs are from the golden period. 'Lost in a Crowd,' 'Drums > Ecstacy,' 'Scattered' and 'Back to the Earth' are the tracks. The sound quality and performance quality is excellent. "Live" is currently selling for $39.99 though the shameless seller smartlion. At the date of this review, it could still be purchased though the band's web site for a mere eight bucks. Save thirty-two dollars and get this vintage part of the band's history through Rusted Root's merchandising page.

Just learned that I'm allergic to cats, so I got the Cherry Blossom Pet Allergy for the bedroom. I'm a very light sleeper; I love that the LEDs turn off when the bedroom lights go out (optional setting) and how you can't even hear the motor or airflow in Silent or Low mode.  This is what prompted me to write a review. Almost all aspects of this machine seem to have been well thought out.

title: Convenient, Glide-on Emollient; No-Spill Delivery; Super-Easy-to-Open Pump
text:
The Product: I purchased this as a gift for my husband who used non-fractionated coconut oil for dry patches on his skin. He likes the convenient pump and liquid consistency. I then started using it for make-up removal and then sometimes as a moisturizer. This oil glides on really well without pulling the skin, especially around the eyes to remove make-up. With my jojoba oil and rosehip oil I usually need to initially pat these on my skin as they do not glide as well. I sometimes mix these oils with the fractionated coconut oil. Alternatively, I sometimes layer the oils, applying the fractionated coconut oil first as a base to help the other oils glide better. I also use the fractionated coconut oil by itself. It feels wonderful on the skin and works well with gua sha. I also apply it to the ends of my hair. (I know, I have to get my own bottle!)

The Cost: At first blush, it appears that I can get twice the amount with other vendors for the same price. However, I did not do an in-depth comparison of the quality of the products. I saw this product had good reviews, is pure and certified organic, not animal-tested, and supposedly hexane-free; so I wanted to try it. Also, only a few drops, a slight squirt, is needed to cover the face and neck.

Shipping & Delivery: I was concerned about spillage during shipping as I had read reviews of spillage issues with various vendors on Amazon. This (plastic) bottle was perfectly delivered with no spillage. It came bubble-wrapped with the top of the bottle sealed and then topped with a screw-on, flip cap. The pump was packed in the same bubble wrap alongside the bottle.

The Pump: The pump was super easy to open, the easiest pump I have opened. (Sometimes it takes some doing to figure out how to get a pump to pop up. ) The pump makes the bottle very convenient to use. Alternatively, the flip cap the bottle was packed with can be used instead, depending on personal preference.

title: What's with this "New" Ancient Wonder Grain?
text: Having heard about this "new" ancient wonder grain, I wanted to try it to see how it tasted.  (I don't eat wheat products but don't like the taste of Quinoa.)  The package doesn't come with cooking instructions, but I found them on the Amazon.com page and cooked a half batch.  It has the consistency of grits or malt-o-meal but with a nuttier taste to it.  It sets up firm so if you want a creamier consistency add more water.  It was delicious as a side-dish.  With some of the left-overs I tried putting milk and maple syrup on it to see how it would taste as a cereal.  It was good but in the future if I was going to eat it as a cereal, I would add milk to the water while cooking the Fonio to give it a creamier texture.  The next day my husband ask me to cook the rest for him to experiment with.  After the Fonio was cooked and cooled he cut it into cubes and stir fried it with red peppers, onions and shrimp.  It was delicious.  The only reason this Fonio has 4 stars instead of 5 is the price.  I understand though that because Fonio is completely hand processed, at this point it will be expensive.  However in the future when production is more mechanized and the price comes down it will become a staple in our household.

title: surprisingly effective
text:
I write software for a living so am on my computer a lot - I use a standing desk and sometimes sit, but no matter what ergonomic changes I make I still get some neck pain into my trapezius muscles (particularly on my left side). Using my smartphone for email and other things seems to make things worse too since you look down to use the smartphone.

I thought I would give this product a try and I am glad I did. The product arrived in a decorative box shown in the picture. I was a little surprised at the solid quality of the inflation pump and valve. The item did not come with any instructions but you can easily figure out how to use it based on the product description on Amazon [which is what I did].

The inflatable rings inflate when you use the hand pump and have some light felt-like covering that is soft to touch on the face/neck area. I pump up the rings until I get a good stretch, and use the valve to close off the airflow to keep the inflation, and will wear the device while sitting up or standing. Trying to look at your smartphone screen is a bit difficult but its a good since it prevents you from putting your neck in a bad position. My face gets a little squished and it looks awkward (I wouldn't walk around in public with it) but my neck definitely feels better after wearing this device for awhile.

I actually wore the device during my work day--2 hours in the morning and 2 hours late in the day (of course not during any video calls)--my neck & trapezius muscles felt so much better than normal at the end of the work day. I plan on using this more often during work now.

Highly recommend!

title: A Hearing Devie My Mother Will Wear, Finally!
text: My mom has had hearing loss for over a decade, would not wear hearing aides.  She remembers her own mother wearing one that was the old fashioned clip on your shirt from the 80's,  We called it the "squeeler". I saw a new hearing device a neighbor had on and started my search for one my mother could use.  I found this one.  I liked that it had a botton to control the volume not screws, I liked that they are rechargable and they come in a charging case, for 99% of the outside they were a beige color and for the price.  They had fast shipping, well packaged, very professional.  Now how do I get a defiante parent to wear theses.  I put one in my ear and went to visit them.  30 minutes in to the visit, my mom goes "what is that in your ear?" I replied "I am trying out your new hearing device and it sounds pretty good, here try it".  She was facinated with how small it was and proceeded to try it .  We did have to use the smaller ear piece, but she left it in for the rest of the day.  I thought the sound qualify was good, not a lot of open air sounds, it would only give a little whistle if you were trying to mess with it.  For my mom, she  now wears a hearing device, she used volume setting 2, she listened to the TV, talked to other visitors during the day, and even heard crickets for the first time in years.  I called her the next day and she was wearing it on her own.  I would recommend these to anyone.  And if you have that defiant parent, try wearing it first on the low setting so you can have it ready for them and they not be so afraid of trying it.

title: Not made to last very long.  Had several break this year.
text: I have bought about 12 of these over the past few years because they are great size, good amount of cushion and decent wheels.  The quality of the build is not meant to last.  We have had 3 chairs break at the plastic base over the last six months, we have had about 1/3 of these chairs need repair to the arm that raises & lowers it.  We were not exceeding the weight limit, both users were around 220 pounds sitting still when the chair failed. The tabs that hold the arm to raise & lower bend & eventually break off making it not possible to go up & down.  These $80 stools don't last as long as the $50 stools I used to buy 15 years ago.  I'm hoping the manufacturer of these stools will start using better materials or engineering to make a better product.  I really like the rest of its features but durability has me looking for another brand to start buying.  We are lucky to get 1.5 years out of these and recently we have had chairs less than 6 months old fail at the base.  They are used 4-5 days a week for around 8 hours a day.  I now have a pile of parts to constantly repair & rebuild these stools, things just aren't built like they used to be.

title: It actually cleans ground-in dirt from TRAVERTINE... with lots of elbow grease!!
text: I didn't know going in, when I had my travertine installed 2 years ago, what a frickin' pain in the a** this stone would be to clean!!  I have tried different methods with the same ground in dirt left on my floors and looking like crap!  So I started doing some research and came across this product and it seemed to work well from everyone's reviews.  What did I have to lose?, so I bought some.  I followed the directions for mixing, but found that just putting the concentrate directly on the floor worked better and then just let sit for about 3 minutes - then get out the scrub brush and scrub and I mean scrub!! It lifted this 2 year old dirt off the floor...amazing!!  Is it back to 100%?, no- but at the very least its 80% better!!  I think some people who reviewed this product thought it was a magic cleaner, just putting it on and wiping away the dirt...let me tell you it is not- you need to put some work into it for the desired results.  I recommend to just focus your scrubbing on the really bad spots!  We have a large collie and he doesn't help matters either just laying in his two favorite places on the floor, let alone the dirt he tracks in from outside.  There is one area of heavier traffic that I know I will have to do a second time, but for the money we spent on those floors, the effort, elbow grease and sweat is definitely worth it!!  I will buy it again and will recommend this product!!

title: Good but no data of its effectiveness
text:
This is a good idea, i.e. microfiber, or micro-organic cotton.
But the manufacturer lists no tests as to its effectiveness, as well as no lab reports, or how many microns it can filter.
It may as well endanger the health than help people as its use may not be either for chemical sensitivities since a mere cloth material does not seem to filter gases, or harmful smog substances.
It may filter up to dust, pollen, etc.
For the serious commuter, they should get a real smog mask, or gas mask specific for volatile gases if they job necessitates this.
They should at least put specific info as to the microns it can filter. On the other hand, the comsumer should stay away from using it in harmful environments.

I bought these one night at 3am. I had been sick for two weeks, my face leaking snot, coughing my brains out, miserable and lacking sleep. I had run out of tissues and my nose was bleeding from blowing it repeatedly with toilet paper. I drunk-dialed amazon. Except I wasn’t drunk. I was sick and bordering on lunacy from weeks of sleepless nights from a miserable head cold. So I ordered this economy-sized package of tissues, desperate for relief. Unfortunately, when I woke up and realized my mistake (I needed tissues NOW, not in the three days prime would take to get here.), the tissues had already shipped!! Fastest shipment EVER. Because I am frugal *or cheap, whatever* I refused to go to a local store to buy tissues; I knew that I would soon have more than I would ever need.

Three long days and sleepless nights later I received these. And MAN I can tell you, compared to these tissues Kleenex felt like sandpaper.

I highly recommend them. But, don’t order them on amazon. If you need tissues go buy them so you don’t have to wait.

title: I’ve had three epilators, this is the gentlest!
text:
I will get what I disliked out of the way: It has a high pitched hum when you use it, I found this hard to get used to. The light: if it were brighter or placed closer to the blade could have worked but as it is? It’s nearly useless. It does not come with a storage bag but that’s not a deal breaker for me. My fix for that was to nab a zippered plastic baggie from my kitchen. The extra bits fit in a sandwich sized bag.

Side note: I’ve used an epilator for several years. It took me maybe a month or two to get used to, it was worth the initial discomfort/pain. There are numbing creams for beginners, having a shower before epilating helps open the pores to aid in gentler removal too. I don’t need these things but added this in hopes it helps someone.

Things I really like about this epilator: This is so gentle I almost didn’t think it was working! I don’t know if the technology around making these has changed over the years but wow! Seriously, wow! I also love that you charge it and don’t have to deal with a cord while shaving. Being attached to a wall while trying to shave is not a great situation. It is light weight, very light weight. So, if I travel with this thing I won’t be worrying about lugging one more heavy thing. It is small too. About the size of a average lady’s palm. It works far better on varying hair lengths than my previous ones too. This little thing is pretty incredible.

*the sound still bothers me though.

I do not intend to use the regular shaving attachment. If by chance I ever do, I hope to remember to update this and let you know how that goes. I hope the information I did share helps you make the right choice for your needs. (:

title: Great Electric Tooth Brush But Sometime Down Sides
text: Overall I enjoy this tooth brush a lot. I was using the iO Series 7 but the downside is they only make two different brush heads for the iO so you can’t enjoy the full experience of changing brush heads and trying them out. I bought this and decided it would be a good alternative for the iO to enjoy other brush heads. A couple downfalls is that to start, it is extremely loud compared to the iO but that doesn’t bother me a ton. I dislike that with this brush it doesn’t light up green telling you that you are applying enough pressure and only lights up red if you apply too much. I thought when it said it has a 360° ring and pressure sensor it would do that. Completely wrong. The other thing I don’t like is with the iO you can start brushing and the app tracks everything so you can place your phone down while you brush (Be sure not to let it lock or you may lose everything) With this it requires you to place your face in a circle and select what hand you brush with so it can tell where you are brushing but once you put your phone down it has no idea where you are brushing. It’s almost like it’s not Bluetooth capable unless the camera is facing you. I’m brushing the top left quadrant and the app is saying I’m brushing my front, then quickly changes to bottom right ... it’s everywhere. This explains why Oral B normally provides a mount to put on your mirror aimed at you with your phone in it to properly track your brushing. With this double pack, it doesn’t provide that so you are stuck holding your phone out right aimed at you straight on which doesn’t help because you tend to move when you brush or even holding your arm straight out for two minutes or more and so the app does a horrible job at tracking where you are brushing.

title: Not contoured enough for this autistic
text:
I can’t give too in-depth of a review since I couldn’t even wear them for more than about 10 minutes. Being autistic, I have sensory issues and so finding things like this that I can handle are difficult. I really struggle using eye masks because of the feeling on my eyes. If my eyelashes rub on them, I can’t wear it. I decided to try an eye mask again to help me sleep while my partner watches TV hoped these would work out since they are contoured away from your eyes and the audio feature would help with the TV sound too. The photos made it seem that the contour is a decent amount. Out of the package, it didn’t look like as much depth as the product photo.

I don’t want to be too harsh with the review since I know this is something that I personally have an issue with and not necessarily something wrong with the product. However, I feel as if the photos and description are a little exaggerated and not representing the product as well as it should. If the depth amount was made more clear and accurate, I would rate it higher.

Again, I cannot comment on the audio, durability, comfort while sleeping, etc. If eye masks aren’t much of an issue for you, my review probably won’t help you; if you have sensory sensitivities or general discomfort with eye masks, my review is something to consider.

title: Worth every penny!
text:
This curler blew my expectations! I initially saw this item on Memebox's instagram in Nov 2018 and I knew I had to have it! The video showed how easy it was to get big curls and the fact the curler was unicorn colored was an extra bonus. Unfortunately it was only for the Korean market at the time but I was so happy to see it now available for the US via Amazon this month (Aug 2019).

I did my research on this curler and I'm happy they met all their claims. This version is the newer one from 2018 and they've made some great improvements! It's now dual voltage, they include a US adapter, the clamp button is bigger and the clamp opens further. Plus, this the only brand that sells such a big barrel (40mm) so I get the big glamorous curls/waves I want!

Some tips on using it. You should use a big sections of hair when curling and clamp where you want the curl to start in your hair (opposite of the beachwaver). Since you start at the top of your hair, all you do hold the rotating button and the curler pulls the hair around the barrel for you. Release the rotating button on where you want the curl to stop (I usually leave a little hair out) and I let it stay in my hair for 10 secs (I have thick hair). Easy peasy big curls!!! PS, the temperature on the curler is in Celsius so I put it at 200C for long lasting curls. There are also videos on Youtube if you need a visual on how to use it. :)

Oh and the fact that you can use it as normal curler is an added bonus. It's like having 2 curlers in one! The made the clamp the same length a normal curler so you don't have to use the rotating mechanism!

I love this thing and it's worth every penny! I'll recommend this to everyone.

If my phone rings, or I decide to watch a video on my phone, the connector goes silent until I'm finished.  My only problem so far was that any movement of the device caused a power loss at first. I hooked the power up to my tv, and it hasn't happened since, so I have to assume it was the AC connection.  It also goes to sleep if I silence it for too long, but it's easy to reconnect, by using my hearing aids' normal method (for me, it's by holding the "down" button for a few seconds).  I like not worrying about bothering the neighbors, and I like being able to walk away from the television and still hear what's going on.  To quote Rick Blaine, "I think this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship."

title: Updated clip design. Same case you would get directly from Tandem.
text:
Love the color. It’s my first pump that isn’t the Medtronic MiniMed and I wanted to have some color back. I can’t wait to get the sticker for the front to tie it all together.

Taking off my black case and putting the green case on was a bit jarring at first on the back because it makes the black sections of the pump standout. The is good and bad. Wish tandem has some other pump color option, though on its own black is very sleek. Seeing the black part of the pump is not as aesthetically pleasing but it does help me distinguish between what is the pump and what is the case. Makes it easier to change the cartridge and pull the pump out. Turns out I was pushing on the case not the pump when I was trying to get the black case off.

I’ve only had the pump for 5 days so the case it shipped with was the newer updated design with the belt clip that has the grip. The pictures on amazon had me worried that buying it off here I might get the older design. But looking at the most recent review pictures I saw the new clip so I took the chance. I was not disappointed. My new green one is exactly like the black with the same clip. So no need to switch them around.

The black I’ll keep in case the green one breaks. I can’t say much on durability. But I imagine if you take good care of your pump and are not trying to constant pop it in and out of the case then there very little room for breaking it.

I can say the color on the hard plastic is solid. I was thinking of getting the pink but for some reason the pink little to be more of a transparent plastic from the picture I saw.

The clip is moveable if you want to change the position or remove it, but you will have to take the case off the pump to do so.

title: Nice electric toothbrush
text:
Nice all black toothbrush set. Included the six toothbrushes, the main body with internal rechargeable battery and the charging cord.

For use, you place the toothbrush onto the body by pressing it down into place. To charge, you remove to circular waterproof silicon type cover from the bottom where the charging port is located. You then plug the USB cord in (you will have to provide your own power plug).

There are six modes that you cycle through by pressing the one button. First is the cleaning mode which is what I've primarily used and most people will also use. After 30 seconds it does do a pause and restart, pause is about a second. This is to let you know to switch to the next quadrant of teeth (top outside, top inside, bottom outside and bottom inside). This makes sure you are giving the same amount of time and attention to all teeth.

The other modes in order are: Massage, Whitening, Polishing, Soft and Care. The Massage, Polishing and Soft mode all sound like variations of a gentle clean. Whitening supposedly will remove stains and Care mode claims to remove plaque and surface stains.

One thing I do worry about is where to get more toothbrushes. It's an off brand so not sure what will work with these. The bristles were soft and I'd prefer a medium. The box says both are included so perhaps this first one I grabbed just happened to be soft. I'll have to check the rest but just judging from the feel while they are still individually wrapped seems most are soft.

title: Awesome!!!
text:
I am NOT a hair stylist, but I think I did a pretty dang good job cutting my husband's hair with these things and some hair cutting scissors! I used the 3" fin on the top and the 2" fin on the sides/back. Here are all the steps I did:

1) Wet hair
2) Comb, section, and hold top hair in place with hair clips do it doesn't get cut with the wrong size fin
3) Use a comb and my fingers with the 2" fin to cut all the hair below the clips, going left to right and then top to bottom so I made sure I got all the hair from every angle
4) Unclip the top hair and use the 3" fin, again going left to right and then front to back
5) I used an electric clipper to trim around the ears and the back of the neck, but that's optional
6) Comb the hair to loosen any leftover bits and check out the final result. My husband parts his hair on the side, as you can see in the photo, so I made sure to part it to make sure it still looked good.

title: The Ultimate Purple seat cushion is about to be the talk of the USPS and drivers everywhere!
text:
I purchased the Ultimate Purple seat cushion for my husband, who is a rural carrier for the USPS. He delivers mail in the standard issue LLV (long life vehicle or mail truck depending on who you ask). My husband has issues with his back and previously had surgery for a herniated disc in his lower lumbar region. Fast forward to now and he has herniation again, along with nerve damage in his legs and feet. He has a large rural route, which takes him along some very bumpy dirt roads and the LLV seat has no shock absorption whatsoever.

After doing some research into the Purple mattress I was happy to see they also made seat cushions, so I bought one for my dad, who is a truck driver and one for my husband, who is a mailman. Amazon sent the wrong cushion initially, but I sent it back and they quickly replaced it for the Ultimate seat cushion. My husband was excited to get the mail that day! He immediately used the seat cushion in his LLV that day and has been using it ever since. It's amazing how something that seems so simple can upgrade your level of comfort instantly. He was bragging to his coworker, who is also a rural carrier about his new seat cushion, so today he decided he would leave the cushion in the LLV for his coworker to try when they switch shifts. I am happy to report that he also loves it!

The Ultimate Purple is pretty wide and perfect for the larger derrière. If you have a smaller derrière or seat width, I could also recommend the Double Purple, which is the cushion I purchased for my father. Just take a look at my Amazon reviews if you are interested in the Double Purple seat cushion. The Ultimate Purple is very comfortable and has helped immensely with the stiff ride, dirt roads, and long days of mail delivery. I would not be surprised to see an influx of orders for every model of the Purple seat cushions once the word of mouth gets out. I will say that I think the Purple seat cushions are priced pretty high, but you pay for a good solid product that is completely mobile, which allows you to upgrade just about any seat. I received my Ultimate Purple seat cushion at a discount for my fair and unbiased review.

Only occasionally will I get on it and it will show me as Guest instead of my initials. I'm not sure why since my weight isn't fluctuating significantly and it is much different than my husband's or kid's. The unfortunate part of that is when it does that it won't register the body fat %. Overall not a big deal since I can go to the online dashboard and switch it to myself so not a game breaker by any means. If you were wavering about getting one, I totally recommend it!

text: So I bought this Fine Powdered Charcoal because I have been seeing all the posts across social media about how charcoal can whiten your teeth, and Wow, it really does. I have noticed a big big difference in how white my teeth have become and this product is food grade. To be honest, this stuff is really messy. So the instructions say to wet the toothbrush and dip it into the powdered charcoal and brush your teeth. I tried this first and I did notice a slight difference in coloring. My biggest problem was the texture. I did not like having that powder in my mouth. It was so dry that it wasn't comfortable. So I decided to experiment with the charcoal and toothpaste. It is so much better. What I did was I took a tube of brand name  toothpaste which I had bought from Dollar Tree and combine that with a few tablespoons of charcoal. I tried to blend it as best I could and added a splash of mouthwash to smooth the texture. It turned out wonderful. I had my best friend try my experiment and I had him try the powder. We both agree that the experiment is more successful because it is the closest thing to actually brushing your teeth normally. it is still kinda messy so I would recommend to brush using the charcoal while in the shower. I typically use the charcoal first and then I go back over it with a regular toothpaste. Because the charcoal doesn't freshen your breath. Even my experiment doesn't freshen breath. The purpose of my experiment was to make the charcoal easier to brush with. Next topic is a charcoal face mask. This application of charcoal was kinda a bust because I don't think it worked. To make the mask, mix 2 teaspoons of charcoal with pure water /rose water/aloe gel to make a paste. Apply to face and let dry. Gently wash off. It had two optional ingredients which were coconut oil and honey. I tried it with just water and it didn't seems to do much. Worse of all, I couldn't get all of it off. So I had a dingy look for the rest of the day. Overall, I would recommend this product to any who was trying to whiten their teeth with out the huge bill.

title: inaccurate ... and fitbit does not consider this to be a defect
text:
This is an attractive scale, it is easy to set up, the automatic upload is convenient, its weights are consistent, and customer support is polite. But in my mind, the primary purpose of a scale is to tell you what your weight is. This is one of the most expensive scales on the market, and it is also one of the least accurate. When pressed, fit-bit support will quote a low accuracy standard, but they do not consider a scale defective merely because it is well outside of that standard.

The average mid-range digital scale seems to be +/- 1%. After months of go arounds, fit-bit support said that their manufacturing standard is +/-2#. My scale reads 3.5# light (on a 145# weight as compared multiple medical and beam-balance scales) ... which is about 2.5%. I spent months taking additional measurements and getting cross checks ... only to have them feed me back boiler plate about position and recalibration after moving the scale (it is on a tile floor and very seldom moves) and how my weight changes over the course of the day (many of my comparisons were side-by-side or bracketed before and after).

title: it works with a just visited the dentist clean.
text:
This arrived quickly and was a decent size container consider I was not sure what to expect. Its about the same diameter as a stand up pump toothpaste about almost 3 inches tall. I have tried to use activated charcoal powder before but it was too messy and so dark black I was really afraid to continue using it with a crown and cap in the back of my mouth thinking it may stain it black. THIS is not black in color its is a very light gray actually and that right there sold me less fearful that this may stain my white crowns and white fillings no more. Not that I have a lot of dental work just one crown and two white small fillings. This container did not have a seal or instructions so I had to google how to use it. I just tap some powder onto the inside of the top cap and then after wetting my toothbrush tap over it to get it to stick onto my toothbrush. I use an oral B electric toothbrush and this I think helps speed up the results. I have been using this for a few weeks now (I wanted to try for a few weeks before posting) and I would say noticeably whiter at least one shade if not a bit more. It does not irritate my gums or teeth and I have sensitive teeth. Does not stain dental work, and fairly easy to use. I sometimes combine it with a very small amount of toothpaste or I wet my toothbrush with minty mouth wash first. The taste on this is not the most pleasant but I was expecting that after googling it. It leave my mouth and teeth feeling the same clean after a dentist visit which I also like. I rinse with water after followed up with mouth wash the strong minty Listerine kind to get rid of the after taste. As many have mentioned its a camphor smell and taste. I try to use it every day at least in the morning sometimes at night but the after taste at night is not the best so I use regular tooth paste at night usually. It does work and it does help overall oral health in a gentle and natural product which I like.

title: Here me now, O' mortal men. For I have a story to tell.
text:
Way back, in the long long ago and forgotten time. A mighty axe was forged from the strongest of metals by elders of a long forgotten craft. This axe was bestowed with heavenly light and the strength of a hundred warriors trained since birth to wield deadly accuracy and a dancers precision. It was then buried beneath a stone and forgotten. Forgotten by all. But not the watchers. The watchers kept close eyes guarding this sacred axe until the day the chosen one would be ready to trim the hair of the gods bestowed upon his face. Such a man came forth finally and was given this axe. That man. Was Chuck Norris.

The trimmings of his beard fell to the earth dividing continents, shaping lands. Those trimmings were collected and blessed by priest with names lost to the winds when they devoted themselves to the fine art of caring for, nurturing and crafting those hairs into the brushes you now see before you. These brushes are not for mere mortal men, but they are here. Now. Available for just that. I do not know how, or more specifically whom these were delivered from. I only know that we weak and foolish mortals were not meant to handle. No. Gaze upon these instruments of true masculinity and pure heart.

For those who come across this brush and become a beholder of it. Know that forever you will be held under the watchful eye of the one. The chosen one whom gave of his fine hairs to create this.

Each pass of these powerful unbroken hairs over your face begins to shape and transform your skin from that of a born man, to that of a near god. Tiny hands reach from each bristle to delicately lace your hairs in their embrace and sing a delicate lullaby only the ears of a newborn could hear. title: Great sacle, but not for children, pregnant women or people with medical devices
text:
I have had this one for a while now. Great build quality and very nice finish on top (sturdy glass), less so on bottom (cheap plastic). Compared to my gold standard which is a Seca medical body analyzer, weight is both accurate (meaning it is close to the value given by Seca) and precise (Aria returns almost the same weight when measuring several times and remains consistent over time). Body fat percentage measurement is less accurate but rather good on precision. It is 4% off the reading I get from Seca but at least with good precision you will get proper tracking and monitoring over time. I noticed that readings can vary a little depending on where the scale is positioned but that is true for all scales so make sure that you position it exactly the same way when tracking your weight and body fat over time.

I have encountered no problems whatsoever with the installation and setup over wifi. 3 minutes and I was done! I went straight to the weblink to set it up the first time.
http://www.fitbit.com/scale/setup/start
Then once the scale was set up, I configured the mobile and mac apps. This is what worked for me.
Note that the scale will not work with static IPs. If you know what this means, you probably know how to fix it. And if you have absolutely no idea, I would say consider this if you have a serious online gamer at home or someone telecommuting for instance.

The scale automatically recognizes people but in order for that to happen each person needs to have their own fitbit account which is annoying especially if you have children. Otherwise, people show up on your account and on the scale as "guest". You have an option to send the invites out to them from your own fitbit account for a maximum of 7 invites.

Last but not least, because of the technology behind body composition analysis, this scale should not be used by people with medical devices such as pace makers, pregnant women, or children under the age of 10. My 2 1/2 year old daughter always wants to go on the scale like mommy and daddy so I make her wear her crocs or flip flops.
