title: Delicious Kosher-Dairy/Halal Medical Nutrition Product
text:
Sometimes people who have medical problems (physical illness/injury/surgery/depression) lose interest in eating or must avoid solid foods temporarily or permanently, so there are medical nutrition products out there meant to provide flavor, fluid, and nutritional value. One of the 8-ounce reclosable cartons (the size of one standard glass of water) has 240 calories, so it is not meant to be a low-calorie diet drink. It is a partial meal substitute.

The apple taste is very refreshing, and might be most appealing in hot weather. It is suitable for vegetarians, but not vegans. It will taste better if refrigerated before use, but must be refrigerated after opening if not finished in one go. It contains a small amount of solids, so it has to be shaken before opening. A sick or injured person might need help with this.

One of the ingredients is whey protein isolate, which is why it is a kosher-dairy product, instead of parve. One carton provides 8 grams of protein, carbohydrate in the form of sugar and corn syrup solids, and vitamins and minerals--but not calcium and potassium. It is obviously not meant to be complete nutrition, but part of nutritional program to help patients recover. The packaging says, "For supplemental use only."

Although it is apple-flavored, it is not vitamiinized apple juice. It is a nutrient-in-water product, with the flavoing meant to make it appealing enough to drink.

Because of the sugar content, I don't know how well this product would work for people with diabetes. They would have to ask a medical professional if it would work well for them.

title: GREAT DECORATIONS FOR 21ST BIRTHDAY
text:
Very happy with the quality of these balloons and the sign is sturdy and well made. A few of the other reviewers complained about the ribbon not being the right color to match the rose gold - but honestly this is such a minor detail that shouldn't prevent you from purchasing. I used one standard 12 inch helium tank to fill the large number balloons and the 8 confetti balloons. There wasn't much helium left after filling all of them so be careful not to waste the helium. Suggest blowing up the confetti balloons first then use the remaining helium to fill the numbered balloons. If you run out of helium you can use the straw provided to top up by blowing into the balloon yourself.

For the confetti balloons, many complained about the confetti falling to the bottom of the balloon. To get the confetti to stick, you just place a very small drop of water into the confetti balloon with a straw and rub the balloon to distribute the water inside - then drain excess onto a paper towel. When you inflate with helium, the confetti will blow through the balloon and stick. *** These balloons only last for 8 hours so blow them up as late as possible!

For the numbered balloons - just a side note.....they are very large! They cost substantially more at Party Depot so this is a good value. Just do not over inflate them to the point where you can't gently press on the balloon. I used clear fishing wire to make it appear that they were floating. Adhesive tabs were also included so you could stick the numbered balloons to a wall. The numbered balloons are still inflated 48 hours later.

Definitely will buy this product again.

text: First off, this isn't a spray wax.  Ease of use and removal shouldn't be compared a spray wax.  The keys to this traditionally applied paste wax is application and removal.  Apply a very thin layer.  I used the supplied foam applicator, but others have said a microfiber applicator works better.  I did the hood first and left it on for around 10 minutes before removing.  It was a BEAR!  I found it started to haze after 2 minutes in my situation - a 75 degree garage.  Removing it at the 2 minute mark dramatically improved the process!  (Note: I used Griot's Wax Removal Towels and had to change to a clean towel quite frequently = used 5 or 6 towels).  The other complaint I've heard was the chemical smell.  It smells like Johnson Paste Wax furniture wax.  I worked in a closed 3-car garage and was not bothered by the smell or fumes.  I applied it to a friend's Highlander, and after a month he said it looks so good he's hasn't bothered to wash it.  I saw it yesterday and he's right.  He also mentioned that he's gotten several comments on how great it looks!  The only thing I've used that would surpass this wax is a Ceramic coating.  One other thing I would add: it seemed to me that gloss improved after an overnight cure time.

title: Was skeptical..not anymore
text:
I do some pretty hard contact martial arts training, along with the intense physical conditioning that goes along with it. I am always aching somewhere and had been looking for something to help with pain and recovery. I was skeptical of anything topical ACTUALLY helping with muscle pain until I was about 20 miles deep into a marathon and my legs were just finished. I had pushed it a little too hard and could hardly take a few steps without my legs cramping up, and I was looking for anything to help me get through the last 5 miles. I saw a guy with a tank of this stuff just spraying any runners’ legs that wanted it, and at that point I was desperate for anything to stop my legs from feeling how they felt.
I ran over, and he doused my legs in this stuff and I ended up having the best final 5 miles I’ve ever had in a marathon. I then forgot it for the next couple years, and at a health expo I saw a booth where they were selling it. “I might as well try it again,” I thought, and I bought a bottle.
I will never train without it again- I use it for absolutely everything. In my personal experience, it has taken the edge off of any ache or pain I’ve had, and I’ve gotten everyone I know to try it.
My friends joke that I must work for the company- with how much I try to get people to use the stuff. Truth is, it works really well for me, and I can’t recommend it enough.

title: What Interstitial Cystitis?
text:
So spoilers, this stuff is amazing and every woman should at least have this in their medicine cabinet.

My story: I’d had a terrible UTI after sex (I know it was sex for sure) in January of this year (2016), was put on nitrofurantoin (macrobid), and it resolved, but I never felt quite right after. I avoided sex until April, 2016, and I developed another severe UTI. The day of sex I was normal, next day bloody urine, no gradual build-up of pain or anything. I’m very lucky I had a wonderful doctor at my local urgent care, because after not having a UTI for the first 6.5 years of my relationship with one person, I’m suddenly getting UTIs immediately after sex, EVERY TIME? She referred me to a urologist, but in the wait to see him, again, I didn’t feel right, pressure in my bladder that would get painful if jostled too much, like in a car. Was put on ciprofloxacin because I’d already taken nitrofurantoin, and just in case I had a strain of bacteria that wasn’t able to be cultured, but was there and needed to be killed.

When I finally saw the urologist (June), he put me on trimethoprim at the lowest dose possible, as a preventative while my bladder mucosal lining healed after being DESTROYED by my severe UTIs (which can take 4-6 months, this is also why women have a higher chance of getting a UTI within the first 6mos after a previous UTI. The bladder hasn’t fully recovered and is more susceptible to infection). But he also told me that I definitely should get a D-Mannose supplement, because anecdotally his clients have been loving it. He even printed out an abstract of the most recent clinical trial to back it up, which convinced me to try it. So I immediately found a bottle and my pain resolved within days. It basically does what pop culture makes you think cranberry juice is supposed to do.

I prefer the powder format, because the pills are gigantic and you have to take 3-4 of them to get the full effect of a teaspoon of the powder form. I put the powder in my water bottle before I leave for work/school, and try to drink it within an hour instead of sipping it throughout the day.
Yes it’s a bit expensive, but if you haven’t had a UTI in a long time/ever, but just want a preventative, taking it every few days and before and after sex is good practice. If you’re like me and had interstitial cystitis that WOULD NOT RESOLVE, this is perfect in combination with prophylactic antibiotics, and life long preventative after the antibiotic course is over.

title: IV bag
text:
I bought this for the jump bag I use for work. I'm an EMT but on the side I work as a mobile phlebotomist. This thing fits perfectly in my jump bag (Lightning X, really nice bags) and it's got loops for catheters, blood collection needles, saline flushes, syringes + luerlocks etc etc. And some pockets that could fit butterfly needles, extra gauzes, alcohol swabs, tegaderms, venous tourniquets and zipper pouches for whatever else... The loops all vary in size from small enough for an IV catheter to large enough for your extra large syringes (one of them is huge for some reason, you could fit a syringe that would inflate a king airway) And it's got a little button loop that I've only ever seen used for shears, so you can even throw in shears if you wanted for some reason. I thought it'd be too tall for a bag but it fits pretty snuggly in there...

The material itself is pretty sturdy, it doesn't feel cheap. It's padded too, so the bag keeps its shape. And clearly marked but not in a tacky way. It's good, I like it...

title: Great phlebotomy bag
text:
EDIT: It's been a little over a year since I first bought this bag and I've used it for work (carrying medical equipment, opening, closing, tossing around) probably an average of 4 days a week and it's held up like a dream. The seams are all still good and I can tell it'll be good for years to come. 100% glad I bought this one.

I work as a mobile phlebotomist, meaning I drive house to house, drawing blood specimens, doing point of care testing, taking measurements and medical history. I wanted a professional looking bag that I could keep all of my supplies in and I saw how great the trauma bags were at my local ambulance corps were so I bought this one! I can finally carry just one bag for work.

PROS:
-Fits all the stuff I need for work, including the small floor scale I use to weigh patients (it even fits with a bit of wiggle room!) Extra needles, urine cups, extra blood tubes, a small sharps box, alcohol swabs, BP cuff, trauma supplies (band aids, gauze, tape, dressing etc), it fits oral airways on the loops that you see on the pictures on the main flap, penlight, ring cutters, CPR mask, and a folder with everybody's paperwork. It even fits extra lab kits in the side pockets.
-And with the dividers it comes with, it all fits *neatly*, too.
-The material is tough, so I'm pretty sure it'll last a long time.

CONS
-The loops I put the airways in are all the same sized loop. They're just a little too big for the small airways and they fit the big airways very tightly. The penlight is a bit loose on the loop (just hanging onto that loop by the clip)
-On the front side there you see a big star of life but on the back side, there's a big "LIGHTNING X PRODUCTS" logo. I personally think it's kinda tacky to put big logos on stuff, especially medical/trauma bags. But at least the logo doesn't look bad.

All in all, I'm very glad I bought this. For all you mobile phlebotomists or mobile medical examiners, this is a great bag. *especially* for the price. For all you EMT's out there, this would definitely make a good jump bag for your car.

I purchased the Household Mall Pack of 16pcs Dry Floor Wipes/Spic and Span Electrostatic Floor Cleaning Wipes to use with the Swifter mop on my hardwood floors. The pads fit the Swifter mop head fine. However, it just may be me but I did not find the quality to be as good as the Swifter brand dry floor wipes. The Household Mall Pack of dry floor wipes are much thinner and more expensive. I included a photo to provide a visual as to the thinnest/transparency of the wipes to illustrate my point. Be mindful that the wipe is not yet stretched around the Swifter mop head. The electrostatic floor cleaning wipes did pick up dust and dirt but I also found that the wipes kind of pushed the dirt around too. I may have set my expectations too high but I found the product to be just okay. Had the price point been cheaper or had there been more than 16 wipes per package than I would probably think differently. Overall, the Household Mall Pack of 16pcs Dry Floor Wipes did glide over the floor pretty easily and picked up quite a bit of dust so it is not to say that they are not a good alternative for light dusting or daily maintenance of hardwoods but certainly not at this price point/quantity in my opinion.

title: A Dream Come True
text:
The cervical neck traction device is a solution I have hoped for over the course of two decades.

I have degenerative joint and disk disease. I have already had two cervical neck fusion surgeries and am trying to delay yet another one. I am frequently in severe pain but refuse to take pain pills as I want to keep my wits about me. For the past two months, I have been getting acupuncture and aggressive massage to help reduce the pain and to again allow me to look to my left direction.

I have told my wife for years now that I wished I had some sort of home traction machine. Over those years, I would sit on the floor Indian styled and she would lift from under my jaw in an attempt to remove some of the pressure. I also have an inversion table. Recently I was on that table and wearing my motorcycle helmet to provide some targeted stretching but with little benefit.

I want to note how pleased I am with this device. I have used it repeatedly over the past week to give it a thorough testing. The results are wonderful. To go from extreme pain one moment to little or no pain 15 minutes later is great. Moreover, that pain relief often last for a day.

It does take one or two times using this device to get used to wearing it. I have a thick football player type of neck, so this device initially had a tendency to ride up my neck muscles. However, I now learned to first slightly snug pump the device up and then hold it down and back under my neck while it inflated the device to very firm. Once it was inflated, I made an effort to further stretch my neck back and over the top edges of the device. I wear this device no more than 15 minutes a day, usually while watching TV.

The device has two long straps that go across the neck opening and velcros to the opposite side. I keep the lower strap loose enough that it does not touch my throat. The upper strap firmly snugs up under my chin and jaws. The only down side is that it does take a lot of pumping to inflate the device. I generally inflate it half way, close the pump wheel, and rest for a few seconds. The balance of the inflation can be made with the pump wheel barely open so you do not have to fight too much with air trying to escape.

This device has answered my dream. I am very pleased with the results and with the sturdiness of this product, I expect it to provide relief for years to come. I now hope to delay another surgery for several years.

Before I purchase any product, I read the reviews written by others in order to help form my opinion. I now wish to pay it forward to future shoppers who may be considering this product by writing this product assessment. I received a discount on this product in exchange for an honest review. No amount of discount is worth my integrity so I will call it as I see it.

title: Strong brain supplement!
text:
There are literally thousands of supplements marketed as “brain supplements.” Research has shown that taking the right supplements can help your brain health and function now and protect against mental decline in the future, but picking the right one is a challenge. Choosing the right supplement depends on the results you are looking for. This supplement includes nutrients that have been proven to be safe, effective, and cover a wide variety of needs. I will provide information on 5 of them so you get the idea of what is in this supplement and if it will help with your needs.

1. Acetyl-l-carnitine is an amino acid that acts as a powerful antioxidant, protecting your brain from free radical damage. It’s good for improving mental clarity, focus, mood, processing speed, and memory and has a strong anti-aging effect on the brain. One study found that it stabilizes tau proteins which produce the brain tangles believed to cause Alzheimer’s. When buying a supplement, don’t confuse acetyl-l-carnitine with the less expensive l-carnitine. ALC is the more bioavailable form that readily crosses the blood-brain barrier, something plain l-carnitine cannot do.

2. Phosphatidylserine is a phospholipid that’s an integral part of every cell membrane in the body, but is found in particularly high concentrations in the brain. It regulates which nutrients get into the brain and how waste gets out of it. It’s good for boosting memory, cognition, concentration, and learning. It helps with ADHD and attention. Large studies have found that phosphatidylserine may be an effective treatment for Alzheimer’s and other forms of dementia. It normalizes levels of the stress hormone cortisol to reduce the effects of stress. It can even improve your golf game. (Yes, a study was done on that!). It protects older brains against aging and is a favorite memory supplement used by students to improve exam performance.

3. Vinpocetine is a relatively new brain supplement that straddles the line between brain supplement and smart drug. It’s a synthetic version of vincamine. In Europe and Japan, vinpocetine is available only by prescription, but in the US it’s an over-the-counter supplement. Doctors in Europe believe it to be more effective than Ginkgo biloba, which has a reputation as one of the best all-around brain supplements. Vinpocetine improves memory, reaction time, and overall mental well-being. It rapidly enters the brain to increase blood flow, decrease brain inflammation, protect against free radical damage, and balance neurotransmitter levels. It protects the brain from degeneration making it a potential treatment for Alzheimer’s.
Consider vinpocetine if your main concern is protecting against memory loss or age-related mental decline.

4. Bacopa monnieri has been used for thousands of years to enhance memory, learning, and concentration. Bacopa is a well-recognized adaptogen, a substance that reduces the negative effects of stress. It works in part by balancing the neurotransmitters dopamine, serotonin, and GABA, while reducing levels of the stress hormone cortisol. It also has a calming effect and has been used to treat anxiety, deal with stress, and promote better sleep. There haven’t been a lot of studies done on this herb, so many of the purported benefits are more a matter of herbalist tradition than modern science. Bacopa is an excellent choice if you have problems with memory, learning and concentration brought on by stress.

5. Huperzine-A is a traditional Chinese herbal remedy used to improve memory, increase blood flow, and reduce inflammation. This alkaloid works by blocking the brain enzyme that breaks down the neurotransmitter acetylcholine. Huperzine A is sold as a dietary supplement mainly to improve memory, concentration, and learning ability in both young and old. It protects the brain against free radical damage and environmental toxins.
It works much like the popular Alzheimer’s drug, Aricept, and is an approved drug for treating vascular dementia and Alzheimer’s in China.

NOTE: Before you start taking brain supplements, make sure you’ve got your basic nutritional needs met. It’s generally thought that vitamin deficiencies are a thing of the past, but that’s not true. Up to 40% of Americans are deficient in vitamin B12, 90% in vitamin D, and 75% in the mineral magnesium. Deficiencies in any of these can have a profound impact on your brain. Research shows that the simple act of taking a multi can improve your memory and overall brain function. And don’t expect your brain supplement to be the magic bullet answer to a bad lifestyle. No supplement in the world can make up for a junk food diet, lack of sleep, or chronic stress.

Bottom Line:
There are many reasons to take a brain supplement: to improve mood, memory, and concentration as well as to protect the brain against aging or to prevent or halt cognitive decline. When choosing a multi-ingredient brain supplement, pick one that contains ingredients that are proven to work and a good match for your particular set of symptoms. This supplement has strong natural ingredients and was manufactured in a FDA registered facility that complies with GMP standards.

title: Impressive to say the least!!!
text:
I'm a fan of Saddleback Leather Co. products. If you're familiar with their bags and other items, they are constructed of heavy full-grain leather. As such, they need a good conditioner that penetrates deeply and delivers a healthy dose of lubrication to the fibers deep within' the material. I find the best method is to just get a good handful and massage it in. The benefit is twofold! You treat the leather and your hands!

My XL sized briefcase from Saddleback has benefitted greatly from regular moisturization from Paul's Pail. The ultra-thick and stiff panels have softened up nicely after successive treatments. Paul's Pail penetrates almost immediately and deeply to give a marked difference in the feel of the leather afterward. I have not had as much success with other treatments. Saddleback recommends another brand to condition their products and after a couple of years of use of that product, I didn't feel that it was doing much of anything. It almost felt as if it would dry the leather out. Paul's Pail certainly doesn't give the leather a dried out feel. After a couple of years of use of the other product, the bag never felt broken in. I can't say enough of how quickly this product penetrates and leaves the leather feeling pliable. Just after one application, the bag has acquired the broken-in feel that it should have for its age.

Another example:

I ordered a guitar strap from Saddleback. In true Saddleback fashion, it's overbuilt. That's a good thing. I wrestled with getting the strap onto one of my guitars and then went to take it off to put on another to see how it would look. To my horror. I could not remove the strap. The opening for the strap horn was too narrow to begin with, and then once on, refused to come off without possibly damaging the guitar itself. Thinking about what to do, I grabbed my container of Paul's Pail and slathered it on the strap. Within' twenty minutes, it had penetrated the leather fully and allowed the fibers to be stretched so the strap could safely be removed without incident.

Bottom line: It works. Use it. You won't be disappointed.

title: just like us, they can’t go to the doctor
text:
Stephen Harrod Buhner;
'Stevia is not a very systemic herb. To work in a live body against infection, especially with Borrelia, an herb has to be VERY systemic, that is it has to spread widely in the body, especially in hard-to-reach places. Stevia does not.'

'The study is in vitro and hence has nothing to do with how the herb will actually work in a living body. It is not possible to extrapolate from a single in vitro study UNLESS there is corresponding data from centuries of historical use, etc (e.g. clinical use and so on).'

'We have over a decade of clinical experience with stevia in the treatment of lyme disease; we suggest it as a supportive herb for a number of problems (blood glucose, etc). We have not seen ANY antimicrobial effects in clinical practice. NONE. However, the herb, because of effects on the GI tract, does help increase the bioavailability of herbs and pharmaceuticals (as does licorice, for example), as such it can help make antibacterials
more effective.'

' The herb is also touted as helping break up biofilms. NOTE: Most herbs contain substances that help break up biofilms; plants figured out how to do that millions of years ago. Plants get sick, just like us, they can’t go to the doctor, they can’t call a medic, they have to treat their own diseases by figuring out what is wrong and crafting substances to deal with the infections they have. Part of the reason they are better than drugs is that they contain multiple substances that they have created to deal with bacteria – they had to deal with bacteria long before our species even existed, so they created antibacterials; they had to deal with bacterial resistance long ago so they create anti-resistance chemicals; they had to deal with biofilms so they created biofilm breaking agents, and so on. There is a list of perhaps 40 herbs that break up biofilms in the second edition of Healing Lyme, this is by no means exhaustive. ALL plants break up biofilms to varying extents.'

title: Fits a baby or maybe a small child.
text: Admittedly, I have a large head; but even so, this is a tiny device -- at least if you consider the two "front" pads that are (apparently) supposed to go somewhere around your temples.  Since those pads are not adjustable (you can't spread them apart), the unit won't fit most human beings.  It fits my cat, but not me.  Also, there are no photos, diagrams or instructions telling you how to position or use the unit.  None on the Amazon page where it is sold, none on or in the box that it comes in.  There is a photo on the box, but that photo is for a differently-designed device.  If you can somehow get this to fit your head, it will give you a "massage" by way of a small vibrator built into the unit.  In my case, I had to cut off the two front pads (they are two inches apart at their narrowest -- and my forehead is certainly wider than 2 inches; but they do fit on my nose).  After doing that I could get a reasonable "massage," but I now have to hold the unit on my head with my hand.  With just one design change this could be a good unit.

text: Saw a lot of one star reviews from people complaining about streaking or poor finish. This is NOT an easy finish to use, you have to know what your doing. If you don’t your going to have a nightmare on your hands. Always sand 60,80,120,150,240,320,400,480,600,800, and 1000 or more if you have it. Clean the wood with acetone or DNA. Use 3-4 coats of sanding sealer, and wipe on one coat of HBFP. Then at at least 1500rpm, apply 2-3 coats, medium pressure making sure to completely saturate the piece and never staying in one place for too long. The Mylands HBFP is some great stuff. It’s not aweful like everyone says, it’s just operator error.

text: I've only really used it once (you know, winter hibernation does not exacerbate crazy partying, at least for me), but they worked pretty well. I did not have the ringing in my ears that I usually get after a hard night of loud music, which is a huge plus. I also was able to hear the music pretty well, but unlike other reviews that said that it was conducive to hearing other people, I can't really promote that piece. Everything seemed muted and if people yelled in my ears I could then hear them, but when it comes down to  the bottom line, when you don't have these ear plugs, people would have to yell in your ears to hear them anyway. This way, I'm doing the same thing, except for the losing my hearing part of that narrative. It felt like I was in my own bubble, just like if I was sticking my fingers in my ears to block out the sound and everything sounded a little nebulous. And that's the reason why it wasn't a full 5 stars; I love the convenient little container that these little earplugs are housed in which upped the ante and the HUGE important piece is that it makes me feel like I am saving my hearing! I would definitely recommend it for people, especially for the price that I paid, long term...REUSABLE is a key word for price. Enjoy!

title: Poor quality - did not work
text:
This mercury test kit comes with 4 vials: one to collect your "specimen" (urine or saliva) and 3 vials with reagents. To use the kit, you pee/spit into the collection vial, add the reagents, and then compare the final color of the solution to a spectrum of colors on the side of the box to determine your mercury levels. This is pretty standard for a DIY test kit.

Everything seemed great, until I noticed that one of the reagent vials was empty. Instead of the "red liquid" the instructions described, all it had was dried red residue. I'm not sure how the liquid dried up (the vial was sealed), but it was definitely unusable. I tried to salvage the test kit by scraping the residue into the collection vial, but unsurprisingly, it didn't work - the liquid never changed color. The box lists an expiration date of June 2016 - need I say poor quality?

I originally bought this kit to avoid more expensive testing at the doctor's office, but it looks like you might be better off making the trek to the hospital.

title: It really works! ... backwards
text:
First, I'm surprised by how much I like the flavor of this powder. If I planned on taking it regularly, I'd drink it in a latte with Oatly or something every day - I think it tastes better than the trendy health powders like matcha or turmeric, almost like a mixture of mild chocolate and horchata. Yum!

Second, I'm convinced this stuff cranks up the immune system as claimed, because after I took it I had mild autoimmune issues all day! It took me about eight hours to realize the astragalus was causing them. I never really have autoimmune issues, so it was an odd hunch, but I had about five strange reactions shortly after taking the astragalus, and when I finally thought to Google "[symptom X] + autoimmune", well ...

* Angry stomach - nausea, bloating, digestive issues after normal food (potentially autoimmune? check!)
* Sudden worsening of my seborrheic dermatitis (potentially autoimmune? you bet!)
* Swollen knees after a very short, very light walk ... WTF (potentially autoimmune? damn straight!)
* Sudden reaction to flea bites (potentially autoimmune? big time)
* Bizarre attraction to the taste of astragalus (... moving on)

So four out of five, none of which is normal for me at all. (They were all mild, though, like 2/10 on the severity scale.) The flea bites one is the most telling: we've got five indoor/outdoor cats at home, and my wife loves to joke that I smell like a horse because fleas NEVER seem to bite me, only her - I've only had one flea bite attack in my life, and that was in like 2009. Anyway, we're fostering four street kittens this week, all of whom have fleas, and while I've been sitting with them since Monday, today was the first day I suddenly started itching after they were on my lap. I grew up with indoor/outdoor cats literally in my crib and never got bitten then either, but after this experience today I'm wondering if maybe fleas do bite me but I just don't have any allergic reaction. (Maybe having the cats in the crib desensitized me at a young age, I don't know.) So that was neat to learn, thanks astragalus, but I don't think I'll be taking you again, for me you were all side effects and no treatment.

That said, I don't want to dissuade other people from trying this. Ever since I started eating healthy (no sugar, no oil, no flour, all real food) my immune system has been *by far* the best it's ever been - I haven't had a cold in three years, even when I actually had immuno-suppression and the doctors kept telling me I'd get sick - so astragalus might be overkill for me. If I were eating a junkier diet a supplement like this could work wonders, so as always YMMV.

title: Bad Smell!!
text:
I was initially impressed with this unit. I read all of the reviews and was prepared for the installation issues regarding the wrong template etc. I used the shipping foam from the box as a template and it worked fine.

Now the problem.
I installed the unit in the plenum of my AC/Furnace above the evaporator coil. I started noticing a strong burning smell after turning the unit on and letting it run. The unit itself does not feel warm nor does the cord. I opened the access panel to the plenum and the smell immediately knocked me back. This means that the smell is being generated by the bulbs themselves inside the plenum. This is not a smell you can get used to or overlook. It chokes you after a few whiffs of it (at the source).

I am disappointed because I had high hopes. The power (72 watts) and the price are both fantastic compared to lowered power more expensive units. I bought this to get rid of smells in my home. However, as much as I want to keep it, the smell it generates is worse than the smell I'm trying to get rid of. If the manufacture can't offer a solution I will have no choice but to return it.

UPDATE: 09/19/2022
I contacted the manufacture via telephone and informed them of the bad smell. They immediately apologized and offered to send me an entirely new unit. Estimated delivery date 3-5 days. I will update after receipt and testing of new unit.

UPDATE: 09/23/2022
Okay, this company gets 5 stars for customer service and timely responsiveness. I called them on Monday and informed them of the bad smell coming from the unit I originally purchased. They promised to ship me a new one and sure enough I received a new unit four days later.

The smell is still present with the new unit but to a much lesser degree. If it does not get any worse, it could become bearable. Based on what I have been reading from other users of UV lights the smell could be ozone, I guess. I am hoping the smell dissipates the longer the unit runs.

On another note, I noticed the Amazon price for this unit has gone from $89.00 to $124.97.

title: Get the pedicure you want at HOME!
text:
With all the things going on with Nail spa's, we are always looking for a way to make sure we have pretty feet. With this callus remover, you will get that look in minutes! No need to wait in a pedicure chair, or even pray that you won't get a disease because they may not sanitize the equipment. No worries! You will have your own personal one at home. This product is very neat, to me. I have had problem with callus for years, and when I got this product and tried it out; I was in awe!

A little description of this amazing remover:
First it does come in a box that will include three different types of heads for your remover. You have one that will immediately get to the bottom of the icky callus. The next one helps with left over callus that wasn't removed with the first mod. The last one smooths the skin on your feet as if you had soaked in a pedicure chair for 30 minutes. Seriously, it is just that good. The product also come with a charge cable for your remover, and I would advise that you let charge for a typical 8 hours to get the best results. You can also use this product with while it is on charger, but I wouldn't recommend. title: Pleased With Cayman 608 Performance, "Two Year Warranty" Not So Much
text: Heating with wood creates a lot of dust. Day One: Sneezing, scratchy eyes and runny nose as usual.  Within 30 minutes air quality improved with sneezing, scratchy eyes and runny nose reduced. Sleep appears  to have also improved with better air quality. Day Two: Wishing I had done this years ago. Week one: Sneezing, scratchy eyes and runny nose eliminated. I note the fan occasionally slows down briefly then picks up. Not a deal breaker.  The Cayman 608 by Okaysou is an attractive, efficient and effective large room air purifier which I use in a medium size room on setting 1 or 2. The round, large area true hepa and charcoal filter is efficient, drawing in contaminants and odors from 360 degrees around the purifier. Consider,  a true hepa filter can help to reduce viruses, mold spores, radioactive particles (fallout), dust mites etc. and could be considered a necessity in the 21st century. The 24 volt DC motor is quiet, draws only 25 watts and can push enough air to flutter the curtains. The sound you hear is moving air and not objectionable to my ear. In sleep mode it's essentially silent.  The illustrated manual is well written and the controls are easy to use. It arrived a day early and packaged for safe shipping.  I am pleased with the purchase but the "two year warranty"..not so much.  Before you can have the "warranty" you need to jump through some hoops: Requirements include the order number, which is reasonable.  Address and phone number are not. What does a company based in China need my phone number and address for? They are data mining and no compliance no warranty. Bait and switch anyone? Consequently no warranty on my purchase. If the unit breaks I'll let you know.

If you are looking for a good, firming eye cream, Soul Naturals Vitamin C Eye Gel is one of the best that I have used. I have been using this product for almost two weeks and can see small differences in tone and texture around my eyes. I am really excited to see continual results!

It dries fairly quick so you can get on with the rest of your beauty routine quickly.

A couple things that I noticed when using the cream is that (1) it does not have much of a scent (i prefer this because I have very sensitive skin and alot of times scented products burn my skin) & (2) once you apply the cream and it begins to dry you can literally feel the cream firming your eye area. I like that because it makes me feel that it is really working! Along with this and the resukts I have seen this far I am excited to see what wonderful things this cream will do for my eyes. A couple things that I really like about this product is that (1) it is made in the USA & (2) it is not tested on animals. Both of these things are important to me when selecting products. I am sure I will be reordering this product. I ahve already told my mom about it. She has every face cream ever made.
If you need a new eye cream look no further. You will be thrilled with the results of this eye cream.

title: A Must have if you are prone to styes!
text: I rarely write any reviews but I never want them to stop making this product so I figured I would. I first came across it almost 5 years ago when I had a stye outbreak in both eyes. One eye was completely swelled shut and there were several on both my upper and lower lids of both eyes. I went to urgent care and an eye doctor and was on antibiotics and an antibiotic drop. Everyone kept saying they’d never seen so many styes before and couldn’t give me any answers. I ended up with 2 giant chalazions and it went on for months. I ordered this one day and figured it was worth a shot. I’m not sure if it’s the product itself or the act of massaging it into the styes that worked but within hours I had several that came to a head (and were absolutely huge). I used it more than three times a day. It is thick and soothing and doesn’t feel uncomfortable at all if it gets inside your eye. In fact, I put it there on purpose to reach the inside of my upper lid. It helps prevent your skin from drying out around your eye as well. The key is to massage! I had no scarring at all and forgot about my styes until I began to feel it in one eye again yesterday. Within hours I could feel at least 10 styes under my upper lid and my eye was quickly swelling. I immediately began using this product and am seeing results quickly. It came to a head at the edge of my lid and has been draining all day and the swelling is going down. I’m so hopeful it doesn’t turn into the same ordeal as last time. It seems I am prone to these in times of stress. I will always keep this stuff in my bathroom!

title: Great once I figured it out
text:
I bought this gel to make my too-loose gold wedding band fit. I followed the directions several times, but the dried gel fell off after no more than a day or two every time. Finally, on about my tenth attempt, I got it to stick. I have had it on for about two weeks now, and it is on solid! I can wash my hands and shower with my ring on, and the gel stays put. Plus, it is discreet and so comfortable that I don't really notice it. I would have given the gel a lower rating because it was so difficult to get right, but now that I got it right, it works so well that I consider it a four-star product.

To make it stick, you have to put a thick glob of gel in one location. Smooth it out on top of the glob, but keep it thick. If it is thin around the edges of the glob, those edges will peel off, and the whole glob will come off. Instead of thinning out the ends of the glob, the ends should be little "cliffs" that go down to the inside of the ring. (Do not coat the entire inside of the ring with the gel! It will start to come off the first time you put the ring on! Use a single glob instead.) Allow at least 24 hours for it to dry. When you put your ring on, be careful not to put too much pressure on the gel as you slide the ring over your knuckle.

I recommend this product to anyone who has a men's wedding band or similar ring that is too large. It works if you're patient!

title: Skeptical at first but WOW did it help!
text:
When I bought this product I was a week into this chalazion or stye being formed and it had grown to the size of pea, maybe a bit larger on my upper eyelid. I'm still not sure what I had exactly, whether it be a chalazion or stye, but it was swollen, red, painful, and got to the point where it was hindering my vision. It also did not have a visible head to it except for bit of redness right under my eye lid. I read online, that at the point it got to I should of gone to the doctor, but there were plenty of people who said they went and surgery was the only option for relief. I did not want to have surgery done on my eyelid especially if there was a way I can resolve this issue at home. I did my fair share of research for home remedies, at first I tried just a hot compresses when I noticed a small bump higher up on my eyelid start forming since at this point it was only swollen once I woke up and only painful if put a bit of pressure on it. A few days later it was even more swollen and larger so I tried ACV. This didn't seam to help at all, and I think it was because there was no visible head to it. I ended up getting TRP Stye Relief at the store which helped with the pain. By then it was larger but stopped causing swelling to the entire eye.

I was like you probably scoping the Internet to try and find some answers and way to get rid of this thing. There were a lot of good reviews on this product so I thought why not and gave it a shot. After using it for a couple days my bump has gone done by 50% and there is no more pain. It is also really soothing since using the hot compresses, ACV, and washing it made my eye area tender. The oil is really thick and a little goes a long way too. I wake up, wash it, put a hot compress for 20 minutes then then I just rub the oil on the bump, under my lash line and I also pick up my eyelid and apply a bit under as well. Then before bed I wash it, do the hot compress and then apply the oil again. It is still on its way to healing but I just wanted to say that it is working. So far it has helped tremendously, since I thought I was never going to get rid of this thing it the slightest way. I know that this review is long but since everyone is slightly different I assumed the more details the better. The pictures are after and before.....

title: Letting me open a window, even with the smoke surrounding me from the Valley Fire that's now blazing through Lake County, CA
text:
We've been forced to stay indoors because of the Valley Fire and the resulting smoke in the air that is also filled with ash and all sorts of chemicals from too many burning homes and buildings. We don't have AC in our 70-year-old house, but have not been able to open the windows because of the smoke (it's THICK, even 10 miles from the fire). With temps in the 90's, this was not pleasant, and we also could not take advantage of night-time temperature drops to cool off the house, because of all the smoke.
This morning, I remembered that I purchased a Safeguard Window Filter about 8 years ago because of seasonal pollen allergies that can be debilitating. It's been in a window in the back of my house since I brought it home. I don't even take it out during our (relatively) mild winters. The breeze usually blows into the house from that side, along with dust and pollen. That room is usually closed from the rest of the house, and has since been a haven for me from the dog hair, pollen, & dust that can cause trouble. That is the one room in my house that does not smell of wood smoke! Luckily, I purchased two filters, and had a second one still in the package! It's now in my kitchen window, letting me cool down my house without letting in the floating ash particles. I still smell smoke, but it is minor.
Even better, I still had the label in the package, and saw that this product is MADE IN AMERICA. I called REP Industries in Lansdale, PA this morning to tell them how wonderful their product is, and was informed that they now have an activated carbon filter that handles the smokey smell!

title: Great for performance enhancement not injury support.
text:
My son is a wrestler and cross country runner. he wanted some light support for his knees to prevent injury and strain. I found an offer to purchase these Icewrap knee sleeves at a discount in exchange for an honest review, so I decided to give them a try.

I purchased the size small for him. He is 5'5" and only 105 lbs. The small were "a little tight" to get on, but not to tight and the snug fit improved support.

The product performed well for what I bought them for. The support was about what I expected, but less than he had hoped. It wasn't enough support to help during a weightlifting workout, but it acted like a light compression sleeve, similar to a compression sock for the knee. It kept his skinny knees warm and lightly supported all day. It was good for his run and unlike his stronger brace didn't tire his legs out. During his weight-training he needed more support so he slipped them down on his calves like a compression sock to increase blood flow and used stronger supports (different product) on his knees. The compression on his calves helped keep his legs energized just like a compression sock.

Basically, if you want support for an injury or weak knees I wouldn't recommend these, but if you want lightweight compression to keep them energized or help with minor swelling, these are good for all day wear. I was pleased with the product, just remember they enhance performance more than provide support. I only gave it 4 stars because it is marketed for strains and sprains and it really doesn't provide enough support for that.

*** UPDATE he has used them for 2 weeks and wears then constantly. He now just slips his heavier brace over them when he needs extra support. He washes them everyday with his sweaty clothes and puts them right back on... He LOVES them... he normally looses everything, but not these! I am truly impressed and upgrading my original 4 star rating to 5 stars. ***

title: Defective batch of steamers
text:
Ordered from this same supplier on another site, and it is the same brand Chromatique. The steamer supposedly has a one-year warranty. Used the steamer for one month in the salon, and it died. The supplier sent a new one that supposedly has a water sensor so the unit automatically turns off if it runs out of water. We filled the machine up according to instructions, and placed a client under it for about 25 minutes to try to get a bleach into her roots. It went dry after about 20 minutes, and the alarm sounded. Within 5 seconds, I ran in there and turned the unit off. Now, the timer works, and the lights comes on, but the element does not heat the water. You will find this exact same steamer on Amazon currently with 400+ reviews and it is for $90 or so. If you look at the reviews for the past two weeks, you'll see all of them are one star, and there are many of them. This batch of units are obviously defective.

The supplier told me he would not be able to send me a second replacement, and would have someone call me instead to "explain how to use it properly." It came with directions, which I followed. The water sensor obviously didn't shut off as promised, and turning it off within 5 seconds of the alarm should be enough to protect the unit anyway. If you do buy a steamer like this, I would advise to buy from another supplier. I will be filing a claim with my credit card company for failure to stand behind the one-year guarantee. We really need steamers to increase our efficiency, but I will likely buy $500 higher-quality steamers from a reputable company with a good warranty instead. These are overseas junk.

title: Very Attractive, Very Functional Floor Lamp
text:
7/30/13 update:

Last Thursday, July 25, the light failed to come on, and I called Verilux. Theresa explained that the first step in warranty service is to send the customer a replacement bulb. If that doesn't solve the problem, the next step is to send the customer a replacement ballast. The bulb arrived four days later, i.e., Monday, July 29. That was all it took. Kudos to Verilux for speedy, cheerful and efficient warranty service. Why a 10,000 hour bulb failed after 7.5 months of normal use is another matter.

(end of update)

This floor lamp looks mighty handsome next to our recliner chair, puts out more than enough illumination in three strengths, and adjusts many ways to throw the light where you want it. Despite all the adjustability, I was surprised to find that the angle and rotation setting of the head aren't that critical. The lamp generates a very wide beam - more like a blanket - that bathes my entire lap in light. The light is very white without being overly cool (i.e., blueish) and is very easy on the eyes. The base is quite heavy and the two sections of the pole screw on solid with no wobble. Unlike another reviewer's experience, the model I received has enough of a machined screw-type head protruding from the base to support the lamp.

The high-medium-low-off rotary switch is reachable from your chair - just lift your arm to turn the lamp on or off. The height adjustment, alas, is not very convenient. You raise or lower the lamp head by first loosening the height adjusting collar (visible on the product illustration). You then pull the head up or push it down. To do this, though, you must either feed in extra cord or pull out the excess. For other than the smallest adjustment, you can't do this from your chair.

It is also worth noting that the first unit I received flickered at the lowest setting until it warmed up. I called Verilux, who told me that this was not normal behavior, and that the reason for the flicker might be other than a defective bulb. Thanks to Amazon's super return policy, I had a replacement unit that worked properly within days. Be aware that once you're beyond Amazon's return period, the true cost of warranty service from Verilux (1 year limited) is substantial. The reason is that you must pay to ship this heavy object to Verilux, and Verilux currently charges over $20 to ship it back to you after servicing it.

All in all, the Verilux Heritage Lamp eliminates eyestrain while adding warmth to our home. I'm very satisfied with this product.

title: Learning curve
text:
I'm in EMS and the reason I got this is that my partner of the day lost my previous pulse-ox.
The asymmetrical design dose make it fall off of moving fingers easier, best to just have the pt rest their hand on something like their lap. charging works easily via USB-C, battery can last me 2-3 days or about 12-15 patients if left on for a 15-20 minute transport. The accuracy is where you need to be careful because it will take 20-30 seconds for your first numbers to appear and they are wrong and always low for spo2 by 5-10%, for the real reading you need to wait a full minute or more.
Your best bet to make full use of this pulse-ox is to get it on early, leave it there while assessing pt and come back to it later. Just remember treat the patient not the machine.

After further use I have found it will not work with fingernails exceeding 1".

title: Good noise reduction and fits smaller ears comfortably

I am an orchestral musician and use ear plugs almost every time I play with a large ensemble. I have had trouble finding earplugs that are comfortable-I think my ears are a little on the small side. I have used Etymotic earplugs in the past, and am still very happy with them, but I was looking for a lower profile option, which is why I tried the Downbeats earplugs.
I also tried the new etymotic earplugs with the shorter stem, and found them very uncomfortable (too large and with a sharp edge), and the eargasm high fidelity earplugs, which felt way too big in my ear. I then found the eargasm smaller ears version, which I am pretty happy with.

Overall, the downbeats are more comfortable than the eargasm smaller ears earplugs, but the eargasm are a little easier to remove from my ear

The etymotic with the longer stems are the easiest to place correctly in my ear and remove, and are about the same comfort level or slightly more comfortable than the downbeats, but the long stem can be a problem depending on what you want to use them for (higher profile, the stem is uncomfortable to sleep in or have headphones on over top of-I know that sounds weird to have headphones on top of ear plugs, but in places like planes that are very loud, I have to raise the volume of my iPod in order to hear, but that passes the safe level, so if I want to listen for longer at the higher volume, I have tried it with earplugs underneath the headphones)

title: This helped me create a heated table for my apartment!
text:
I'm an ice cube living in a co-op where the heat is dictated more by the whims of a vindictive super than by state legal requirements. As such, I really wanted a cute little kotatsu like this (https://www.amazon.com/YAMAZEN-ESK-751-Casual-Kotatsu-Japanese/dp/B00F2C31AM) to keep my feet toasty for the winter! In case you're not familiar, heated tables are a seasonal staple all over Asia (and maybe other parts of the world?), where entire families will gather round and enjoy snacks and TV while enjoying the sweet sweet warmth of a little heater cranking away at the underside of a tabletop.

Unfortunately, these babies run $150+ without the fitted comforter (an additional $150) and I don't trust myself to install a tiny $50 space heater to the bottom of my (pretty low, pretty cheap) coffee table without creating some sort of long term fire hazard or at least burning my lap. Combining this heating pad with things I already had at home meant my cold, frostbitten soul could be revived with a deliciously warm-footed cup of cocoa on a Sunday morning without doing any drilling / spending more than $40! This thing is a lifesaver.

text: I purchased this product because of the integrity of the process in which these products are made.  I like that they don't include the mycelium and associated starch in their manufacturing.  I noticed a difference immediately with the look, color, taste, and smell (vs a previous brand that included the mycelium) as well as the effect I felt from taking it.  With my previous brand I took 1 tsp 2x per day, but this is much stronger and I had to cut the dosage in half to avoid some detoxing.  It definitely works and seems to be the best medicinal mushrooms I've come across.  This reishi is definitely more bitter than other brands, which makes sense since it appears to be the purest brand on the market.  I take a lot of herbs in hot water on an empty stomach, so I'm used to things not tasting good, so the bitterness doesn't bother me.  In fact, it reminds me of black coffee.  I knocked off one star for two reasons.  First, the packaging is some of the most difficult I've encountered.  It sounds like they are working on it, but in the meantime, be aware that you will have issues with closing the envelope and you will lose product via a powder vapor that occurs everytime you fuss with trying to open/close the product.  The second reason being there is no Customer Service phone number, which I am a stickler about.  I think all companies should offer their customers a chance to speak with them, even if it is only during limited hours.  Nonetheless, I completed the Contact Us form on their website and never heard back.  They said it would be a 48 hour turnaround, but it's been about a week and still no response.  So service is lacking entirely, but the product seems to be second to none, so for this reason alone, I will continue to purchase it.  I also work with a renowned herbalist and will be mentioning to her how great the Real Mushroom products are.

title: 1) I wanted something different from natural whey flavors like plain whey
text:
I started looking into Syntrax’s Nectar products because:
1) I wanted something different from natural whey flavors like plain whey, vanilla, and chocolate
2) I wanted to mix in a tsp or two of creatine powder into my protein drinks and not have it taste terrible.

Furthermore you’re supposed to take creatine daily so I wanted something I would enjoy drinking every day that wouldn’t be too sweet or bitter. Creatine tastes very bitter and metallic and does not go well with the milky base flavor of most whey powders. As an avid cook I know how to mask and balance flavors, and to cover up bitterness, you can use sweetness and/or sourness (among many other things). So, I bought a sample pack of 10 Syntax flavors from MyBariatricPantry.com, and here’s my tasting reviews:

Roadside Lemonade - 9/10 Covers up bitterness of creatine, but is a bit too sweet to have every day and just not quite enough tartness for me. Very close though. I really expect lemonade to be sour and I wasn’t finding enough of it. It could possibly work if you watered it down or if you like lemonade a bit on the sweeter side.

Strawberry Kiwi - 8/10 Covers up bitterness of creatine, but is a bit too sweet. This one surprised me in that strawberry flavoring can often be overly sweet and I don’t normally enjoy it, but by adding kiwi it balanced the sweetness and brightened it a bit with some tartness. That said, this one was still too sweet to have every day.

Caribbean Cooler - Never arrived! They gave me two Roadside Lemonades instead.

Fuzzy Navel - 10/10 Covers up bitterness of creatine, and is the best flavor in my opinion of them all. It was actually the most tart/sour of any of them with a surprisingly natural peach flavor and not too sweet. I found myself wanting to drink more after the first sip! I was truly shocked by this as I was expecting an overly sweet peachy candy flavor, but this is the flavor I went with and works perfectly for my uses.

Apple Ecstasy - 3/10 Covers up bitterness of creatine, but is way too sweet for me. Reminds me exactly of green apple jolly ranchers in flavor and sweet/sourness. Very artificial tasting and hard to get down except in small sips.

Pink Grapefruit - 8/10 Covers up bitterness of creatine, but was slightly too sweet. I was hoping this would be the winner as I love grapefruit, but if there’s anything I expect from grapefruit it’s sourness, tartness, and bitterness, which I hoped would mask the chemical bitterness of creatine. Instead it was more sweet than tart with an aftertaste of grapefruit. It did cover it up, but was slightly too much like candy for me. You could dilute it a bit more with water and it would work for an every day protein drink though.

Crystal Sky - Crystal Sky - 7/10 Wow, this one surprised me. First, it covers up the creatine. Second, it tastes way better than it looks. The bright bubble-gum blue color and smell is definitely off-putting but the flavor is actually not too sweet and balanced some with good tartness. It definitely has some tropical hints of banana and pineapple, but they are balanced by its sourness. It's not the most natural tasting flavor, but kind of reminds me of if you took a bunch of sweet tart flavors and mixed them together in your mouth with a sip of pina colada. I definitely couldn't drink this every day, but I would have no problem with it once in a while to shake things up.

Lemon Tea - 6/10 Covers up the creatine taste. Unfortunately the color of this one looks way more like a cappuccino flavor than lemon tea, which is not too nice to look at, but the flavor isn't bad. It's exactly like an arizona ice tea, but this means it's way more sweet than sour, which I wouldn't want to drink regularly.

Wild Grape - 1/10 Could still taste the creatine slightly and it was brought out by the slightly chalky Tylenol grape child chew tablet flavor that I used to have as a kid. Very sweet with only a bit of sourness to put it off. Somewhere between grape jolly rancher and medicinal grape flavor. It was difficult getting this one down for me.

Cappuccino Latte - 1/10 Could still taste the creatine a bit and the flavor was overpoweringly sweet. Was like a frappucino gone haywire. Definitely could not have this every day and I’m a coffee lover. The aftertaste was like colored sugar dots on paper I used to have as a kid—just cloyingly sweet. Had to mix with actual coffee to get it down.

title: L was good for plus (20-22) size belly and back pain
text:
There are two surprising things about this brace: 1) as a plus size woman, the large fits me at singleton pregnancy 35 weeks (with room to grow) and 2) it actually works.

My measurements pre-pregnancy are 49-42-52, so I don't tend to carry a ton of weight in my middle. Still, I was concerned about this being a little too small since I'm at the very top of the weight range for a large. Turns out, when I first got this at 34 weeks, I needed to put it on the most snug setting. At 35 weeks, I now comfortably use the middle setting and probably will be able to for a while. (I think the adjustable band is one of the best parts, so if you're trying to save money and get the older version that's not adjustable, reconsider!)

Now for the pain: I had SI joint dysfunction pre-pregnancy, and I pulled my back out very badly at about 34 weeks. Although this didn't exactly "fix" the problem, wearing the brace after a couple of days of resting has allowed me to fold laundry or make a light dinner without any additional pain. I can even sit down for a little bit (rather than lay or stand). It really does releive a few pounds of pressure from my hip joints. I wonder if I'd been wearing this earlier if I wouldn't have injured my back at all... I highly recommend this product, even if the front straps are difficult to "hide" under many of my clothes. To me, it's worth the extra effort.

title: Amazingly portable toothbrush.
text:
This toothbrush is very easy to use. The soft head might be a bit smaller than what you might be use to. Most toothbrushes have a slightly larger head, or at least more bristles on the head. That doesn’t stop it from being a good travel toothbrush. The cap has a few holes for vent, but dust and dirt can get in those holes.

To fill the toothbrush, simply unscrew the bottom part from the head of the toothbrush and turn the knob up until it hits the top. Then turn the knob down until it gets to the bottom again. Point the exit of any or your favorite toothpaste into the hole of the bottom piece and squeeze. The bar will show when the bottom toothpaste holder is full.

To use the toothpaste or have it come out of the top of the toothbrush, simply turn the knob up until the desired amount of toothpaste is on the toothbrush then turn the knob back down a bit to release the pressure. There is a little tube that is in the center of the toothbrush head for toothpaste to exit.

I usually clean the toothbrush in a bottle or cup of water and swirl it around when I don’t have a faucet or running water to clean it with, such as camping. Other times, I would clean it like a normal toothbrush.

For me, each use takes up about 1 bar of toothpaste and the tube that the toothpaste travels up will take a few bars. I get about 10 uses out of each full fill.

I really like this toothbrush but it would be perfect if it had a slightly larger head and maybe even store more toothpaste. The head can be easily resolved by having replacement heads of different sizes and firmness.

I received this product for free or at a discounted price in exchange for an unbiased and honest review.

title: I call it the FREEDOM ACCELERATOR!
text: It changed my life! I have a right leg amputation, Now I can drive with my left foot. Also, did not have to spend thousands to equip my new SUV with ugly hand controls and permanent hardware to make it ugly and hard to share with my wife. I had to take an approved driver rehab class to get my license back. I needed to get signed off on the left sided accelerator and take the state road test with it. Perfect in every aspect. Just a bit to light. I used gorilla tape to secure it in place on a plush floor mat, now I just have to pull it out on the mat, and it goes back in place lined up every time. Makes it very easy to swap out with my wife driving. It took about 3 minutes to install. About 10 to 15 minutes to get it lined up properly. Thank you to the Vet who sells and manufactures them. Side note: if your vehicle has the stops in place to secure floor mats, you have to remove them. They wont allow the base to sit flat. Also if you have memory features on the pedals and seats, you will have to make sure that the other drivers setting does not force the accelerator to get pushed down. Just remember to hit your memory button before you throw it in.

title: Worth the $$
text: I purchase quite a bit from the Amazon market place and this is the first item that I've felt compelled to take the time to sit down and right a review. I am a professional handyman...I get paid to install this and all other types of home repair and upgrade products. I must say this is the most well made and well functioning handheld shower/diverter system I have ever installed, and luckily it was for me and my family. Every component of this system weighs twice what you think it would. These are precision machined parts from solid stock material, very similiar to billet type products if you are familiar with those. Installtion was easy and straight forward and it works very well. Both the showerhead and handheld showerhead have a very easily removable water restriction device. So if you're like us and have low water pressure to begin with it's very simple to remove and gain full-flow. The adjustable clamp on the verticle rod is very easy to operate, even my 8 year old is able to do it. The additional momentary shut-off valve installed at the handheld shower is great to use while giving pets a bath. Set the water temp, leave the main valve open and turn on/off water flow as needed and maintain a constant temperature. I rate this product an A+ and well worth the money.

title: Two A23 batteries, ultrasonic fogger, no shut off switch, no automatic shutoff
text:
I purchased this device directly from manufacture.

Be careful to not let the electrodes touch each other or any conductive material (e.g. metal).
The electrodes are connected directly to the batteries, and there is no shut off switch
or fuse (AFAICS) between the electrodes and the batteries.

The device consists of:
1. Plastic body containing an ultrasonic fogger and a glass jar.
2. Plastic cap containing two 12V A23 batteries and electrode holders.
3. AC 24VDC @ 1Amp ultrasonic fogger transformer.
4. Scrub pad to clean electrodes.

The device DOES NOT include silver rod electrodes, which are purchased separately.

To assemble device:
1. Press the angle cut end of thinner electrode into silver colored electrode holder on bottom of cap.
2. Press the angle cut end of the thicker electrode into the gold colored electrode holder on bottom of cap.
3. BE EXTREMELY CAREFUL TO NOT ALLOW THE ELECTRODES TO TOUCH EACH OTHER OR ANY CONDUCTIVE MATERIAL (E.G. METAL).
4. Download IONX Timer app or use some other timer.

To operate the device:
1. Remove glass jar from plastic body.
2. Instructions say to add 50 ml (I think actually 30 ml or 1 oz) of ice cold water to body to submerge ultrasonic
fogger with water. It is very important use ICE COLD water to prevent the ultrasonic fogger from overheating.
Using distilled water will make the ultrasonic fogger last much longer.
3. Add 4 oz of distilled water to glass jar.

Sadly, my sleep began to suffer. I still never felt tired so I didn't really care at first. But then I began getting to the point where I would shake from exhaustion, in spite of still not really feeling tired.

I had to quit because I was getting to the point where I was losing full nights of sleep. I even tried cutting my already tiny portion in half again to 1/64 of a teaspoon. No luck.

Mix the yogurt and dry ingredients well. Then add the liquid ingredients and mix well again. If using a thickening agent, let stand 5 minutes to thicken.

title: An excellent quality device at an incredible price point
text:
About four months ago, I was offered a free Antrolife Blood Pressure Monitor for review via the Amazon Vine Program, and I accepted.

My blood pressure (BP) has always been a little high. It's great to be able to track it at home with a straightforward, compact, lightweight, easy-to-read, easy-to-use device like this. It is SUPER easy to use. The most difficult part is putting the arm cuff on, and that's easy! Once you have the arm cuff in the correct position, slightly above the elbow, attach the hose to the main unit and press start. The built in voice guidance is fairly good and understandable. The cuff will inflate and your BP will register on the bright, crystal clear screen. When the reading is all done, the unit will read the results aloud and give you a prognosis. Depending on what you're shooting for, your interpretation of the numbers may be a little different than what it says though.

The unit itself is lightweight, but feels like it's well made. I like the clean design a lot, too. The edges are all rouned so it's easy to handle and hold. The LED screen is super crystal clear and easy to read... in fact, I'm not 100% certain, but I think it may be OLED. There are four rubber feet on the bottom along with the the speaker. The cuff is easy to insert and remove. The design is great.

It comes with a nice little carry case that fits the main unit, the arm cuff and a USB-A to USB-C cable for using it without batteries (and it includes 4xAAA batteries).

Overall, it is an excellent quality device at an incredible price point. I gotta say that at this price, everyone should have one of these along with a fingertip blood oxygen monitor and maybe even one of the new ECG (EKG) readers. Take charge of your health. The first step is knowing your readings. Highly recommended.

Just a little side note: One of the most important things in taking an accurate BP reading is to be relaxed. If you look up info on the proper procedure, you're really not supposed to be doing any activity for at least 10 to 15 minutes prior to the reading and certainly you wouldn't take a BP reading for hours after any strenuous excercise. BP is very sensitive to both physical activity and stress. IMO the best time to do it is when you're relaxing at home, maybe even just prior to going to bed. When you put the cuff on, try to stay calm and let it do it's thing. You can throw off a reading by a lot just by being tense.

title: Dissolves well, but very expensive per ounce when compared with others
text:
About two months ago, I was offered a free 7.4oz jar of Ketond Collagen Peptides (types I & III) for review via the Amazon Vine Program, and I accepted.

I've been using various brands of collagen peptides for almost three years - mostly type I & III. I can't be 100% clinically certain, but collagen peptides seem to have done a lot of good for the health of my gut - so I'm definitely a fan.

The Ketond Collagen Peptides arrives in a resealable 7.4oz plastic jar. In my case, it was completely unlabeled - I assume, because it was a new product released to me for early Amazon Vine review. That said, I prefer plastic jars over bags for collagen peptides as they offer the easiest, fuss-free usage. There is a fairly small plastic serving scoop in the jar.

According to the product description here (since my jar had no label), this is a type I & III collagen peptides. According to the question that I asked of the manufacturer, "the collagen ingredients are from the USA and the product is also manufactured in the USA." The description also states that the product is from "grass-fed, pasture-raised, Grade A bovine, and are certified hormone-free and 100% non-GMO." That is all very good.

Probably unlike most people who add collagen peptides to liquid for consumption, such as coffee, I tend to add them directly to my meals whenever possible. However, for the purpose of this review, I tested this Ketond collagen peptides in both hot and cold liquids. It dissolved as quickly as some of the fastest dissolving peptides I've used in the past, such as [[ASIN:B00XQ2XGAA Sports Research]] or [[ASIN:B07BL69CD2 Orgain]]. Like most collagen peptides, it dissolves notably faster in hot liquids than cold. In my experience, all unflavored collagen peptides add some very subtle flavor, usually similar to a very, very weak salt. This is no exception. Depending on what you put it in, you may or may not be able to detect it.

In all honesty, I tend to purchase the cheapest collagen peptides I can per ounce and stock up when I see sales. There are huge price differences between various brands and aside from subtle differences in they way they dissolve, I seriously doubt there is much actual difference in the efficacy at different price points when compared with other type I & III peptides. I am willing to pay a higher price for the more complete type I, II, III, V & X peptides. I try to get certified grass fed whenever possible and would never purchase *any* labelled to have *anything* to do with China.

As of the time of this review, this Ketond Collagen Peptides is on the very expensive side per ounce at $4.05. I've seen some good collagen peptides that I've used for as low as $1.09/ounce. I've seen others at well over $2/ounce, such as this brand. Based on the price alone, which is really high for a type I & III peptides powder, I'd give this three stars. I'll give it an extra star because it dissolves quickly, if that's important to you. That said, at well under this price point you can easily get a superior type I, II, III, V & X collagen peptides.

title: Not Worth Any Price
text:
Don't buy this pipe unless it's ONLY for display. It looks good, but if you're a pipe smoker, you'll be disappointed, frustrated, and angry!
1) To start with, the product description would lead one to believe that the bowl --while not meerschaum-- is porcelain, as in fine china tea cup. Not so! To be sure, it IS porcelain but not like fine china; it is more like a porcelain bathroom fixture. The bowl itself weighs 5.5 ounces (164 grams); that's about a third of a pound! Without using your hand to hold it up while smoking, you must clench your teeth really tight around the bit. The rest of the pipe is lightweight for a total of 7 ounces (198 grams).
2) When I started trying to smoke this pipe, the smoke wouldn't draw. There were leaks where the bowl rests on the body, where the stem screws into the body, and where the bit fits into the stem. I was able to fix that as follows: I used Teflon white plumbers tape on the threads on the porcelain, the threads on the screw-in stem, and the bit where it fits into the stem. I also used white casein glue (kid's glue or carpenter's glue) between the bowl and the Wax Berry body. (The Teflon there was to keep the glue out of the threads so if I ever wanted to get it apart again, I could.) After that, I was reasonably happy with my pipe; it smoked fairly well for about a month. Then, ...
3) I got out my pipe, filled it with tobacco, clenched it in my teeth around the bit to light it, and the stem broke off completely, left hanging only by the plumbers tape!
Though I'm loath to throw the pipe away after all that trouble, I think I will.

title: Decent Inexpensive Stone Heating Pad - Never Reached Max Temp (158 deg)
text:
There is alot to like about the XUYU Infrared Heating Pad Mat. Its relatively large (app 16x21"). The heating stones are well placed and the tubes are full enough to get the heating effect while still allowing for the mat to be rolled up. The digital heat controller allows you to control both the temp and the heating duration.

I've never used one of these before and it's a little different. As opposed to your typical electrical heating pad, it doesn't heat up immediately - building heat into the stones over about a 30 min time period. The control unit allows for temp selection so I just turned it all the way up and waited. The heating was very uniform and did a pretty good job. I liked the auto-turn off function as I worried that the heated stones would get too hot and start melting either the heating pad or my clothing. I guess at the temp it reaches, that's really not a risk, but you never know.

The only knock I have is that the mat did not reach its maximum stated heating temp of 158 deg F as it never go about about 146 deg. This isn't a big difference, but if your documentation states a specific temperature threshold, it should meet that threshold.

The purchase price of $62 sounds super steep for a heating pad, but after a quick look at other similar pads on Amazon, the price is actually on the low end of the spectrum for infrared/rock heating pads. Some of the other pads have greater functionality and temp control and larger size, but you get the idea.

Off the bat, there is nothing "attractive" about the shield frame. You look like an absolute idiot wearing it. Although attractiveness should not be what you are going for and I won't knock the product on the review for this, I still needed to point out how laughable this point was.

2nd the frame doesn't look anything like the photos as it has no sharp corners on the sides. It's just a graduale arc for the clear plastic to fit into.

3rd the clear plastic not only doesn't wrap around your face, as shown in the photo, they don't fit in the frame correctly. The film as inserted into the frame only covers a little longer than eye to eye - you have no side protection at all. And to get the film into the frame you need to snip the edges in order to insert them - the slot in the frame is about 1/4" to short.

With all that together, I would never wear this product since it has no side protection and it is VERY unattractive. The clear plastic film is nice quality, but nothing else is. I wouldn't pay $5 for this product let alone $19.
