title: A Good Decent Cleaner ✔
text:
The "GreenFist Hydrogen Peroxide All Purpose Cleaner" arrives in a 1 gallon jug. It has no color / is clear but does have a faint Orange scent.

I have used Hydrogen Peroxide cleaners before and actually prefer to use them in my bathroom.

I feel like they clean soap scum off my sink better than regular cleaning products. I didn't have to scrub as much either.

This time I decided to try this brand in my kitchen. I used it on my countertop and to clean my stainless steel double sink.

It removed the food spills off my countertop easily enough, leaving behind a faint Orange scent.

The sink was a little harder, it had a white film on some of the stainless steel from dish liquid and various food / drink leftover build up. I had to use a little power to scrub with this cleaner but then I went back and rinsed my stainless steel sink, it looked good and shiny. I was satisfied with the results overall.

title: Gives a decent shave and trim, but takes too long
text:
[[VIDEOID:4e7127560e0dce32815de1168e58073]] This compact, lightweight 3-in-1 Nose, Ear and Facial Trimmer has the 3 blades that are easy to install, and to remove.

The nose hair trimmer pulled an occasional nose hair as I trimmed my nose hairs. I needed to move the trimmer inside my nose repeatedly to trim the long hairs that I could see, taking longer than it normally takes me to trim the hairs. When I was done, I cleaned this trimmer under running water.
note: I could not remove any parts of the nose hair trimmer.

The round shave trimmer gave a decent shave (I shave multiple times a week), but it took longer to shave my face than it did when using my preferred razor. When I felt my face after shaving, I didn't get as close a shave as I'd like.

The hair trimming blade, with options for 2.0 mm and 6.0 mm, gave a good cut that I liked. This was my favorite of the three blades.

Of the 3 blades, the nose hair trimmer makes the least noise, while the hair trimmer makes the most noise. I did not find this trimmer to be too noisy.

Lastly, the user manual has detailed illustrations; but, the text instructions were a bit confusing. For instance, under in the section "Cleaning and maintenance - machine body cleaning" --- the manual says "...can split the blade and body, it's convenient to clean the hair debris in the gap.....".

title: Gets our surfaces cleaner; abrasive texture; lightweight
text:
[[VIDEOID:b6b9e7fb29337dba3cfed77f93ad002]] These six (6) pumice stones come individually wrapped in plastic.

When I unwrapped a pumice stone, tiny bits of pumice debris fell on to the counter. It's not a big deal, just something I noted.

The pumice stone felt light in my hand. It has an abrasive texture.

I wet the pumice stone before I use it to avoid excessively scratching those surfaces.
I like how well these pumice stones worked to get rid of the stains and rust rings of our sinks and toilets, although it took a lot of scrubbing to remove those stubborn stains.
I like that although the pumice stone does get smaller the more times that I use it, the stone did not break off into multiple pieces.

Lastly, the product description page has good details and tips on how to use the pumice stones. The product I received did not contain any information, just the pumice stones themselves.

Overall, these pumice stones helped make our surfaces look better.

title: Does a decent job in cleaning our bricks; mild lemon scent.
text:
This All-Green Cleaner comes in a 22-oz bottle with a separate sprayer top.
I removed the cap and saw no inner seal. This cleaner has a mild lemon scent, as I sniffed the bottle.
I then put the sprayer top on. I like that the tube touches the bottom of the bottle.

I used this Cleaner to clean the bricks around the fireplace, as follows:
1) I poured water on the bricks to get it wet. A few minutes later, I sprayed the bricks with this Cleaner.
2) After ".....let[ting] the product sit for 30 minutes...." (as per directions on the bottle), I then started scrubbing.

I like that the bricks did not look as dusty as they did before I started cleaning, even though I could not get the bricks to show that classic red color.

My driveway has areas with dirt/grime/debris that were recently made, and other areas that haven't been cleaned in a while. I sprayed all those areas, waited 30 minutes and then started scrubbing. This Cleaner got the areas with the newer stains clean, but I couldn't get the more stubborn stains out.

Overall, this All Green Masonry Cleaner does a decent job in cleaning the bricks and parts of our driveway.

title: Sterile; Soft, stretchy; applies in comfortable, firm, secure manner; Not constrictive
text:
[[VIDEOID:72de899de748e7f7d3bd4af1bdc264af]] This product consists of a box containing 30 rolls of gauze.
Each gauze is individually wrapped in plastic, which I like because it keeps them free of dirt and debris until I need to use the gauze.

The gauze is 4-inches wide.

I opened a roll, and then wrapped it around my lower leg, and left it there for the rest of the day. The gauze is very soft to the touch and is stretchy. It did not feel constrictive and did not cause pain in my leg.

Overall, this rolled gauze has the features that I look for: soft, elastic, and does not feel overly tight against the skin once it is applied.

title: Cleans floor decently; mild pleasant scent
text:
I like the convenience of these Floor Cleaning Sheets: put sheets into a bucket of water, go get my mop and mop heads and when I come back a few minutes later, the sheet has dissolved. While wearing a pair of gloves, I swished the solution around to get a good mixture.

The sheets - dissolved in water - cleans our floor decently. I could not get the more stubborn stains at the bottom of the baseboards cleaned with the mop, so I hand-scrubbed the stains away using another product.
Once cleaned and dry, the floor has a mild, pleasant scent. I saw minimal residue on the floor once I was done cleaning and the floor got dry.

These 30 sheets take up very little space in our cabinet.

Lastly, the product package did not have instructions that I could understand to tell me how much water I should use with one cleaning sheet.

title: All-in-one repair kit for my eyeglasses needs
text:
This EyeGlass Repair Kit contains the items I need for replacing my old nose pads, and the plastic case (which holds all the parts of this product) is compact and portable.

I used the Phillips side of the screwdriver to remove the old screw. I removed the used nose pad, cleaned that area of my glasses with rubbing alcohol to remove the dirt and grime.
Then, I inserted a new silicone nose pad, used the tweezers to insert the screw into the hole before using the Phillips to tighten the screw.
note: the screws are tiny, and the tweezers were great to pick up a screw and inserting it into the hole. I tried using my fingers to pick up a screw, but kept dropping it on the table.

The PVC nose pads are too hard on the bridge of my nose, so I decided not to use them.

I bent the temple tips of my eyeglasses frame to fit my ears just fine, so I had no need to use the flexible anti-slip ear grips.

Overall, I find this repair kit useful for my eyeglasses needs.

title: Does a decent job in trimming nose hairs
text:
[[VIDEOID:cf07da52f282a7439cbf0291066a0247]] This lightweight and compact Nose and Ear Hair Trimmer does a good job in trimming my nose hairs.

The blades cut fairly well, although it takes doing multiple rotations with the trimmer head in my nose before I feel as if my nose hairs are trimmed well enough.

I did not find the trimmer to be too noisy while I am using it.

The oddity about this trimmer is that the cap/lid at the bottom of the trimmer has multiple functions. There is a vertical mark on the cap/lid.
a) if I align this mark to the triangle icon on the trimmer, I can remove the cap/lid and insert the battery before closing it.
b) if I align this mark to the "O" icon, the trimmer is in Off position.
c) if I align this mark to the "I" icon, the trimmer in in On position.

This trimmer uses 1 AA-battery (which is included).

Overall, while this trimmer does the job in trimming my nose hairs, it is not user friendly in regards to the multiple functions of the cap/lid.

title: Deliciously sweet; soft texture; I take these for my nerve & red blood cells
text:
These Vitamin B12 Energy Gummies come in a plastic bottle with an outer plastic seal around the cap and an inner seal - two good security measures.

The gummies are soft to the touch.
These gummies taste deliciously sweet! I also like that they did not stick to my teeth or the roof of my mouth as I chewed them.

For what it's worth, the shape of the gummies I received do not resemble that shown on the product description page.

I take B12 vitamin supplements for their health benefits, such as beneficial effects on my nerve and red blood cells. However, since taking these gummies on a daily basis for the past 3 weeks, I can't say that I feel more energetic than I did before taking this product.

With 60 gummies, and a daily recommendation to take 2 of them daily, this bottle will last me 30 days.

A daily serving of 2 gummies gives:
-- 1000 mcg Vit B12 (41,667% recommended daily value)
-- 400 mcg DFE folate (100%)

Expiration date is located on the bottom of the bottle. Mine expires 03/2023.

Lastly, I like the high quality manner in which these gummies are made: GMP (good manufacturing practice) seal, made in FDA-registered facility, gluten-free, non-GMO.

title: Basic first-aid kit
text:
[[VIDEOID:46267d34caf579aa53ecbe39a3c1dfcc]] What I like:
-- the elastic bandages feel soft.
-- the gauze pad and triangular bandage are in sterile packages, keeping them clean until I need to use it.
-- antiseptic towelette is good for cleaning a wound before applying a dressing treatment.
-- the bag is compact and portable, and has a number of loops to attach it to something else (for instance, I could put this on a carabiner inside my backpack).

On the other hand:
-- there are too many safety pins and adhesive bandages. The smallest sized adhesive bandages (10*40mm) do not stick well once I place them on my fingers.
-- adhesive tape is too thin in width, being only 1.25 cm wide (1/2-inch), and it doesn't stick as well as I would like. I have to use multiple pieces of tape to secure a dressing.
-- the plastic tweezers are too flexible.

Overall, this is a decent mini first-aid kit.

title: Semi-solid consistency; spreads well on my skin
text:
This petroleum jelly comes packaged in 6-ounce plastic jars with a lid that opens by lifting the lid and closes by pressing the lid down on the jar to snap it shut.
There is no inner security seal; but, these jars are packaged neatly in tight plastic, and when I opened a jar, the petroleum jelly was smooth all over, and not disturbed.

This petroleum jelly has a semi-solid consistency and is soft & smooth to the touch.

I sniffed the jar, and could not smell a scent.

It feels gentle on my skin. It spreads well as I applied it to various areas of my body.
I make sure, when I am applying this, to spread just a thin layer.
note: on my skin, the dead skin cells will slough off; if I put on too much petroleum jelly, it makes it harder for the cells to slough off, and will also trap dirt/debris/bacteria.

On the product description page, the 2nd picture at the upper right left side (2nd picture out of 7 pictures) states, "..tested and approved by dermatologists..."; however, I examined the label on the front and on the back of the jar, and did not see any mention of this. When claims are made, I like to see them on the label.

Currently, I am using this on my dried, cracked skin for the past 3 weeks, and it's helped the skin close together, and eased the pain.

On the bottom of the jar, there is a manufacturing date (9/2020) and an expiration date (8/2023).

Overall, I like how well my skin has responded and that this petroleum jelly did not irritate my skin.

title: Artificial elderberry flavor; mild sweet; chewy; 2 gummies: 90mg Vit C, 100mg elderberry, 7.5mg Zinc
text:
This Elderberry + Vitamin C gummy product comes in a plastic bottle with a protective inner seal.

The gummies have a moderate fruity scent as I sniffed the gummies in the bottle. They taste mildly sweet.
They are chewy; as I kept chewing, some of the gummy stuck to my teeth.

According to the label, a daily serving of 2 gummies gives 90-mg Vitamin C (100% daily value), 100-mg elderberry, and 7.5-mg zinc (68% daily value), and has 18 calories.

When I am taking an herbal supplement, I look to see how the product is manufactured and the ingredients list.
The product label on the bottle makes no mention of the quality and manner in which these gummies are produced.
In the Other Ingredients section, I noticed that one of the ingredients is artificial elderberry flavor.

Expiration date is on the bottom of the bottle; mine expires 11/2021.

While this brand has the ingredients that I need (elderberry, Vitamin C, Zinc) to help with my immune system, I am returning to my current brand that is made in an FDA-registered facility, GMP-certified, and 3rd-party tested and has a higher content of elderberry and zinc per two gummies.

title: Mask protects my face well; adjustable ear loops for good fit
text:
These 2 cloth face masks (each mask is individually packed in its own resealable plastic bag) fit my small-size face in a comfortable manner.
The flexible nose clip helps the mask stay more securely on the bridge of my nose. I find that the more closely the mask fits around my nose, the less often my glasses fog up.
The ear loops are adjustable, allowing a good form-fitting mask without the loops tugging at my ears.

At each side of the mask, the ear loops are sewn into the mask (as opposed to masks that have the loops sewn on the outside or the inside of the masks).

I like that there is a slot inside the mask, where I can put in a PM2.5 filter.
note: filters are not included with these masks. I am fine wearing these 3-ply masks as is, and have not bought filters to put inside the slot.

I like that the bottom part of the mask has a extension such that the mask goes under my chin.

The mesh helps prolong the life of these masks during repeated washings.

There are a number of laundry symbols on the back of the resealable bag. Here's how I interpreted the symbols:
wash in water temperatures not above 30 degrees, do not bleach, do not tumble dry, iron any temperature - steam, any solvent.

On the back of the resealable bag, there are confusing instructions, such as "...wash the poison once a day, wash it with warm water first, then bot and hot to dry..."
The instruction to wash in warm water is in contrast with the laundry symbol that I interpreted above, "wash in water temperatures not above 30 degrees".

Overall, I like how well this mask fits my face from the bridge of my nose to under my chin.

title: Can't fit mop into Wash or Dry compartment without pad lifting off mop
text:
[[VIDEOID:efb7d9cdb254f16979b4f77332c3479b]] Short summary: I had a hard time getting this flat mop and bucket to work in its intended manner.

More details:
I could not get the mop with the microfiber pad to fit into either the Wash or Dry compartment without the pad lifting off the mop.
After repeated attempts to get the mop & pad into the bucket, the sticky part lifted away from the mop (see pic).
However, if I held each side of the width of the mop at one end with my hands, and slowly pushed it into either the Wash compartment or the Dry compartment, I was able to get the mop into the compartments.

To take off the top part of the bucket (so that I could pour out the water), I gently pull out the red handle on both sides. Then, I could lift the top off of the bucket.
After I placed the top part back on to the bucket, I could not fully fit the red handle back into its slot. Instead, the red handle juts out a little. (see pic).

The user manual has clear illustrations on how to assemble the mop & handle. As I am using the mop, sometimes, the handle comes apart. I decided to tape the handle at multiple areas.

As I am cleaning our hardwood floor, the microfiber pad does clean the floor, but, it also pushes some of the dust/debris (instead of picking it up) along the floor as I mop the floor.

I measure the bucket to be 15" tall.
I measure the bucket to be 8-1/2 inches from front to back.
I measure the bucket to be 8-inches from side to side.
I measure the microfiber pad to be 13-inches length x 5-inches width.

In short, this product did not work for me.

title: Rich, smooth, sweet, delicious vanilla taste. 26 Vitamins & minerals
text:
This ready-to-drink Nutrisure protein shake (vanilla flavor) comes in 6 compact plastic bottles that have an outer seal on the cap. Each bottle is 8-fl. oz.

This shake has a rich, smooth, sweet, delicious vanilla taste. It doesn't have a gritty taste (it helps that I shake each bottle vigorously prior to drinking it).

The consistency of this shake is like that of whole milk (whereas, I typically drink low-fat milk, which has a thinner consistency).

Instructions on the bottle label advises, "...shake well...serve cold..."
I agree. I drank one at room temperature, and while it still tasted sweet, it was not as refreshing as the others that I drank after it had been refrigerated.

I like how nutritious a serving size of 1 bottle is:
-- 26 vitamins & minerals (including Vitamins A, K, B12, E)
-- 9g protein

One minor issue: I found it a bit difficult to open the outer seal. I used a knife to lift up the plastic seal, and then I could unwrap it. It's not a big deal to me.

Expiration date is on the cap of each bottle. Mine expires Dec 2, 2020.

Finally, this protein shake should not be consumed by those who have galactosemia, as per writing on the label.

When I don't have time to eat as healthy as I'd like (typically, at lunch at work), I look for drinks that give me a more complete, balanced nutrition. This Basic Care Nutrisure Vanilla nutrition shake suits my needs well.

title: Fairly quiet operation of the motor; some of the trimmers work well.
text:
[[VIDEOID:824e87d93bfdcedb5a52eb24519a145d]] Short summary: I could not get the body trimmer or the nose trimmer to work.
The full trimmer, precision trimmer, and design trimmer (along with the comb guides) work well for our family needs to cut and style our hair.
The handle operates in a fairly quiet manner.
The instruction manual is useful.

More details:
This 6-in-1 grooming kit includes:
-- handle
-- full trimmer, design trimmer, precision trimmer, nose trimmer, micro shaver, body trimmer
-- 4 comb guides (3-, 6-, 9-, 12-mm)
-- comb guide for precision trimmer (4-. 4.5-, 5-, 5.5-mm)
-- comb guide for body trimmer (2.8-, 5.8-, 9.8-mm)
-- charging cable
-- instruction manual
-- base/stand to hold the handle and a few of the accessories
-- cleaning brush

The handle has an On/Off button. There is an indicator light - it turns green when in use. It turns red while charging. At the bottom is the port to charge the handle.

I like the fairly quiet humming sound this handle emits as our family uses the full trimmer, design trimmer, and precision trimmer for the various hair cuts they want.

I could not get the nose trimmer and the body trimmer to work.

Like the other trimmers, I could easily install the microshaver; but, I had a very difficult time removing it. I could easily remove all other trimmers.

According to the manual, charging the handle initially takes 8 hours. I charged it up before I left for work, and asked family members to un-plug it when the handle was done. I forgot to ask them to check the time. Regardless, I've used this to cut 2 family members hairs on just the initial charge. Neither one complained about the trimmers pulling the hairs in a painful manner as their hairs were being cut.
I did not need my hair cut since a family member cut mine recently with another hair trimmer brand.

This hair trimmer performs well for the full trimmer, design trimmer, and precision trimmer.
But, I prefer the hair trimmer brand we currently use, which has all trimmers functional, and its handle has a screen that shows us know how much battery life we have left.

title: Gel, thick consistency; mild minty taste; quality ingredients gentle on my sensitive gums.
text:
This toothpaste product (Fresh Aid, Sensitive Teeth & Gum health) consists of 3 individually boxed toothpaste tubes.

Each 4-oz toothpaste tube has a flip-top cap, and when I removed the cap, has a foil seal covering the opening.

I smelled a pleasing mild minty scent as I held an opened tube to my nose.
The toothpaste is a gel with a thick consistency and a green-yellowish color.

There is just a little bubbles/suds forming as I brushed my teeth.
I did not have any unpleasant aftertaste when I am done brushing my teeth.

The quality ingredients (including aloe vera, ginger, sunflower seed oil, etc) and its lack of irritating ingredients (such as sodium lauryl sulfate) make this a toothpaste that is gentle on my sensitive gums.

The disadvantage of a toothpaste without fluoride is that it doesn't help with cavity prevention.

Expiration date is on the bottom of the box, as well as at the bottom of each tube (in the creased section). Mine expires October 2022.

This Fresh Aid toothpaste is a decent back-up option when I run out of my preferred brand that not only deals with my sensitive gums but also repairs my weak enamel (with its sodium fluoride ingredient).

title: Floss is fragile; I use up more lengths of this dental floss for my dental care.
text:
This all-natural corn starch dental floss product comes in 2 compact rectangular-sized boxes.

Each box measures 2-3/8 inches tall (not including the lid, which I removed) x 1-inch width x 1-inch depth.
I like taking this dental floss with me when commuting; this box does not take up much space in the center console of my car.

Each box contains 50 meters of dental floss. The floss is unraveled from the top.

I find this floss is not as sturdy as my usual brand. If I used the same area of floss to go through 2-3 teeth, the floss will break. But, if I move along the dental floss area in between each teeth, the floss holds up well.
So, the end result is that I use more lengths of this floss during my normal oral care routine, than I would my usual brand.

I can't really taste the mint-flavor as I am flossing; but, that's not a big deal, as I am more interested in cleaning my gums and in-between the teeth.

Ingredients: 100% corn starch PLA, natural plant peppermint oil, candelilla wax
This floss is vegan and biodegradable; the box is made of 100% recyclable material.

While this product is made in a manner that is friendly to the environment, the strength of the floss is weaker than the other brands I use. But, it is a functional dental floss, and I do like using it.

title: Has ingredients to help improve immune system (elderberry, garlic, turmeric, echinacea)
text:
This Immune Blend supplement product consists of 60 capsules, placed inside a bottle with an outer plastic wrap around the cap. Upon removing the seal and opening the cap, there is an inner seal.

Each capsule is oval-shaped, measuring nearly 1-inch in length.
I have no difficulty swallowing these capsules; but, if I were unable to do so, I could open the capsules up, pour the powder contents into a liquid drink, and take this supplement in that manner.

Ingredients include:
-- Elderberry fruit extract
-- Echinacea powder
-- Garlic powder
-- Turmeric
-- Vit C, Vit. B6

The above ingredients have mineral and antioxidant properties that help me cope better with cold, flu, or other health issues that take advantage of a weak immune system.

I note that the ingredient Vitamin E (DL-alpha tocopherol acetate) is in the synthetic form. I prefer to take Vit E products that are of a natural form, which have the "D-alpha" designation.

The product label recommends a daily serving of 2 capsules. So, one bottle will last 30 days.
Expiration date is on the bottom of the bottle. Mine expires April 2022.

While this product has some of the ingredients that I look for in helping to boost my immune system, I prefer the brand that I am currently taking, which has been tested by an independent 3rd party, has Good Manufacturing Practice label, has no fillers, is non-GMO, and has 17 ingredients (including the natural form of Vitamin E) to help improve my body's defense.

title: Semi-rigid from heel to middle of foot; decent comfort for my feet/knees/back
text:
This pair of Orthotic insoles (Medium size; U.S. 8-9) gives my feet better support as I go through my daily activities than the insoles that came with the shoes I wear. I feel less pain in my knees and lower back, especially near the end of the day, after I've been on my feet all day.

These insoles are semi-rigid, thanks to the black-color hard material (on the bottom of the insole) that spans the region from the heel to the middle of the foot. The arch part bends, yet is firm. Leaving the insole on the table, I can press the arch area flat to the surface, but when I release pressure, the arch rises back to its original shape.
This is one of the best features of this insole.

At the bottom of the insole, at the heel area, is an oval-shaped heel pad (measuring 1-3/4 inches long x 1 inch wide at its widest width). I would have preferred for this heel pad to be larger to provide better shock absorption for the entire heel. This oval shape does not provide padding for my entire heel.

I do like the heel cup area, as the edges are nicely raised, and my heels fit well within the depths of this heel area.

I would have liked for the front of the insole (which I measure to be 3/16 inches thick) to have a slightly thicker padding.

I measure the length of the insole (from back of heel to tip of toe) to be 10-1/4" inches.
I wear a size 8 men's shoes.
I removed the old shoes' insoles, put them on top of these longer EverHealth Orthotic insoles, and cut off the very tips of the new insoles to the same size as the old insoles. It fit well inside my shoes.

Overall, these insoles work much better at providing comfort for my feet/knees/back than the regular insoles that came with the shoes I bought.

title: Fruity, slightly sour; thick liquid texture. I like the boost it gives me.
text:
This Protein 2GO liquid dietary supplement comes in a 2.5-fl. oz. (75mL) compact bottle that measures 4-1/2 inches tall and 4-5/8 inches diameter..
There are twelve total bottles; each bottle has a tight plastic seal around the cap. It takes a bit of effort to remove the seal.

The taste is that of strawberry - a bit fruity/sweet, but also some sourness to it.
The texture of the liquid is a bit thick.

I drank a bottle on its own; its thickness and taste made it slightly tough to drink the entire bottle.

The next day, I drank a second bottle, and then drank water right after. It made the product more tolerable for my taste.

I find this works best for me when I poured the Protein 2GO into a bottle, and added about 6 ounces of water. Makes it less sweet, and more of a liquid. I took it to work, left it in the fridge until I was ready to use it. Tastes great when it's cold.

I have not experienced any side effects (I wasn't anxious, fidgety, etc).

It gives me a nice boost to get me through the last few hours at work, when I am most tired, but still need to be productive at work.

I like that one bottle gives me 26g of protein; there are no fats, no carbohydrates, no sugars, no cholesterol.

Expiration date is located on the top of the cap. Mine expires Jan, 2022.

One curious thing I noted: these 12 bottles are packed in a box. One side of the box says the product is used for surgery, treatment, illness. But, the label on the bottle says, "...this product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease..."

title: Need generous amount on tough odors; fine-mist spray; chlorine smell; no protective seal on bottle.
text:
This Odor-Destroying Spray (by Crutcheze) comes in a 6-oz spray bottle.
There was no outer seal on my bottle.
When I removed the cap, there was no inner seal.
There was no sealant/plastic cap over the spray opening.

The bottle is 7-1/4 inches tall, with a circumference of 5-5/8" - easy for me to hold (I have small size hands).

The bottle delivers a fine mist spray as I press the spray pump, with a moderate chlorine smell.
This bottle works best when held upright. When I held this upside down to spray into my shoes, it did not deliver much spray.

I have very comfortable, but old, shoes and gloves that I love to wear while out gardening; these items are well-worn, and do not smell good.
I took out the insoles of those shoes, then sprayed inside of the shoes, and on the insoles.
I sprayed inside the gloves.
We sprayed the kids' shoes and their backpacks.
We left them outside the house to air out.

The gloves did not have the smell they used to have.
The kids' shoes did not smell as bad as before.
My shoes still smelled a bit; although the odor was not as potent as before. The smell that remained came from deep inside the shoe, at the toe area, where the spray did not get into. With what I had left in the bottle, I removed the cap and poured the liquid down into that area. After leaving the shoes outside for a couple more days, the smell was was still present, but I am fine with the improvement.

The product got used up quickly.

Overall, this product does work in greatly reducing the heavy odors in my shoes.

note: the bottle says that it, "..instantly eliminates odors...", but the description says that it "...does not mask difficult odors...."

title: Useful for various chores around house and yard. Tiny tear on inside of glove.
text:
These medium-sized gloves - 1 pair of blue, 1 pair of yellow - measure 12-3/4 inches at its longest length. The width of the cuff is 5-inch.

I like the ridges/swirls on the palm and the fingers - provides decent grip.

Before using it, I turned the gloves inside out to inspect it; There is a minor tear in one of the blue-color glove (see first pic). It does not extend all the way through the glove. These gloves are not too thin, but slightly thick enough so that I can wash the dishes in hot water without feeling my hands getting uncomfortably hot.

I sniffed the inside of the gloves - didn't smell anything.

The gloves are great to pull out damp weeds and unwanted plants in the yard; it's been raining lately, and with little sun throughout the day, the weeds are too wet to use my regular gardening gloves to remove, as the water goes through the gloves and gets my hands wet.
With these Pacific PPE gloves, my hands have not gotten wet while I am out in the yard, tending to my plants.

The gloves are great to use when I need to remove twigs and small branches and throw them in the yard/refuse bin.

These gloves are also useful for various cleaning chores in the home (washing the dishes, cleaning the hardwood floors, etc).

The materials of the gloves has caused no rashes/itching on my skin so far.

Overall, I use these gloves in a variety of ways around the house and yard. I can easily wash dirt off the gloves, then use regular dishwashing soap to clean them more. Then, I leave them out to dry for next use.

title: Soft, gentle, soothing. Doesn't irritate my nose/face/elsewhere with repeated use. No scent.
text:
What is included in this product:

--- 18 boxes of Kleenex Expressions (soothing lotion)
Each box 65 tissues. Each tissue has 3-ply feature.
Each box is shaped like a cube. It measures just a tad above 5 inches tall, when I have the box positioned upright, ready for me to lift a tissue out of the box.
Overall measurement for each Kleenex box is 5-inch x 4-1/2 inch x 4-1/2 inch.

I easily removed the serrated, oval-shaped cover. Then, I removed the thin plastic lining, with help of the scissors, as the plastic is quite stubborn. Then, once I removed one tissue, another tissue popped up in its place.

These Kleenex facial tissues are soft, gentle, and soothing to my skin.
As I hold a tissue to my nose, I could not smell any scent.

With the cold weather, I am more prone to getting a runny nose. I used these coconut oil- and aloe-infused Kleenex tissues repeatedly, and it doesn't cause irritations to my nose or the area under my nose and above my upper lip. This is very important to me; in the past, I have used other brands (with different features), and after repeated use on my runny nose, I end up rubbing the skin raw, causing painful cracks in the skin.

Also, when I needed to blow my nose, these tissues held well under pressure.

note: the large box that contained these 18 Kleenex boxes were dented in on one side, resulting in 3 Kleenex boxes being dented because they were located on that side. It didn't matter to me, as the Kleenex tissues function in the manner that I needed them.

5-stars for the excellent way these Kleenex tissues function in addressing my needs.

title: Needed 10+ tablespoons of Agave inulin to get mug of hot tea to be sweet.
text:
This product - Super Organics Powder, Agave Inulin, - is advertised as a ".. substitute for sugar in recipes, and add to taste for beverages..".

I needed to use a lot of the product to get the amount of sweetness that I like.

When I drink hot tea, I typically use honey to sweeten my tea. In a pinch, I will use 2-1/2 tablespoons worth of regular sugar to my 16-oz mug.

With this Agave Inulin, I put 2-1/2 tablespoons worth of it in my tea; there was no sugary taste.
I needed to add 4 more tablespoons to get mild sweetness.

The next night, I added 10 tablespoons worth of Agave Inulin to my mug of hot tea. There was a better taste of sweetness.

What I like about this product:
-- it's healthier than the typical sugar product, being non-GMO, organic, Vegan, gluten-free, Plant-based ingredients
-- there is some slight clumping once the powder is placed in hot water, but with vigorous stirring, it dissolves well.
-- easy to open, re-sealable bag

Expiration date is located on the back of the package, in the silver background, below the ingredients label. Mine expires 12/2020.

Overall, this is not a product for me, as I would need to use over 10 tablespoons worth of Agave Inulin in order to get my tea to be sweetened to how I like it.

title: Dissolves well in water with vigorou stirring; spoon is included; like the vanilla flavor
text:
This NeoCell Super Collagen product (French Vanilla flavor) came with an intact protective seal.
After I removed the seal, I smelled a nice slight vanilla flavor when I held it near my nose.

A convenient-to-use spoon is included (to get the spoon, I had to shift the powder around a bit, as the spoon was totally immersed in the powder, and not visible when I first removed the protective seal)

I added a spoon of the powder to 1- cup (via measuring cup) of plain water into a mug. I stirred and stirred. After about 1-2 minutes of somewhat vigorous stirring, the powder dissolved. I couldn't see any significant amounts of the powder remaining. (see pictures).
The taste was somewhat bland, with a slight vanilla flavor.

I did the same thing; but this time, added 1/2 cup (via measuring cup) of plain water. The vanilla flavor was a bit stronger. I prefer this combination of 1 spoon of powder and 1/2 cup of water, just because I like to taste the vanilla flavor more.

I added a spoon of powder to my smoothie. Smoothie tasted fine.
I added a spoon of powder to my refrigerated orange juice. Juice tasted fine.

I prefer using this powder in a juice drink, rather than plain water.

I have used it daily for 4 days; so far, I have not experienced side effects.

Nutritional information (1 spoon serving size):
Calories = 25
Protein = 6 gm
Hydrolyzed bovine collagen = 6.6 gm
Other ingredients: Natural flavors, citric acid
May contain: trace amounts of naturally occurring sulfite residue
Collagen type 1 & 3
No soy, no wheat, no lactose, no artificial flavors
This is Gluten-free, grass-fed
Non-GMO tested
The manufacturer says that you get about 26 servings total per container. So, this product, taking 1 spoon of powder daily, should last about 26 days.
This container is 100% recycled
Does not contain common GE genes or proteins.

Given that I have had no side effects, I will finish out the product, and see how my skin, hair, nails and joint feels. I will upgrade this to a 5-star if I see positive body changes upon finishing out the product. I've only used it for 4 days so far.

title: Soft, chewy, peanut butter in center of bar, delicious. Quite filling!

Each bar has segments that you can break into smaller pieces. It was easy to break the bar into smaller segments, without too many little pieces of the bar breaking apart.
I prefer to eat the entire bar in one sitting without breaking it into smaller pieces.

I use these Cliff Cubes as an afternoon snack while at work - they are filling, which I like. Eating snack bars often makes me thirsty, so I also drink water. It helped keep up my energy for those last couple hours of a work day.

This is USDA-organic, Non-GMO product.

text:

I placed one disc as instructed on the shower avoiding for the water to get directly on top of it. I bent down to see if that was really doing something and yes, I could smell a little bit, but that's it.
Good thing they did not stain my tub nor my non-slip shower floor mat.
Leaving 2 stars just because of the nice presentation, other than that, I think they are not really adding any value to your shower.

title: Scent doesn't last .... 98.75% water
text:

I mean it is good that comes in a small bottle (2.3 oz) that can easily be carried inside your purse/backpack/fanny pack for when you have to go to public restrooms, composting toilets or portable toilets. But when I have used it, I had to spray from 2 to 3 times when I entered the restroom, and then after 1 minute, the scent was completely gone.
Considering the above, using from 3 to 6 sprays per use, this small bottle won't last long.
I guess it can also be a nice addition to you house restroom for when you have visitors, it's just a little overprice for 2 little bottles.

title: Cute and functional facial cleansing brush but ...
text:
Cute cleansing brush. It is comfortable to use and good size to cleanse and massage your face. There are a few particular features that I am not a big fan such as the plug to charge it and the way you have to remove the little cap on the back to charge it. However, I think this is a great tool to integrate into your daily beauty routine that can be used on a daily basis to ensure you are completely cleansing your face and removing dead skin.

Pros:
* Soft silicone
* Comfortable to hold
* Adjustable vibration
* Waterproof
* Portable

Cons:
* Short USB cable
* USB cable has a very specific plug, does not use a standard micro USB cable like many other devices. So if you lose this cable, you will not be able to recharge it.
* The removable little cap that protects the area to plug it, can get lost in a blink. It is tiny and does not have a strap that ties it to the device.
* Price, I think is a little overprice considering all the above. I have seen other cleansing devices for the same price that offers features such as wireless charging and different textures to cleanse and massage.

title: Stylish and functional facial cleansing brush
text:
[[VIDEOID:e3a0911f5aa9d6a2ab3a58dd043fb6ff]] This brush does not rotate, it just vibrates which I personally like a lot.
The shape is really comfortable to hold. It is totally different to other facial cleansing brushes that are all silicone. However, this offers to option to change the brush for a regular gentle brush or silicone one.
The power button is at the bottom, very easy to operate. It is waterproof, so you can use it while in the shower which is great because it's when your pores are opened due to the steam, hot/warm water.

title: Nice, could be better
text: I work 7 days a week and am always on my feet so I thought this might be something nice for when I finally get to sit down in the evenings. I have a little sauna that I love, but it's a much bigger commitment to use and this is nice for when I'm just sitting on the couch. It lasts ~1 hour before the water needs to be refilled. I've only used distilled water in it and with anything like this, I wouldn't recommend using faucet water if you want it to last a long time. I find two things really disappointing: 1) the feet massagers don't move themselves so you have to move your feet on them and I don't find it to be pleasant or comfortable even. I wish they included something flat to just rest your feet on instead of a second, similar manual option and 2) the top that rests over your feet when it's on is awful. It isn't attached and it just sits on it, it doesn't click into place or anything so you really can't move without it falling off and then you lose the steam and heat you're trying to keep in. I do like the heat settings and the amount of steam this thing makes is impressive. I would feel comfortable recommending this to someone as long as I could clarify what I didn't like, but without some design changes, I don't see myself willingly paying $100 for this item.

title: Great Supplement for Vision
text:
Lutein and zeaxanthin are “carotenoids,” or plant pigments. They are also found in high amounts in the human eye where they filter out harmful light. However, the body can’t make them naturally, so you need to get them from food sources.

Unfortunately for many people’s taste buds, lutein is found in high amounts in kale, spinach and other greens (collard, turnip). So, unless you’re Popeye, you’ll likely need supplements to maintain optimal levels.

Bilberry is another supplement that has been linked to eye health. However, I am less sold on the effectiveness of bilberry. But, there’s so little here that it won’t do much anyway.

This formula provides 20mg of lutein, 2.2 mg of bilberry extract, and 1mg of zeaxanthin in a safflower oil base. It’s a good amount of lutein, but a little weak on zeaxanthin. Make sure to take it with a meal, since lutein is fat soluble.

The price is a little high, but you do get a 60 day supply. And, 20mg is a good amount of lutein. They use FDA GMP standards, but, as I’ve said in countless reviews, I wish they also did third party testing to ensure quality.

title: Promising Supplement for Liver Health
text:
Tudca is a bile salt made in the body that primarily benefits the liver. It’s been shown to have great effectiveness in treating cholestatic diseases. These are issues related to the flow of bile from the liver to the intestines.

An obstructed bile flow can have a domino effect on other parts of the body and can lead to other health problems like inflammation, premature aging, and, of course, liver issues. Tudca has also been associated with helping undo liver problems associated with drinking alcohol.

Tudca has also been linked to thyroid, heart, and neurological benefits, although the evidence is less clear than its liver benefits.

Tudca is regarded as safe, but never take it right before or during alcohol consumption as it can cause greater problems.

Staunch Labs is a well-known company that practices third party testing. They are mainly focused on fitness and bodybuilding, but don’t let that fool you. Tudca isn’t just for body builders. In fact, the scientific evidence is strongest for benefits unrelated to fitness.

title: Great pills, no funky taste
text:
I've taken a variety of glucosamine/chondroitin pills over the last half year to help with some ongoing joint pain I have. I take them along with turmeric supplements as I find that the combination of two known supplement types to help with joint pain reduce or eliminate my pain. These are as good as any other pills of the same time, and possibly better in a few ways. The capsules are pretty standard sized, and they're easy to swallow. That's good, because the suggested serving is four per day. Since I have my joint pain under control (and perhaps because I combine this with another supplement type), I have been able to take three a day without noticing a change in the effects. One of the things I like about these is that they don't taste strongly of anything at all. Some other glucosamine/chondroitin supplements I've taken have tasted strongly of shellfish, or kind of fishy/crabby. This indicates on the bottle that it contains shellfish, but the blend and capsules are put together effectively to eliminate that flavor. I wouldn't necessarily suggest letting the capsule dissolve in your mouth, as the flavor may appear, but when they're swallowed pretty quickly, there's not even the slightest hint of unpleasant flavor.

So, they work, they don't taste fishy, and they seem to be of high quality. That's what I look for in this type of joint supplement. It's worth noting (again) that these contain shellfish (and possibly other animal products), they're likely not acceptable for vegetarians/vegans.

title: Amazing for my feet
text: Ok so when you read my review please don’t think this was any fault of the product, I am an adult and the one controlling the product and could’ve loosened it. So I love foot massages and I have very bad circulation in my feet so when I ordered this I couldn’t wait for it to arrive. It came, I took a shower, plugged it in, sat down, put my feet in, set the settings and picked up my PS4 controller and started playing while my feet were getting massaged. It has a setting for how much compression you want, I had it on low at first, it has a heat or no heat , I used heat, and it has a pressure button and I put it at it’s lowest. I wasn’t feeling it much so I turned it all the way up on everything. Let me say here I have a size 9 in women’s feet and they are not thick and have a normal arch. So I’m sitting there playing CoD and I feel it getting tighter and then it starts really getting into my right foot near that ball part near the middle coming off the big toe(sorry if that’s a bad description) and it’s making me say oh and stuff and my fiancé is laughing at me, I actually had to stop playing my game cause it felt so good and I couldn’t concentrate, it felt amazing, I did that for about 10 mins, it got in deep and my right foot was feeling especially happy, the blood was flowing and it felt like it was just so relaxed and happy. I didn’t stop though, I moved my foot in so it would get my arch more( the massager for some reason doesn’t have a massager directly where your arch is which is disappointing cause that’s where you want it massages the most) so its massaging me and my left foot is happy too, but my right is the foot that hurts most usually. So I do that for another 5 mins and let my fiancé try it out. He has thick, high arch feet. He didn’t feel it as well as I did but when I turned it al the way up he liked it but no where near as much as I did. Anyways I went to bed my feet feeling amazing, my blood flowing in them, just super happy and excited for this new foot massager. I wake up and go to stand up and my right foot is super bruised on the bottom, I over worked it lol but it was worth it. A week later my foot is about healed and I’ve tried to still use the massager while bruised but it hurt too much, it was a deep bruise so the machine gets deep and gets in there and works it out. I used it on my left foot while my right foot heals though still. So please don’t take this negative as in it doesn’t work because I’ve had foot massages and back massages by people that were so deep I was in pain cause you gotta get deep to get the kinks out and blood flowing. The way my feet felt after the first massage was well worth the bruise cause even for days after my foot still had better circulation. So I’ll continue using this great massager. It does have a few flaws like the arch. It could get warmer cause honestly I don’t feel heat at all and even put my hand in it. Maybe if it was adjustable so people with wider or thicker feet cause if you have bigger feet you can’t slide them out the front so you cant get the full effect. I like the compression and the massaging. It does what I want and fits me perfectly aside from the arches. So I like this a lot but I can see if you don’t have the correct size feet how this wouldn’t work for everyone. I think it’s for smaller less thick feet.

title: Burst of Energy
text:

Now, I know that it says that you can take it with water or any liquid, I don't think a powder like this would go well with anything other than some kind of citrus drink.

In any case, I've been fortifying my bottle of orange juice with a teaspoon of this and within roughly 45 minutes, a feel a momentary burst of energy, sort of like that first cup of coffee feeling. Except, it's not coffee.

I work during the week in a warehouse, so I'm always on the move, this is great when you need some extra energy.

Very good product.

text:

I can't over-recommend a green-plant based diet but Moringa Leaf has to be an essential part of that equation.

text:

title: Bubbles R:  An Airborne Substitute?
text:

title: Extremely convenient, and has some big pluses, such as easy to keep in pocket, or purse
text:
First off, I usually don’t mention the packaging and presentation, in a review. I only am going to because this company makes a big effort, so I will mention it. The spray containers come in a drawstring bag, with stickers, but more importantly, a detachable lanyard, that attaches to each dispenser. It was a nice touch.

I am big on convenience, and these definitely are extremely convenient. I usually have some type of caffeine supplement with me, and while I have some that are easy enough to take while on the road, they don’t have the flexibility to take a small amount of caffeine, or maybe a little more than a very small amount, while sitting in traffic. These are easy to pop open, and while they recommend 5 sprays (they call them mists) you obviously can take more, or less, as needed. They are like the mini breath spray containers in size, and the top pops off, and you spray away. The taste is not bad at all, which is something that is novel with caffeine supplements, because unless you swallow a tablet, or capsule, caffeine usually has an unpleasant taste.

This is definitely a personal preference, and I do like coffee, but I don’t like the hassle of stopping for coffee, on the road, and the prices are getting pretty crazy, when I do have the time. While these are not exactly inexpensive, compared to the better coffee shops, it actually is not a that expensive.

I actually tried a few different flavors of these, and they were all fine, and I actually didn’t find any flavor better than the other ones. Definitely worth trying, if you like having a quick and convenient way to get a quick boost. Very convenient product!

title: Great taste, horrible price
text:
These have the perfect amount of sweetness that you crave on a low carb diet, but that's about the only good thing.

It's advertised as Keto Coffee, and it is, but all of the other stuff is kind of just a marketing tactic. There's 5g of MCT oil in these. That's almost nothing, and you'd certainly want to add more to your morning coffee. There's very little fat/protein, though I personally see that as a good thing since I'd rather eat my calories instead of drink them.

The flavor is great (before you start adding in your own MCT oil and stuff like that) and the dissolve in 80C water was passable, but the dissolve in 10C water was not, at least if you plan on drinking it instead of eating it.

The price is also kind of nuts. Considering you need to add more of the ''included' ingredients to actually get a benefit from it, these seem to have next to no purpose unless you just enjoy lighting your money on fire.

If they were cheaper (currently $45/20pack) and/or had more MCT oil I would have definitely left a better review. I love the idea, but the execution was poor. Unless you really, really want something sweet, stick to normal instant coffee with your own butter/MCT instead.

title: Mostly MEH
text: I admit that I have higher expectations when you see that this is a reputable brand, Shaper Image. We have a different foot massager from them, and LOVE IT. This one, not so much. It' just a very meh product. There are Shiatsu massagers under the soles of your feet that spin and rotate. The top strap that goes over your feet then has air bags inflate and deflate to create a rhythmic wave like feeling as it causes the massaging nodes to press harder on the soles of your feet. Generally, I have not been a fan of any of the newer massaging devices that use inflated chambers to simulate a massaging effect. It always feels weak and borderline annoying. It's like having someone give you a back massage but doesn't press down with they hands/fingers and just does circular swirling motions. The next problem I have with this device would be the height of the massager. It's higher off the floor than most massagers, so it feels awkward and uncomfortable. Our recliners are a little higher than the couches, and it still feels a little off. Although the fabric is smooth and relatively soft, I worry about how this would hold up over time. Stretching over moving parts and rubbing dirty feet isn't a recipe for long device life.

title: Strange, off-putting flavor (not the ACV...beets maybe)? Kids won't eat them.
text: We believe in the benefits of ACV, but the taste of it isn't that great for some. title: Tastes pretty decent and does a decent job replacing a meal here and there, but it's also kind of expensive.
text:
I'm surprised by this, but I actually kind of like the taste of Soylent. Normally I'll mix it with some unsweetened almond milk (although it's fine with good old H2O), and the taste is pretty good. It's hard to described, and similar to a lot of the other "meal replacement" products that I've used in the past, but it's kind of like soy milk with sweetness and a bit of grit. It works as a meal replacement, but is also a great product for fortifying (and thickening) smoothies as well.

When using it as a "meal replacement," something that I unfortunately seem to gravitate toward during busy workdays, it's a decent option. You're not really getting a whole lot of calories if you're going with the one-scoop serving (200 calories isn't replacing that much), it will get you through the day and does seem to stave off the pangs of hunger. I don't really want to drink much more than that, so in that capacity, it works pretty well for me.

You'll definitely want to have a blender bottle at hand for mixing Soylent. The first time I tried it, I just tried mixing it in a glass with a fork (hoping that the tines would break up the powder sufficiently while I stirred), since I didn't have a whole lot of options at work. The results weren't that great, with lot of solid, gritty bits floating throughout (and stuck to the sides of the glass). Using a blender bottle gives much better results, and it's a good bit tastier when properly mixed.

All-in-all, I do like the taste and versatility of Soylent, but for the servings you get out of this, it really is on the expensive side of things (although the pouches are apparently less expensive, which makes no sense). In case you were wondering, I am happy (relieved?) to say that this Soylent is *NOT* people.

The bristles are super soft and create a great foaming effect when I use it with my bar soap. After I wash my face, I deflate the brush by pushing the center of the top. The handle is comfortable and easy to use and the inflated face of the brush prevents too much pressure from being applied to sensitive areas.

Included with the brush is a wall hanger. The back has a sticky area that adheres to a clean flat surface where the handle can be slipped into so the brush can be off the countertop. It's a great idea to help keep the brush clean and not sitting in water.

Overall, I'm really enjoying this brush and I'm pleased with the results so far. It suds well and does a great job of getting my face clean. It's a little wide from some areas (between my eyes, close to my nose), but I'm figuring it out. I love the unique way this brush works and it comforts me to know I'm not pressing too hard on my face while washing.

title: Definitely keto-friendly.  Just realize it's keto-friendly matcha
text:
The product is labeled, "Keto Latte, Ceremonial Matcha Tea." As far as being keto-friendly, it certainly is. There are 6g of fats, and 1 net carb per serving with zero proteins. Just don't think this drink will put you into ketosis by itself. Some powders out there are designed to do that. This is not one of them.

As far as its taste and blendability, I have no complaints. The taste is fine (not outstanding, but definitely not bad), and it blends up fine in my bullet blender.

There are 21 servings for ~$20, or ~$17 if you use subscribe & save (at the time of this writing). This price point is on par with other powdered mixes in this genre.

If you like the matcha craze, this might be for you. As for me, it's okay. I don't say "wow" after drinking it, in either a good or a bad way.

title: Easy to work with - and works great
text:
This Heavy Duty Degreaser by Dawn Professional showed up just in time for Fat Tuesday, when we make our annual batches of Paczki. My wife never looks forward to cleaning up the grease splatters from that endeavor, but this product made short work of it. Spray it on, let it sit for a minute or two, and wipe it up. It worked so well on kitchen grease I decided to try it on some oil stains in my garage. My car had recently developed an oil leak (bad o-ring), and I had soaked up the oil using kitty litter, but there was a still a mark on the garage floor. Sprayed this on the stain, let it soak for a few minutes, and it did a surprisingly good job of getting rid of the stain.

You should know that this Dawn product is not viscous like dish soap - it's got the consistency of water and sprays out of a spray bottle like a glass cleaner. Very easy to work with, and impressive results. Gotta give it five stars for sure.

However for the straps, these can be game changers if you have to wear a mask for long durations of time. I have grown dependent on these little guys as we just welcomed tiny twins into the world and they are remaining in the hospital's NICU for several weeks. I'm up there several times per day for several hours and ALWAYS use one of these extenders. I'm not sure how much of an extension it offers if you truly need that capability since I'm always on the outer most prongs. But these are a huge help for me!

I've seen a few different types of designs for mask extenders. They seem to work well for me personally. I saw and tried others that are thinner and more like a 3D-printed plastic than a rubbery silicone material - with mixed reviews and perhaps 1 important variable for me is that I have a shaved head. So these don't mess with my hair and they happen to hold well at least for the few masks I've used them with.

I use these only on occasion as I have a few masks which I like but the ear loops are not stretchy and this don't all fit me well unless using one of these extenders.

I'd say that I would recommend these if you have some masks which you'd like to use but just don't fit well due to ear hoop restrictions. Otherwise I don't see much of a point other than taking avoiding a mask tugging on the back of your ears if you need to wear one for hours.

title: Excellent Red Light / NIR Wrap
text:
I'll start by saying this: I was aware of the clinical benefits of red light therapy, but was always a bit skeptical. As such, I approached this with a keen awareness of the possibility of placebo effect. That said, I'm quite impressed with this device. The first thing I wanted to try was on my nagging elbow pain. It's pretty much a daily pain in the ECRB tendon area, which admittedly, I work out nearly every day and don't let it properly heal. Anyway ... I tried this wrap after using another first. The first one is good as well, except it's a little shorter, and even this one doesn't quite wrap around my elbow/arm - but I get it over the painful area okay.

As for effectiveness ... After only three 20 minute sessions, I realized my elbow wasn't hurting AT ALL. Even when I did my workout that involved face-pulls, reverse flies, deadlifts and other pulling exercises, I felt not one bit of pain. I honestly can't explain it other than the red light / NIR therapy wrap works. I was so on guard for placebo effect, I don't think that's it. And it wasn't like I was waking up checking my elbow - I literally didn't even think to check and just noticed the pain-free movement incidentally when working out. I guess you could say I'm now a believer.

This wrap is very well made and feels like a durable device that will last. The only downside is the price. I found a big red light / NIR therapy panel for almost half the price of this wrap, which is a far better LED to $$ ratio, but ... knowing what I know now and how it has completely worked for me, I'd pay this price for sure, to get one of these if I didn't already now have one. The value is something that's more personal to decide, but as for the quality and effectiveness of this, I definitely recommend it.

The bottle looks like premium vodka and has a nice cork stopper. It is shipped very securely and arrived in perfect condition.

I tested by using a tbsp in my early afternoon espresso (no butter or anything else). Over the course of about a week I would say it has had a small effect on my overall hunger level (which was never too bad). I did hit my all-time low weight and body fat percentage while on it, but there are many other factors at play as well.

So, while I can't actually endorse MCTs in general in this review since my test is hardly scientific, I can say this bottle seems like it's excellent quality and has no taste, as promised.

title: Good support, adhesion works best in new shoes under the insole
text:
I have high arches and hypermobility, so if my shoes don't have good arch support, my ankles will roll inward; while I use full insoles in my tennis shoes and hiking boots, they're usually too thick to use in dressier shoes without making the heels rub uncomfortably, and show quite obviously in sandals.

These little sticky-backed gel cushions get around those issues, only adding support where it's really needed, and the three different colors blend in in most shoes--including sandals and D'Orsay-style heels! I can actually wear moccasins and ballet flats again without causing knee and back pain; there's no more "those are cute, but I can't wear them because there's no arch support."

The adhesive could be a little better, as the cushions can shift out of position sometimes; I've found the best way to limit that is to put them in new shoes (or shoes that have been carefully cleaned to remove any lint and dirt from them, removing the insole if it's a separate piece) and put them under any removable insoles. They'll stay put pretty well if my feet aren't sliding directly on them every time I put the shoes on or take them off. Obviously, that's not usually possible with sandals, and the best way I've found to keep them in place in that situation is to hit the insole with some warm air for a few minutes before placing the arch support, rub it down firmly, and then wait a couple of days before wearing the shoes.

All in all, these are a solid product and a game-changer for those of us who need arch support and don't want to always be wearing obviously medical shoes and can't afford to pay $70-120 for a pair of shoes with orthotics built into them. And at a little over $2 a pair for these, they're a good budget-friendly solution.

title: Extremely Potent, Effective Cinnamon Supplement
text:
This cinnamon supplement is great! I love that it's organic, has a veggie cap, and 600mg per capsule. There are 60 caps in each bottle, which means it's a 1 month supply.

Cinnamon has been hailed as a potent supplement that possesses outstanding health benefits especially for diabetics and those challenged by obesity and high cholesterol issues. Unfortunately this cinnamon which is native to Sri Lanka and sourced from the plant Cinnamomum Zeylanicum, is rather unknown to most people and also known as Cinnamomum Verum or Mexican Cinnamonor (Canella). In the United States and many parts of Asia, what the majority of us have been buying from the Supermarket and groceries and consuming is actually not the real cinnamon but Cassia cinnamon, which comes from a different plant called Cinnamomum Cassia (or Cinnamomum Aromaticum), also commonly known as Chinese cinnamon that are mostly cultivated in China and Indonesia. While the two species of cinnamon share certain characteristics such as antimicrobial, and in terms of inhibiting the growth of fungi and yeast, and regulating blood sugar, their contents differ much in terms of the amount of coumarin, which is a naturally occurring substance with strong blood-thinning properties. The coumarin level in Ceylon cinnamon is negligibly small, while that in Cassia cinnamon is an appalling 1200 times higher. The ingestion of large amount of coumarin or consumption of coumarin over a prolonged period of time can cause serious health damages and a negative impact on the liver and kidney. German FDA has warned against consuming the excessive intake of Cassia bark due to its coumarin content.

Bottom line for now is that this is a good product for a good price, and I would recommend it.

title: Solved my Galaxy S3 battery charging problem
text: Very happy with it. Solved my problem. I had purchased two batteries for my Galaxy S3 in the last year, as others suggested to me that the battery was bad due to the quick battery drain.  Now I am convinced my problem was related to the two OEM chargers I had. One of the chargers seemed to have a poorer connection in the phone port, but with both of the chargers my battery would show fully charged and then, after unplugging the charger, the battery indicator would drop down to 30%.  Now, I simply charge one battery with this wall charger while I have the other one in my phone.  The battery now lasts me for about two days. The only inconvenience is having to open the phone to put in the battery, but I'm okay with that, because it is less expensive than buying a new smartphone.

title: Great sunscreen for the entire family!  Works amazingly and the smell is wonderful!!!!
text:
The bottle of Sun’n’Fun Broad Spectrum Sunscreen for Kids that Sweetsation Therapy sent us was 3.3 oz and the scent was chocolate. Yes, there was a lovely scent that wasn’t too strong. It was a nice light chocolate aroma that my littlest one just loved. She said yummy every time we put it on her. My other kids and I really like the smell too. This Broad Spectrum Sunscreen for Kids is a light brownish color and goes on very lightly. There is no greasy feeling and it does absorb very quickly. Even though it absorbs quickly I still think it’s a good idea to apply it 15-30 minutes before sun exposure. That is just my personal preference and what I have found works best for my kids.
Since this SPF 30 Broad Spectrum Sunscreen for Kids is water resistant it makes it nice for the kids to play in the water without worrying it’s going to run and irritate the kids eyes. I use SPF 30 sunscreens when we are in a more shaded area or when we aren’t going to be in the sun for very long or during the harmful sun hours
When we will be out in direct sun for many hours or I know it’s not possible to avoid the harmful times of 10 Am to 2 PM I will always go towards a higher SPF.
The level of SPF in this sunscreen is very good for every day use. I’ve noticed we’re able to enjoy our park time with no sunburns when we get home. There is no funny white film on our skin and its mess free. I love that there is no oily residue. I love how Sweetsation Therapy makes a wonderful mineral sunscreen for kids that is safe and provides all the antioxidants us parents need and want in our children’s sunscreen. There are no harmful chemicals and I feel 100% safe using it with my precious little ones. I find sunscreens that contain Zinc work the best, especially in this Hawaiian Sun.
One of my sons has sensitive skin, when using the Sun’n’Fun Broad Spectrum Sunscreen for Kids he had absolutely no reaction, rashes or itching. It worked very nicely for him.
This is a great sunscreen that works very well and is made of fabulous ingredients we all want for our children. It’s made so kids will enjoy having it put on and won’t fight having to have it reapplied. It’s sold at a reasonable price. The size seems a little small at first, but it’s made with such quality ingredients that you don’t need as much as other sunscreens on the market. I felt this smaller bottle lasted as long as bottles double its size.
Without a doubt I can say as a mother and as a pediatric nurse one of the most important and preventative things we can do for our children and teach our children is the importance of sunscreen. No matter if you tan, burn or barely go out in the sun. Sunscreen protection is needed. Just an ounce of prevention now can save us and our loved ones horrible consequences. Remember, if in doubt use sunscreen. I received this product at a discount for only my honest opinion.

title: Among the very best of shaving soaps.
text:
Update on 01/15/2011: This review is for the Potassium Stearate based original formula of this soap not for the current veggie oil based version. The potassium stearate version is no longer available as of this update. I have not used the veggie oil based version and this review in no way alludes to that version. That said, my experience has been that veggie oil based soaps are not quite as good in the best instances and can be downright dreck in other instances. And in any instance not as skin friendly as their superior stearate versions. Ymmv.

This is an excellent soap for the money. No doubt the user that said it was hard to lather has either very hard water or is not proficient with lathering hard shaving soaps. And the dirty little secret about the wooden bowls amongst all the vendors is that they're nearly all proprietary sizes. This forces you to get their bowl with their soap so they can make an extra buck off of you. Some are interchangeable but not many. And creams lather in almost any kind of water so no surprise about his experience with them. Creams are excellent but many men prefer the hard soaps because their performance is so good, superior even.

Taylor's is an excellent shaving soap. In fact this soap provides lots of protection and lots of cushion yet it's versatile enough to pivot into a slicker lather with the addition of a tiny bit of water to the formed lather for application on the second pass (or even the first pass if you're so inclined). Fantastic stuff. It has a genuine sharp yet bright lavender scent that is thee classic scent of men's shaving soap. I've used all the premium hard shaving soaps - D.R. Harris, Trumper, Art of Shaving, Truefitt and Hill, Kent, Penhaligon's, Tabac and Valobra (stick version). Taylor's is right up there with all of the best. They're all fine soaps and some are better than others but at this level you're splitting hairs (no pun intended) so there's really not much difference. Of course the Taylor's costs less which is a blessing. I recommend you try all the top shelf shaving soaps (the ones I mentioned as well as many others) and decide for yourself what you like but don't knock the Taylor's on performance as it is one of the best.

title: Nice lubricant without any weird fragrances or silliness
text:
Short version: Very nice silicone lube with no added fragrance.

Right off the bat, I really prefer a silicone lubricants over water-based, but if you're used to water-based lubricants they feel and perform different, so this might take some getting used to for you. One of the main reasons I prefer silicone over water-based is longevity, and this particular lubricant has plenty of that. It lasts for a long time without feeling sticky or tacky like some brands do. It has a really nice "slip" to it, and doesn't have any unpleasant greasy after feel. Another thing I like is that it's not fragranced and it doesn't have any of the gimmicky warming ingredients in it. I prefer to keep things simple and unscented when it comes to especially delicate skin and this lube, with only four ingredients, does just that.

Being ever curious, I looked up the ingredients to see what they're used for. Dimethicone is what provides most of the slip and glide, and is sometimes used to treat dry, chapped, or irritated skin. Cyclopentasiloxane also adds slip, and is widely used in skin and hair care products. Same with dimethiconol, it has the same uses as the previous two ingredients. Last on the ingredients list is Phenyl Trimethicone, which is also used in lots of hair and skin care as a lubricant. That's it, no flavorings or fragrances that might cause irritation, just four very commonly used silicones that have proven track records in health and beauty products.

I'm really happy with the lubricant itself, and the price is quite reasonable for an 8 ounce bottle. If you aren't familiar with silicone lubes, a little goes a long way so the bottle lasts quite a while. I did receive a discount in exchange for my opinion, but that in no way influenced this review. It's a good product at a good price, and I'd be happy with it even at full price.

When I got the chance to review this product and in turn receive it at a free or reduced price, I was unsure about whether I was up to the task or not.
I'll be honest with you. I'm taking too many medications and weight loss/energy supplements right now to be able to determine whether this product has made a significant difference in my health or not. However, I have a friend that has been looking for a nice, natural product like this. She wants to shed a few pounds to get into her wedding dress in a couple of months. When I saw this, I thought I might make her my test rat. Luckily, she was cool with the idea, so I accepted the offer and immediately gave it to her when the package arrived 2 days later. I just got a text message from her today, and she says she loves the product! She says that she has already dropped a couple of pounds (though probably just water weight) and she has more energy during the day, even though she's during her intense stage of wedding planning right now. She would probably give the product five stars, should she be given the chance, but since I cannot personally attest to the usefulness of this product, I'm going to give it 4. These are disposable foam earplugs the kind that you sort of twist at one end and slip into your ear and then all sound is blocked. They really fit well or at least to my ears. They are in a huge box but all the earplugs are wrapped by themselves. I will say that I still have some noise slip in but I am not sure if it is because of my ears or just how load the dog is. Either way I think they are good and I would recommend them to family and friends. I like that they are different colors and bright. Not only does the dog snore he likes to get the plugs and play with them. The bright color keeps them in the open where I can make sure he does not get into them. I could see them being a issue with choking, as they are small and kids and pets put everything in their mouths. I was really excited that the company offered me a chance to review their product so that I could get a bit of a lower price to let them know my feelings and thoughts. Here it goes I think they work and I am happy every night when I crawl into bed that my Rottie is in his cage and I cannot (for the most part) hear him snore.

title: I love this scale but I am worried about Fitbit's product ...
text:
I love this scale but I am worried about Fitbit's product durability.

The Fitbit Aria scale is elegant in design and comes in black and white. I am really happy with this scale when it performs but I have has some of the worst issues in a long time with the devices. The company has been great about taking care of those problems.

The problems that I have had are that I purchased the scale from Amazon, the scale reported an error a week after I got the scale and would not work after that. It was also overly complicated to sync the scale although they have improved the process since. Fitbit immediately sent me another scale to replace the damaged one. That new scale was dead on arrival. They sent me a third scale and that scale was also dead on arrival. My fourth scale was sent as well and they included a very nice t-shirt for my troubles (I did have to ask for that). The scale that I have works well. Overall, the company handled the product failures well and, therefore, I have chosen to not return the scale.

The scale itself will measure your weight and body fat and sync with through wireless to your phone or computer. It comes in black and white and has a simple LCD panel that displays your weight and body fat numbers. I like the functionality of the scale and the design.

I bought my girlfriend one of the smaller watches and the they had to replace it due to the back falling apart. My Fitbit​ surge is great with a few durability issues as well. I will post a review.

I also have to spread my feet when picking her up for balance, and I guess I was unable to put enough pressure on that one foot to help anything. Instead, between the two of us, there was only one steady foot. I put her right back down, and accomplished the transfer without the disc.

The wedge almost fit- it is still a little too wide, but I figured maybe after some use the sides would give a little. When I first sat on this cushion in my car, I felt like I was sitting on a wooden board or something. It put a little more pressure on my tail bone, which I was afraid would become an issue, as I already have back and sciatic problems. Since the cushion gave me a little boost, I had to adjust my seat lower. I was certainly more comfortable sitting at this angle with my pelvis tilted upwards a bit. I just wished it wasn't as firm or  wished it had a memory foam type of feel. Anyway, because I was so uncomfortable without a cushion, I stuck with it. I seem to be "breaking it in" a bit, as it doesn't feel as awkward now. I'm hoping it will get even more comfortable with time. One other thing that would've been nice is if this cushion had a cover, to keep it clean. Overall, I think it was worth a try and will keep using it for now.
