title: So far so good!
text:
My midwife recommended one of these because I am carrying twins - if you're considering between this and some of the ones consisting of only a lower band, go for this one, it is worth it! The

First, some information on sizing to hopefully save someone else some of the same hassle that I had...
If you go to the manufacturer's website, you will notice that they sell two products that look like this. They sell the "Prenatal Cradle" (non-adjustable) and then they sell this, which is actually called the "Best Cradle" and is adjustable.

According to their website, sizing information for this product is as follows:
Size | pre-pregnancy pant size | current Weight
Small | 3-10 | 90-165
Medium | 8-16 | 150-220
Large | 14-20 | 180-250

I was size 6 pre-pregnancy and had weighed about 150 at 22 weeks when I ordered this (I'm pregnant with twins, starting weight was 130) - I actually ordered according to the size of the wrong product and the small at that time juuuust fit me at the largest setting. I exchanged it for the medium (thanks Amazon!) and that was a much better fit.

I am 5'6", currently 160 (+30 lbs) and the cradle fits very comfortably on the middle settings.

Pro's:
- I have been wearing this all day, every day and I'm pretty sure this is saving both my back and helping to keep pressure off of my cervix (which is definitely more of a concern with twins) I'm currently at 28 weeks and feeling quite good. At first I started to take it off before dinner (I thought it was adding to my acid reflux) but found on those occasions my sciatic nerves started acting up. (Not much, but enough that I've not taken this thing off since!)

Con's:
- There are three settings for this, and each is about 3" apart making it very inconvenient if you happen to be between two. I've purchased some additional hooks that I may try to sew on if I need to move up a setting, but this seems like it's going to be a royal pain to adjust so I'm holding out and hoping it won't be necessary!
- It does show under your top. Personally I don't care, because I'd rather have the support! You could easily cover it up with an under shirt, but that is going to get somewhat hot in summer. You also might be able to adjust it a bit by taking out the seam in the "x" in the front and sewing it up further down. It feels like it's been sewn a little bit high (on me anyway), I just haven't found the time to attempt it!
- I have found that the strap in front can get irritating by the end of the day. If you have full tummy pants, just put the brace on top - yes, you will then have to re-adjust every time you use the bathroom, but this is not a big deal. I also have been using a "tummy sleeve" for those pants that don't go up far enough and that works well. In the summer, though, I expect this will get hot.

That feels like a lot of cons, but the bottom line is that it is comfortable, I like wearing it and it really feels like it's helping! I've been wearing it for about a month now, and it's the first thing I put on in the morning and the last thing that I take off.

Only 4 stars because there are some very easy fixes that they could make to make it even better!

title: Great option for custom kicks
text:
I’ve been playing in rubber bottom golf shoes for the past 3 seasons. Previously, I had only ever used traditional spikes for golfing, so the rubber soles were an ehhh transition. I was looking to get back to traditional spikes this season, but was struggling to find any golf shoes that I liked for a reasonable price. Conveniently, an advertisement for golf kicks graced my Instagram several weeks ago (go figure), so I skeptically decided to give them a try. I figured worst case scenario I wasted $35 and have a ruined pair of tennis shoes.

The results exceeded my expectations. Now I haven’t played in traditional spikes for years, but these seem to give pretty incredible traction/grip throughout my entire swing. My lead foot was rotating in my rubber golf shoes, and now I’m able to keep it perfectly planted throughout my entire follow through, allowing for much more consistent and straighter shots overall.

In terms of durability, which I was most concerned about with these DIY spikes, I have played 36 holes thus far in various weather conditions and have yet to lose a single spike. I did use shoe goo as recommended by the company, and that seems to have helped ensure the spikes don’t fall out. If these hold up for me throughout the season, I reckon I will be getting several more pairs for future custom golf kick projects.

Installation was simple in theory, but did require quite a bit of force to manually screw in the spikes. I do not own a drill, but would recommend using one if you do have one.

From what I've read, you can't expect to get an SPF of more than 15. The molecules of this stuff tend to clump together so it's not properly dispersed into the formula. There's been a lot of hype about adding carrot seed and raspberry seed oils to the formula. Some websites claim these oils have an SPF of up to 50, but I cannot find any scientific data supporting these claims if you find any I'd love to hear about it. title: For home use (not a veterinarian), you may need some information from your vet.
text: I bought this product after reading about various monitors and deciding this one appeared to be the best.  I bought it to be able to measure our geriatric cat's blood pressure at home.  She had a stroke and to help her urinate more easily, my vet recommended a med that can lower blood pressure.  Since she also has kidney dysfunction, not a good thing.  So wanted to use the monitor to determine her home blood pressure before starting med, then monitor it while she's on med.  The monitor, blood pressure cuff, various attachments are all easily used.  The User's Manual tells you everything you need to know to use the monitor/connect various items/etc.  Only pieces of information I needed from my vet to use the monitor and get an accurate reading was (1) where the main leg artery is (cuff is positioned based on artery and User's Manual intended for vets doesn't identify where the artery is of course) and (2) my cat wouldn't keep her leg still so needed to know if I could hold the leg at some point where it wouldn't effect the blood pressure result.  This would be an excellent monitor for a veterinarian clinic and for those people who are willing to spend the money and need to be able to measure their pet's blood pressure at home.  Note the "package" purchase I made includes the 6 different size cuffs (for our cat, smallest was appropriate cuff) and the ac adapter.  I didn't read the Amazon listing well enough and didn't think the cuffs came with the monitor so I bought them separately and then returned them as "bought by mistake".  Amazon, as always, made it extremely easy to return the cuffs and receive my refund.

I was expecting the color to be bright for some reason, however it was a darker color and the components started to set after a while (I accidentally left it in the car for 30 minutes) it’s not big deal though, a nice thorough whisk and they remixed back with the water and the rest of the dissolved supplement. I usually start my warm up right before the 30 minutes window is up before it starts to kick in and I feel like it’s beneficial for me and helps get my head in the game than waiting for it to completely kick in first.

All of my workouts have been done at home with various dumbbell, kettlebell and banded exercise moves. So for the first week I took half scoop each session since it has been a few months since I’ve taken a pre-workout. I am on day two of taking full scoops and let me tell you, I love how this product makes my body feel- so much stronger and more of a sustained focus on my workout without being over bearing. The difference between last week and this week has been so great for me- I am able to use heavier weights for some of my reps, more reps and sets, and my workouts are lasting longer. After my workouts I do not feel as exhausted and my body has adjusted to how it feels Post-workout too. I am not as sore after my workouts, and I don’t feel too fatigued that I don’t want to continue the upcoming workouts. I use my Apple Watch to monitor my heart rate during my workouts and is used to increase rapidly during each rep and slow back down rapidly, with the pre-work out I noticed that my heart rate steadily climbs during each rep AND STAYS elevated even during my rest periods between my reps and set unlike without it. I feel like I am having really positive effects while using this pre-workout, and cannot wait to see more results!The pictures are 6 days apart- the progress is starting to become more noticeable in muscle definition, although I still have a long way to go I’m proud of how far I have come. I cannot wait to see what goals I can accomplish using the unaltered products!

title: Bye bye b.o.! This stuff works!
text:
This review is for Ethique eco-friendly deodorant bar - Botanica:

This is the first deodorant I’ve ever used that actually works.
I sweat heavily when I workout, but after trying this for a week I have noticed that the workout b.o. smell is nonexistent.
I was concerned that working out in my apartment would cause it to smell like a gym, but after switching to this deodorant my roommate can’t even tell that I’ve worked out!
The deodorant itself is just a bar with no holder. It glides on easily after a shower, but applies just fine otherwise, though it may take a few more application swipes if your body’s not warmed up. A little goes a long way.
The smell is pleasant and doesn’t bother my allergen sensitive nose at all. It’s a mostly light lavender smell with a hint of vanilla (think spa/relaxing scents). The smell is not at all overpowering. I think you’d have to apply globs of it for that to happen.
No need to reapply throughout the day, this stuff works the entire day!
I do suggest getting the Ethique square bar container to store the deodorant so it doesn’t get wet or dusty. But a regular travel soap container would work too.
It’s a small square, but when you think in terms of volume, I’d say this is around the same size that you get in a traditional deodorant applicator, but unlike traditional deodorants, you don’t need to apply as much of the Ethique deodorant for it to work so this will last longer.
I highly recommend this. Yes, it’s a bit more expensive than other deodorants (even 3x more than some brands), but unlike other brands, this Ethique deodorant actually works.

Mostly for his water bottle and snacks, but you just don't think about how much 6 year olds carry around until their hands are busy steering a scooter! He really really loved it. title: Ignore the one star review!! This is a great product!
text:
Ignore the one star review. This IS a wipe on wipe off OIL finish. It’s made from vegetable oil and has zero VOCs. Yes it is a two part finish but that is a benefit. The second part is a hardener, this helps cure the finish and strengthens the ware layer.

I’m a professional hardwood refinisher and have used Bona Craft oil for the past year. It’s very easy to apply, you can hand rub it on for smaller projects or for larger projects like a hardwood floor you can use a trowel or a buffer to apply. Wait 15-30 minutes and buff it off. Make sure to only apply 25-50 square feet at a time until you get comfortable with the process.

The biggest benefit is that it can be easily repaired, just sand out the damaged area and reapply. You don’t need to worry about lap lines.

This is a mono coat finish, but you can add multiple coats without sanding between coats. You can also top coat it with Bona Traffic finish for extra protection. Make sure to follow the instructions on the can, different colors will have different cure times. Usually between 12-18 hours.

Update - The review that talks about this product staining easily is miss informed. Yes using a Bona Certified Craftsman is recommended but isn’t required. I feel I need to make something clear. This product is Susceptible to water popping for a while after it is applied. If you get water on it or roll an appliance dolly across the floor with wet wheels it will look stained. This is not to worry though. You just need to water pop the floor to remove these marks. To water pop the floor use clean water in a spray bottle or the recommended Bona oiled floor cleaner and a microfiber mop. Work across the floor in sections working with the grain. Like a magic eraser this will remove the areas that the dolly rolled across or where you spilled water on the floor.

If you top coat the floor with at least one coat of Bona Traffic series finish you will have sealed the floor in and the water popping issue will be eliminated.

The following photos are of a quarter sawn white oak that we wire brushed, used a mix of Clay and Garnet craft oil then top coated with 2 coats of Bona Traffic HD Satin. This floor is hard as nails and with proper care with will last for the next 30 plus years.

title: What are you buying?
text: First. This product looks exactly the same as "SilverLungs" product. So who's ripping off who? ALL so-called colloidal silver home machines make ionic silver via electrolysis. You have two silver rods, each clipped to an electrode placed a certain distance apart-one positive pole, one negative. You stick it in distilled water and it make silver ions. The better ones have auto shut off, swap polarity. You increase PPM by increasing time or distance between the rods. Every single home machine should produce exactly the same ionic silver. Second. This machine sells with it a reducing agent which needs to be stirred for a certain time (and I believe at the right temperature) to produce a silver particles in suspension. There are a lot of reducing agents, some of which produce toxic molecules. I have no idea about the science behind this company's reducing agent. Is the result safe, stable.. What is the resultant ratio of particles to ions? All vs. a professional subtantiated product like MesoSilver. Perhaps someone more knowledgable than me can clarify.

title: Great Parking Assistant BUT only after Modification!
text:
I was looking for a great looking LED Parking Assistant that would help me get my car within 8” of my work bench. The idea of it being able to adjust the stopping distance was a plus for me. It shipped fast and package well, instructions are minimal and explained well, I followed the setup by the book and each and every time it would not work right, it would not give the Green yellow red light properly. You have to reset it each time, I sent out questions to the seller and never received any answer but received a few from other buyers with the same problem. (Look in question and see them) so after days of reading and research on sensors I figured maybe I’ll build a better parking Assistant since I have a nice LED light. I decided to remove the two screws on the back of the sensor using a Allen wrench this is the the part you aligned with your bumper and has two little cones in the front which are, one of them is a transmitter, the other a receiver. The two screws I removed held on the front plastic cover around the cones. My idea was to get the model number so I could purchase a better quality item. Then I got thinking let’s try it without the front cover I noticed the cones are recessed way back into the cover and maybe it might interfere? I put the battery’s back in mounted were I had it and YEP it Works and Works Fantastic!
If you own this unit and want to make it work remove the front cover from the sensors by removing two Allen screws from the back side.
My Notes to the Seller/Manufacturer. Redesign the front cover of the sensor allowing the cones to stick out 1/4” this can be done by retooling the inside of the cover by removing additional 1/4 off the ledge were the sensor sits and adding additional foam to the rear side (I did it works great) I would also add mount tabs for screws to both the sensor and light for ease of mounting, and a longer wire between the sensor and light. all of which I have done in modifications along with a AC jack.

title: Unexpected Daylight
text:
There's nothing like unexpected daylight, unless you are trying to sleep in longer.

St. Francis of Assisi actually never said, "Preach the Gospel at all times. Use words if necessary," inasmuch as we like to say he did. Similarly, we can't prove that Swiss Reformed theologian Karl Barth (1886-1968) never said, "We must hold the Bible in one hand and the newspaper in the other," because he actually never wrote those exact words. Indeed, there are statements made by these men that we might be able to piece together to suggest that they might have agreed with the quotes that have been attributed to them. Yet, the quotes themselves do not belong to these men.

Dubious quotes aside; with the newspaper in one hand, his fingers of the other hand searching the internet, George Weigel on speed-dial, his other book The Tide Is Turning Towards Catholicism being propped up by his kids like a lectionary, and his wife channel surfing back and forth from EWTN to CNN, author David J. Hartline, once again, proves that by preaching the Gospel at all times, and using words when necessary, the Catholic Church is still the world's light on hill.

Being an author and blogger it's always difficult for me to find time to read books other than my own or those I'm merely using for research. In fact, the only books other than my own, and writings by Popes John Paul II and Benedict XVI, that I've been able to read over the past two years have been books that I have been asked to review. As such, I've always had the pleasant opportunity with these books to depart from my own thoughts and enter into the reflections, stories, musings, and rants of my fellow Catholics. The Catholic Tide Continues to Turn by Hartline was no different in that regard. In fact, several sections of this book were so gripping that I couldn't put the book down, while other sections compelled me to just set it aside for a moment, so that I could contemplate upon what I had just read. There's nothing like unexpected daylight, unless you are trying to sleep in longer. :D

I was one of those Catholic converts that Hartline refers to in the fourth chapter his book, `The Number of Converts Keep Increasing', that, in spite of the child sex abuse scandal, we came home to the Catholic Church. In fact, his first book, The Tide is Turning Toward Catholicism was one of the books I read while I was still discerning my call to become a Catholic. What that book and several of his articles in the Catholic Times did for me back then in 2006 was to assure me that the Catholic Church truly is being protected, preserved, and promoted by Christ Jesus. Outside of Christ Jesus there is no other way to explain how the Catholic Church continues to exist and flourish after nearly 2,000 years in spite of we who call ourselves members and clergy of the Church. Outside of Christ Jesus there is other way to explain how the Catholic Church confounds the dark world every time that it triumphs over the demise that its critics had prophesied.

Continuing on with that same gift that he has to undercover fascinating news and events that the mainstream media wouldn't dare to consider covering, even if it knew how, Hartline offers us in his new book twenty chapters and nearly four hundred pages of stunning evidence and undeniable eyewitness accounts that God is still in the business of gathering the world into His Catholic Church and protecting it at all cost.

While I was reading chapter after chapter of this book, the phrase that kept ringing in my head was, `In Spite of'. I believe that anyone who reads this book, has to come away with seeing that there is truly a miracle taking place in the Catholic Church throughout the world today; and that this miracle is taking place `In Spite Of' those within and without the Church who are working so very hard to conform the Church to the world, and to even to destroy Her all together.

This isn't just a book for Catholics, and it wasn't written as such - evidenced by the appendix at the end that offers a brief introduction to basic Catholic beliefs. On the contrary, what we have here is a book that you want to buy for yourself to read, but you also want to make sure that you put either your own copy or a new copy in the hands of a non-Catholic - either someone who is interested, indifferent, or oppose to our faith. You also want to put a copy in the hand of lukewarm Catholics and those who have a distorted understanding of Vatican II. This uplifting book is definitely a must have book for anyone over the age of about 10, and anyone younger than 10 should have it read to them aloud.

title: Fast- and frizzy.
text:
The Apalus Hair Straightening Brush, is a very interesting straightener. It only takes about 3 minutes to heat up, and another 4 minutes to straighten my hair(if that). I did not have the previous version, but I am thankful for the addition of locking controls, as I've hit the buttons with my fingers numerous times while running the brush through my hair.
You definitely want to brush your hair BEFORE using the product, as I sleepily tried running this through my hair one morning, and ended up in tremendous pain as I almost yanked a whole chunk of hair out, and ruined my brush. Definitely noted as soon as that happened.
The reason I am giving this 4 stars is due to the frizz factor. I have wavy hair that has a LOT of frizz-which is less noticeable when it's natural. When straightened it looks horrendous. I hate that I now need a frizz serum now. A normal ceramic straightener gets rid of frizz.

Edit** be careful around your ears/pull the hair away from your face, because I burnt the top of my ear with the brush! It didn't really hurt too much, but later in the day I did notice a blister had formed. It was gone the next day so it's no big deal. I STILL RECOMMEND THIS BRUSH THOUGH!

I definitely recommend this product, however!

title: Great Product -- Leaky Seal
text:
I use this for extensive backcountry use to stay "clean" in the grosser areas when I don't have access to a shower, flowing water, soap, etc. Works GREAT. Keeps things WAY less smelly, gross, etc. Heals skin. Helps with rashes. Disinfects. Can't recommend enough.

The only issue? The top twists off (not the cap, that pops off, the actual top third of the bottle) and it's a horrible seal. It leaks when the bottle is not upright. I threw this in a bag and it leaked everywhere, albeit slowly.

The solution was easy enough: twist off, wrap top seal with plumbers tape, reseal. Works great. So only 4 stars because they didn't design this bottle with an o-ring. So...buy this. The foaming agent is worth it. Just be prepared that it will leak unless you seal it yourself.

***UPDATE 9/22
So....it's still leaking... On all 3 bottles I have (home use, backcountry use, first aid kit). Now I have tried a new solution. I added MORE plumbers tape but I think the problem is the bottle itself is compressible...like a cheap plastic bottle. So the seal can separate with pressure. Not good if its on its side in a pack with other items shuffling around. So on top of the added tape, I used E6000 industrial strength adhesive to the outside of the seal. Then a layer of leukotape, then a layer of PowerSteel duct tape.

This is a lot of work to get this darn bottle to cease leaking. GET US A BETTER BOTTLE. Downgraded to 2 stars.

I really like the scale, ease of use, convenience of the wireless connection and the web app.

I would like an option to turn off the body fat measurement - when it has the weight, I'd like it to just indicate it's done instead of continuing to try to read the body fat of my socks.

I'd also like to see a couple of options in the app: the ability to add notes to certain readings ("was wearing blue jeans" or "had caffeine the day before" for example), and the ability to make the badges wait for a few days of stable readings before rewarding (I got a badge for losing 5 pounds when I had actually only lost 1 pound).

title: There is so much good solid data on this naturally occurring plant that has ...
text:
This is my first time using Ashitaba powder and after researching the product I was expecting some of the health benefits that many others have experienced from this plant. After five weeks of daily use of this product I have seen no significant benefits - so maybe five weeks is not long enough. Then I noticed on the packaging that the "Best By Date" of the material was blacked out with a magic marker. When I held it to the light I could read that the date that was crossed out was "August 2018". I believe that I was shipped old and almost out of date product by the supplier and this is possibly why I have seen no effect from the product. I feel that is a deceptive practice. I have not contacted the supplier or Amazon. I just don't have the time to fight over a one time purchase of 2 ounces of the material. I am moving on.

I still want to give Ashitaba another try. There is so much good solid data on this naturally occurring plant that has been used for centuries. I am looking for another good Ashitaba powder. Does anyone have any suggestions?

title: Overall, I would recommend this brush
text:
Cons: I agree with the reviews about this brush being a little too soft. My beard is maybe 1.5 inches long and it feels like this product only brushes a little deeper than the surface, doesn't really penetrate to the roots like some reviews claimed. I have been applying wet oil (different brand than this brush) to my beard and didn't feel like putting the oil directly onto the brush was very efficient. It felt like I had to use a much greater amount to get the brush wet than if I directly applied the oil to my beard with my fingers.

Pros: The soft bristles do feel comfortable. The handmade aspect is nice, I can tell this was not made by a machine/assembly line. After applying my wet beard oil with my fingers, this brush does do a good job of making my beard look awesome! It's smooth and compact/tight and has a good contour. I do wish the bristles would dig a little deeper and give me the satisfaction of scrubbing the skin below my beard, but still, I can't complain about the way my beard looks and feels afterwards, so if that's what matters most to you then I would recommend it.

Overall opinion: I would purchase again. In the future I may try this with dry beard oil to see if that makes a difference vs wet oil I've been using.

title: I thought I could install them myself, but I was wrong.
text:
I bought these fully aware of the difficulty others has installing them, but I’m much handier than most and thought I could manage it. Nope! Finally I broke down and bought a $30 special tool just for installing this type of wheelchair tire, placed it in the vice as recommended, and lubricated the tires and rims to make them easier to slip on. Still no way I could do it. I enlisted the help of another sturdy guy. Even the two of us working on it together couldn’t get these tires on the rims, though we did manage to rotate a very, very heavy workbench with the pressure we were applying. I even tried to soak them in hot water to see if that might help them stretch, but it did not. These tires simply do not stretch the way others I’ve seen in instructional videos do!

Before buying the special tool I called a wheelchair place to ask if they could do it, and they said they only order new rims with new tires on them because installation is so hard.

title: I hate protein drinks...
text:
[[ASIN:B001180348 SynTrax Nectar Whey Protein Isolate, Fuzzy Navel , 2-Pound Plastic Jar]]

I have tried all kinds of the chocolate protein drinks, after one drink the whole jar went in the trash, this one's a keeper. I'm glad that I went with the reviews. My 3yr old and I just taste tested it. I used half a scoop in 8oz of water with 2 ice cubes. By the way 1scoop has 4tbs in it. It's a bit foamy, a little watered down (I'll use less water next time), as for the flavor, tangy, I taste more peach than orange, It does not taste like a protein powder & I am surprised that it's not chalky nor is there any after taste. Judging by the flavor, I believe it would be tasty in milk. I bought it as a meal replacement & with the ingredients my toddler (who at times I can barely get to eat) can drink it in smaller doses.

Also, I highly recommend the blender bottle [[ASIN:B0064QW0YI Original 28oz Blender Bottle Black]] or blender bottle sport [[ASIN:B007SNLKWE BlenderBottle Sport Mixer 20oz & 28oz]]. It mixed up perfectly in it. I have a 28oz sport that I mix my daughter's powdered milk in (works great), then I've given the regular 28oz blender bottles to my dad who uses them for protein powders, I had a smaller regular one that my husband was using, and for the fuzzy navel protein powder I bought a green 20oz blender bottle sport (nice color, perfect size). I've read about the other mixer bottles breaking easily. I've used blender bottles for probably 4-5yrs now and they work as well as they did when I purchased, a quality product.

title: Beads are the way to go for proper cigar humidification
text:
I did a lot of online research and after all was said and done, I was "sold" on the beads 2-way humidification capabilities. As soon as this product reached my door, I threw away my old "foam-based" humidification system that came with my humidor. I combined using beads with a transition from analog to digital hygrometer (an important shift!). Analog hygrometers may look nice, rustic, pretty, what have you, but they are terribly unreliable. Get a decent digital hygrometer; you won't be disappointed. Back to the beads: After switching, I noticed how much steadier the humidity remained inside the humidor and also, how much *less* I had to tend to it (i.e. add water). The only reason I didn't rate this product a 5 was for it's packaging. Shortly after I purchased this item, I found another product that came in a disk with an adhesive/magnet system that mounts on the inside lid of the humidor. I purchased that and started using it; strictly because I retain more space in my small humidor (50 ct) with the disk mounted on the lid's interior vs setting this bag in a small bowl in the bottom of the humidor.

As far as this product is concerned; it's aces! I would like to see them come out with a mountable disk-type option.

You cigar aficionados, if you haven't already

1. Ditch the foam humidification system. Literally, throw it in the garbage; it's no good.
2. Get your beads!
3. Get a digital hygrometer (Mine's a Xikar; I'm sure there are a few different brands to choose from)

Your cigars will thank you.

title: On my 4th Bottle because It Works!
text:
I figured as I was about to purchase my 4th bottle of this, I may as well leave a review. I have an old grumpy cat who has taken to soiling anywhere she happens to be if I don't pick her up and carry her to the litter box in time. Needless to say I haven't been around to do that or I haven't picked up on her kitty cues exactly when she's wanting to go 100% of the time and thus she's soiled a lot of fabric-covered things in my home over the past two years!

I've taken to using waterproof mats (like you might put in a crib, etc) on my chairs, sofa, bed, etc. However, as I don't want my apartment just looking like a giant wee wee pad, I've been covering them with multiple colorful 100% cotton throws that I can also toss into the wash.

Let me tell you, cat piss stinks, female, male, it all stinks!!! I've tried a lot of things and no matter how quickly you get a soiled item into the wash, most of those products don't fully get the stink out. I gave Skout's Honor Laundry Booster a try last year and it is now my go-to product. I don't even follow the directions. I just get the wash started with Persil detergent (because it also had great reviews for getting the stink out) and squirt a very generous amount of the Skout's Honor in with it, like maybe 1/2-3/4 cup depending how bad I think the situation is. I let it agitate just a bit to be sure all the laundry is covered with liquid and to give it all a better chance to mix in. Then I stop it for an hour and just let it soak (have old school upright coin-operated machine in our laundry room, so that means I just lift the lid and it stops:).

After that I let the whole wash, rinse, spin cycle continue and dry it as usual in the dryer. I always give it the sniff test when all is finished and I have not been disappointed yet! I have some other products in the laundry room that are meant to do the same thing, but I can't bring myself to try them now, because I've been disappointed before-- nothing like a failed sniff test--yuck!

Skout's Honor just works for me. So those other bottles will continue to sit on the shelf while I place an order for my 4th bottle of Skout's Honor Laundry Booster! And no I have not received any free product for my review, although I would love some:)!

title: Equinox "Professional Razor Edge Series"
text:
For the discounted price I guess you could say that this set is barely adequate but if you're expecting anything close to professional level barber shears for $13 you will be sadly disappointed. I wear a medium size glove and the finger holes on these shears are too small for comfort or proper fine control when cutting.They are too heavy for their small size making the balance awkward. I have a couple of pairs of small shears, nothing fancy, stamped steel, riveted , non-adjustable that I picked up in the discount drugstore for a couple of bucks apiece maybe 15 years ago that have never been sharpened that I was hoping to replace with this set. They are both still noticeably sharper than the Equinox set. In fact, some Chinese made general purpose scissors that I got in the Dollar Store are sharper. Trimming with the standard shears, especially shorter hairs, can be problematic and frustrating because at least half the time the final quarter inch at the tip of the blades doesn't cut cleanly on the first attempt or just folds over the hair trapping it between the blades.

If you plan on using these on a regular basis save your money and invest in a better pair - you'll be much happier with your purchase.

text:
This review is for Premium Lutein Vision Support Formula (Best Eye Care & UV Protection) w/ High Potency Lutein (20mg), Vitamin A, Bilberry Extract, Grape Seed, Zinc for Eye Strain, Dry Eyes, Red Eyes - 60 Capsules by Sigmaceutical. I have had issues with my vision for the past 20+ years and have been through various levels of eye glasses and am currently wearing Ortho K contact lenses to try to correct / treat my vision. I also work night shift and have to work on a computer for 12 hours a shift. My eye Dr. has told me to do everything I can to help my vision and taking Lutein was one of those things.

These capsules are full of various ingredients that can help with the various eye issues that we all can have as we get older. Dry eyes from allergies, eye strain from computer and / or cell phone usage, and just age in general can be helped over time by adding Lutein to your diet. I have taken other forms of Lutein in the past and had pretty good results. These capsules have the Lutein as well as other ingredients that can assist with vision improvement. Granted the ingredients and the dosage is not established by the Food and Drug Administration but there are studies that say the ingredients will help.

The capsules are not very large and are easy to swallow (either one or two at a time) with whatever drink you choose. Taking them with a meal may help with absorption and is usually recommended. Upon opening the bottle there was a slight odor to the capsules but seems to have gone away after a couple of days of being open. I'm just starting the bottle so it's hard to say if there is any changes yet but I will keep taking them and see how it goes.

I received this item for free or at a discounted rate for my fair and honest review.

title: New, improved SleepTracker.
text:
I've used the older version for about a year. I liked it, but it would stop recording from time to time, I think I was rolling over and mashing buttons in my sleep. That's not a problem with the new version, the buttons are smaller and better protected from accidental pushes.

It's considerably bigger than the original, too big to be a practical day to day wristwatch like the old one. It's a small price to pay for the added functionality in my opinion.

The data transfer via USB cable works perfectly, no more typing for me. The software for analyzing the data is rather simplistic for my taste, but here's the good news, the data are stored in native MS Access format! So if you're a data geek like me, you can build your own reports and do your own analysis. I'm so happy they didn't go with a weird proprietary format.

I used to wake up grouchy and groggy all my life, that's now a thing of the past with the SleepTracker. If that's all it did it would be worth it. The data recording feature is an added bonus if you're like me, and need to determine the effect of different medications on your sleep patterns.

title: Does what it claims!
text:
I had a stack of cotton T-shirts that had become brownish over the past 5 years. I was about to donate them to a rag drive, but I remembered an old product that touted "active enzymes". I couldn't find any - probably because I remember that the sewer department decided that these enzymes were eating away at the seals on some sewer pipes.
I still wanted to try, so I ordered this stuff. I soaked the T-shirts for four hours in one cup of Biz and about three gallons of water. The water turned yellow! I couldn't wait! I washed them normally then, and the result was spectacular! They were white again. Not brand-new white, but white nonetheless.
I've since used Biz on ring-around-the-collar white shirts, other delicate underthings and grimy old kitchen towels with similar results. This is a winner.
OBTW: Pay attention to the directions on the box. This stuff will do a job on your unprotected hands. And, if you don't use it often, the effect on sewer pipe seals is minimal.

title: Can't trust it
text:
Love the FitBit Ultra and have really increased my activity as a result of watching my steps, so the Aria seemed like a natural addition to the family. I bought mine at a Brookstone retail store (same price as Amazon).

From the start, I knew this would be a problem. I'm a geek and I never read the instructions. This time was no exception but I failed miserably. So I broke down and followed the instructions step-by-step. I still found it difficult. Maybe I was over-thinking it, but it took me close to 30 minutes. Once I did get it connected, it sync'd perfectly. Both my wife and I added it to our FitBit profiles and were able to track our weight without writing it down. It's really cool that it knows who is on the scale without you having to tell it.

The problem is that it just didn't give consistent weight readings. I would get on the scale 3 times in a row and have variations between 1 and 3 pounds, sometimes more. Often the first reading was the outlier. The body-fat percentage varied wildly, especially before and after shower. Honestly I could live without the body-fat reading, but weight must be consistent. I used Aria daily for two weeks and the bottom line was: I just can't trust it. So I went back to my simple, inexpensive electronic scale that is rock-solid reading after reading.

Aria went back to the store and they gave me a refund without question (be sure to bring your receipt and the exact same card or you'll end up with store credit).

title: Awesome Travel Shaver
text:
I won't waste your time as I will echo most of what David Pearlman has said in another review of this product. Norelco is still the go-to shaver for me, especially when I want my face smooth. So that's what I use at home. That said, my Norelco was more than twice the price of this thing so that's not a fair comparison.

Where I really do like this thing, especially for the price, is as my travel shaver. And I travel a lot for work. For that reason I don't want to beat up an expensive shaver in my bag. When I'm on the road I just need a quick shave as I'm in more of a "blue collar" mode. This shaver takes care of that well and it has great battery capacity. I really like that it tells you just how much capacity is left too, something my expensive shaver doesn't do.

I was a little alarmed to see marked on the shaver that it is 110 to 240 Volts. Uh...that wouldn't be at all safe in the shower. Rest assured it is a 5 VDC unit and charges from whatever USB source you use. I think whoever put the marking on there was a bit confused.

So I feel that this is a great shaver for the price. Don't expect too much out of it, but then you won't be paying too much. Take this thing on the road with you and you'll be happy with it.

text:
These things taste great. I like all the flavors, but the raspberry are the best by far. Cookie dough a close second.

However, while technically they may have very low net carbs, they use a lot of things in the ingredients like maltitol and maltodextrin which can affect your blood sugar levels quite a bit. These ingredients don't pair well with diets looking to cut carbs but also regulate blood sugar levels, such as people with diabetes or doing a keto diet.

It pains me to say it as I do love these bars in almost every other way, but I won't be buying any more boxes of them until they change the recipe to use better sugar alternatives.

title: Great Combo!
text:
After 50, energy levels drop like crazy. Not talking libido but overall motivational energy. I used to be able to get up and hop on a treadmill and workout for about an hour. These days I wake up and it feels like I'm carrying a tank. Till the first cup of coffee, then I'm ready for anything. So thinking that I needed to wake up dormant energy, I ordered these as a "what the hell, try it" .

All people react differently to supplements. You have to find the "sweet spot" on how your body reacts in a way that you want it to. For me, I didn't want to wake up feeling exhausted. So I took these in the morning and it gave me the jitters big time. So experimenting, I started taking them 2-3hrs before bed time. For some reason, they don't give me the jitters at night and I sleep soundly. When I wake up though, I wake up like I used to 20 yrs ago. Ready to tackle the gym, the yard, etc.... and still get ready and do a full day's work at my job.

That's what I wanted these pills to accomplish. Physical energy levels that I can tap when I'm mentally motivated . Whatever that may be. Surprisingly, these pills did that. I've tried lots of supplements with only marginal results. I've been on these for about 3 months and so far they've been working. No more waking up like I've been partying all night; then gotta go to work. I don't mind that because at least a good time came out of the partying. But c'mon, waking up groggy and tired after a restful sleep?? I know we're getting older but if a couple of supplements can stave off aging for awhile, then so be it. : )

title: Not just another expensive treatment. This one works well for me!
text:
K, this is my new favorite cold sore treatment. I've had this balm in my cart for ages as I was waiting for my next big sore to happen before I ordered it. My sores are caused by changes in my hormones, plus changing of seasons, plus stress. Last week, with all the worry and anxiety coming from the COVID-19 crisis, I developed a bigger-than-usual sore on my upper lip. I ordered this balm that night and it arrived quickly, which I was really grateful for.

I've had sores since I was a kid, and only had a few things that felt like they really worked for me. I've tried Abreva time and time again with only a little success (which is frustrating considering how expensive it is), and a few other over the counter ointments like it, but nothing has seemed to help much. I've even tried applying tea tree or eucalyptus oil to them, and those seem to help the most, but dry my skin out terribly, and they smell unpleasant to boot.

But this balm has changed my life, I'm not joking. I can apply this balm as often as I want, and it softens and heals gently. My current sore is on day 9, and very nearly healed, but I feel confident that if I'd had this from day one, it would have healed by now. The balm has a very pleasing lemon scent, and seems to soak in to the sore but stay on the surface of the skin around it to help keep everything from drying out and cracking, which would prolong healing and suffering. Admittedly, this balm seemed expensive at first glance, and I was skeptical about buying yet another high priced treatment option that would only work so-so, but now that I've tried it, I don't ever want to be without it!

I will be buying a couple of extra tubes when life settles down some, so I can keep one in my bag and at my office. I'm eager to see how well it works when applied right at the first annoying tingle. I hope that if you try this, you'll be as relieved as I was.

title: Fits Jet toothbrushes, but bristles soften pretty quickly.
text:
I bought these as they also fit "Jet" brand electric toothbrushes. They're pretty pricy, especially comparing it to other basic toothbrush heads you can buy at a department store, but this is the only place I can find them. The bristles are as described (i.e. soft, medium, hard) but they soften up really quickly. They go soft so fast that I tried a soft bristle head once and removed it after like a month because it felt and looked like it wasn't actually cleaning anything. You can also tell after about 2.5 months that you need to replace the bristles because they're so soft, even though they're supposed to last for the standard 3 months.

I'm tired of spending this much money for something this basic. While they do work, I would rather just switch toothbrushes considering the cons of using these heads.

title: Stick with Ety's
text:
A year ago I bought the ER20's and DB's. Initially I used the Ety's just because of the string attaching both of them made it easier to take on and off. After a year of using the Ety's at over 20 concerts, I had really grown to love using earplugs. Never an issue understanding what someone was saying and the music sounded great. I lost my Ety's about three weeks ago and had to switch to the DB's. After using them at two concerts, they just aren't as enjoyable. Conversations are harder to hear, and the music sounds muddled. I found myself consistently aware of the reduction and effect they had on the music and as a result fiddling with them throughout to find a sweet spot that was never found.

As music earplugs they're lacking, in comparison to the Ety's, but they are more comfortable, and likely block more sound. As a result, I expect they will make pretty decent pair to sleep in as a upgrade from foam plugs. The aluminum case is pretty cool too.

title: Phonak TV connnector - a wonderful add on for Marvel hearing aids
text: I have had the TV connector for only a few days but I am truly impressed with the sound quality streamed to the hearing aids.  The TV connector includes both the analog 3.5mm cable and the optical cable for connection to I believe virtually any TV.  I have both TV sets one with the 3.5mm plug and a newer smart TV that has only the optical sound port. I connected to both and to my ears I believe the sound seems even better with optical port.  The sound is so crisp and  clear that it seems someone who does not have hearing loss may in fact want to use hearing aids just to couple to the TV connector when watching TV.  The amazing thing is my TV sound is turned down to 1 which is virtually turned off but the sound streamed over to the hearing aid is excellent even at that setting.  It is as though the TV is broadcasting to me personally as every little sound made in the telecast  is heard by me.  I can even hear the sound in other parts of the house where there is no TV set.  Someone may say I have the hearing aids and therefore why does one need the TV connector.  The answer to that is the sound is so, so much better with absolutely no background from any other source.  I am happy to have purchased this device from Hearing Accessories on Amazon. The item was shipped very quickly and they answered several questions for me prior to the sale.  They appear to be a very reputable seller of this product.  This device has generated a renewed interest in watching some TV programs for me.  It is a great addition to the marvel hearing aids.

title: Started to rust
text:
Update: I am downgrading my review to 0 stars.

This unit has developed rust on the stainless steel interior. I followed all instructions for care and cleaning. I never left the unit wet or closed. It has only contained water -- nothing else.

It now has rust inside and puts out water that tastes very metallic. I do not think quality stainless steel is supposed to do this. For instance, I have a stainless steel sink that is wet all the time -- my sink has not started to rust and it is exposed to the same water as this distiller.

I am very unhappy with this product. At the moment it is useless.

Old Review:

I was going to return it because the water container is made of unidentified potentially toxic plastic. The other problem is that there is a small metal piece that fits between the distiller and the container. It is very loose. I mean it doesn't attach to anything at all. It just sits loosely on the container. It looks as if it was made for another size opening. I expected to have a closed container to catch the distilled water and keep airborne bacteria out. I inquired about it and was met with less than satisfactory customer service. After going back and forth, customer service asked me to send them photos of the distiller and the metal piece. I guess they don't know what their product looks like. At any rate they were amenable to giving me a refund. But I decided to keep it. I found a stainless steel pot which fits under the spout. This is not the hygienic standard I hoped for but it will do. On the up side -- the reviews about the water having no aftertaste or smell are correct. I have been using it for several months and I'm satisfied with the water it puts out, if not the container quality.

title: I love the Bald Eagle
text: I was eagerly anticipating the Bald Eagle and it landed on Sunday. The packagng was aesthetically pleasing and it contained a brush and carry bag. I opened it and there was really nothing for me to do-the shaver was already assembled and charged. I took it in the shower and started using it as shown on a 'youtube' video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkygOkmUB4k). At first, the blades whirred but the Bald Eagle was not cutting any hair. I turned off the unit and reseated the blade assembly. When I turned on the shaver again, the whirring sound was deeper. I knew the Eagle was now hungry. I lathered my head with shaving cream and started moving the razor in slow circular movements. In between, I dipped the blades in a cup of water to remove any hair clippings. I could not believe how easy it was to use the Bald Eagle and how well the shaver fit the contours of my skull. I did not feel any tugs or burns and the skull was smooth. I would have given it 5 stars if it worked just as well on my face. I will give a few more weeks (as recommended) and may revise my rating to 5 stars. Overall, I am very happy with the purchase and have already recommended it to several of my fellow 'baldies'

CONTAINS NO: Artificial coloring, artificial flavor, preservatives, yeast, corn, milk or milk derivatives, lactose, salt, sodium, soy, sugar, gluten, starch or wheat.

Usually sellers have a picture of all sides of the bottle so that you can read the ingredients for yourself. I had previously purchased a brand of phosphatidylserine that had soy and I stopped taking it and wanted to find one that didn't contain soy but had a higher dose.

I thought that this product was the solution, especially since the seller clearly states that it has no soy, even though that's a lie. Anyone who has allergies to soy please be warned that this product does in fact contain soy.

title: Effective home remedy for LPR
text: The product arrived quickly and was as advertised.  I thought I'd try sodium alginate after reading that it's the main ingredient of Gaviscon  Advance.  Several studies have indicated that Gaviscon Advance (G.A.) is the most effective treatment for LPR.  (Disclaimer: I'm not a doctor) Since it's only sold in Europe, G.A.  is difficult and costly to acquire in the States.  My DIY version is simple:  about a 2:1 ratio of sodium alginate to baking soda in a small amount of water.  That's about 1/8 tsp sodium alginate in 1 tablespoon of water.  I have to add the sodium alginate very slowly to the liquid, as it globs easily.  I use a shot glass, and stir rapidly with a chop-stick while shaking the powder in.  Then I let sit for at least half an hour to fully gel up.  Ideally, it should be about the consistency of molasses.  I take it just before bed, and  other times as needed.  Along with avoiding acid foods and eating smaller portions, sodium alginate has effectively controlled my symptoms of LPR and related cough.  It's a good product, and 4 oz. has lasted a long time. I'll be reordering soon.

title: Body fat and BMI measurements are not even close to being accurate
text:
I have been monitoring my body composition for several years. Every three months I do hydrostatic body testing (google it) so that I can track the results of my training for that period. I recently added a FitBit Surge (which I love) to my arsenal of gadgets, so I was excited to get this scale and add it to my FitBit account. Tracking my body fat and BMI stats daily, in-between hydrostatic sounded appealing. Regrettably the body fat and BMI measurements are not even close to being accurate. The scale posted me with 16.2% body fat, I have been in the 6% to 8% range for over 2 years, the BMI was even more out of touch with reality. That’s how WRONG this scale was. I tested it several times throughout the day to allow for proper hydration, and to eliminate all possible variables.
It’s a shame it does not work, but it clearly does not...….or at the very least the one that I had didn't. Either way I packed it up and shipped it back.

title: If It's Too Loud, You're Too Old!
text:
I used to not care about my hearing when I was younger. I sat in a Red Hot Chili Peppers concert in the first ten rows and couldn't hear correctly for about three days. I almost got on stage of a Tom Petty Concert. I was within feet of the stage of a few Dave Matthews Band Concerts. That was awesome, but only when I was between 18-25 years old.

I recently went to a Dream Theater indoor concert (Dream Theater is the best band ever by the way) and decided my precious ears needed a break. I was thinking about the bumper sticker "If it's too loud, you're too old" and decided to buy these earplugs anyway. They take the sound down about 18 decibels and don't make the sound too muddy as traditional earplugs do. I have always wanted to purchase a pair of musician's earplugs but didn't want to drop $150 or so. This is the best alternative I have found and they're super affordable.

I'm not sure if it was the venue or the earplugs, but the bass did sound a little funny, and that shouldn't ever happen when you're listening to John Myung shred on his axe. There might be better earplugs out there, but I would expect you would have to pay a much higher price.

Rock on without permanent hearing damage! It's a win-win!

title: WOW! What a Value!  HUGE, STRONG, POWERFUL!  Not perfect for fine finishing work or around delicate nick prone areas though.
text:
What an incredible bargain these are!! I have several pairs of Oster A5's, and top of the line Andis shears... all of them significantly more expensive than these...but these by far seem to be the more substantial, and expensive of the bunch. (If I didn't know the sales prices or brands.)

Starting with the great molded case, the two extra replaceable motor brushes, and the tools and oil that it comes with.

I ordered this to use primarily on my dog, (Based on some great reviews of Arksen's other shears being used on canines) due to his often getting thick mats, that are difficult on the Oster's and Andis's. The blades get really hot and uncomfortable against his skin, and I have to keep switching from one to the other. I ordered these when my dog was overdue for his spring cut..and boy was he matted. I was anxiously waiting to clip him until these arrived. So right after these arrived, I got right to it.

I must say, these cut right through mats like crazy...a huge improvement... however, I personally wouldn't buy these as your only set of shears for use on a dog. These are some BIG...POWERFUL...and loud shears, with some huge blades. I also wouldn't use these on a dog if you don't know what you are doing... you wouldn't want to nick your dog's skin with these...as they are big teeth, with a tremendously powerful motor. I must admit, I was pretty nervous, and only used these when I got to the thicker mats, in areas that I could be careful to not get any skin into the teeth.
Also, know that they are not designed for a "finished" smooth, look to the fur. Plan to either go back over with other shears to "even out" the cut marks, or use when you don't mind a bit more of a rougher look. :-) They are also big/heavy, so a bit awkward to handle easily. If you consider yourself to be "dainty" at all...these probably aren't for you. (If you remember "Tim the Tool-man Taylor... well he would have LOVED these shears!! I can hear him grunting right now as I imagine him holding these monsters! :-)

Overall, I am incredibly impressed with the power, quality, and design of these, as well as the value that they represent for sure!! I am convinced that those with larger animals will be even happier with them, and I am thrilled to have them for those tough spots, that can take so long with other shears.

**I purchased these at a discount in exchange for my promise to provide my 100% honest and impartial review, which I promise I am giving here. (This does not keep me from giving 1, 2, or 3 star reviews or full praise as warranted.) Let me know if you have any questions at all.

title: Buckles and velcro are backward ...
text:
I like it, but it's designed really badly. I want to pin my shoulders back but when I tighten the straps all the way the buckle sits right in the crease of my arm and shoulder. It pinches like crazy and hurts like hell. The straps are designed and built backward or up-side-down. The buckle should move down and away from the shoulder to get tighter, not upward. If it weren't for the buckles, I'd love it.

Also, there should be a strap that goes horizontally from the front of the shoulder strap to the mid-back. A strap that crosses the upper arm. That would really pull the shoulders back rather than the way this is designed, it actually pulls between the clavicle and the shoulder rather than the actual shoulder, or it should have shoulder cups.

I can sew, so maybe I'll tear this thing apart and redesign it properly.

One more thing, I'm very athletic but the belly part is a bit too small and the shoulder part is a bit too big. Oddly, being fit and athletic makes it hard to find clothes and apparel that fit properly. It's a shame that most things are made for the pear-shaped person. Not this though, this is backward from that.

Finally, the waist strap has the male or rough side of the velcro facing the body and the female or soft side facing outward. That means that if you don't cover all of the male velcro it digging and ripping into your clothes or even worse ... your skin.

title: Flexicose Plus
text: I have been using this product for a long time - probably 11 years. I love how it helps me to not have pain and be able to move.  I have a bad scoliatic back, bad hips ( I have had one hip joint replacement several years ago but not the other), and bad knees (I have had lateral releases and arthoscopic on both my knees and have deep crevices under both knee caps where the cartilage is gone) plus I have arthritis. Only pain I sometimes get now is a little in my lower back if I walk a long way without my cane ( I am also about 40 lbs overweight and nearly 70 yrs old). If I am just doing my normal activities including a day of shopping and errands, I have no pain because of flexicose plus. I can tell how much the flexicose plus helps as on rare occasions I run out of the product or forget to take it and within 24 hours I am in hurt city - bad. My dog (a lab) is 11 yrs old and was starting to walk slow, limp badly, and seemed to be in a lot of pain. He would even chew on his wrists until they bleed. After taking Xrays, the vet said he was very arthritic, I started giving him my flexicose plus a few months ago and within a couple of weeks he was running and acting like a much much younger dog. He is 75 lbs and I give him a teaspoon each day in the morning. I pour it on his food and then add a little roast beef to disguise the taste and smell of the flexicose plus. He hasn't chewed on this front paws since (after a couple of weeks of taking it). If you start taking this, give it a few weeks to take effect before you judge it's effectiveness. Also it has a slight taste that at first may seem a little unpleasant - sort of a slight fishy smell. After a couple of times you won't even notice that. I highly recommend this product. Of all the things I have tried, this works the best. I tried Move Free and other products but they didn't help.  I read that you only get about 10% absorption from them as they are pills. Flexicose is a liquid so you get 100% of the value.  I take it straight from a spoon first thing in the morning. I take a tablespoon each morning. I store it in the refrigerator.

title: Great product
text:
Pure Science Supplements’ Hyaluronic Acid with MSM is a pretty good supplement. I have fairly bad joints and quite a bit of arthritic pain. After taking it for about a week or so, I noticed my joints were cracking and popping less. This has been a pretty concern for me so I can not tell you how relieved I was when I started hearing less cracks an pops. I lift weights everyday and this supplement has helped with my soreness also. After heavy workout days, I like to take a bath in Epsom salts and I always make sure to take one of these also. It has transformed my leg day workouts so now I can push myself a lot harder and not be sore for almost a week to a week and a half. Incredible difference honestly.
One of the most important things for me when looking at potential new supplements is seeing if they cause an upset stomach. My stomach is very sensitive and I was most relieved when this one did not upset my stomach. This pill is easy to swallow, doesn't really have a taste, and is best taken with some food (I usually take it with my breakfast).
Side note, I have noticed my skin looking better and firmer in conjunction with being at the gym more. Always a nice benefit fighting wrinkles and aging from the inside, out. I also use Hyaluronic acid on my face topically for wrinkles.

Disclosure: I received this product for little or no cost in exchange for testing and an honest review. I am in no way required or influenced by the seller to leave a positive response. I stand by my review and do not give discounted products great reviews if I would not personally recommend them. I count on honest reviews as much as you do when making purchases.

title: Love all the extra brush heads
text:
My Son is in love with this toothbrush and I am in love with the fact that he is actually using it. This brush is very easy to set up and the base is not overly large so it makes it easy for me to find a place to sit it on my shelf. It has a red light that lets you know it is charging and on the base properly and its runs quietly. There is some noise but not enough to disturb the youngest child that always jumps up to investigate sounds. I like the fact that it comes with so many replacement heads there is no need to buy him another for a very long time. The only thing is making sure he doesn’t lose them. I like the round polishing brush heads for him verses the long heads because these seem to give him a better clean and can reach every tooth. It is nice that the brush heads come with different colors along the bottom so that if you wanted to you could use one base and switch heads for different users, it’s just that I prefer to keep it on base per user.
This product was purchased for free or at a discount in exchange for my honest review. The price of the product had no influence on how the final review was written. Things to affect my review:
1 did product look as expected? Yes
2. Will this work for my family? Yes
3. Was it worth the original purchase price? Yes
4. Will I buy it again? I might I have one more person in house needing a toothbrush but waiting on them to decide.
5. Is the product going to last the daily use from my family? Hasn’t broken on me yet and seems to hold up under daily use.
I often read the reviews of a product before I make a purchase so if like me you read this to make a decision I hope this review was able to help you in making a decision on your own purchase.

title: This item has a bad description title... Buyer Beware!
text: They are not "rechargeable" they have to be plugged in to work. I have had heated insoles before and they were expensive so when I saw these I thought "too good to be true" but why not try?!? My bad on not reading the description more carefully but calling these rechargeable is like saying the kitchen toaster is rechargeable....no it is not rechargeable, just because it is not totally cold the second you unplug it does not make it "rechargeable" it will be cold in a minute and so will these inserts. In the title it says "Winter hunting skiing fishing hiking". I "charged" them and by the time I walked from the bedroom to the kitchen (the kitchen is in the same small house, not in another town) not only were they no longer warm they felt cold. Maybe the author of the description goes fishing in a tank next to the computer indoors but most people take the item description to mean they will keep your feet warm while you hunt and fish etc. outdoors. I don't hike or ski. Do you guys carry USB battery packs or maybe a generator on the slopes? All of that being said I can put them in bedroom slippers and sit at the computer with them plugged into the computer and have warm feet but I won't be walking around with wires coming out of my shoes plugged into a battery in my pocket. I would not have purchased them had I known. If you want warm feet outside warming your shoes and socks with a blow dryer before you put them on would likely work as well.

title: Photosonix Vs Procyon
text:
I recently got a Nova Pro 100 and Procyon. This is based on my experience using both the devices. Please note, experience using these devices widely vary among users, so please use caution while deciding on purchasing any device.
Nova Pro 100 Pros
1) Really good built in sessions. Most of them worked for me very well.
2) Sound quality is really good, good depth. I use a Sony MDR V6 with this.
3) Color Track glasses are really good. May not be very bright for some people.
4) Option for 2 users.
5) Solid build, metal casing.
6) Amazing customer service. People at Photosonix are really helpful. They stand behind their product.
Nova Pro 100 Cons
1) Bulky, not very portable esp if you travel.
2) The frame of ColorTrack glass look fragile. I have to tuck it inside my headset to keep it in place.

Procyon Pros
1) Very portable, nicely built.
2) Glasses are really bright, more visualizations.

Procyon Cons
1) Built in sessions did not work for me very well. For e.g I used the sleep sessions and I was wide awake at the end of it. With Nova Pro 100, I was sleeping when the session ended. Had to remove headset and glasses in the middle of the night.
2) Sound doesn't have much depth. I used the same Sony MDR V6 with this one too.

Please note, I did not use the session editing software with any of these. After trying for weeks, I choose to keep the Nova Pro 100 as it is working really well for me.

title: Doesn't last long
text:
I used to love this scale, however, it is extremely flawed. First off, it is not very precise. Meaning, if I weigh myself once, I'll get one reading, then weigh myself again, I'll get another. ESPECIALLY with the body fat percentage. However, they body fat percentage isn't really expected to be extremely accurate. It is a simple bathroom scale.

My main and most important grievance with this is that I've had this scale for about a year and a half. For the first time, my batteries died. I finally changed them, only to be greeted with "Step on...Thinking...Err." which the scale is on a loop now (when I try to weigh myself). I removed batteries, reconnected, repeated, and nothing. I contacted fitbit support, and they offered no help. Once you're out of the 1 year window, there is nothing they can do/will do for you. I will NOT be buying this again, because I will not buy a $130 scale every year and a half. Get a simple scale($40) and input the information into an app yourself because this will go to crap in no time.

title: You’re stomach is not a styrofoam cup
text:
These reviews absolutely drive me insane. Everyone is so concerned with a fish oil’s ability to “burn through a styrofoam cup”, and in this case, the fact that it contains “unhealthy fillers”. There’s a reason doctors recommend this brand as opposed to ones that have absolutely no credibility, source from who knows where, and contain who knows what.

If this was pure fish oil without the additional ingredients, it would be absolutely disgusting to swallow. Luckily, it’s DELICIOUS and even amplifies flavors when added to meals. Yes, it contains sunflower oil, but not nearly enough to cause any worry. Another review expressed concerns about the omega 6 in sunflower oil, which again is insignificant to begin with, but considering omega-6 is found in nuts, meats, and some vegetable, you’d have a hard time avoiding it.

As for the burn-through-the-cup phenomenon everyone on Amazon obsessed over...do a quick google search and see that credible health sites, including Consumer Lab, blatantly state that this is a myth and should not be a concern when buying fish oils. Your stomach is not a styrofoam cup.

Now, the product itself...I’ve purchased and used MANY brands of fish oil, and I’m simply not turning back. The quality is obvious, as are the results, while minimal as all fish oils tend to be. This is the first fish oil I’ve used that actually had me noticing any semblance of results. In all honesty, you’re moreso buying this product based on the company’s regulation and history of producing a clean, effective product, and for the long-term health benefits that, unlike drugs, are not going to be immediately obvious.

I have not been paid to write any of this and am simply doing so out of frustration with the reviews on this product and fish oil supplements in general. Do research outside of amazon and make a decision for your self, however.

title: Excellent way to balance n-3:n-6 PUFA
text:
High quality fish oil. Because it's not in pill form you're forced to notice if it's rancid. Very cost effective too.

There's a lot of misconception out there regarding heart disease. Heart disease is primarily caused by oxidized LDL. You get oxidized LDL when your diet is low in stable medium chain triglycerides, and high in PUFA (poly unsaturated fatty acids, like omega3 and omega6). What's worse is when the PUFA is primarily omega 6, which causes inflammation in the body to increase and LDL to become small/dense which is more likely to oxidize.

You could have low total LDL, but have high oxLDL and still get heart disease. Conversely, you could have high total LDL but have low oxLDL and live to be 100. The cholesterol hypothesis is based on the work of Ancel Keys's 7 countries study in which he correlated *all* fat with heart disease in 7 countries. That's really it. And there were actually way more countries, but it didn't fit Keys's theory so he dropped him. No true scientist does this. For example, France and Nordic countries have low heart disease, but high fat intake (including saturated). Chile has low fat but high rates of heart disease.

Getting to a 1:1 omega 3 to omega 6 ratio is key to reducing inflammation and preventing chronic diseases. But too much PUFA including omega3 is also bad. I would recommend reducing your omega 6 intake (industrialized seed oils, vegetable oils) and supplement about a tablespoon of this stuff daily. Get your fats from medium chain triglycerides (cream, coconuts, lard). This is in conflict with public dietary advice, but not with the science.

To those trying to lower triglycerides, lower your fructose intake and improve insulin sensitivity through exercise. Fish oil isn't going to cure the effects of 36 oz soda/day.

So my doctor suggested I starting taking fish oil supplements as a means to help control and reduce my LDL levels. I'm not a big pill popper, so naturally I started to look for a liquid supplement. If you try to have this without a meal you will be subjected to an incredible amount of burps (fish burps is the technical term, I believe). No, I don’t know why just scrubbing hard with brushes, mops, rags or various cleaners don’t take this stuff off. These pads did and I’m stocking up on them.

Living in south Florida really bakes those bird droppings on. These pads will clean that up in a hurry.

title: All Natural with a Gentle Scent
text:
The Omstore 6 Large Bath Bomb set is a treat. What I love about these bath bombs is that they are made from 100% natural ingredients and organic oils and scents. Unlike one of the other reviewers, my bath bomb did fizz. My skin felt smooth and moisturized when I got out of the bath. The packaging is lovely. The six bath bombs come nestled in shredded paper and each bath bomb is labeled with both the scent and the feeling the scent is supposed to evoke.

Full Revive: Lavander Oil
Pure Relaxation: Jasmine with Ylang-Ylang Oils
Perfect Moistening: Cucumber Extract
Stress Reduction: Citrus Oil Blend with Peppermint Extract
Relax & Meditation: Rose Oil with Sandalwood
Smooth skin: Cocoa Butter with Glistering Honey

The two things that I did not absolutely love-
The scent was a bit weak. Maybe this is because there are no artificial scents in the bombs.
There was a bit of film on the tub after my bath. I assume that this film is from the oils used in the making of the bombs.

If my review was helpful to you, please let me know. I aim to give you the information that you need to make great Amazon choices. This product was provided at a discounted price or free in exchange for my honest review. As a dedicated Amazon shopper I personally trust in the Amazon reviewer’s collective judgement and rely on reviews to guide my shopping. My thoughts are my own and are not influenced by the seller or the fact that I may have received the product for free or at a discounted price for testing purposes.

title: Wow,it's actually awesome.
text:
My wife bought this for me as a surprise gift.(how I didn't notice she bought it on my Amazon purchases I'll never know).
I developed a vestibular disorder about 3 years ago, possibly meneres disease,and suffer from extremely thight neck and upper back muscles,and debilitating vestibular migraines and dizziness. I lost insurance, because I had to stop working,and thanks to the affordable healthcare act, a policy that was 400 bucks a month 4 years ago,is now 1100 a month,since I can't work, medical care isn't an option.
When the item arrived,I was sceptical,as most of these things are Chinese junk,and plain old stupid. This was an exception,what an awesome massage!!! It's powerful, like a real therapist is working the crap out of your neck and back muscles. The heat function is ok, feels good,but isn't very hot,but that's a limitation of the power supply and price point of the massager. I like how your able to move it to spicific areas and control the pressure with your arms. Make sure others know what is going on, because the sounds and grunts of pleasure you will make from the relief, might make someone think your with an actual therapist who is giving a happy ending. This thing is awesome, loosens up the back and neck providing much needed relief... I've had it for about 7 months,and use it several times a week,and besides a few plastic crackling sounds, it's working as good as the day it was new. It is a low Buck Chinese item, and I would expect it to probably break within the next two years, but at that price point I definitely got my money's worth.

Other responders did rip the oxygen port from the device when attempting to attach it to oxygen, however.

title: Unlocks the potential of the Procyon.
text:
Mind machines have been around for a long time. I bought my first one at Sharper Image in the early 90’s. The red LEDs within the early Ganzframes allowed me close my eyes to experience the Ganzfeld effect, providing just the right amount of neural noise to induce relaxation and/or trippy fractal-like sequences lasting up to an hour. But the LEDs were embedded in what appeared to be knockoff sunglasses frames, and I kept having to cobble everything back together with Sugru and duct tape when the lenses would snap at the nosepiece.

The Deepvision goggles are a different breed altogether. The whole apparatus is much sturdier than those early frames. LEDs are projected onto from a depth of about 2cm onto a translucent white lens, allowing wide range of pulsing colors with eyes wide open. Design-wise they look like mini VR goggles but for a much subtler non-VR effect.

The Procyon manual describes one of my favorite Ganzfeld sessions as “complex imagery, with an emphasis on Mandalas, vortexes, and spin-spaces.” I never quite vibed with neural noise of earlier Ganzframes that way. With the Deepvision goggles, everything seems to work as advertised.

I only wish that I hadn’t let go the old mind machine which was elegantly made from a milled chunk of anodized aluminum—about the size of a deck of cards— instead of the plastic used nowadays. Hopefully that design feature returns one day.
